text: Ang arrest warrant ginpagwa sang Municipal Trial Court sang Cagayan De Oro City.
english: The arrest warrant was issued by the Municipal Trial Court of Cagayan De Oro City.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang mga kapulisan si Yang samtang ginaproseso ang iya kaso.
english: Yang is currently in police custody while his case is being processed.

text: Wala pa sang pahayag halin sa kampo sang mga Yang angot sa isyu.
english: There has been no statement from the Yang camp on the issue.

text: Patigayunon alas syete subong nga aga, Abril 17, ang Misa sang Santo Crisma ukon Chrism Mass sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.
english: The Chrism Mass will be held at 7 am this morning, April 17, at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.

text: Ini ang pagbendisyon sang Santos Oleos kag pagpanibag-o sang panaad sang pagka-pari.
english: This is the blessing of the Holy Oils and the renewal of the vows of the priesthood.

text:
Ang principal celebrant ukon magapanguna sa sini nga okasyon amo si Jaro Archbishop Most Reverend Midyphil B. Billones, D.D.

Ang Chrism Mass nga ginapatigayon kadungan sang Holy Week ang isa ka importante nga liturgical event sa Catholic Church.
english:
The principal celebrant or presiding over the occasion will be Jaro Archbishop Most Reverend Midyphil B. Billones, D.D.

The Chrism Mass, which is held during Holy Week, is an important liturgical event in the Catholic Church.

text: Lakip sa liturhiya amo ang blessing of holy oils nga ginagamit sa sakramento sa bilog nga tuig amo man ang pag-renew sang panaad sang mga pari.
english: The liturgy includes the blessing of holy oils used in the sacrament throughout the year as well as the renewal of the vows of the priests.

text: Kadungan sini, nagpanawagan man ang Simbahang Katolika sa mga tumuluo nga ipangamuyo man ang mga pari kag abi-abihon ang “gift of priesthood.”
english: At the same time, the Catholic Church also called on the faithful to pray for priests and welcome the “gift of priesthood.”

text: Nagpaandam sang World War III ang reelected president sang Russia nga si Vladimir Putin kadungan sang iya victory speech matapos nabulsa ang panibag-o nga termino sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Russia's reelected president Vladimir Putin warned of World War III during his victory speech after pocketing a new term in the country.

text: Namensyonar sini ang amo kadaku nga gyera sang nahambalan ang conflict sa tunga sang Russia kag NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization ukon kilala man nga North Atlantic Alliance) — isa ka intergovernmental military alliance sang 32 member states kun sa diin 30 ang European kag duha ang North American.
english: It mentioned such a large-scale war when discussing the conflict between Russia and NATO (North Atlantic Treaty Organization or also known as the North Atlantic Alliance) — an intergovernmental military alliance of 32 member states of which 30 are European and two are North American.

text: Una na nga nagpaandam si Putin sang risgo sang nuclear war sa kaiping nga pungsod Ukraine (nga ila gin-atake paagi sa “special military operation” duha ka tuig na ang nakaligad) apang una man sini gin-athag nga wala pa siya sang nakit-an nga pagkinahanglan nga maggamit sang nuclear weapons sa amo nga pungsod.
english: Putin has previously warned of the risk of nuclear war with neighboring Ukraine (which they attacked with a “special military operation” two years ago) but has also previously made it clear that he has not yet seen the need to use nuclear weapons in that country.

text: Sang nagligad nga bulan, nagpahayag si French President Emmanuel Macron (Miyembro sang NATO) nga posible ang deployment sang ground troops sa Ukraine sa puturo.
english: Last month, French President Emmanuel Macron (NATO member) said that the deployment of ground troops in Ukraine is possible in the future.

text: Ini bangud apisar madamo nga Western countries ang nagadistansya sa amo nga isyu, madamo naman sa Eastern Europe ang bukas nga nagapabutyag sang ila suporta.
english: This is because although many Western countries are distancing themselves from the issue, many in Eastern Europe are openly expressing their support.

text:
Sang ginpamangkot naman si Putin kaangot sa sini nga pahayag ni Macron kag sa posibilidad sang conflict sa tunga sang Russia kag NATO, ang sabat sini: “𝘌𝘷𝘦𝘳𝘺𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘨 𝘪𝘴 𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘣𝘭𝘦 𝘪𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘮𝘰𝘥𝘦𝘳𝘯 𝘸𝘰𝘳𝘭𝘥.”

Diri na kag iya ginsal-ot ang World War III: “𝘐𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳 𝘵𝘰 𝘦𝘷𝘦𝘳𝘺𝘰𝘯𝘦, 𝘵𝘩𝘢𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘣𝘦 𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘦𝘱 𝘢𝘸𝘢𝘺 𝘧𝘳𝘰𝘮 𝘢 𝘧𝘶𝘭𝘭-𝘴𝘤𝘢𝘭𝘦 𝘞𝘰𝘳𝘭𝘥 𝘞𝘢𝘳 𝘛𝘩𝘳𝘦𝘦.
english:
When asked about Macron's statement and the possibility of conflict between Russia and NATO, Putin said: 𝘱𝘰𝘴𝘴𝘪𝘣𝘭𝘦 𝘪𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘦 𝘮𝘰𝘥𝘦𝘳𝘯 𝘸𝘰𝘳𝘭𝘭.”

This is where he inserted World War III: “𝘐𝘵 𝘪𝘴 𝘤𝘭𝘦𝘢𝘳 𝘵𝘰 𝘦𝘷𝘦𝘳𝘺𝘰𝘯𝘦, 𝟩𝘵 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴 𝘸𝘪𝘭𝘭 𝘣𝘦 𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘴𝘵𝘦𝘱 𝘢𝘸𝘢𝘺 𝘧𝘮𝘢 𝘧𝘶𝘭𝘭-𝘴𝘤𝘢𝘭𝘦 𝘞𝘰𝘳𝘭𝘥 𝘞𝘢𝘳 𝘛𝘩𝘳𝘦𝘦.

text:
𝘐 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘬 𝘩𝘢𝘳𝘥𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯𝘺𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘦𝘴𝘵𝘦𝘥 𝘪𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴.”

Ang pagbulsa ni Putin sang ikalima nga termino bilang Russian president paagi sa landslide nga 87% sa boto amo ang pinakadaku nga kadalag-an sa eleksyon sa post-Soviet history sang amo nga pungsod.
english:
𝘐 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘯𝘬 𝘩𝘢𝘳𝘥𝘭𝘺 𝘢𝘯𝘺𝘰𝘯𝘦 𝘪𝘴 𝘪𝘯𝘵𝘦𝘳𝘦𝘴𝘵𝘦𝘥 𝘪𝘯 𝘵𝘩𝘪𝘴.”

Putin’s pocketing of a fifth term as Russian president by a landslide of 87% in the vote was the biggest electoral victory in that country’s post-Soviet history.

text: Wala ini sang ginpangatubang nga daku nga opposition candidate bangud kontrolado sang Kremlin ang political system, media, kag elections.
english: It did not face a major opposition candidate because the Kremlin controls the political system, media, and elections.

text: Ang amo nga eleksyon ang ginpakamalaot man sang iban nga pungsod — gintawag ini sang Germany nga pseudo-election” samtang gintawag naman ini sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga “obviously not free nor fair”.
english: The election was also condemned by other countries — Germany called it a pseudo-election” while the United States of America called it “obviously not free nor fair”.

text: Ang mga nagpakita naman sang suporta sa Russia kag sa resulta sang eleksyon amo ang China, India, Iran, kag North Korea.#
english: China, India, Iran, and North Korea have expressed support for Russia and the election results.

text: Maga-implementar si US President Donald Trump sang 20% nga tariff rate sa mga produkto sang Pilipinas nga magasulod sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: US President Donald Trump will implement a 20% tariff rate on Philippine products entering the United States of America.

text: Sa sulat nga ginpadala ni Trump kay President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: In a letter Trump sent to President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: nga napetsahan sang Hulyo 9, 2025, ginsiling sini nga madugay na nga indi patas ang trade sa tunga sang US kag Pilipinas.
english: dated July 9, 2025, it said that trade between the US and the Philippines has long been unequal.

text: Bangud sini, himuon sini nga mas mahal ang buwis nga kinahanglan bayaran para sa mga ipasulod nga mga serbisyo kag mga produkto sang Pinoy sa Amerika.
english: As a result, it will make the taxes to be paid more expensive for the import of Filipino services and products into the United States.

text: Epektibo ang bag-o nga taripa umpisa sa Agusto 1.
english: The new tariff is effective from August 1.

text: Nalakip ang Pilipinas sa panibag-o nga round sang tariff letters nga gin-isyu ni Trump kun sa diin 30% sang taripa ang ginsukot sini sa Algeria, Iraq, Libya kag Sri Lanka kag 25% naman sa Brunei kag sa Moldova.
english: The Philippines is included in the new round of tariff letters issued by Trump where it has charged 30% of the tariffs to Algeria, Iraq, Libya and Sri Lanka and 25% to Brunei and Moldova.

text: Ang 20% nga ipatuman sa Pilipinas ang mas mataas sa 17% rate nga una gin-set sang Abril 2.
english: The 20% to be implemented in the Philippines is higher than the 17% rate initially set on April 2.

text: Matandaan nga sa una nga desisyon ni Trump, gin-suspende anay ang tariff rates nga ginsukot kag ginhimo lamang nga 10% tubtub sang Hulyo 9 agud nga mahatagan sang tyempo ang mga pungsod nga mag-negosyar.
english: It can be recalled that in Trump's initial decision, the tariff rates were suspended and reduced to 10% until July 9 to give countries time to negotiate.

text: Matandaan nga una na nagsulat si Trump sa South Korea kag Japan nga naga-impose sang 25% nga taripa sa mga produkto sang amo nga mga nasyon.#
english: Trump has already written to South Korea and Japan imposing 25% tariffs on products from those countries.

text: Madugay na nga may mga reklamo batok sa kontrobersyal nga principal sa Laua-an, Antique.
english: There have long been complaints against the controversial principal in Laua-an, Antique.

text: Ang principal amo si Venus Divinia Nietes nga nangin sentro sang eskandalo matapos ginpauba sa mga estudyante ang toga sa ila End-of-School-Year (EOSY) rites sang Abril 15 sa Col.
english: The principal is Venus Divinia Nietes who became the center of the scandal after students were asked to take off their togas during their End-of-School-Year (EOSY) rites on April 15 at Col.

text: Ruperto Abellon National School (CRANS) sa Laua-an, Antique.
english: Ruperto Abellon National School (CRANS) in Laua-an, Antique.

text: Sang Septyembre 2023, sang siya ang principal sang Laua-an National High School, masobra 500 nga mga estudyante kag kapin 20 ka mga manunudlo ang nagpatigayon sang hublag-protesta sa atubang mismo sang agud ipabutyag ang ila disgusto sa pagdumala ni Nietes bangud sa ginaalegar pagpang-bully, pagpamahog kag pag-abuso sa iya posisyon.
english: In September 2023, when he was the principal of Laua-an National High School, more than 500 students and more than 20 teachers staged a protest rally right in front of the to express their displeasure with Nietes’ management over alleged bullying, intimidation and abuse in his position.

text: Matandaan nga mismo si Laua-an, Antique Mayor Aser Baladjay ang nagpanawagan sa Department of Education nga pangitaan na sang paagi agud nga ma-transfer ang kontrobersyal nga si Nietes.
english: It can be recalled that Laua-an, Antique Mayor Aser Baladjay himself called on the Department of Education to find a way to transfer the controversial Nietes.

text: Suno pa kay Baladjay, antes gin-assign sa iya banwa si Nietes, nangin magamo man ang sitwasyon sa duha ka mga eskwelahan nga ginhalinan sang principal.
english: Baladjay said that before Nietes was assigned to his town, the situation in the two schools where the principal came from was chaotic.

text: Sa Culasi kag sa Tobias Fornier, ginkasuhan man si Nietes kag may petition nga pahalinon nagikan sa mga ginikanan kag mga manunudlo.
english: In Culasi and Tobias Fornier, Nietes was also charged and there was a petition to expel him from parents and teachers.

text: Dugang niya, daw kaangay nga wala na man sang local government unit nga handa nga magbaton kay Nietes bangud sa iya batasan.
english: He added that it seems that no local government unit is ready to accept Nietes because of his behavior.

text: Maga-import ang Pilipinas sang halos tunga sa milyon ka metriko tonelada sang refined sugar subong nga tuig.
english: The Philippines will import nearly half a million metric tons of refined sugar this year.

text: Sa Sugar Order No.
english: In Sugar Order No.

text: 08, series of 2024-2025 sang Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA), gintugutan ang pagpasulod sang 424,000 MT sang imported refined sugar nga maga-abot sa Pilipinas halin sa Hulyo 15, 2025 tubtub sa Nobyembre 30, 2025.
english: 08, series of 2024-2025 of the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA), allowed the entry of 424,000 MT of imported refined sugar that will arrive in the Philippines from July 15, 2025 to November 30, 2025.

text: Pahayag sang ahensya, ini nga sugar import program ang nagatuyo nga mapadayon ang “sufficient actual supply” sang kalamay para sa domestic consumption kag buffer stock.
english: The agency said the sugar import program aims to maintain sufficient actual supply of sugar for domestic consumption and buffer stock.

text: Ang importers nga pahanugutan nga magpasulod sang required refined sugar volume amo lamang ang licensed international sugar traders nga may “good standing” amo man ang nakapartisipar anay sa sugar importation calls sang gobyerno kag ang nakapasakop man sa export sang raw sugar sa US agud malab-ot ang tariff rate quota.
english: Importers who will be allowed to import the required refined sugar volume are only licensed international sugar traders who have “good standing” as well as those who have previously participated in the government's sugar importation calls and those who have also participated in the export of raw sugar to the US to meet the tariff rate quota.

text: Suno pa sa ahensya, ang imported refined sugar sa idalom sang latest order ang iga-classify nga “reserve” nga subject sa “future disposition or reclassification” nga pagatumuron sang SRA.
english: According to the agency, imported refined sugar under the latest order will be classified as “reserve” subject to “future disposition or reclassification” to be directed by the SRA.

text: “Imported sugar classified under this SO shall only be stored in an SRA-registered warehouse or directly to the consumer’s warehouse as indicated in the importer’s application,” base pa sa nakasaad sa order sang sugar agency.
english: “Imported sugar classified under this SO shall only be stored in an SRA-registered warehouse or directly to the consumer’s warehouse as indicated in the importer’s application,” the sugar agency said in its order.

text: “However, the declared consumer’s warehouses must be pre-inspected to avoid co-mingling of imported sugar stocks and domestic sugar stocks,” dugang sini.
english: “However, the declared consumer’s warehouses must be pre-inspected to avoid co-mingling of imported sugar stocks and domestic sugar stocks,” it added.

text: Una na nga gin-report sang SRA nga ang sugar production sa crop year 2024 to 2025, as of June 8, 2025, ang nagalab-ot sa 2.015 million MT.
english: Earlier, the SRA reported that sugar production in the crop year 2024 to 2025, as of June 8, 2025, is 2.015 million MT.

text: Mas mataas ini sang 4.7% halin sa 1.92 million MT sang crop year 2023-2024.
english: This is up 4.7% from 1.92 million MT in crop year 2023-2024.

text: Wala gihapon nagtawhay ang sitwasyon sang ginabanta 11-million ka mga residente sa Haiti apisar pa nga nag-anunsyo na si Prime Minister Ariel Henry nga maga-resign ini sa posisyon sa tunga sang pagpangggamo sang dalagku nga mga gang.
english: The situation of Haiti's estimated 11-million residents remains tense despite Prime Minister Ariel Henry's announcement that he will resign from office amid gang violence.

text: Kun balikan, nagkadto ang prime minister sa Kenya agud nga planuhan ang pagpadala sang multinational security force sa Haiti; apang bilang balos, nagdeklarar ang anay pulis kag subong gang leader nga si Jimmy Chérizier alias “Barbecue” nga magapatigayon sila sang coordinated attack agud kakason si Henry kag ang iya mga kaupdanan sa gobyerno.
english: To recall, the prime minister went to Kenya to plan the deployment of a multinational security force to Haiti; but in return, former policeman and current gang leader Jimmy Chérizier alias “Barbecue” declared that they would conduct a coordinated attack to remove Henry and his colleagues from the government.

text: Kasunod sini, natabo ang pagsulong sa National Penitentiary sa kapital sang pungsod nga Port-au-Prince kun sa diin ginpaguwa ang ginabanta 3,700 ka mga preso kag 12 naman ang nagkalamatay.
english: This was followed by an attack on the National Penitentiary in the country's capital Port-au-Prince where an estimated 3,700 inmates were released and 12 were killed.

text: Lakip sa ginpaguwa amo ang mga gang members nga suspek sa pagpatay kay anay President Jovenel Moïse sang 2021.
english: Among those released were gang members suspected in the 2021 assassination of former President Jovenel Moïse.

text: Sunod nga nag-deklarar ang Haiti sang state of emergency kag nag-anunsyo ang prime minister sang iya nga resignation.
english: Haiti subsequently declared a state of emergency and the prime minister announced his resignation.

text: Apisar sini, may natabo gihapon nga shootout sa kaiping nga lugar kag gin-atake man mangin ang police academy sang Huwebes.
english: Despite this, there was still a shootout in the neighboring area and the police academy was also attacked on Thursday.

text: Nasunog man ang National Prison pati ang balay sang hepe sang national police.
english: The National Prison and the house of the national police chief were also burned down.

text: Sunod nga nagpaandam ang gang leader sa mga opisyal nga nagaplano nga mag-intra sa transition council sang gobyerno.
english: The gang leader next warned officials planning to join the government’s transition council.

text: Ginpangtawag niya ini nga mga “wala sang huya”, kag nagpaandam man nga pangdalahigon pati ang ila pamilya.
english: He called them “shameless”, and warned that their families would be raped.

text: Nahibaluan nga may mga political parties na subong kag iban pa nga sektor nga ginplastar agud nga makumpleto ang nine-member transition council nga amo ang magabulos sa anay prime minister.
english: It is known that there are now political parties and other sectors that have been put in place to complete the nine-member transition council that will replace the former prime minister.

text: Ang nagpatunga sa negosasyon amo ang Caribbean leaders kag si US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, apang wala pa sang ginsapubliko nga formal appointments.
english: The negotiations were mediated by Caribbean leaders and US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, but no formal appointments have been made public.

text: Bangud wala pa sang kasiguruhan ang dalagan sang pulitika kag wala man sang sigurado kun madayon ang pag-abot sang security mission halin sa iban nga mga pungsod, nabutang man sa alang-alang ang seguridad sang mga residente kag pati sang mga embahada.
english: Due to the uncertainty of the political situation and the uncertainty of the arrival of security missions from other countries, the security of residents and embassies is also at risk.

text: Mangin ang United Nations, Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag ang Canada ang nagbuhin na sang ila nga mga staff sa embahada.
english: Even the United Nations, the United States of America and Canada have reduced their embassy staff.

text: Ang Britanya ang nagpabaskog man sang ila nga seguridad sa ila teritoryo sa Turks kag Caicos Islands.
english: Britain has also strengthened its security in its territory in the Turks and Caicos Islands.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang Dominican Republic nga may teritoryo man sa Hispanolia nga teritoryo man sang Haiti ang nagsirado na sang ila nga border kag regular nga naga-deport sang Haitians.
english: On the other hand, the Dominican Republic, which also has territory in Hispanolia, which is also Haitian territory, has already closed its border and regularly deports Haitians.

text: Si U.S. state of Florida Governor Ron DeSantis ang nagpadala man sang 250 ka dugang nga mga opisyal kag mga soldado kag dinosena nga mga air kag sea vessels sa southern coast agud maprotektahan ang ila nga teritoryo.
english: U.S. state of Florida Governor Ron DeSantis also sent 250 additional officers and soldiers and dozens of air and sea vessels to the southern coast to protect their territory.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang prime minister sang pungsod ang wala na-eleher kundi na-appoint lamang halin sang ginpatay sang gang ang ila anay presidente sang 2021.
english: It is known that the country’s prime minister has not been elected but only appointed since the gang killed their former president in 2021.

text: Halin man sang amo nga tuig, halos 3,000 na sa 15,000 ka mga pulis sa amo nga pungsod ang nagbiya sa ila nga mga posisyon — kun sa diin, bangud wala man sang presidente ukon na-eleher nga national officials, ang mga gang amo ang nagakontrol sa daku nga bahin sang kapital nga Port-au-Prince.
english: Since that year, nearly 3,000 of the country's 15,000 police officers have resigned — where, with no president or elected national officials, gangs control much of the capital, Port-au-Prince.

text:
Magluwas sa lapnagon nga civil kag political unrest, nabutang man sa alang-alang ang public health system kag ang ekonomiya sang amo nga pungsod.#

[Luckenson Jean/AFPTV via AFP]
english:
In addition to widespread civil and political unrest, the country's public health system and economy have also been threatened.

[Luckenson Jean/AFPTV via AFP]

text: Masobra isa ka siglo na ang nagligad halin sang natabo ang Titanic tragedy kun sa diin masobra 1,500 ang napatay kag yara lamang sa 700 ang nakaluwas.
english: More than a century has passed since the Titanic tragedy in which more than 1,500 people died and only 700 survived.

text: Sa pihak sini, halos tanan ilabi na ang researchers kag historians ang nagabalik-balik sa sini nga istorya nga daw kaangay nga daw yara gid sila nagakabuhi sang tuig 1912.
english: Despite this, almost everyone, especially researchers and historians, come back to this story as if they were living in 1912.

text: Sa Australia, may yara sang isa ka bilyonaryo nga nag-anunsyo nga buhion sini ang iya handum nga makatukod sang replica sang Titanic kag natalana man ini nga maglayag sa kaangay nga ruta sang iconic nga barko sa Hunyo 2027.
english: In Australia, there is a billionaire who has announced that he will revive his dream of building a replica of the Titanic and is also set to sail a similar route of the iconic ship in June 2027.

text: Una nga naanunsyo sang 69-anyos nga billionaire nga si Clive Palmer ang iya plano sang 2012 apang wala ini nadayon.
english: Sixty-nine-year-old billionaire Clive Palmer first announced his plan in 2012 but it fell through.

text: Ginlunsar ini liwat sang 2018 kag malayag na kuntani sang 2022 apang na-delay liwat bangud sa COVID-19 pandemic.
english: It was relaunched in 2018 and was supposed to sail in 2022 but was delayed again due to the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ini nga replica ang magabug-at sang 56,000 tonelada kag may siyam ka mga deck.
english: This replica will weigh 56,000 tons and have nine decks.

text: May kabug-usan man ini nga 835 cabins nga sarang maka-akomodar sang 2,435 ka mga pasahero.
english: It also has a total of 835 cabins that can accommodate 2,435 passengers.

text: Halos katunga naman sini ang itigana para sa first class passengers.
english: Almost half of it will be reserved for first class passengers.

text: Kaangay sa naglugdang nga barko, lakip man sa layout sini ang ballroom, ang bridge, ang swimming pool, kag ang Turkish baths.
english: Like the shipwreck, its layout includes a ballroom, a bridge, a swimming pool, and Turkish baths.

text: Pahayag pa sang bilyonaryo, i-hire niya ang pinakamaayo nga ship-builders, designers, kag engineers sa bilog nga kalibutan agud nga mahuman ang Titanic ll.
english: The billionaire said he will hire the best ship-builders, designers, and engineers in the world to build the Titanic ll.

text: Plano ni Palmer nga masuguran ang construction sa 2025 kag magalayag na sa Hunyo 2027 halin sa Southampton, England padulong sa New York nga amo man ang ruta sang original nga Titanic sang 1912.
english: Palmer plans to start construction in 2025 and sail in June 2027 from Southampton, England to New York which is the same route as the original Titanic in 1912.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang original nga Titanic ang naglugdang sadtong Abril 1912 matapos nga nakabunggo sa iceberg.
english: The original Titanic sank in April 1912 after hitting an iceberg.

text: Ini nga trahedya amo ang inspirasyon sa 1997 hit romantic film ni James Cameron kun sa diin bida sanday Leonardo DiCaprio kag Kate Winslet kag nakadaog sang 11 ka Oscars lakip na si Kate nga amo ang Best Actress.
english: The tragedy was the inspiration for James Cameron's 1997 hit romantic film starring Leonardo DiCaprio and Kate Winslet and won 11 Oscars including Best Actress.

text: Gintawag sang People’s Republic of China nga isa ka akto sang “pagpang-bully” ang ginaduso nga i-ban ang bantog nga Chinese-owned application nga TikTok sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The People’s Republic of China has called the proposed ban on the popular Chinese-owned application TikTok in the United States of America an act of “bullying”.

text: Ginpahayag ini sang Chinese foreign ministry kasunod sa pagbinotohay sang US House of Representatives nga amo ang maga-pwersa sa tag-iya sang TikTok nga ByteDance nga ibaligya ang short video app sa American company — ukon i-ban ini sa US kun sa diin may masobra 170 million users.
english: The Chinese foreign ministry made the announcement following a vote by the US House of Representatives that will force TikTok owner ByteDance to sell the short video app to the American company — or ban it in the US where it has more than 170 million users.

text: Apisar pasado ini sa House paagi sa bipartisan vote, kinahanglan pa nga mag-agi ini sa Senate kag kinahanglan nga mapirmahan sang presidente agud mangin isa na ka layi.
english: Although it passed the House by a bipartisan vote, it still needs to pass the Senate and be signed by the president to become law.

text: Suno kay Wang Wenbin nga amo ang spokesperson sang Chinese ministry, wala man sang nakit-an ang US nga ebidensya nga may dala ang TikTok nga pamahog sa ila nga national security apang wala gihapon ini nagauntat.
english: According to Wang Wenbin, spokesperson for the Chinese ministry, the US has not found any evidence that TikTok poses a threat to its national security but it still does not stop.

text: Gin-akusaran man sini ang US nga “nagapang-bully na lang” kun indi ini makasarang sa patas nga kumpetisyon.
english: He also accused the US of “bullying” if it cannot afford fair competition.

text: Nagpaandam man ang opisyal nga maga-backfire sa Amerika ang amo nga akto bangud ma-disrupt sini ang market operations, matiphag ang investor confidence kag masabotahe ang global economic order.
english: The official also warned that the act would backfire on the United States because it would disrupt market operations, undermine investor confidence and sabotage the global economic order.

text: “This kind of bullying behaviour that cannot win in fair competition disrupts companies’ normal business activity, damages the confidence of international investors in the investment environment, and damages the normal international economic and trade order,” suno kay Wang.
english: “This kind of bullying behavior that cannot win in fair competition disrupts companies’ normal business activity, damages the confidence of international investors in the investment environment, and damages the normal international economic and trade order,” according to Wang.

text: Una na nga ginsiling sang US officials kag lawmakers nga nalakip sa ila ginakahangaw-an nga matabo amo nga basi kun pwersahon sang Chinese government ang tag-iya sang TikTok nga ihatag ang tanan nga ila nakolekta nga data halin sa users sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Earlier, US officials and lawmakers said that among their concerns is that the Chinese government might force the owner of TikTok to hand over all the data they have collected from users in the United States of America.

text: Ginakahangaw-an man nga ang Chinese app ang gamiton sang Beijing agud magpalapta sang propaganda kag misinformation ukon magbilin sang malain nga impluwensya sa Americans.
english: There are also concerns that the Chinese app will be used by Beijing to spread propaganda and misinformation or leave a bad influence on Americans.

text: Una naman nga ginklaro sang TikTok nga wala ini sang kaangtanan sa Chinese government.
english: TikTok has previously clarified that it has nothing to do with the Chinese government.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga gin-restructure nila ang kumpaniya agud mapabilin gid lamang sa US ang data nga nakuha gikan sa amo nga pungsod.#
english: He also said that they have restructured the company to keep the data obtained from that country only in the US.

text: Hindi pangkaraniwan ang makitang magkakasama sa isang hapag ang mga apelyidong Romualdez, Benitez, Poe, at Recto ngunit sa Kamara ng mga Kinatawan, nagsama-sama ang susunod na henerasyon ng mga kilalang pamilyang ito upang pag-usapan ang mga patakaran at adbokasiyang nais nilang isulong sa susunod na tatlong taon.

english: On Monday, the two were spotted laughing together before the start of one of the training sessions for the newly elected and returning legislators of the 20th Congress.

text: Ginaabisohan sang Iloilo Provincial Health Office ang mga deboto nga magapartisipar sa pagtaltal ukon magpaidalom sa physical penance nga gilayon ipa-check sa healthcare workers ang mga pilas agud malikawan ang bacterial kag tetanus infection.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Health Office advises devotees who will participate in physical penance to immediately have their wounds checked by healthcare workers to avoid bacterial and tetanus infection.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Maria Socorro Quiñon, Head sang Provincial Health Office, iya ginpahayag nga indi man mahimo nga punggan ang mga tawo nga luyag magpenitensya bangud kabahin na ini sang ila nga tradisyon kada Semana Santa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Maria Socorro Quiñon, Head of the Provincial Health Office, said that people who want to do penance cannot be stopped because it is part of their tradition every Easter.

text: Magluwas sa mga nagapartisipar sa pagtaltal, may iban naman nga nagabisita sa mga pilgrims.
english: In addition to those who participate in the ceremony, there are others who visit the pilgrims.

text: Dugang pa ni Quiñon, nagakadapat man nga magbalon sang bastante nga tubig ang publiko ilabi na nga tuman ang init.
english: Quiñon added that the public should also pack enough water especially in the heat.

text: Ang mga katigulangan nga may hypertension ang kinahanglan nga mag-inom sang maintenance nga bulong.
english: The elderly with hypertension will need to take maintenance medication.

text: Sa mga nagasaka sa bukid, mas maayo pahayag niya nga maghatag sang pila ka minuto sa pagpasilong ukon pagkadto sa mahandong nga lugar.
english: For those climbing the mountain, he said it is better to take a few minutes to take shelter or go to a shady place.

text: Panugyan sini, indi anay mag-inom sang mga kape kag softdrinks bangud nagatuga pa gid ini sang dehydration.
english: He advised people not to drink coffee and softdrinks because they cause dehydration.

text: Sa iban nga maga-upod sa mga religious activities kaangay sa mga prusisyon, magsuksok sang komportable nga bayo, magbitbit sang payong agud indi matam-an sang init.
english: For others who will participate in religious activities such as processions, wear comfortable clothes, carry an umbrella to avoid the heat.

text: Mas maayo man suno kay Dr. Quiñon nga magdala na lang sang mga pagkaon nga ginluto sa tagsa ka mga panimalay agud malikawan ang food borne diseases.
english: It is better, according to Dr. Quiñon urged the public to bring cooked foods to their homes to prevent food borne diseases.

text: Nagapangabay ang natungdan nga mapabilin nga hilway, malinong kag safe ang Semana Santa.
english: He called for a free, peaceful and safe Easter.

text: Sa Iloilo Province, pila ka mga destinasyon kag popular nga mga pilgrims amo ang Bucari sa Leon; Agony Hill sa Alimodian, Garin Farm Pilgrimage Resort sa San Joaquin, kag “Ang Pagtaltal” sa Barotac Viejo.
english: In Iloilo Province, some destinations and popular pilgrims are Bucari in Leon; Agony Hill in Alimodian, Garin Farm Pilgrimage Resort in San Joaquin, and “The Pagtaltal” in Barotac Viejo.

text: WALA sing survey, ukon pagpanalawsaw, nga himo sang tawo parti sa iya panghuna-huna kag desisyon, nga maka-predict sing lubos kon ano ini tubtub ipatuman na niya ini.
english: NO survey, or research, done by man about his thoughts and decisions, can fully predict what they will be until he implements them.

text: Kag ina bisan ginpatigayon pa ini sa isa ka scientific nga paagi.
english: And that's even if it's done in a scientific way.

text: Daku nga rason diri ang mabudlay nga pagkuha sang madamo nga random sample respondent para mangin “representative” gid sang kabug-usan, given ang kinahanglan nga budget kag ang kadamuon sang sectoral groups.
english: A big reason for this is the difficulty of getting a large enough random sample of respondents to be truly “representative” of the whole, given the budget required and the number of sectoral groups.

text: Ang ideal nga kadamuon sang isa ka political survey sunu sa bantugon nga Gallup Polls amo ang 10% sang populasyon nga tuyu kuhaan sing prediction.
english: The ideal size of a political survey according to the famous Gallup Polls is 10% of the population from which the prediction is intended.

text: Mga 11 ka milyon ini sang mga Filipino.
english: This is about 11 million Filipinos.

text: Sa masami diri sa Filipinas, ginakuha na gid lang ang pila ka libu  nga sample respondents, mga 2,000 lang, kag liwat-liwaton ang survey sa pareho nga lugar ukon demographic group, katulad sang 100 times tubtub maangkon ang isa ka consistent nga resulta.
english: Usually here in the Philippines, only a few thousand sample respondents, about 2,000, are taken and the survey is repeated in the same area or demographic group, such as 100 times until a consistent result is obtained.

text: Tungod sini, ang prediction kon kis-a husto, kon kis-a sala, nga tungod sini madamo ang wala nagapati sini.
english: Because of this, the prediction is sometimes right, sometimes wrong, which is why many people do not believe it.

text: Although kon ano man ang resulta makabulig ini sa pagpamuklat sa mga isyu nga luyag sang mga botante tagaan importansya, nga importante man sa mga kandidato samtang sige ang kampanya.
english: Although whatever the outcome, it will help shed light on the issues that voters want to be given importance, which is also important to the candidates as the campaign continues.

text: In fact, experyensya ini mismo sang Gallup Polls sa survey sini sa pag-predict kon sin-o ang madaug nga Presidente sa Estados Unidos.
english: In fact, this is the experience of Gallup Polls in its survey to predict who will win the President of the United States.

text: Hambalon pa, wala ma-predict sini kon sin-o ang nagdaug nga kandidato sa pagka-Presidente sa eleksyon sadtong 1948, 1976, 2004, 2012 kag 2016.
english: In other words, it did not predict who would win the presidential elections in 1948, 1976, 2004, 2012 and 2016.

text: Sa wala na-predict sang Gallup Polls nga nagdalaug sa presidential election, pinasahe ang kaso ni Harry Truman (D) batok kay Thomas Dewey (R) sadtong eleksyon sang 1948.
english: In the absence of Gallup Polls predicting the winner of the presidential election, the case of Harry Truman (D) against Thomas Dewey (R) in the 1948 election was passed.

text: Sa walo (8) ka monthly survey halin sang Pebrero tubtub Oktubre, isa ka bulan bag-o ang eleksyon, wala gid maka-abanse si Truman.
english: In eight (8) monthly surveys from February to October, a month before the election, Truman never advanced.

text: Pirme siya wigit sa survey sang indi magkulang sa 10% nga abanse (average) ni Dewey.
english: He was always wigit in the poll by at least 10% ahead (average) of Dewey.

text: Apang sa adlaw na sang eleksyon sang masunod nga bulan sang Nobyembre, si Truman ang gindeklarar nga nagdaug.
english: But on election day the following November, Truman was declared the winner.

text:
***

Tungod sining experyensya sang Gallup Polls, indi imposible nga magsayop ang Pulse Asia sa Election 2022 diri sa Filipinas nga sang nagliligad nga binulan nag-predict sang padayon nga pag-abanse sing daku ni Marcos Jr., samtang naga-abanse man si VP Leni sa survey sang CEAP, Veritas Truth Survey kag latest OCTA Research.
english:
***

Given this experience of Gallup Polls, it is not impossible for Pulse Asia to be wrong in Election 2022 here in the Philippines which last month predicted a continued lead of Marcos Jr., while VP Leni is also leading in the survey of CEAP, Veritas Truth Survey and late OCTA Research.

text: Gin-aku sang Pulse Asia nga wala nila nalakip sa survey ang Class A kag B nga respondents.
english: Pulse Asia admitted that they did not include Class A and B respondents in the survey.

text: Lakip diri ang mga manggaranon kag may ikasarang sa pangabuhi nga mga professional.
english: This includes wealthy and well-to-do professionals.

text: Importante ini nga mga grupo tungod, samtang indi gid man sila madamo, mga “influencers” ini sila sa madamo tungod sang ila respetado nga tindug sa sosyedad kag bilang dalangpan sang bulig sang mga kasilingan.
english: These groups are important because, while they are not many, they are “influencers” to many because of their respected position in society and as a refuge for help from neighbors.

text: Tungod sini, upod ang mga “more credible” endorsers, pwede ini sila matagaan sing “weighted score” bilang separado nga grupo sa survey, nga maka-impluwensya bisan sang panghuna-huna sang iban.
english: Therefore, along with the “more credible” endorsers, they can be given a “weighted score” as a separate group in the survey, which can even influence the thinking of others.

text: Diri sa mga “influencers” kag “more credible endorsers”, no doubt, pinakabakud si VP Leni ikumparar sa iban nga kandidato sa pagka-Presidente.
english: Among the “influencers” and “more credible endorsers”, no doubt, VP Leni is the strongest compared to other presidential candidates.

text: May 160 ka ekonomista nga nag-endorso sang iya kandidatura.
english: There were 160 economists who endorsed his candidacy.

text: Yara man ang 150 ka law professors upod si retired Supreme Court Chief Justice Hilario Davide, grupo sang health frontliners, teachers’ groups, retired AFP chiefs of Staff, halos tanan nga anay cabinet officials nanday Presidente Ramos kag Arroyo, leading celebrities sa entertainment world, kag iban pa halin sa academe, entertainment world, health workers, business, kag bisan foreign investors.
english: Also present were 150 law professors including retired Supreme Court Chief Justice Hilario Davide, groups of health frontliners, teachers’ groups, retired AFP chiefs of staff, almost all former cabinet officials of Presidents Ramos and Arroyo, leading celebrities in the entertainment world, and others from academia, entertainment world, even foreign health workers, businesses, businesses investors.

text: In fact, madamo nga mga sektor sang mga kubos kag “disadvantaged”ang nag-endorso kay VP Leni, lakip ang mga “influential” nga labor groups (moderate kag militant) nga segurado naton wala natagaan sing bulag nga pagtalupangod sang Pulse Asia.
english: In fact, many sectors of the poor and “disadvantaged” endorsed VP Leni, including the “influential” labor groups (moderate and militant) that we are sure were not given blind attention by Pulse Asia.

text: Gin-ako man sang Pulse Asia nga samtang madamo ang  nagpahayag sang ila preference kay Marcos Jr., ginsiling man nila nga luyag nila ang kandidato nga  “…has the greatest concern for the poor, most honest and trustworthy, and least corrupt”.
english: Pulse Asia also acknowledged that while many expressed their preference for Marcos Jr., they also said they wanted a candidate who “…has the greatest concern for the poor, most honest and trustworthy, and least corrupt”.

text: Ini nga “inconsistencies” gapahangop lang nga wala sila kahibalo kon ano gid ang pagkatawo ni Marcos Jr.
english: These “inconsistencies” only mean that they do not know what Marcos Jr. really is.

text: Tungod sini, kinahanglan gid sang grupo ni  VP Leni – nga limpyo ang pagkatawo, wala bahid sing corruption,  may excellent service track record, kag programa – kag sang iban nga opposition candidates nga mahublasan si Marcos Jr.
english: Because of this, VP Leni's group – which is clean in character, free from corruption, has an excellent service track record, and program – and other opposition candidates need to expose Marcos Jr.

text: sa nabilin pa nga sobra isa ka bulan nga pang-kampanya.

english: The Philippines defeated Indonesia in straight sets, 25-17, 25-17, 28-16, to secure the podium finish.

english: Before that, Alas lost to Thailand and Vietnam, which prevented them from reaching the finals.

english: Angel Canino, Dell Palomata, and Bella Belen also made huge contributions that were key to the team winning medals.

text: Isa ka ahente sang Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) sang Estados Unidos ang nagtiro- patay sa 37-anyos nga babayi bangud sa pagtuyo sini nga palagyuhang ang checkpoint sa Minneapolis.
english: A US Immigration and Customs Enforcement (ICE) agent shot and killed a 37-year-old woman for trying to escape a checkpoint in Minneapolis.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa tunga sang hugot nga kampanya sang administrasyon ni President Donald trump batok sa mga immigrante sa nagakalain-lain nga bahin sang pungsod.
english: The incident occurred amid the intense campaign of President Donald Trump's administration against immigrants in various parts of the country.

text: Suno sa Department of Homeland Security, nagpalupok ang ahente matapos nga gintuyo sang babayi nga bungguan ang opisyal sang dala sini nga salakyan.
english: According to the Department of Homeland Security, the agent opened fire after the woman tried to hit the officer with her vehicle.

text: Suno pa sa alcalde sang syudad kag hepe sang pulisya nga indi pa klaro ang una nga imbestigasyon sa pagtuyo sang biktima sa pag-ipit sa opisyal.
english: The city mayor and police chief said the initial investigation into the victim's attempt to pressure the officer is not yet clear.

text: Ginkumpirma sang opisyal nga ang babayi isa ka American kag indi target sang operasyon sa imigrasyon.
english: The official confirmed the woman was American and not a target of the immigration operation.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sa insidente nga liwat nagpukaw sang pagkamalaot batok sa indi manami nga pagpatuman sang layi sang imigrasyon sa Estados Unidos.
english: The incident, which once again sparked outrage against the poor enforcement of immigration laws in the United States, is still under investigation.

text: Pinaigting ng Department of Energy (DOE) ang pagsusuri sa kalagayan ng suplay ng kuryente sa mga isla at off-grid na lugar sa bansa, bilang pagtugon sa direktiba ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The Department of Energy (DOE) has stepped up monitoring of the state of electricity supply in the islands and off-grid areas of the country, in response to the directive of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: na tiyaking pantay-pantay at abot-kayang access sa kuryente para sa lahat ng Pilipino.
english: that ensures equal and affordable access to electricity for all Filipinos.

text: Kamakailan ay nagsagawa ng assessment ang DOE sa Camotes Island, Cebu, matapos makatanggap ng ulat ukol sa madalas na brownout sa lugar.
english: The DOE recently conducted an assessment in Camotes Island, Cebu, after receiving reports of frequent brownouts in the area.

text: Ayon kay DOE Assistant Secretary Mario Marasigan, kahalintulad ito ng naging problema sa Siquijor, kulang ang kapasidad sa power generation at distribution.
english: According to DOE Assistant Secretary Mario Marasigan, this is similar to the problem in Siquijor, lack of capacity in power generation and distribution.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, sinusuplayan ng Camotes Island Power Generation Corporation (CAMPCOR) ang isla gamit ang diesel generators.
english: Currently, Camotes Island Power Generation Corporation (CAMPCOR) supplies the island with diesel generators.

text: Subalit, hindi sapat ang single-phase distribution system ng Camotes Electric Cooperative, Inc.
english: However, the single-phase distribution system of Camotes Electric Cooperative, Inc. is not enough.

text: (CELCO), na nagdudulot ng madalas na aberya sa suplay ng kuryente.
english: (CELCO), which causes frequent breakdowns in the power supply.

text: Pinalala pa ito ng mga pagkaantala sa paghahatid ng diesel fuel lalo na sa panahon ng bagyo, dahil umaasa pa rin ang isla sa supply mula sa Cebu.
english: This is exacerbated by delays in the delivery of diesel fuel especially during typhoons, as the island still relies on supply from Cebu.

text: Dahil dito, nakita ng DOE ang pangangailangan para sa mas matatag at mas sustainable na mga solusyon, gaya ng hybrid renewable energy systems, solar panels na may battery storage, at iba pang energy efficiency measures.
english: Because of this, the DOE saw the need for more stable and sustainable solutions, such as hybrid renewable energy systems, solar panels with battery storage, and other energy efficiency measures.

text: “We have already identified the mitigated measures some of those are already being implemented,” ayon kay Marasigan.
english: “We have already identified the mitigated measures some of those are already being implemented,” said Marasigan.

text: “Halimbawa, ini-improve na ang kanilang distribution lines.
english: “For example, they are already improving their distribution lines.

text: Dati, bihira at walang insulation ang mga wire dahil sa cost considerations.
english: Previously, wires were rare and uninsulated due to cost considerations.

text:
Ngayon, nagsimula na ang CELCO ng ‘three-phase program’ para mapabuti ang kanilang distribution facilities at gumagamit na rin sila ng insulated wires.”

Ayon sa DOE, hindi lamang nito layong tugunan ang kasalukuyang problema ng mga lugar tulad ng Camotes Island, kundi maging bahagi rin ito ng mas pangmatagalang solusyon sa sektor ng enerhiya, lalo na sa mga liblib at malalayong komunidad sa Pilipinas.
english:
Now, CELCO has started a three-phase program to improve their distribution facilities and they are also using insulated wires.”

According to the DOE, this will not only address the current problems of areas such as Camotes Island, but will also be part of a more long-term solution to the energy sector, especially in the remote and remote communities in the Philippines.

text: ILOILO  CITY- Pasado na sa House of Representatives sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang hagna nga nagaduso sa pag-ban sang TikTok sa amo nga pungsod matapos naghilisugot ang mga Republicans kag Democrats nga makabig nga pamahog sa national security ang popular video-sharing application nga ginapanag-iyahan sang China-based company.
english: ILOILO CITY – The House of Representatives of the United States of America has passed a bill proposing to ban TikTok in the country after Republicans and Democrats agreed to consider the popular video-sharing application owned by a China-based company a threat to national security.

text: Ini ang ginatawag nga Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act.
english: It’s called the Protecting Americans from Foreign Adversary Controlled Applications Act.

text: Suno kay Bombo Rufino “Pinoy” Gonzales, international correspondent sa Texas, USA, sunod nga ipasa ang hagna sa US Senate kun sa diin ginalauman man suno sa iya nga madasig ini nga maaprubahan nga mapasar.
english: According to Bombo Rufino “Pinoy” Gonzales, international correspondent in Texas, USA, the bill will be submitted to the US Senate where it is expected to be quickly approved and passed.

text: Ginpahayag ni Gonzales nga mangin si President Joe Biden ang nagpasalig nga pirmahan niya ini nga hagna sa tion nga makalab-ot na ini sa iya lamesa.
english: Gonzales said it will be President Joe Biden who has promised to sign the bill once it reaches his desk.

text: Suno kay Gonzales, nagapati ang mga mamalidha nga ang TikTok mahimo gamiton agud mag- access sang American data kag magpalapta sang “harmful” information gikan sa millions nga mga users.
english: According to Gonzales, lawmakers believe that TikTok can be used to access American data and spread “harmful” information from millions of users.

text: Una naman nga nanginwala si TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew nga gina-kontrol sang Chinese government ang application.
english: TikTok CEO Shou Zi Chew earlier denied that the Chinese government controls the application.

text: Ang TikTok ang ginapanag-iyahan sang China-based parent company nga ByteDance nga nagpatigayon man sang agresibo nga kampanya nga indi magmadinalag-on ang amo nga hagna.
english: TikTok is owned by China-based parent company ByteDance, which has also waged an aggressive campaign to prevent the bill from passing.

text: Nangako ng suporta ang tinaguriang “Duterte Bloc” o mas kilala ngayon bilang “Duter7” para sa pananatili ni Senador Francis “Chiz” Escudero bilang Senate President sa ika-20 Kongreso.
english: The so-called “Duterte Bloc” or better known as “Duter7” has pledged its support for the retention of Senator Francis “Chiz” Escudero as Senate President in the 20th Congress.

text: Sa isang pulong balitaan, kinumpirma ni Senador Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa na nakapag-commit na ang grupo — na kinabibilangan nina Senators Dela Rosa, Imee Marcos, Rodante Marcoleta, Bong Go, Robinhood Padilla, Camille Villar, at Mark Villar — para suportahan ang liderato ni Escudero sa Senado.
english: In a statement, Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa confirmed that the group — which includes Senators Dela Rosa, Imee Marcos, Rodante Marcoleta, Bong Go, Robinhood Padilla, Camille Villar, and Mark Villar — has already committed to support Escudero’s leadership in the Senate.

text: Ayon kay Dela Rosa, nilagdaan na niya ang resolusyong iniikot para pormal na ipahayag ang kanilang suporta kay Escudero.
english: According to Dela Rosa, he has already signed the resolution being circulated to formally express their support for Escudero.

text: Nilinaw rin ng senador na walang anumang kondisyon na isinama kapalit ng kanyang suporta.
english: The senator also clarified that no conditions were included in exchange for his support.

text: Ani Dela Rosa, wala siyang hininging committee chairmanship at boluntaryo niyang ibinigay ang suporta dahil sa kanyang tiwala sa istilo ng pamumuno ni Escudero.
english: Dela Rosa said he did not ask for committee chairmanship and voluntarily gave his support because of his confidence in Escudero's leadership style.

text: “Ikinalulugod ko ang pamamalakad niya sa Senado, kaya buong puso akong pumirma sa resolusyon,” ani Dela Rosa.
english: “I regret his leadership in the Senate, so I signed the resolution with all my heart,” Dela Rosa said.

text: Samantala, kinumpirma rin ni Dela Rosa na hiningi ni Senador Rodante Marcoleta ang pamumuno sa Blue Ribbon Committee, na aniya’y ipinangako na rin sa kanya ni Escudero sa pagsisimula ng bagong Kongreso.
english: Meanwhile, Dela Rosa also confirmed that Senator Rodante Marcoleta requested the leadership of the Blue Ribbon Committee, which Escudero promised him at the beginning of the new Congress.

text: Gayunpaman, iginiit ng senador na ang kanilang pagsuporta kay Escudero ay walang kaugnayan sa posisyon nito kaugnay ng impeachment case laban kay Pangalawang Pangulo Sara Duterte.
english: However, the senator insisted that their support for Escudero has nothing to do with his position on the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Gin-abi-abi sang Metro Iloilo Water District (MIWD) kag sang Metro Pacific Iloilo Water (MPIW) ang proposal sang Aboitiz Group sang bulk water supply sa Iloilo City.
english: The Metro Iloilo Water District (MIWD) and the Metro Pacific Iloilo Water (MPIW) welcomed the Aboitiz Group's proposal for bulk water supply in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alfredo Tayo III, General Manager sang Metro Iloilo Water District, iya ginpahayag nga manami nga may dugang nga player nga mahimo mangin supplier sang tubig sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alfredo Tayo III, General Manager of the Metro Iloilo Water District, said it is good to have an additional player who can become a water supplier in Iloilo City.

text: Suno kay Tayo, ang importante diri amo ang mahatagan sang kaayohan ang syudad sa patag sang tubig.
english: According to Tayo, the important thing here is to benefit the city in the field of water.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga welcome ang tanan nga ‘players’ nga mahimo magtanyag sang ila tinutuyo sa bulk water supply.
english: He also said that all players who can offer their intentions in bulk water supply are welcome.

text: Ginalantaw man sang natungdan nga mahimo lantawon sang Aboitiz Group ang timeline sang ila nga operasyon.
english: He also expects the Aboitiz Group to look at the timeline of their operation.

text: Dugang sini nga kinahanglan nga i-revisit sang nasambit nga water supplier ang ila pricing sang tubig bangud labing-importante gid ang hinun-anon sang mga consumers.
english: He added that the said water supplier needs to revisit their pricing of water because the consumers' opinion is very important.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagtanyag sang nasambit nga kompanya sang P37 to P41 per cubic meter sang bulk water para sa syudad.
english: The company offered P37 to P41 per cubic meter of bulk water for the city.

text: Ginlaragway naman sang Committee on Public Private Partnership sang Iloilo City Government nga matalunsay ang nangin presentasyon sang tagsa ka bulk water supplier.
english: The Committee on Public Private Partnership of the Iloilo City Government described the presentation of each bulk water supplier as smooth.

text: Ini kasunod man sang ginpatigayon nga Public and Stakeholder Consultation.
english: This follows the Public and Stakeholder Consultation.

text: Suno kay Atty. Dave Garcia, vice chairman sang Committee on Public Private Partnership, iya ginpahayag nga madamo sang mga concern ilabi na ang mga palamangkutanon nga ginbato sa ila.
english: According to Atty. Dave Garcia, vice chairman of the Committee on Public Private Partnership, said there are many concerns especially the questions that were asked to them.

text: Dugang sini, duha tubtob tatlo ka mga tawo ang nagpalab-ot sa ila nga kalabanan sa problema sa mga water supplier amo ang ila linya sang tubig.
english: In addition, two to three people conveyed to them that most of the problem with water suppliers is their water line.

text: Paathag sini nga may concern nga nagapatumod nga indi problema ang balor sang tubig, kundi ang water distribution lines.
english: He explained that there is a concern that the value of water is not the problem, but the water distribution lines.

text: May yara man nagsiling nga anhon ang bastante nga water supply kon indi man makalab-ot sa ila tagsa ka puluy-an.
english: Some also said that what is the use of sufficient water supply if it does not reach their respective homes.

text: Sa piyak sini, nagpasalig sa gihapon ang mga proponent nga sa sulod sang tatlo tubtob apat ka adlaw, mahimo makaayo ang mga distribution line nga maguba.
english: Meanwhile, the proponents still promised that within three to four days, the damaged distribution lines can be repaired.

text: Inihayag ni Senador Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa ang kanyang planong maghain ng mosyon upang kuwestyunin ang hurisdiksyon ng ika-20 Kongreso ng Senado sa pagpapatuloy ng impeachment case laban kay Pangalawang Pangulo Sara Duterte.
english: Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa has announced his plan to file a motion to question the jurisdiction of the 20th Senate Congress to continue the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Sa isang pulong balitaan, sinabi ni Dela Rosa na nais niyang linawin kung may karapatan ba ang kasalukuyang komposisyon ng Senado na ituloy ang mga hakbang na sinimulan ng ika-19 na Kongreso ng Kamara kaugnay sa kaso ng impeachment.
english: In a news conference, Dela Rosa said he wanted to clarify whether the current composition of the Senate has the right to continue the steps initiated by the 19th Congress of the House of Representatives regarding the impeachment case.

text: “Kung kaya nilang tanungin ang Kamara ng 20th Congress kung binding sila sa aksyon ng 19th Congress, dapat tanungin din natin kung binding sa atin ang kanilang mga naging hakbang,” paliwanag ng senador.
english: “If they can ask the House of the 20th Congress if they are binding on the actions of the 19th Congress, we should also ask if their steps are binding on us,” the senator explained.

text: Binigyang-diin ni Dela Rosa na personal niyang paniniwala na dapat ding kuwestyunin ang hurisdiksyon ng Senado.
english: Dela Rosa stressed that he personally believes that the jurisdiction of the Senate should be questioned.

text: Umaasa rin siyang susuportahan siya ng kanyang mga kapwa senador mula sa Duterte bloc.
english: He also hopes that his fellow senators from the Duterte bloc will support him.

text: Hindi naman tiyak kung muling isusulong ni Dela Rosa ang pagbasura sa kaso laban kay VP Duterte, ngunit inuna raw muna niyang i-mosyon ang pagtalakay sa hurisdiksyon bago ang anumang desisyon ukol sa merit ng kaso.
english: It is not clear whether Dela Rosa will again advance the dismissal of the case against VP Duterte, but he said he will first motion the discussion of jurisdiction before any decision on the merits of the case.

text: Samantala, una nang sinabi ni Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero na maaaring pagbotohan ng Senate impeachment court ang kapalaran ng reklamo sa pamamagitan ng simple majority vote.
english: Meanwhile, Senate President Francis “Chiz” Escudero earlier said that the Senate impeachment court can vote on the fate of the complaint through a simple majority vote.

text: Ayon sa kanya, anumang mosyon na ihahain ay dadaan sa parehong proseso.
english: According to him, any motion that is filed will go through the same process.

text: Dagdag pa ni Escudero, posible ring maibasura ang kaso batay lamang sa answer ad cautelam na isinumite ng kampo ni VP Sara Duterte.
english: Escudero added that it is possible to dismiss the case based on the answer ad cautelam submitted by VP Sara Duterte's camp.

text: Ipinahayag ni Senador Risa Hontiveros nitong Miyerkules ang pagsampa ng hiwalay na reklamong cyberlibel sa Department of Justice (DOJ) laban sa isang abogado, limang social media personalities, at kay Michael Maurillo, na kilala rin bilang alias Rene.
english: Senator Risa Hontiveros on Wednesday announced the filing of separate cyberlibel complaints with the Department of Justice (DOJ) against a lawyer, five social media personalities, and Michael Maurillo, also known as alias Rene.

text: Si Maurillo ang nag-iisang respondent sa isang kaso, samantalang sina Ferdinand Topacio, Bryon Cristobal (Banat By), Jeffrey “Ka Eric” Celiz, Krizette “Kiffy” Chu, Jose “Jay” Sonza, at Alex Destor (Tio Moreno) naman ang mga respondents sa isa pang reklamo.
english: Maurillo is the sole respondent in one case, while Ferdinand Topacio, Bryon Cristobal (Banat By), Jeffrey “Ka Eric” Celiz, Krizette “Kiffy” Chu, Jose “Jay” Sonza, and Alex Destor (Tio Moreno) are the respondents in another complaint.

text: Ayon kay Hontiveros, hindi lamang ito usapin ng fake news kundi isang sistematiko at sinadyang pag-atake laban sa mga testigo at mga taong naglakas-loob ipahayag ang katotohanan kahit na may takot.
english: According to Hontiveros, this is not just a matter of fake news but a systematic and deliberate attack against witnesses and people who dared to reveal the truth despite fear.

text: “Hindi lang po ito kaso ng fake news… ito ay sistematiko at sadyang pag-atake pati sa mga witnesses, mga taong nag lakas loob sa kabila ng kanilang takot na sabihin ang kanilang katotohanan,” ani Hontiveros.
english: “This is not just a case of fake news... this is a systematic and deliberate attack on witnesses, people who have the courage despite their fear to tell their truth,” Hontiveros said.

text: Ang isa sa mga video na ipinalabas sa Facebook ni Maurillo ay naglalaman ng kanyang pahayag na pinilit siyang gumawa ng pahayag laban kina Duterte, VP Sara Duterte, at pastor Apollo Quiboloy.
english: One of the videos posted on Facebook by Maurillo contains his statement that he was forced to make a statement against Duterte, VP Sara Duterte, and pastor Apollo Quiboloy.

text: Iginiit niya na peke ang lahat ng mga testimonya ng mga testigo sa Senate hearings.
english: He insisted that all the testimony of the witnesses in the Senate hearings was fake.

text: Noong nakaraang linggo, nagsampa na rin si Hontiveros ng reklamo sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) laban kay Maurillo at sa social media account na Pagtanggol Valiente, na siyang nag-post ng mga video nito.
english: Last week, Hontiveros also filed a complaint with the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) against Maurillo and the social media account Pagtanggol Valiente, which he posted videos of.

text: Nilinaw ni Hontiveros na naniniwala siya sa kalayaan sa pananalita at pagpapahayag, ngunit hindi ito nangangahulugan na pwede nang magkalat ng kasinungalingan na naglalagay sa ibang tao sa panganib.
english: Hontiveros clarified that he believes in freedom of speech and expression, but that does not mean that he can spread lies that put other people at risk.

text: Nagpadala lamang sang mensahe ni King Charles kadungan sang ika-75 nga anibersaryo sang Commonwealth bangud absent ini sa mga selebrasyon kasunod sang pang-angkon sini sang cancer.
english: King Charles sent his message only on the occasion of the 75th anniversary of the Commonwealth because he was absent from the celebrations following his cancer diagnosis.

text: Isa ka pre-recorded video message ang gin-play nga amo ang nagahatag sang tribute sa Commonwealth, isa ka voluntary club sang 56 ka mga nasyon nga nag-evolve halin sa British empire.
english: A pre-recorded video message was played that was paying tribute to the Commonwealth, a voluntary club of 56 nations that evolved out of the British empire.

text: Isa man ini sa pinakadaku nga international organizations nga naga-cover sang 2.5 billion ka mga tawo kag ginapamunuan anay ni Queen Elizabeth nga iloy ni Charles.
english: It is also one of the largest international organizations covering 2.5 billion people and was once headed by Queen Elizabeth who is the mother of Charles.

text: Ang Commonwealth Day amo ang isa sa pinaka-importante nga tuigan nga royal occasion nga wala natambungan sang 75-anyos nga hari halin sang nagpaidalom ini sa cancer treatment.
english: Commonwealth Day is one of the most important annual royal occasions that the 75-year-old monarch has missed since undergoing cancer treatment.

text: Tubtub subong, wala man ginsapubliko sang palasyo kag sang Royal Family kun ano nga sahi sang cancer ang ginasuprer ni King Charles.
english: So far, the palace and the Royal Family have not made public what type of cancer King Charles is suffering from.

text: Bilang tiglawas sang hari, ang asawa sini nga si Queen Camilla ang nagpanguna sa senior royals sa service sa Westminster Abbey sa London nga ginsundan sang reception sa international headquarters sang Commonwealth.
english: As the king’s representative, his wife Queen Camilla led the senior royals in the service at Westminster Abbey in London followed by a reception at the Commonwealth’s international headquarters.

text: Wala man nakatambong sa okasyon ang Princess of Wales nga si Kate nga asawa ni Prince William bangud nga naga-recover pa ini sa iya nga abdominal surgery.
english: Princess of Wales Kate, wife of Prince William, was also unable to attend the event as she is still recovering from abdominal surgery.

text: Wala pa gihapon nakuha ang bangkay sang duha ka Filipino seafarers nga lakip sa tatlo nga napatay bangud sa pag-igu sang missile sa ila nga barko nga True Confidence sa Gulf of Aden.
english: The bodies of two Filipino seafarers who were among the three killed when a missile hit their ship True Confidence in the Gulf of Aden have not been recovered.

text: Suno kay Migrant Workers Officer-in-Charge Hans Leo Cacdac, nag-igu gid ang missile sa fuel section sang barko kun sa diin nagatinir ang duha ka mga biktima.
english: According to Migrant Workers Officer-in-Charge Hans Leo Cacdac, the missile hit the fuel section of the ship where the two victims were staying.

text: Bangud sini, gilayon nga ginpatigayon ang emergency evacuation bangud sa tuman ka daku nga sunog kag wala naman nabalikan ang duha nga napatay.
english: As a result, an emergency evacuation was immediately conducted due to the huge fire and the two dead were not returned.

text: Una naman nga gin-report nga nagbulig ang Indian Navy agud nga madala ang iban nga crew sa ospital lakip ang 13 ka iban pa nga Pinoy seafarers.
english: Earlier, it was reported that the Indian Navy helped to take the other crew to the hospital including 13 other Pinoy seafarers.

text: 10 diri nga mga Pinoy ang hilway na sa katalagman samtang padayon naman nga ginabulong ang tatlo nga Pinoy sa ospital sa Djibouti City sa Horn of Africa bangud sa mga samad nga ila naangkon.
english: 10 of these Filipinos are safe while three others are being treated at a hospital in Djibouti City in the Horn of Africa for their injuries.

text: Ginsulit ni Cacdac nga may kinamatarong ang Filipino seafarers nga magpangindi sa deployment kun mahibaluan nila nga magalayag ang barko sa “high risk areas” ilabi na sa kun sa diin nagapang-atake ang rebelde nga Houthis nga halimbawa amo ang south sang Red Sea kag bug-os nga Gulf of Aden.
english: Cacdac reiterated that Filipino seafarers have the right to refuse deployment if they know that the ship will sail in “high risk areas” especially where the Houthis rebels are attacking such as the south of the Red Sea and the entire Gulf of Aden.

text: Pahayag pa sini, ang kutob naman sang magapasugot nga mag-upod sa deployment apisar pa sang mataas nga risgo ang dapat nga makabaton sang mas mataas nga sweldo kag mga benepisyo.
english: He said those who agree to join the deployment despite the high risk should receive higher salaries and benefits.

text: Sandig sa Joint Manning Agency (JMA), 70 percent na sa mga barko ang naga-reroute agud likawan ang Red Sea kag ang Gulf of Aden apang may iban man nga nagakapilitan nga didto mag-agi bangud sa tuman nga gasto kun mangita pa sang alternatibo kag mas malayo nga mga ruta.
english: According to the Joint Manning Agency (JMA), 70 percent of ships are already rerouted to avoid the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden but there are others who are forced to pass there because of the high cost of finding alternative and longer routes.

text: Ibinunyag ni Vice President Sara Duterte na nais ng kanyang amang si dating Pangulong Rodrigo Roa Duterte (FPRRD) na ipa-cremate siya sa Netherlands sakaling siya’y pumanaw habang nasa naturang bansa.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte revealed that her father, former President Rodrigo Roa Duterte (FPRRD), wants him to be cremated in the Netherlands in case he passes away while in that country.

text: Sa isang panayam sa labas ng Scheveningen Prison sa The Hague noong Hulyo 8, sinabi ng Pangalawang Pangulo na nag-iwan na ng “huling habilin” ang dating pangulo.
english: In a greeting outside Scheveningen Prison in The Hague on July 8, the Vice President said the former president had left a “last legacy”.

text: “Nagbigay na siya ng kanyang mga huling habilin.
english: “He has given his last remains.

text: Sabi niya, kung saan daw siya mamatay, doon daw siya i-cremate,” ani Duterte.
english: He said, wherever he dies, he will be cremated there,” Duterte said.

text: Ayon pa sa kanya, sinabi ng dating pangulo na kung siya ay mamatay sa Netherlands, huwag nang iuwi ang kanyang labi sa Pilipinas, bagkus ay ipa-cremate na lamang siya roon.
english: According to him, the former president said that if he dies in the Netherlands, do not return his body to the Philippines, but have him cremated now.

text: Bagamat tinanggap ni VP Sara ang habilin ng ama, sinabi niyang kailangan pa rin nila itong pag-usapan dahil siya ay hindi pabor sa cremation.
english: Although VP Sara accepted the father's remains, he said they still need to discuss it because he is not in favor of cremation.

text: “Sabi ko sa kanya, hindi pa natin pag-uusapan ‘yan ngayon dahil hindi ako pro-cremation,” dagdag pa niya.
english: “I told him, we’re not going to talk about that now because I’m not pro-cremation,” he added.

text: Inamin ng Pangalawang Pangulo na natural lamang na mapag-usapan ang mga ganitong bagay lalo’t ang dating pangulo ay nasa edad 80 na.
english: The Vice President acknowledged that it is natural to discuss such matters especially since the former president is in his 80s.

text: Aniya, kapansin-pansin ang pagpayat ng kanyang ama, ngunit gumanda naman umano ang kutis nito.
english: He said his father was noticeably thin, but his skin was beautiful.

text: Gayunpaman, sinabi rin ni VP Sara na tila wala sa mood ang kanyang ama noong araw ng kanyang pagbisita.
english: However, VP Sara also said that his father was not in the mood on the day of his visit.

text:
Ang tanging mensahe raw nito para sa mga Pilipino ay: “No guts, no glory.”

Dumating si VP Sara sa The Hague noong Hulyo 5 upang masulit ang panahon ng pagbisita sa kanyang ama.
english:
Its only message for Filipinos is: “No guts, no glory.”

VP Sara arrived in The Hague on July 5 to repeat the visit to her father.

text: Kasama rin niya roon ang kanyang ina na si Elizabeth Zimmerman, na kamakailan ay nagbigay rin ng update tungkol sa kalagayan ng dating asawa.
english: He was also accompanied by his mother, Elizabeth Zimmerman, who recently gave an update on her ex-husband's condition.

text: Nang tanungin kung may posibilidad na muling magkabati ang kanyang mga magulang, sinabi ni VP Sara na magkaibigan na lamang sila sa ngayon.
english: When asked if there is a possibility that her parents will meet again, VP Sara said that they are just friends for now.

text:
Mananatili si VP Sara sa The Hague hanggang Hulyo 23 at lilipad patungong South Korea sa Hulyo 28 para sa isang “Free Duterte Rally.”

Hindi siya dadalo sa ika-apat na State of the Nation Address (SONA) ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english:
VP Sara will stay in The Hague until July 23 and fly to South Korea on July 28 for a “Free Duterte Rally.”

He will not attend President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.'s fourth State of the Nation Address (SONA).

text: sa parehong araw.
english: on the same day.

text: Nalakip ang 15 ka mga Pinoy sa crew sang isa ka panibag-o nga barko nga gin-igu sang antiship ballistic missile sa Gulf of Aden.
english: Fifteen Filipinos were among the crew of a new ship that was hit by an antiship ballistic missile in the Gulf of Aden.

text: Sa amo nga insidente, sandig sa inisyal nga report, duha ka seafarers ang patay, anum ang naka-agom sang seryoso nga mga samad bangud sa pagkasunog samtang tatlo naman ka iban pa ang missing apang wala pa ginkumpirma kun ano ang ila nga nationalities.
english: In the incident, according to initial reports, two seafarers were killed, six sustained serious injuries due to burns while three others are missing but their nationalities have not been confirmed.

text: Suno sa Greek Operator sang barko nga True Confidence, naigu sang missile ang barko sang yara ini sa 50 nautical miles southwest sang Yemeni port sang Aden rason nga nagkarab-karab gilayon ang kalayo.
english: According to the Greek operator of the ship True Confidence, the missile hit the ship when it was 50 nautical miles southwest of the Yemeni port of Aden causing the fire to ignite immediately.

text: Suno sa amo nga source, wala pa sang available nga impormasyon sa status sang 20 ka crew kag tatlo ka armado nga guwardiya sa sulod sang vessel nga ginalakipan sang 15 ka mga Pinoy, apat ka Vietnamese, duha ka Sri Lankans, isa ka Indian kag isa ka Nepali national.
english: According to the source, there is no information available on the status of the 20 crew and three armed guards on board the vessel, which includes 15 Filipinos, four Vietnamese, two Sri Lankans, one Indian and one Nepali national.

text: Nag-isyu naman sang statement ang rebelde nga Houthis nga sila ang may kahimuan sa pagpalupad sang missile.
english: The Houthis rebels issued a statement claiming responsibility for the missile launch.

text: May shipping source man nga nagsiling nga nagaguwa subong nga gin-abandonar na lamang ang vessel — pareho man sa impormasyon nga ginpaguwa sang United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency.
english: A shipping source also said it now appears that the vessel was abandoned — similar to information released by the United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations agency.

text: Nahibaluan nga sunod-sunod nga pagpang-atake ang ginahimo sang Houthi rebels paagi sa pagpalupad sang drones kag missiles batok sa international commercial shipping halin pa sang tunga-tunga sang bulan sang Nobyembre.
english: It is known that the Houthi rebels have been carrying out a series of attacks by flying drones and missiles against international commercial shipping since mid-November.

text: Ila ginpahayag nga kabahin ini sang ila nga pagdampig sa Palestine bangud sa pagpang-atake nga ginahimo sang militar sang Israel sa Gaza.
english: They said this was part of their support for Palestine because of the Israeli military's attacks on Gaza.

text: Ini ang ginakabig pinaka-seryoso nga nahalitan bangud sa na-rekord nga mga nasamaran kag napatay.
english: It is considered the most seriously damaged due to recorded injuries and deaths.

text: Base sa impormasyon, ang barko nga True Confidence ang ginapanag-iyahan sang Liberian-registered company nga True Confidence Shipping kag gina-operate sang kumpaniya nga Third January Maritime nga naka-base naman sa Greece.
english: According to information, the ship True Confidence is owned by the Liberian-registered company True Confidence Shipping and operated by the company Third January Maritime which is based in Greece.

text: (Photo:Dario Bonazza/via REUTERS)
english: (Photo:Dario Bonazza/via REUTERS)

text: Ginalantaw ni Palace Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro nga exercise lang ang kinahanglan ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Palace Press Officer Atty. Claire Castro that exercise is all that former President Rodrigo Duterte needs.

text: Ini matapos ginpahayag sang anay asawa ni Duterte nga si Elizabeth Zimmerman nga “skin and bones” na ang anay presidente matapos ginbisita niya ini sa International Criminal Court (ICC) sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: This comes after Duterte's ex-wife Elizabeth Zimmerman said the former president is "skin and bones" after she visited him at the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague, Netherlands.

text: Suno naman kay VP Sara, ang kahimtangan sang lawas sang iya amay subong ang daw kaangay sang iya itsura sang soltero pa ini.
english: According to VP Sara, her father's physical condition is similar to his appearance when he was a young man.

text: Yari naman ang pahayag ni Castro sang ginpamangkot ini tuhoy sa kahimtangan ni Duterte.
english: Here is Castro's statement when asked about Duterte's condition.

text: “Sa napanood po natin na pagsasalita ni Ma’am Elizabeth Zimmerman, sinabi niya na pumayat, yes, pero mukhang healthy ayon sa kaniya, and he’s okay.
english: “In the speech we watched Ma’am Elizabeth Zimmerman, she said to lose weight, yes, but she looks healthy, and he’s okay.

text: Ang sabi pa nga raw ng dating pangulo ay ‘You go home.
english: The former president said, 'You go home.

text: I’m fine.
english: I’m fine.

text: I’m okay.’ At hindi na raw siya nagte-take ng medicine, parang maintenance, so it’s good for him, according to Ma’am Elizabeth Zimmerman.
english: I’m okay.’ And he doesn’t take medicine anymore, like maintenance, so it’s good for him, according to Ma’am Elizabeth Zimmerman.

text: Saka mas maganda po talaga na natitingnan naman po ang kaniyang kalusugan doon mismo sa The Hague.
english: And it's even better that his health is being monitored right there in The Hague.

text: Hindi naman po pababayaan ang dating pangulo doon.”
english: The former president will not be left there.”

text: Ginalantaw ni Board Member Ramon Sullano nga insakto ang tikang sang mga transport cooperatives nga magsulat sang petition letter agud nga makuha ang atensyon ni Department of Transportation Sec.
english: Board Member Ramon Sullano believes that the move of the transport cooperatives to write a petition letter to get the attention of Department of Transportation Sec.

text: Vince Dizon kaangot Public Utility Vehicle (PUV) Modernization Program.
english: Vince Dizon is affiliated with the Public Utility Vehicle (PUV) Modernization Program.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Board Member Sullano, ang chairman sang Committee on Transportation sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan sang Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga nagasunod lamang ang probinsya sa kon ano ang deriktiba sang national government nahanungod sa Modernization Program.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Board Member Sullano, chairman of the Committee on Transportation of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of Iloilo, said the province is only following the directives of the national government regarding the Modernization Program.

text: Suno kay Sullano, kon pahanugotan gidman ang mga unconsolidated jeepney nga makabyahe liwat, magaguwa nga disbentaha ini sa mga transport cooperative nga naghatag sang ila tyempo agud nga mangin myembro sang isa ka kooperatiba.
english: According to Sullano, if the unconsolidated jeepneys are allowed to operate again, it will be a disadvantage to the transport cooperatives that gave their time to become members of a cooperative.

text: Dugang sini nga nagsunod lamang ang transport cooperatives sa mandu sang gobyerno.
english: He added that the transport cooperatives were only following the government's order.

text: Una na nga nagpasa sang petition letter sa Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) ang pila ka transport cooperatives lakip ang Iloilo City Loop Alliance of Jeepney Operators and Drivers Association (ICLAJODA) agud nga indi pagpabalikon-byahe ang mga unconsolidated jeepneys.
english: Earlier, several transport cooperatives including the Iloilo City Loop Alliance of Jeepney Operators and Drivers Association (ICLAJODA) submitted a petition letter to the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) to prevent the resumption of unconsolidated jeepneys.

text: Ini kasunod man sa pagpabutyag sang No to PUV Phase-out Coalition nga nagalaum sila nga makabalik-byahe ang mga drivers kag operators kasunod sang pagpasalig ni Transportation Sec.
english: This follows the No to PUV Phase-out Coalition's expression of hope that drivers and operators will be able to resume travel following the assurance of Transportation Sec.

text: Vince Dizon nga i-suspend ang implementasyon sang PUV Modernization Program.
english: Vince Dizon to suspend the implementation of the PUV Modernization Program.

text: Matabo gid ang madugay na nga ginalauman kag ginakalangkagan nga maragtason nga rematch sa tunga nanday United States President Joe Biden kag anay US President Donald Trump sa general election sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa maabot nga Nobyembre.
english: The long-awaited and long-awaited historic rematch between United States President Joe Biden and former US President Donald Trump will take place in the general election in the United States of America this coming November.
