text: Ini matapos pareho nga nagdaog sa nomination contests sa ginbansagan “Super Tuesday” kun sa diin nagboto ang mga tawo sa 15 ka mga estado sa ila nga nominee para sa pagka-presidente.
english: This is after both won the nomination contests on the so-called “Super Tuesday” where people in 15 states voted for their nominee for the presidency.

text: Wala man lang ginbalhasan si Trump sa paglutos kay anay South Carolina Governeor kag anay U.N. Ambassador Nikki Haley kun sa diin nadag-an sini ang 14 sa 15 ka states lakip ang Alabama, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Maine, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Texas, Minnesota kag Virginia.
english: Trump was not even rewarded for defeating former South Carolina Governor and former U.N. Ambassador Nikki Haley won 14 of the 15 states including Alabama, Arkansas, California, Colorado, Maine, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Tennessee, Texas, Minnesota and Virginia.

text: Wala sang sweep nga natabo bangud daog si Haley sa estado sang Vermont.
english: No sweep happened because Haley won the state of Vermont.

text: Nangin presumptive nominee si Trump sang Republicans matapos nga opisyal nga nag-suspinde si Haley sang iya nga presidential campaign.
english: Trump became the Republicans' presumptive nominee after Haley officially suspended her presidential campaign.

text: Ginpanginbulahan sini si Trump apang wala niya ini gin-endorso.
english: He congratulated Trump but did not endorse him.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga wala siya sang paghinulsol sa iya pagkampanya sa pagka-presidente.
english: He also said he has no regrets about his presidential campaign.

text: Sa speech naman ni Trump, ginlaslasan na sini si Biden kag gintawag nga worst president sa maragtas sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: In his speech, Trump lashed out at Biden and called him the worst president in the history of the United States of America.

text: Madasig naman nga kadalag-an ang naangkon sang Democrat nga si Biden sa 14 states lakip sa Minnesota kun sa diin nangatubang ini sa protesta.
english: Democrat Biden won quickly in 14 states including Minnesota where he faced protests.

text: Nalutos naman ini sa US territory nga American Samoa.
english: It was defeated in the US territory of American Samoa.

text: Ini nga rematch sa tunga sang 77-anyos nga si Trump kag 81-anyos nga si Biden amo ang labing-una nga una nga pagsulit sang US presidential matchup humalin sang 1956.
english: This rematch between 77-year-old Trump and 81-year-old Biden is the first-ever repeat of the US presidential matchup since 1956.

text: Isinumite na ng International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecution panel ang ika-12 batch ng mga ebidensya laban kay dating Pangulong Rodrigo Duterte.
english: The International Criminal Court (ICC) prosecution panel has submitted the 12th batch of evidence against former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Ayon sa opisyal na dokumentong may petsang Hulyo 4, iniulat ng prosekusyon na naipasa nila sa kampo ng depensa ang 1,253 na pahina ng mga ebidensya noong unang araw ng Hulyo.
english: According to an official document dated July 4, the prosecution reported that they submitted to the defense camp 1,253 pages of evidence on July 1.

text: Ang nasabing ebidensya ay hinati sa sampung (10) pakete at sumasaklaw sa mga isyu kaugnay ng diumano’y “Davao Death Squad” noong panahon ni Duterte bilang alkalde, mga “Barangay Clearance Operations,” at mga “High-Value Target” operations noong siya ay Pangulo.
english: The said evidence is divided into ten (10) packages and covers issues related to the Davao Death Squad during Duterte's tenure as mayor, Barangay Clearance Operations, and High-Value Target operations during his tenure as President.

text: Nauna nang itinakda ng ICC pre-trial chamber ang Hulyo 1 bilang deadline para sa prosekusyon sa pagsusumite ng lahat ng ebidensyang gagamitin para sa confirmation of charges hearing.
english: The ICC pre-trial chamber had earlier set July 1 as the deadline for the prosecution to submit all the evidence to be used for the confirmation of charges hearing.

text: Samantala, patuloy namang isinusulong ng kampo ni dating Pangulong Duterte ang petisyon na mapayagan siya sa isang interim release habang nagpapatuloy ang proseso ng kaso.
english: Meanwhile, former President Duterte's camp continues to advance the petition to grant him an interim release while the case process continues.

text: Nananatiling nakaantabay ang publiko at ang buong bansa sa mga susunod na hakbang ng ICC at kung ano ang magiging resulta ng isinasagawang imbestigasyon laban sa dating Pangulo.
english: The public and the entire country remain eager to see the next steps of the ICC and the outcome of the ongoing investigation against the former President.

text: Sinuspinde na ang dalawang kadete ng Philippine Military Academy (PMA) matapos masangkot sa umano’y hazing incident na kinasangkutan ng apat na kadete, ayon sa Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).
english: Two cadets of the Philippine Military Academy (PMA) have been suspended after they were involved in an alleged hazing incident involving four cadets, according to the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP).

text: Ayon kay AFP spokesperson Col.
english: According to AFP spokesperson Col.

text: Francel Margareth Padilla, sa apat na nasangkot sa insidente, isa ang naabsuwelto, dalawa ang sinuspinde, at isa ang binigyan ng parusa bilang bahagi ng prinsipyo ng chain of command.
english: Francel Margareth Padilla, of the four involved in the incident, one was acquitted, two were suspended, and one was punished as part of the principle of chain of command.

text: Batay sa imbestigasyon ng Baguio City Police, nakaranas umano ang biktima ng paulit-ulit na physical abuse at humiliation mula Setyembre 2 hanggang 29, 2024.
english: According to the investigation of the Baguio City Police, the victim allegedly experienced repeated physical abuse and humiliation from September 2 to 29, 2024.

text: Tinukoy ng complainant ang mga nangyari bilang “animalistic tripping”, na kinabibilangan umano ng pananapak at labis-labis na physical training.
english: The complainant referred to the incidents as “animalistic tripping”, which allegedly included kicking and excessive physical training.

text: Dahil sa naranasang pananakit, naospital ang kadete matapos halos mawalan ng malay dulot ng isang malakas na suntok.
english: Due to the pain experienced, the cadet was hospitalized after almost losing consciousness due to a strong blow.

text: Na-discharge siya sa ospital noong Hunyo 30, 2025.
english: He was discharged from the hospital on June 30, 2025.

text: Ayon sa PMA, hindi ito itinuturing na hazing sa ilalim ng Anti-Hazing Act, dahil hindi raw ito bahagi ng isang initiation process.
english: According to the PMA, it is not considered hazing under the Anti-Hazing Act, because it is not part of an initiation process.

text: Sa halip, ito raw ay pagpapalabas ng sama ng loob ng mga kapwa kadete dahil sa umano’y mahinang performance ng biktima.
english: Instead, it was an expression of anger by fellow cadets because of the alleged poor performance of the victim.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, hinihintay pa ng PMA ang opisyal na reklamo at kopya ng ulat ng pulisya upang makumpleto ang kanilang aksyon sa kaso.
english: Currently, the PMA is still waiting for the official complaint and a copy of the police report to complete their action in the case.

text: Ipatuman ang road closure sa pila ka dalan sa Iloilo City kadungan sang pag-obserbar sang Semana Santa.
english: Road closure will be implemented on some roads in Iloilo City during the observance of Easter.

text:
Ini ang magasugod sa Abril 16 tubtob 20, 2025

Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head sang Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office (TTMO), iya ginpahayag nga ipatuman ang one-way traffic scheme sa Libertad-Lapuz, halin Rizal Street padulong sa Muelle Loney Street.
english:
It will run from April 16 to 20, 2025

In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Retired Police Colonel Uldarico Garbanzos, head of the Iloilo City Traffic and Transportation Management Office (TTMO), said the one-way traffic scheme will be implemented in Libertad-Lapuz, from Rizal Street to Muelle Loney Street.

text: Suno kay Garbanzos, indi makasulod ang mga motorista sa Muelle Loney / Cesar Drilon Bridge padulong Libertad-Lapuz tubtob sa Rizal Street.
english: According to Garbanzos, motorists will not be able to enter the Muelle Loney / Cesar Drilon Bridge to Libertad-Lapuz until Rizal Street.

text: Samtang, ang tanan nga mga motorista nga nagahalin sa Muelle Loney Street padulong Libertad-Lapuz ang mahimo nga mag-agi sa alternate routes via Quirino Bridge, padulong sa Rizal Street kag sa ila tagsa ka destinasyon.
english: Meanwhile, all motorists coming from Muelle Loney Street to Libertad-Lapuz can take alternate routes via Quirino Bridge, to Rizal Street and their respective destinations.

text: Dugang ni Garbanzos, ginpatuman ang amo nga tikang bangud sa ginalauman nga pagdugok sang mga pasahero padulong sa Parola Wharf nga magapauli para sa Semana Santa.
english: Garbanzos said the move was implemented due to the expected influx of passengers heading to Parola Wharf returning home for Easter.

text: Todo-dayaw ang coach sang Iraq sa team sang Pilipinas nga nagahampang sa 2025 FIBA Asia Cup sa Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
english: The Iraqi coach is full of praise for the Philippine team playing in the 2025 FIBA ​​Asia Cup in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

text: Kasunod ini sang ila nga do-or-die match kahapon sang hapon, Agusto 9, kun sa diin nagdaog ang Gilas, 66-57, nga rason kun ngaa nakaabante ini sa classification phase para sa tyansa sa quarterfinals.
english: This follows their do-or-die match yesterday afternoon, August 9, where the Gilas won, 66-57, which is why they advanced to the classification phase for a chance in the quarterfinals.

text: Sa first quarter sang hampang, abanse na ang Iraqis, 18–12, nagpatas sa 33-33 sa second half; apang naagaw sang Pilipinas ang momentum sa third period nga nag-umpisa sa sunod-sunod nga tres ni Dwight Ramos.
english: In the first quarter of the game, the Iraqis were ahead, 18–12, leveled at 33-33 in the second half; but the Philippines seized the momentum in the third period starting with consecutive threes by Dwight Ramos.

text:
Dalayon nga nakuha sang Nationals ang kadalag-an samtang nataktak naman ang Iraq nga wala gid sang daog sa Group D.

“I know for a long time, this team of the Philippines… all these players, they are superstars over there.
english:
The Nationals immediately secured the victory while Iraq remained winless in Group D.

“I’ve known for a long time, this team of the Philippines… all these players, they are superstars over there.

text: And that is when the championship [experience is] coming, they are coming with a superstar.
english: And that is when the championship [experience is] coming, they are coming with a superstar.

text: I’m sure that the Philippines is improving [by] playing hard games, that will help them in the future,” suno kay Iraq head coach Veselin Matic kasunod sang hampang.
english: I’m sure that the Philippines is improving [by] playing hard games, that will help them in the future,” Iraq head coach Veselin Matic said following the match.

text:
Pahayag pa sini, para sa iya, sulod sa Top 4 pa-Top 6 ang Pilipinas: “For me, the Philippines is [a] top four or top six team here.”

Nahibaluan nga pang-92 naman ang Iraq sa world rankings sang FIBA.#
english:
He said that for him, the Philippines is in the Top 4 to Top 6: “For me, the Philippines is [a] top four or top six team here.”

Iraq is ranked 92nd in the FIBA ​​world rankings.

text: ABYAN sang aton pungsod ang tanan nga myembro sang United Nations nga naga-respeto sa aton, lakip na ang pungsod sang Russia.
english: OUR country is a friend of all members of the United Nations who respect us, including Russia.

text: Apang indi kita kunsintidor sang sayop sang abyan kag gina-kondenar naton ang desisyon ni Russian President  Vladimir Putin agud salakayon ang halos wala inugbato nga pungsod sang Ukraine.
english: But we are not condoning the friend's mistake and we condemn the decision of Russian President Vladimir Putin to invade the almost undefended country of Ukraine.

text: Aba, kag wala gid ini sing kaluoy!
english: Why, and it is so merciless!

text: Labi na gid sa pagpaulan sang mga “killer missiles” sa Ukraine, nga wala sing pili kon sin-o ang iguon.
english: Especially in the rain of “killer missiles” on Ukraine, which does not choose who is hit.

text: Soldado ka man ukon sibilyan kag bisan ang mga “helpless” nga mga pumuluyo.
english: Whether you are a soldier or a civilian and even the “helpless” citizens.

text: Lakip diri ang mga pasyente sa ospital, mga tigulang sa “elderly homes” kag ang mga inosente nga mga kabataan.
english: This includes hospital patients, elderly people in “elderly homes” and innocent children.

text: Pati na gani ang yara pa sa taguangkan sang mga iloy nga manugbata sa maternity wards.
english: Even those who are still in the womb of mothers who give birth in maternity wards.

text: Sunu sa ulihi nga pagpahibalo sang United Nations (Marso 10, 2022), luas sa linibu nga nagkalamatay nga mga soldado,  mga 549 ka sibilyan ang napatay kag 957 ang nahalitan (injured), although nagapati ang UN nga sobra dira ang kabug-usan nga nabiktima.
english: According to the latest United Nations announcement (March 10, 2022), in addition to the thousands of soldiers killed, about 549 civilians were killed and 957 injured, although the UN believes that the total number of victims is higher.

text: Myembro ang Russia kag Ukraine sang United Nations, kon diin ang mga myembro may sinumpaan, pagkatapos sadtong Second World War, para sa “peaceful coexistence” kag paglikaw sa “outbreak of violence” nga indi ma-“justify”.
english: Russia and Ukraine are members of the United Nations, where members have pledged, after the Second World War, to “peaceful coexistence” and avoiding “outbreaks of violence” that cannot be “justified”.

text: Sa pagpasalakay ni Putin sa Ukraine, maathag nga na-violar sini ang kasugtanan para sa “peaceful coexistence”.
english: By invading Ukraine, Putin has clearly violated the agreement for “peaceful coexistence”.

text: Ang rason lang ni Putin amo nga ang kasilingan nga Ukraine isa ka daku nga pamahog sa iya seguridad.
english: Putin’s only excuse is that neighboring Ukraine is a serious threat to his security.

text: Paano abe mangin pamahog ang isa ka mahuyang nga pungsod katulad sang Ukraine batok sa isa ka world power nga may kusog nuclear katulad sang Russia?
english: How can a weak country like Ukraine be a threat to a world power with nuclear strength like Russia?

text: Bisan gani ang mga pumuluyo nga Ruso nag-kondenar sining desisyon sang ila president paagi sa malawakan nga protesta sa mga dalanon.
english: Even the Russian people condemned this decision of their president with widespread protests in the streets.

text: In fact, ginpakamalaut man ini ni Pope Francis, ang lider sang sobra isa ka bilyon nga mga Kristiyano, kag gintawag ini nga “armed aggression” nga indi ma-“justify” ni Putin.
english: In fact, Pope Francis, the leader of more than a billion Christians, has also condemned it, calling it an “armed aggression” that Putin cannot “justify”.

text: Pang-bully lang ini!
english: It’s just bullying!

text: Indi lang ni Putin seguro luyag makita ang malipayon kag hilway nga panghulag sang kasilingan nga Ukraine nga sadto Komunista apang Demokrasyahon na ang pagpangabuhi sa karon.
english: Putin probably doesn't just want to see the happy and free movement of neighboring Ukraine, which was once Communist but is now living in a democracy.

text: Imposible ugaling nga mag-surrender na gid lang ang Ukraine kay para sa bisan isa ka gamay nga pungsod nga palangga ang kahilwayan maayo pa mapatay nga nagaaway sangsa i-surrender ining ila kinamatarong, nga amo na gani karon ang nagakatabo.
english: It is impossible, however, for Ukraine to surrender because for even a small country that loves freedom it is better to die fighting than to surrender this right, which is what is happening now.

text: Ugaling man kay indi mabatas sang iban nga pungsod ang ining “unjustified aggression” kag pagpanglupig sang Russia.
english: However, other countries cannot tolerate this “unjustified aggression” and oppression by Russia.

text: Gani, samtang wala pa sila makita nga aktwal nga peligro sa ginahimo sang Russia kontra sa ila, luas sa pagpangaman, naghimo na sila sing mga lihok agud diri pa lang sa Ukraine mapunggan na ang posible nga pag-abanse sang Russia sa ila mga pungsod.
english: Therefore, while they are not yet seen as an actual threat to what Russia is doing against them, in addition to being precautionary, they have already taken steps to prevent a possible Russian advance into their countries right here in Ukraine.

text: May nagapatuman na gani sing mga “sanction” agud mapabatyag ang ekonomiya sang Russia.
english: Some are even imposing sanctions to make the Russian economy feel better.

text: May mga humanitarian aid man sa mga nahalitan sa Ukraine.
english: There is also humanitarian aid to those affected in Ukraine.

text: Ang iban nagahatag armas diri agud bisan paano mapangapinan nila  ang ila pungsod.
english: Some give weapons here so they can somehow defend their country.

text:
***

Sa bahin sang mga magagmay kag may kabalaslan nga mga pungsod sa Russia, lakip ang Filipinas, katulad  sa ginhatag sini nga mga COVID-19 vaccines sa aton, indi man dapat naton i-surrender ang aton kinamatarong sa paghimo sing matarong nga panindugan.
english:
***

On the part of the small and wealthy countries in Russia, including the Philippines, as it has given us COVID-19 vaccines, we must not surrender our right to take a righteous stand.

text: Otherwise, ang gwa naton daw robot nga wala sing konsyensya kag erehes nga wala sing ginatuohan nga matarong nga Diyos.
english: Otherwise, our outside is like a robot without a conscience and a heretic who does not believe in a righteous God.

text: Hambalon naton si Putin nga ginapasalmatan naton ang nabulig sini sa aton, apang prankahon ta ini nga indi naton naluyagan ang daw binuang niya nga pagsugo agud salakayon kag dugmokon gid ang Ukraine.
english: Let’s tell Putin we appreciate what it has helped us with, but let’s be blunt about it that we don’t like his seemingly foolish order to invade and absolutely crush Ukraine.

text: Updan man naton ang mga panawagan na sang madamo nga mga pungsod nga untaton na sang Russia ining iya malain nga buhat  sa Ukraine.
english: Let us also join the calls of many countries for Russia to stop its evil actions in Ukraine.

text: Ipanugyan ta man nga makigsugilanun lang ang duha ka pungsod para mauntat na ang ila pag-inaway kag ipadayon ang commitment sa “peaceful coexistence” bilang myembro sang UN.
english: Let us also suggest that the two countries simply talk to stop their fighting and continue their commitment to “peaceful coexistence” as members of the UN.

text: Indi man imposible ini bisan pa magkasilingan sila kag lain ang ila ideolohiya – Komunista ang Russia kag Demokrasya ang Ukraine.
english: This is not impossible even if they are neighbors and have different ideologies – Russia is Communist and Ukraine is Democracy.

text: Katulad bala sa tunga sang North kag South Korea, nga bisan magkatuhay ang ila ideolohiya, wala man sila problema bilang magkatupad nga teritoryo.
english: Is it like between North and South Korea, who despite their different ideologies, have no problems as neighboring territories.

text: Abyan naton ang tanan nga pungsod sa UN, kag tungod mag-abyan kita, obligasyon ta man nga sawayon ang nakasayop kag patung-an ang ila problema nga indi na maglain pa kag mapabalik ang ila “peaceful coexistence”./PN
english: We are friends with all the countries in the UN, and because we are friends, it is our obligation to rebuke the wrongdoers and resolve their problems so that they do not get worse and restore their “peaceful coexistence”./PN

text: Ginmanduan ni Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla nga mangin mandatory na ang pagsuksok sang body-worn cameras sa mga fire inspection sang taga-Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla has ordered the mandatory wearing of body-worn cameras during fire inspections by Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) personnel nationwide.

text: Suno kay Remulla nga ang ini nga tikang ang kabahin sang pagpasiguro sang transparency, accountability kag mas madasig nga serbisyo sang BFP.
english: Remulla said the move is part of ensuring transparency, accountability and faster services of the BFP.

text: Dugang pa sini nga sa amo nga pamaagi, magabalik ang pagsalig sang publiko sa serbisyo sang BFP, ilabi na sang mga negosyante.
english: He added that in this way, the public's confidence in the services of the BFP, especially the businessmen, will be restored.

text: Sa matandaan nga gin-alegar sang DILG ang BFP bilang isa sa mga korap nga ahensya sa idalum sini, bangud sa ginapahayag illegal recruitment, pagbaligya sang mga fire extinguisher kag mga inspection fees.
english: The DILG has alleged that the BFP is one of the corrupt agencies under it, due to alleged illegal recruitment, sale of fire extinguishers and inspection fees.

text: Nagpatuman sang adjustment sa guidelines ang Department of Education central office pinaagi sa flexible working arrangement para sa ila mga opisina bilang kabahin sang ginapatuman nga four-day work week.
english: The Department of Education central office has implemented an adjustment to the guidelines through a flexible working arrangement for its offices as part of the four-day work week.

text: Suno sa patakaran, Lunes tubtob Huwebes ang onsite nga trabaho sa opisina samtang ang Biyernes ang work-from-home arrangement sang mga empleyado.
english: According to the policy, Monday to Thursday is onsite work in the office while Friday is the work-from-home arrangement of employees.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Hernani Escullar, spokesperson sang DepEd Region VI, ginpahayag niya nga kabahin ini sang tikang sang ahensya agud makatipid sa operational expenses.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Hernani Escullar, spokesperson of DepEd Region VI, said this is part of the agency's efforts to save on operational expenses.

text: Samtang sa pihak nga bahin, padayon naman nga magasunod ang mga teaching personnel sa gin-set nga schedule sang end of school year rites.
english: Meanwhile, the teaching personnel will continue to follow the set schedule of the end of school year rites.

text: Suno sa DepEd, Marso 19 tubtob 20 ang final examinations, samtang Marso 23 tubtob 27 ang pagpatigayon sang recognition day para sa mga kabataan, samtang Marso 30 tubtob 31 naman ang gin-set nga schedule para sa end of school year rites.
english: According to the DepEd, the final examinations will be held from March 19 to 20, while the recognition day for children will be held from March 23 to 27, while the end of school year rites will be held from March 30 to 31.

text: Dugang pa ni Escullar nga ginapahanumdom sang ahensya ang mga eskwelahan nga magpatuman sang no collection policy sa pagpatigayon sang end of school year rites, bangud tanan ng expenses ang ginakuha sa Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses (MOOE) sang eskwelahan.
english: Escullar added that the agency reminds schools to implement a no collection policy in conducting end of school year rites, as all expenses are taken from the Maintenance and Other Operating Expenses (MOOE) of the school.

text: Gina-emphasize man sang DepEd sa mga manunudlo, estudyante kag attendees nga siguruhon ang maayo nga ventilation sa mga lugar nga pagahiwatan sang moving-up kag recognition ceremonies agud masiguro ang kaayuhan kag kaluwasan sang tanan.
english: The DepEd also emphasizes to teachers, students and attendees to ensure good ventilation in the areas where the moving-up and recognition ceremonies will be held to ensure the well-being and safety of all.

text: Gin-ako sang retired television presenter kag actress nga si Kris Aquino nga nahidlaw na ini kun ano man siya sadto sang maayo pa ang iya ikaayong lawas.
english: Retired television presenter and actress Kris Aquino admitted that she misses what she used to be when she was in good health.

text: Suno sa abyan ni Kris nga si Dindo Balares, sa karun yara sa isa ka private resort si Kris kag nagakaon sang organic food bangod nahidlaw na ini sa mga homemade nga pagkaon.
english: According to Kris' friend Dindo Balares, Kris is currently at a private resort and eats organic food because she misses homemade food.

text: Suno diri, naghambal si Kris sa iya nga nakita na sa karun sang mga abyan sini ang iya kalbaryo.
english: According to him, Kris told him that his friends have now seen his calvary.

text: Sang ginpamangkot ni Balares ang aktres kun ano ang nagatulod sa iya kun ngaa bisan papaano malipayon ini, sabat ni Kris nga mahapos lang para sa iya magkadlaw bisan sa gamay lang nga butang.
english: When Balares asked the actress what drives her to be happy, Kris replied that it is easy for her to laugh even at the smallest things.

text: Kag suno pa sa aktres ang tawo nga nalipay sa iya kabuhi ang makabig na nga isa ka winner.
english: And according to the actress, the person who is happy with his life is considered a winner.

text: Ginshare man ni Kris nga nahidlaw na gid siya sa iya kaugalingon kun ano man siya sadto kag sa naagyan sini sa karun masakit para sa iya ang iya nagakaeksperyensyahan.
english: Kris also shared that she misses herself as she used to be and that what she is going through now is painful for her.

text: Samtang, suno naman kay Dindo, sang nabatian sini ang ginhambal ni Kris, wala ini nakahibalo kun ano ang iya isabat.
english: Meanwhile, according to Dindo, when he heard what Kris said, he did not know what to say.

text: Interesado ang tatlo ka mga kumpaniya sa United Kingdom nga makig-partner sa lokal nga mga kumpaniya diri sa Pilipinas agud nga mag-suplay sang meat products.
english: The three companies in the United Kingdom are interested in partnering with local companies in the Philippines to supply meat products.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni Jonathan Eckley, director sang international trade development sa Agriculture and Horticulture Development Board, kadungan sang Philippine-British Meat Trade Mission year-end reception.
english: This was stated by Jonathan Eckley, director of international trade development at the Agriculture and Horticulture Development Board, during the Philippine-British Meat Trade Mission year-end reception.

text: Suno kay Eckley, diri na sa Pilipinas ang tatlo ka meat exporters agud malab-ot ang existing kag bag-o nga mga kliyente kag agud matun-an ang market opportunities sa pungsod.
english: According to Eckley, the three meat exporters are already in the Philippines to reach existing and new clients and to learn about market opportunities in the country.

text: Pahayag sini, indi nila mabalewala ang Pilipinas bangud amo ini ang pinakadaku nila nga market sa guwa sang Europa.
english: He said they cannot ignore the Philippines as it is their largest market outside Europe.

text: Plano man nila nga padayunon ang trade missions sa Pilipinas agud nga mabuligan ang meat exporters sang United Kingdom.
english: They also plan to continue trade missions in the Philippines to help meat exporters of the United Kingdom.

text: Base sa data sang Bureau of Animal Industry, naka-export ang United Kingdom sang 580 metric tons sang karne sa Pilipinas; 1,032 metric tons sang manok; kag 15,372 metric tons sang karne sang baboy as of September.
english: Based on data from the Bureau of Animal Industry, the United Kingdom exported 580 metric tons of meat to the Philippines; 1,032 metric tons of chicken; and 15,372 metric tons of pork as of September.

text: Liwat nga nagpahanumdom ang Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC) sa mga kandidato kag supporters nga likawan ang pagbutang sang mga campaign materials sa guwa sang common poster area.
english: The Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC) once again reminded candidates and supporters to avoid placing campaign materials outside the common poster area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Pinky Jevini Tentativa, Election Officer IV sang Iloilo City COMELEC, iya ginpahayag nga lakip sa mga indi dapat pagbutangan sang mga tarpaulins amo ang barangay hall, covered gyms, tanod outpost, lakip na ang mga waiting sheds, public sidewalk, poste, ilabi na sa mga kahoy.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Pinky Jevini Tentativa, Election Officer IV of the Iloilo City COMELEC, said that among the areas that should not be placed tarpaulins are barangay halls, covered gyms, tanod outposts, including waiting sheds, public sidewalks, poles, especially on trees.

text: Suno kay Tentativa, may mga nakadesignar nga mga lugar para sa individual, national and local candidates kon sa diin, may yara sang pito ka mga public plaza sa syudad nga amo ang common poster area.
english: According to Tentativa, there are designated areas for individual, national and local candidates where, there are seven public plazas in the city which are the common poster area.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga nagapatuman sang ‘weekly oplan baklas’ ang talatapan apisar pa nga holiday.
english: He also said that the office is implementing 'weekly oplan baklas' despite the holiday.

text: Gintuad man sang natungdan nga masami rason sa pagkakas sang ila nga tarpaulins amo ang oversize nga sukol sini.
english: He also admitted that the often reason for the removal of their tarpaulins is the oversize size.

text: Nahibaluan nga santo sa pagsulundan sang talatapan, ang tagsa ka kandidato ang mahimo magbutang sang ila campaign posters sa designated area nga may sukol nga 2 feet by 3 feet nga kasangkaron.
english: According to the office's rules, each candidate can put up their campaign posters in a designated area with a size of 2 feet by 3 feet.

text: Lakip na man sa rekisitos ang pagbutang sang ‘paid for by’ sa tagsa ka poster.
english: The requirement also includes putting a 'paid for by' on each poster.

text: Ginadumilian man ang tanan nga sahi sang pagpangampanya ang sa Abril 17 tubtob 18, 2025 nga isa ka balaan nga adlaw sa pag-obserba man sang Semana Santa sang simbahang-Katolika.
english: All forms of campaigning are also prohibited on April 17 to 18, 2025, a holy day to observe Holy Week of the Catholic Church.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini sa mga kandidato nga antes ang adlaw sang eleksyon kag adlaw mismo sang eleksyon sa Mayo 11 kag 12, 2025, ginadumilian ang magpangampanya, sa social media man ukon sa personal.
english: It also advised candidates that before election day and election day itself on May 11 and 12, 2025, campaigning, whether on social media or in person, is prohibited.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang sin-o man ang indi magsunod sa amo nga mga pagsulundan ang magapangatubang sang kaso sa paglapas sa Comelec Resolution No.
english: Anyone who fails to comply with these rules will face charges of violating Comelec Resolution No.

text: 11086 ukon ang Republic Act No.
english: 11086 or Republic Act No.

text: 9006 ukon Fair Elections Act.
english: 9006 or Fair Elections Act.

text: Napa-“eh di wow” si Senador Juan Zubiri matapos nga ginpahayag sang iban nga senador nga masobra na 10 sa ila mga kaupdanan ang naga-suporta kay Francis “Chiz” Escudero nga magpabilin bilang Senate President sa 20th Congress.
english: Senator Juan Zubiri was shocked after some senators said that more than 10 of their colleagues support Francis “Chiz” Escudero to remain as Senate President in the 20th Congress.

text: “Eh di wow!
english: “Oh the wow!

text: Congratulations!” pahayag sang former Senate President samtang nagakadlaw.
english: Congratulations!” the former Senate President said while laughing.

text: Ginpabutyag sini nga si Senador Tito Sotto gihapon ang iya luyag nga mangin lider sang upper chamber.
english: He said he still wants Senator Tito Sotto to be the leader of the upper chamber.

text: Wala man sini direkta nga ginhambal ang pangalan ni Escudero, apang ginpanglawag sini ang iya ginapaboran sa istilo ni Sotto bilang lider.
english: He did not directly mention Escudero's name, but he expressed his preference for Sotto's style as a leader.

text: “Ako naman, I’m not actively campaigning [for the Senate presidency].
english: “As for me, I’m not actively campaigning [for the Senate presidency].

text: Of course, I’m supporting Senator Tito Sotto.” Dugang sini: “Ang nagustuhan ko kay Sen.
english: Of course, I’m supporting Senator Tito Sotto.” He added: “What I like about Sen.

text: Sotto, naniniwala siya sa consensus building katulad ng ginawa ko for my two years as senate president.
english: Sotto, he believes in consensus building like I did for my two years as senate president.

text:
[Hindi] po siya diktador.”

“I am for a leader of the Senate that will keep protecting the integrity, the traditions of the Senate.
english:
[He] is not a dictator.”

“I am for a leader of the Senate that will keep protecting the integrity, the traditions of the Senate.

text: I don’t want a Senate leader who would (lead with) a dictatorial (style),” pahayag man sini anay sa nauna nga interview.
english: I don’t want a Senate leader who would (lead with) a dictatorial (style),” he said in an earlier interview.

text: Matandaan nga sanday Senador Alan Peter Cayetano kag Senador Joel Villanueva ang nagsiling nga may 13 na ka senador ang naga-suporta kay Escudero nga indikasyon sang dako nga posibilidad nga siya ang magapadayon sa liderato.
english: It can be recalled that Senator Alan Peter Cayetano and Senator Joel Villanueva said that there are already 13 senators who support Escudero which is an indication of the high possibility that he will continue in the leadership.

text: Si Sotto ang nagserbe bilang SP sang 2018-2022.
english: Sotto served as SP from 2018-2022.

text: Una na sini ginpahayag sa interviews nga handa siya sa pagserbe sa Senado sa anuman nga kapasidad lakip na ang pagtindog bilang minority leader kun indi man siya ang mapilian nga Senate President.#
english: Earlier, he said in interviews that he is ready to serve in the Senate in any capacity including standing as a minority leader if he is not elected Senate President.

text: All set na ang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) sa ila security preparations para sa Holy Week ukon Semana Santa.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) is all set in its security preparations for Holy Week or Easter.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office, iya ginpahayag nga gindihon na ang mga security protocols nga ipatuman sa probinsya agud mapasigurado ang kalinong samtang naga-obserbar sang Semana Santa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office, said that security protocols have been developed to be implemented in the province to ensure peace while observing Easter.

text: Suno kay Araño, indi lamang obligasyon sang kapulisan ang pagpabilin sang masangkad nga seguridad, bangud lakip sa mga may responsibilidad amo ang tagsa ka indibidwal.
english: According to Araño, it is not only the obligation of the police to maintain tight security, because among those who have responsibility is each individual.

text: Bangud diri, nagpanugyan ang natungdan nga tsekyaron gid ang mga balay antes maghalin ukon maglakat agud nga indi manakawan ukon masudlan sang mga kawatan.
english: Because of this, the concerned advised to check the houses before leaving or walking so as not to be stolen or entered by thieves.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga dapat nakandado ang pwertahan ilabi na ang mga bintana nga posible mangin alagyan sang kawatan.
english: He also said that the doors should be locked especially the windows that could be a way for thieves.

text: Nagpanugyan man ini nga likawan ang pagdala sang dako nga kantidad sang kwarta kon nagaguwa kag may laktan.
english: He also advised to avoid carrying large amounts of cash when going out and about.

text: Nagbilin man si Araño nga mag-inom sang madamo nga tubig agud malikawan nga ma-dehydrate subong nga tag-ilinit.
english: Araño also left it to drink plenty of water to avoid dehydration this summer.

text: Gilayon nga nakagwa sa presuhan ang kagawad nga nagtiro sang isa ka delivery truck sang tubo sa banwa sang San Enrique, Iloilo matapos nga nakapyansa.
english: The kagawad who shot a pipe delivery truck in San Enrique, Iloilo was immediately released from jail after being released on bail.

text: Ang barangay kagawad amo si Rogen Pama, residente sang Brgy.
english: The barangay kagawad is Rogen Pama, resident of Brgy.

text: Imbang Pequeño, San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: Imbang Pequeño, San Enrique, Iloilo.

text: Si Pama ang umagad man sang Vice Mayor sang banwa sang San Enrique nga si Ernesto P. Palomado.
english: Pama is also the son-in-law of San Enrique Vice Mayor Ernesto P. Palomado.

text: Samtang ang driver sang truck amo si Jay Agujetas, residente sang Brgy.
english: The driver of the truck was identified as Jay Agujetas, resident of Brgy.

text: Abaca, San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: Abaca, San Enrique, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Christy Val Dalde, hepe sang San Enrique Municipal Police iya ginpahayag nga matapos mapreso sang isa ka gab-i si Kagawad Pama, gilayon man ini nga nakagwa kasunod sang pagpyansa sini sang ₱50,000.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Christy Val Dalde, chief of San Enrique Municipal Police, said that after being detained for one night, Kagawad Pama was immediately released on bail of ₱50,000.

text: Wala naman makuha sa kagawad ang pusil nga gingamit niya sa pagpaniro apang ginkumpirma sang kapulisan nga na-igo ang na-wala nga bahin sang truck.
english: The gun used in the shooting was not recovered from the kagawad but police confirmed that the left side of the truck was hit.

text: Nahibaluan nga naghalin ang duha ka salakyan sa syudad sang Passi kag padulong kontani sa banwa sang San Enrique, apang, nagit-gitanay ang duha sa dalan rason nga nagtuga sang komosyon sa mga driver sini.
english: It was learned that the two vehicles were leaving Passi City and were heading to San Enrique town, but the two collided on the road causing commotion among the drivers.

text: Bangud diri, ginpanaog sang barangay kagawad ang iya windshield kag gintiro padalom ang truck nga may karga nga tubo.
english: As a result, the barangay kagawad lowered his windshield and shot down the truck loaded with pipes.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagpalagyo ang driver sang Mitsubishi Xpander, apang, natandaan ini sang driver sang truck lakip na ang plate number.
english: The driver of the Mitsubishi Xpander immediately fled the scene, but the driver of the truck remembered the plate number.

text: Nagpatuman naman sang hot pursuit operation ang San Enrique PNP kag naabtan ang barangay kagawad nga driver nga yara na sa ila balay.
english: San Enrique PNP conducted a hot pursuit operation and found the barangay kagawad driver who was already at his house.

text: Natukiban man nga may impluwensya sang makahulubog nga ilimnon ang nasambit nga kagawad.
english: The kagawad was also found to be under the influence of alcohol.

text: May natumod na ang awtoridad nga partikular nga area sa Taal Lake kun sa diin umpisahan ang pagpangita sang mga missing nga mga manugbulang nga gin-alegar ginpangpatay kag ginpangtagbong didto sang 2021 kag 2022.
english: The authorities have identified a specific area in Taal Lake where the search for the missing fishermen who were allegedly killed and dumped there in 2021 and 2022 will begin.

text: “Merong fishpond lease ang isang suspect na ano natin, tinutukoy natin.
english: “There is a fishpond lease with a suspect that we are referring to.

text: Bali ‘yun ang ating ano… ground zero natin,” suno kay Justice Secretary Boying Remulla.
english: That's what we have... our ground zero,” said Justice Secretary Boying Remulla.

text: Pahayag sang tiglikom, subong na nga semana umpisahan ang pagpangita sa mga bangkay.
english: The secretary said the search for the bodies will begin this week.

text: Ang natalana nga operasyon ang nag-ugat sa alegasyon sang isa ka whistleblower nga si Julie “Dondon” Patidongan nga ginpapatay ang mga biktima sa adlaw mismo nga gin-kidnap sila, ginhigot ang lawas sa mga sako, antes sila ginpangtagbong sa lake.
english: The planned operation is rooted in the allegation of a whistleblower, Julie “Dondon” Patidongan, that the victims were killed on the same day they were kidnapped, their bodies tied in sacks, before they were thrown into the lake.

text: Matandaan nga nag-request man ang Pilipinas sang technical assistance sa Japan apang wala pa sang sabat sa hingyo sang gobyerno.
english: The Philippines also requested technical assistance from Japan but the government has not yet responded to the request.

text: Nagtanyag naman ang Department of Science and Technology (DOST) nga gamiton ang ila nga expertise and equipment sa search, ilabi na bangud positibo suno sa tiglikom nga didto pa ang mga tul-an kun matuod nga didto gid man ang mga bangkay ginhaboy.
english: The Department of Science and Technology (DOST) offered to use its expertise and equipment in the search, especially since it is positive that the bones are still there if it is true that the bodies were dumped there.

text: Handa man ang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) nga maghatag sang ila nga forensic expertise.
english: The National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) is also ready to provide its forensic expertise.

text: Una na nga gintudlo sang whistleblower ang negosyante nga si Charlie “Atong” Ang nga amo ang mastermind sa krimen, kag gin-tag man si Gretchen Barretto nga may ihibalo.
english: The whistleblower had previously pointed to businessman Charlie “Atong” Ang as the mastermind behind the crime, and also tagged Gretchen Barretto as having knowledge.

text: Pareho nga nagpanginwala ang duha sa nasambit nga akusasyon.#
english: Both have denied the charges.#

text: Apisar nga amat-amat pa lang nga nagapaumpaw sa iya trangkaso, gingamit ni Pope Francis ang kahigayunan sa pag-atubang sa mga tumuluo sa St.
english: Despite still slowly recovering from his flu, Pope Francis used the opportunity to address the faithful at St.

text: Peter’s Square sa Vatican agud magpanawagan nga tapuson na ang gyera sa Gaza.
english: Peter's Square in the Vatican to call for an end to the war in Gaza.

text: Mismo ang Santo Papa ang nagpanguna sa Angelus prayer, kun sa diin iya man nga ginplastar ang mga kunsekwensya sa mga kabataanpananglitan magpadayon pa ang Israel-Hamas war.
english: The Pope himself led the Angelus prayer, where he also laid out the consequences for children if the Israel-Hamas war continues.

text: “I carry in my heart with pain the suffering the people of Palestine and Israel.
english: “I carry in my heart with pain the suffering the people of Palestine and Israel.

text: Is this really how we plan to build a better world?
english: Is this really how we plan to build a better world?

text: Stop, Enough,” kabahin sang pahayag sang Santo Papa.
english: Stop, Enough,” part of the Pope’s statement.

text: Liwat man ini nagpanawagan nga hilwayon na ang nabilin nga mga bihag nga ginpangkuha sang Hamas sa southern Israel sang Oktubre 7, 2023.
english: It also reiterated its call for the release of the remaining hostages taken by Hamas in southern Israel on October 7, 2023.

text: Masobra 30,000 na ang nagkalamatay bangud sa amo nga giyera sa Gaza kun sa diin 21,000 ang ginabug-usan sang kababainhan kag kabataan.
english: More than 30,000 people have been killed in the war in Gaza, including 21,000 women and children.

text: Talalupangdon man nga ini ang una nga tion nga mas klaro na ang tingog sang Santo Papa sa sulod sang pila ka adlaw.
english: It is also noteworthy that this is the first time the Pope's voice has been clearer in several days.

text: Sang Sabado, ginpalihog lamang sini sa iya aide ang pagbasa sa ceremonial speech bangud sa ginasuprer sini nga bronchitis.
english: On Saturday, he asked his aide to read the ceremonial speech because he was suffering from bronchitis.

text: Nagpa-check up man ini sa isa ka ospital sa Roma sang nagligad nga semana bangud sa trangkaso.
english: He also checked up at a hospital in Rome last week for the flu.

text: Nagpaguwa ang United Nations sang global alert bangud sang kakulangan sang mga manunudlo.
english: The United Nations has issued a global alert due to the shortage of teachers.

text: Kadungan ini sang meeting sang International Task Force on Teachers for Education sa Johannesburg, South Africa.
english: This coincides with the meeting of the International Task Force on Teachers for Education in Johannesburg, South Africa.

text: Suno sa UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), pito sa 10 ka mga manunudlo sa secondary level ang nagakinahanglan na nga buslan sa 2030 — kaupod sa katunga sang tanan nga manunudlo nga posible magbiya na sa propesyon sa katapusan sini nga dekada.
english: According to the UN Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), seven out of 10 secondary level teachers will already need to be replaced by 2030 — alongside half of all teachers who are likely to leave the profession by the end of this decade.

text: Tuman ka daku ang epekto sini nga kakulangan suno sa ahensya lakip na ang pagdamo sang mga estudyante nga naka-assign sa kada manunudlo; pagtumpok sang trabaho sang educator; pagtuhaw sang kinalain sang lebel ukon treatment sa edukasyon; kag kakulang sa pinansyal sa mga eskwelahan nga nagaapekto sa kalidad sang pagtudlo.
english: The impact of this shortage is very significant, according to the agency, including the increase in the number of students assigned to each teacher; stacking of educator workload; emergence of level or treatment difference in education; and financial shortfalls in schools affecting the quality of teaching.

text:
Suno pa sa report sang ahensya, nagakinahanglan ang kalibutan sang 44 ka milyon nga manunudlo sa 2030 agud nga malab-ot ang Sustainable Development Goal sa quality kag equitable education.#

(Photo: Ali Vicoy)
english:
According to the agency's report, the world needs 44 million teachers by 2030 to achieve the Sustainable Development Goal in quality and equitable education.

(Photo: Ali Vicoy)

text: Nakahunong na sa San Joaquin Municipal Police Station ang lalaki nga ginapahayag nagbato sa kapulisan matapos nga ginserbehan sang warrant of arrest sa Brgy.
english: The man who allegedly threw stones at the police after being served with a warrant of arrest in Brgy.

text: Jawod, San Joaquin, Iloilo.
english: Jawod, San Joaquin, Iloilo.

text: Ang lalaki amo si Alias June, 57-anyos, residente sang Tuy-an East, Maasin Maasin, Iloilo, kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga murder.
english: The man was identified as Alias ​​June, 57, resident of Tuy-an East, Maasin Maasin, Iloilo, and is facing murder charges.

text: Si Alias June ang ginakabig man nga Top 8 most wanted person – Regional Level.
english: Alias ​​June is also considered the Top 8 most wanted person – Regional Level.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), iya ginpahayag nga nakuha sa paghinakop sang subject ang duha ka m16 armalite rifle, lakip na ang mga live ammunitions.
english: Police Major Rolando Araño, spokesperson of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), said two m16 armalite rifles, including live ammunitions, were recovered from the suspect's possession.

text: Suno kay Araño, may ginapatigayon nga bulang sa lugar kon sa diin mismo nakit-an ang subject.
english: According to Araño, a bulang is being conducted in the area where the subject was found.

text: Sang natiktikan sang iya kaupdanan kagsang subject nga may mga pulis, didto na kag nagbaylohanay sang lupok ang kapulisan kag ang kaupod sang subject.
english: When his companions and the subject noticed that there were policemen, the policemen and the subject's companion exchanged fire.

text: Gintuad man sini nga nagapabilin nga wala pa matul-id kon ka-grupo gidman sang subject ang mga nagbalos palupok sang armas-luthang kon sa diin, padayon nga gina-ayam.
english: He also admitted that it remains unclear whether those who retaliated are members of the subject's group and are still being hunted.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Alias June ang anay myembero sang Revolutionary Proletarian Army-Alex Boncayao Brigade (RPA-ABB).
english: Alias ​​June is a former member of the Revolutionary Proletarian Army-Alex Boncayao Brigade (RPA-ABB).

text: Ginpalihog na lamang ni Pope Francis sa isa ka aide ang pagbasa sang iya speech sa isa ka seremonya sa weekend bangud sa gina-suprer nga bronchitis.
english: Pope Francis has asked an aide to read his speech at a weekend ceremony because of bronchitis.

text: Pila ka adlaw na nga gina-trangkaso ang Santo Papa kag indi pa maayo ang tingog sini sang nagtambong sa opening ceremony sang judicial year sang Vatican tribunal.
english: The Pope has been suffering from the flu for several days and his voice was not good when he attended the opening ceremony of the judicial year of the Vatican tribunal.

text: “I have prepared a speech but as you can see, I am unable to read it because of bronchitis.
english: “I have prepared a speech but as you can see, I am unable to read it because of bronchitis.

text: I have asked Monsignor [Filippo] Ciampanelli to read it for me,” suno sa pope.
english: I have asked Monsignor [Filippo] Ciampanelli to read it for me,” the pope said.

text: Kasunod sini, nagpakigkita si Pope Francis kay German Chancellor Olaf Scholz sa Vatican.
english: Following this, Pope Francis met with German Chancellor Olaf Scholz at the Vatican.

text: Nahibaluan nga pila na ka mga isyu sa ikaayong lawas ang ginapangatubang sang 87-anyos nga Santo Papa.
english: The 87-year-old Pope is already facing several health issues.

text: Sang nagligad nga Myerkules, nagbisita ini sa ospital sa Roma para sa check-up matapos nga wala man ini nakabasa sa atubang sang weekly audience bangud sa ginabatyag nga trangkaso.
english: Last Wednesday, he visited a hospital in Rome for a check-up after he was unable to read in front of the weekly audience due to the flu.

text: Sang Lunes kag Sabado, kanselado man ang appointments sini bangud sa mild flu apang nakahatag ini sang regular weekly address sa atubang sang mga tumuluo sa Saint Peter’s Square sang Domingo.
english: On Monday and Saturday, his appointments were also canceled due to mild flu but he was able to give a regular weekly address in front of the faithful in Saint Peter's Square on Sunday.

text:
Sang Disyembre, matandaan nga wala man gindayon ang planado na kuntani nga byahe sang Santo Papa sa COP28 climate meeting sa Dubai bangud sa epekto sang influenza kag lung inflammation.#

(Photo: AP News)
english:
In December, the Pope's planned trip to the COP28 climate meeting in Dubai was canceled due to the effects of influenza and lung inflammation.

(Photo: AP News)

text: Ginaduso sa Senado ang hagna nga hatagan sang gobyerno sang bulanan nga P1,000 allowance ang mga estudyante.
english: A bill is being pushed in the Senate to provide the government with a monthly P1,000 allowance to students.

text: Kun mangin layi ang “National Student Allowsance Program (NSAP) Act” ni Sen.
english: If the National Student Allowance Program (NSAP) Act of Sen.

text: Loren Legarda, ihatag ang allowance sa tanan nga naka-enroll nga estudyante nga Pilipino nga nakakuha sang minimum attendance requirements.
english: Loren Legarda, the allowance will be given to all enrolled Filipino students who meet the minimum attendance requirements.

text: Ini para may idugang sa galastuhon sa pagkaon, pamasahe kag school supplies ang mga estudyante.
english: This is to add to the expenses of food, fare and school supplies for the students.

text: Ipadala ang allowance paagi sa student cards ukon digital vouchers nga mahimo nga gamiton sa mga accredited vendors pareho sang school canteen, transport providers kag school supply retailers.
english: Send the allowance through student cards or digital vouchers that can be redeemed at accredited vendors such as school canteen, transport providers and school supply retailers.

text: Ginpahayag ni Legarda nga ang nasambit nga ­mekanismo ang magapat-ud nga ang allowance ang magamit para sa edukasyon sang kabataan kag mapataas ang school attendance agud mag-improve ang ila nga academic performance.
english: Legarda said the mechanism will ensure that the allowance is used for the education of the children and increase school attendance to improve their academic performance.

text: Gin-athag man ni Legarda nga ang nasambit nga allowance ang para lamang sa mga “school-related expenses.”
english: Legarda also clarified that the said allowance is only for school-related expenses.

text: Naggamit ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sang tatlo ka C130 military planes agud nga i-parachute ang masobra 38,000 ka putos nga mga pagkaon kag ayuda para sa mga tawo sa Gaza.
english: The United States used three C130 military planes to parachute more than 38,000 packages of food and aid for the people of Gaza.

text: Suno sa U.S. Central Command, ini nga operasyon ang ginpatigayon kaupod ang Royal Jordanian Air Force.
english: According to the U.S. Central Command, this operation was conducted in conjunction with the Royal Jordanian Air Force.

text: Ini man ang labing-una nga tion nga nagpatigayon ang Amerika sang airdrop sang pagkaon nga una naman nga ginhimo sang Jordan, United Kingdom, Egypt, kag France.
english: This is also the first time that the United States has conducted an airdrop of food, which was previously done by Jordan, the United Kingdom, Egypt, and France.

text: Suno sa White House, padayunon ini nga tikang kag suportado ini sang Israel.
english: The White House said the move will continue and that Israel supports it.

text: Magluwas diri, ginakonsiderar man sang Biden administration nga magpadala sang ayuda apang ipa-agi sa mga barko halin sa Cyprus.
english: In addition, the Biden administration is also considering sending aid but via ships from Cyprus.

text: Ini ang una nga bulig nga napadala sang US halin sang natabo ang ginapahayag “massacre” sang nagligad nga adlaw kun sa diin masobra 100 ang patay kag masobra 700 ang pilason bangud gin-alegar nagpinalupok ang militar sang Israel sang nagpalapit ang mga tawo sa mga truck sa Gaza City agud kuntani magpangayo sang pagkaon.
english: This is the first aid sent by the US since the alleged massacre last day in which more than 100 people were killed and more than 700 wounded when the Israeli military allegedly opened fire when people approached trucks in Gaza City to ask for food.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs nga one-fourth sang populasyon sa Gaza ukon 576,000 ka mga tawo ang nagasuprer sang tuman na gid nga kagutom.
english: Earlier, the United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs said that one-fourth of the population in Gaza or 576,000 people are suffering from extreme hunger.

text:
Suno naman sa Health ministry sang Gaza, masobra na sa 30,000 ka mga tawo — lakip ang 21,000 ka mga babayi kag kabataan — ang napatay halin sang natabo ang Israel-Hamas war sang Oktubre 2023.#

(Photo: The Times of Israel)
english:
Meanwhile, Gaza’s Health ministry says more than 30,000 people — including 21,000 women and children — have been killed since the Israel-Hamas war broke out in October 2023.#

(Photo: The Times of Israel)

text: Nagbiyahe liwat padulong sa Vatican ang tatlo ka Filipino nga cardinal agud magtambong sa una nga extraordinary consistory nga ginpatawag ni Pope Leo XIV.
english: The three Filipino cardinals traveled to the Vatican again to attend the first extraordinary consistory convened by Pope Leo XIV.

text: Ini amo sanday Manila Archbishop Cardinal Jose Advincula, Kalookan Bishop Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David, kag Cardinal Orlando Quevedo, archbishop emeritus sang Cotabato.
english: They are Manila Archbishop Cardinal Jose Advincula, Kalookan Bishop Cardinal Pablo Virgilio David, and Cardinal Orlando Quevedo, archbishop emeritus of Cotabato.

text: Maga-updanay man sila ni Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle nga sa karon naka-base sa Roma bangod sa iya papel bilang pro-prefect sang Dicastery for Evangelization.
english: They will also be joined by Cardinal Luis Antonio Tagle who is currently based in Rome for his role as pro-prefect of the Dicastery for Evangelization.

text: “Off for the extraordinary consistory of the College of Cardinals.
english: “Off for the extraordinary consistory of the College of Cardinals.

text: Please include us in your prayers,” post ni Cardinal David sa social media.
english: Please include us in your prayers,” Cardinal David posted on social media.

text: Ang consistory amo ang pormal nga pagtililipon sang College of Cardinals nga ginapatawag sang Santo Papa agud diskusyunan ang husto kag matarong nga pagdumala sang Simbahan Katolika.
english: A consistory is a formal meeting of the College of Cardinals convened by the Pope to discuss the proper and just governance of the Catholic Church.

text:
Sa press release sang Vatican, ginsiling nga ang consistory magalakip sang “moments of communion and fraternity” kag tyempo nga idedikar para sa “reflection, sharing and prayer.”

“These moments will be oriented towards fostering common discernment and offering support and advice to the Holy Father in the exercise of his high and demanding responsibility in the governance of the universal Church,” suno sa Vatican.
english:
In a press release from the Vatican, it said the consistory will include “moments of communion and fraternity” and time dedicated to “reflection, sharing and prayer.”

“These moments will be oriented towards fostering common discernment and offering support and advice to the Holy Father in the exercise of his high and demanding responsibility in the governance of the universal Church,” according to the Vatican.

text: Magasugod ang consistory subong nga adlaw, Enero 7, kag magapadayon ini tubtob Enero 8.
english: The consistory will begin today, January 7, and will continue until January 8.

text: Sa “PANIC MOOD” na subong ang pamilya Marcos sa madasig nga paglagas ni VP Leni Robredo sa mga political survey sa iya pagdalagan sa pagka-Presidente.
english: The Marcos family is now in “PANIC MOOD” with VP Leni Robredo's rapid pursuit of political surveys in her presidential race.

text: Sa survey sang CEAP kag Veritas Truth Survey nga naggwa sang sini lang, abanse na gani si Leni.
english: In the CEAP and Veritas Truth Survey released recently, Leni is even ahead.

text: Subong man sa survey sang OCTA Research.
english: Also in the OCTA Research survey.

text: Sa survey sang CEAP, gapanguna si VP Robredo by 52.57% kay anay Senador Ferdinand Marcos Jr., nga nagapangaduha kag nakaangkon lang sang 24.54%.
english: In the CEAP survey, VP Robredo is leading with 52.57% over former Senator Ferdinand Marcos Jr., who is second with 24.54%.

text: Sa sini nga survey, nanguna si VP Robredo sa 11 ka rehiyon kag apat lang ka rehiyon ang para kay Marcos Jr.
english: In this survey, VP Robredo led in 11 regions and only four regions were for Marcos Jr.

text: Nanguna man si VP Robredo sa survey sang Veritas Truth Survey, nga may 42% nga preference votes.
english: VP Robredo also topped the Veritas Truth Survey, with 42% preference votes.

text:
***

On the other hand, ang OCTA Research sa ila panalawsaw sa sentimiento sang publiko sa social media (Facebook) sadtong Pebrero 12-17, 2022, nagapanguna diri si Marcos Jr.
english:
***

On the other hand, OCTA Research in their research on public sentiment on social media (Facebook) on February 12-17, 2022, led by Marcos Jr.

text: sing 5 ka puntos batok kay VP Robredo, kon diin nakakuha lang si VP Robredo sing 38.54%, ukon 4,799,593 engagments.
english: 5 points against VP Robredo, where VP Robredo only got 38.54%, or 4,799,593 engagements.

text: However, sang masunod nga bulan sang Marso 2022 nanguna na si VP Robredo sing 5 ka puntos, nga may 8 ka milyon ka total engagments kontra kay Marcos Jr.
english: However, by the following month of March 2022 VP Robredo was leading by 5 points, with 8 million total engagements against Marcos Jr.

text: nga may 7.5 ka milyon lang ka engagements.
english: with just 7.5 million engagements.

text: Gina-predict gani sang mga data scientist sang OCTA nga sa sunod nga mga inadlaw masaka pa ang abanse ni VP Robredo kay Marcos Jr.
english: OCTA data scientists even predict that in the coming days, VP Robredo's lead over Marcos Jr.

text: tungod sa mga “swing votes” pabor kay VP Robredo.
english: because of the “swing votes” in favor of VP Robredo.

text:
***

Tungod gani sining mga ulihi nga development, nangayo na sing tabang ang Marcos family, paagi kay Senador Imee Marcos, agud mabuligan ni Presidente Duterte ang kandidatura ni Marcos Jr.
english:
***

Because of these recent developments, the Marcos family, through Senator Imee Marcos, has asked for help from President Duterte to help Marcos Jr.'s candidacy.

text: Mahimo bala ini ni Presidente Duterte?
english: Can President Duterte do it?

text: Earlier, nakapahayag si Duterte nga wala siya luyag kay Marcos Jr.
english: Earlier, Duterte said he did not like Marcos Jr.

text: nga mangin Presidente, samtang ka-tandem sini ang anak nga si Sara Duterte-Carpio nga nagadalagan sa pagka-Bise Presidente sa idalom sang partido Lakas CMD.
english: to become President, while his daughter Sara Duterte-Carpio is running for Vice President under the Lakas CMD party.

text: Katapo naman si Marcos Jr.
english: Marcos Jr. is a member.

text: sang Federal Party.
english: of the Federal Party.

text: Gintawag ni Presidente Duterte si Marcos Jr.
english: President Duterte called Marcos Jr.

text: nga “weak leader”, “spoiled brat” kag wala disiplina sa kaugalingon.
english: who is a “weak leader”, “spoiled brat” and has no self-discipline.

text: “You must be decisive (bilang Presidente),” siling gani niya sa isa ka TV interview.
english: “You have to be decisive (as President),” he even said in a TV interview.

text:
Dugang pa niya nga ang isa ka Presidente, “(dapat) compassionate (pro-people), and a good judge of a person… and (surprisingly) sana abogado.”

Sa mga kandidato sa pagka-Presidente duha lang ang abogado – si VP Robredo kag ang halos indi kilala nga si Jose Montemayor.
english:
He added that a President, “(must be) compassionate (pro-people), and a good judge of a person… and (surprisingly) hopefully a lawyer.”

Among the Presidential candidates there are only two lawyers – VP Robredo and the almost unknown Jose Montemayor.

text:
***

Samtang ginkakibut sang mga Remulla, nga mga supporters ni Marcos Jr., ang daku nga rally sang Leni-Kiko sa Gen.
english:
***

Meanwhile, the Remullas, who are supporters of Marcos Jr., were surprised by the large Leni-Kiko rally in Gen.

text: Trias, Cavite sadtong Marso 4.
english: Trias, Cavite on March 4.

text: Gintambungan ini sing sobra 47,000 ka tawo.
english: It was attended by over 47,000 people.

text: Nga daan indi lang baluarte sang mga Remulla ang Cavite, kundi iya man ni Senador Ping Lacson nga tumandok sang Cavite.
english: That Cavite is not only the stronghold of the Remulla, but also belongs to Senator Ping Lacson who is a native of Cavite.

text: Bisan gani ang caravan kag rally sang Marcos Jr.-Sara tandem kag sang Lacson-Sotto daw indi pa gani katupong sa rally diri nanday Leni-Kiko sadtong Marso 4.
english: Even the caravan and rally of the Marcos Jr.-Sara tandem and the Lacson-Sotto seems to be no match for the rally here of Leni-Kiko on March 4.

text: Gani kon ano na lang nga binutig ang ginpahayag sang kampo ni Congressman Remulla.
english: So what lies did Congressman Remulla's camp tell.

text: Kuno binayaran ang mga nagtambong.
english: Those who attended were supposedly paid.

text: Ayhan?
english: Perhaps?

text: Ti, wala man sila ebidensya.
english: Well, they have no evidence either.

text: Basi seguro ang mga rally sang mga Remulla ang bayaran.
english: Maybe the Remulla rallies will be paid for.

text: Man balatian na ina sang mga political dynasty, katulad nanday Remulla, nga gamitan sang sinako nga kwarta, kon indi “guns and gold”, ang ila pangkampanya.
english: It is also the disease of political dynasties, like Remulla, to use sacks of money, if not “guns and gold”, their campaign.

text: Sa mga Ilonggo, ugaling, indi katingalahan nga dugukan sing libre sang mga pumuluyo ang rally sang isa ka palangga nga kandidato.
english: For Ilonggos, however, it is not surprising that the people will attend the rally of a beloved candidate for free.

text: Testigo kita sa panahon ni anay Mayor Roding Ganzon, ang Prince of the Timawa, nga luyag gid tambungan sang mga pumuluyo bisan kapuyon pa sila sa paghulat agud magpamati lang personal kay Roding.
english: We are witnesses during the time of former Mayor Roding Ganzon, the Prince of the Timawa, who was eager to be attended by the residents even though they were tired of waiting to hear Roding personally.

text: Natandaan ko pa ang amon iloy kag ang iban pa nga mabitbit gid sang ila pulungkuan sa rally-han agud makita lang si Roding kag makapamati sa iya pamulong-pulong nga ila gid ginakakunyagan.
english: I still remember our mother and others carrying their seats to the rally just to see Roding and listen to his speech that they were so excited about.

text: So, wala kita gapati sa sining akusasyon sang mga Remulla.
english: So, we don't believe this accusation of the Remullas.

text: Balibards lang ina.
english: That's just balibards.

text: Kuno may mga komunista nga nakasimpon sa Leni-Kiko rally.
english: There were allegedly communists who joined the Leni-Kiko rally.

text: Kon matuod, tani ginpadakop nila.
english: If it were true, they should have arrested him.

text: Isa pa, kon matuod, wala man ina sila ginpang-imbitar.
english: Besides, if it's true, they weren't invited either.

text: Si Presidente Duterte pa gani ang nag-imbitar sadtong Marso 7 sa mga nars sang CPP-NPA agud hilway nga makabulig sa pagtatap sa mga Covid-19 patients sa aton mga ospital.
english: President Duterte even invited CPP-NPA nurses on March 7 to freely help care for Covid-19 patients in our hospitals.

text: Pwede man gani kuno magpabakuna ang mga CPP-NPA nga indi pagdakpon.
english: The CPP-NPA can even get vaccinated without being arrested.

text: Indi bala?/PN
english: Isn't it?/PN

text: Ilisipon na lamang ang inadlaw antes ang Christmas break — buot silingon, tion naman ini agud makabyahe ang kadam-an ilabi na ang mga estudyante.
english: Just count the days before Christmas break — that is, it is time for many people, especially students, to travel.

text: Isa gid sa indi naton gusto ma-eksperyensyahan amo ang madulaan sang bag sa airport, apang masami gid ini nagakatabo ilabi na kun nagadugok ang mga pasahero.
english: One of the things we don't want to experience is losing a bag at the airport, but it happens very often especially when passengers are crowded.

text: Apang nakahibalo ka bala nga may yara sang airport nga 30 ka tuig na nga matinlo ang record kun halungay sang baggage sang pasahero ang pagahambalan?
english: But did you know that there is an airport that has a clean record for 30 years when it comes to passenger baggage handling?

text: Ini ang Kansai International Airport (KIX) nga amo ang ikapito sa pinakamasako nga airport sa Japan.
english: This is Kansai International Airport (KIX) which is the seventh busiest airport in Japan.

text: Pahayag sang paluparan, wala gid ini nakaagi-dula sang bag halin sang pagbukas nila sang Septyembre 1994.
english: The airport said it has never lost a bag since it opened in September 1994.

text: Kada tuig, ini nga airport ang naga-average sang 20-30 million nga mga pasahero.
english: Every year, this airport averages 20-30 million passengers.

text: Madamo ang nagadayaw sa sini nga achievement, apang indi ini “big deal” para sa airport staff.
english: Many admire this achievement, but it is not a “big deal” for airport staff.

text: Suno sa Kansai, indi man ini “something special” bangud ginahimo lamang nila ang ila trabaho paagi sa paghalong sang gamit sang mga byahero.
english: According to Kansai, it is not “something special” because they are just doing their job by taking care of passengers' belongings.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, sini nga tuig, nakabaton sang award ang amo nga paluparan sa world’s best airport baggage delivery.
english: In fact, this year, the airport received an award for the world’s best airport baggage delivery.

text: Ang naghatag sang pagkilala amo ang UK-based aviation ranking and rating website nga Skytrax.
english: Providing the recognition was UK-based aviation ranking and rating website Skytrax.

text: Ang Kansai ang natukod sa artificial island sa Osaka Bay kag nagaserbe ini sa Osaka, Kyoto kag Kobe regions.
english: Kansai is built on an artificial island in Osaka Bay and it serves the Osaka, Kyoto and Kobe regions.

text: Para sa 2024, nagapang-18 ang Kansai sa lista sang best airport in the world overall, kasunod sa mga kaiping sini nga Tokyo, Narita (fifth place) kag Haneda (fourth).
english: For 2024, Kansai ranks 18th on the list of best airports in the world overall, following its neighbors Tokyo, Narita (fifth place) and Haneda (fourth).

text: Nahibaluan nga ang on time nga baggage arrival ang isa lamang sa factors nga ginalantaw kun mag-rank sa “world’s best” airport.
english: It is known that on time baggage arrival is only one of the factors considered when ranking the “world’s best” airport.

text: Ginakonsiderar man diri ang food and drink offerings, percentage sang on-time arrivals kag departures, kag siyempre, ang kalimpyo para kumportable man ang byahe sang mga pasahero.
english: It also considers food and drink offerings, percentage of on-time arrivals and departures, and of course, cleanliness for a comfortable journey for passengers.

text: Sa subong, nakatutok ang Kansai sa renovation kag bag-o nga security checkpoint bilang pagpanghanda sa Expo 2025 ukon kilala anay nga World’s Fair nga natalana nga patigayunon sa Osaka, Japan.#
english: Kansai is currently focused on renovations and new security checkpoints in preparation for Expo 2025 or formerly known as the World's Fair scheduled to be held in Osaka, Japan.

text: Nalipong na naman ang komedyante nga si Boobay samtang yara sa tunga-tunga sang isa ka event.
english: Comedian Boobay fainted again while in the middle of an event.

text: Makit-an sa video nga masinadyahon nga naga-perform ang comedian, nagalakat-lakat samtang naga-wave sa audience, apang wala pa natapos ang performance sini sang naghinay ini sa paghulag kag natumba.
english: The video shows the comedian performing cheerfully, walking around while waving to the audience, but before he finished his performance, he slowed down and fell.

text: Maayo na lang bangud nasalo ini sang isa ka babaye kag wala nagtupa ang iya ulo sa matig-a nga bagay.
english: Maayo na lang bangud nasalo ini sang isa ka babaye kag wala nagtupa ang iya ulo sa matig-a nga bagay.

text: Gintatap sang organizers ang komedyante samtang yara sa likod sang stage, apang sang ulihi, nagbalik pa gid ini sa pag-perform kag natapos gid ang event.
english: The organizers took care of the comedian while he was backstage, but later, he returned to perform and the event ended.

text: Nagpanawagan naman ang fans nga magpahuway na lang anay ang komedyante.
english: Fans called for the comedian to rest.

text: Indi ini ang una nga medical related incident kay Boobay.
english: Indi ini ang una nga medical related incident kay Boobay.

text: Sang Abril 2023, samtang yara sa live interview sa veteran host nga si Boy Abunda, nagsuprer man ini sang absent seizure, samtang sang 2024 nalipong man ini samtang naga-host sa Aparri, Cagayan.
english: In April 2023, while on a live interview with veteran host Boy Abunda, she also suffered an absent seizure, while in 2024 she also fainted while hosting in Aparri, Cagayan.

text: Una na nga ginpakigbahin ni Boobay nga ini nga seizures ang resulta sang ginsuprer sini nga mild stroke sang 2016.
english: Una na nga ginpakigbahin ni Boobay nga ini nga seizures ang resulta sang ginsuprer sini nga mild stroke sang 2016.

text: Gintawag ni Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda nga isa ka ‘political plan’ lamang ang ginpasaka nga kaso ni former Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava.
english: Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne “Jamjam” Baronda called the case filed by former Iloilo City Councilor Plaridel Nava a political plan.

text: Ini kasunod sang pagpasaka ni Nava sang kaso may kaangtanan sa ginapahayag ‘unexplained wealth’ ni Baronda.
english: This follows Nava's filing of a case regarding Baronda's alleged unexplained wealth.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rep.

text: Baronda, iya ginpahayag nga hayag kag bukas sa publiko ang iya nangin pangabuhi.
english: Baronda, he said that his life has been open and open to the public.

text: Suno kay Baronda, simple lamang siya nga nagpangabuhi sugod sang nagsulod siya sa pulitika sang tion sang siya ang isa pa Sangguniang Kabataan (SK).
english: According to Baronda, he has lived a simple life since he entered politics when he was a member of the Sangguniang Kabataan (SK).

text: Ginpaanggid man sini ang kaso nga ginpasaka ni Nava sa kaso nga ginpasaka man sa iya amay nga Councilor Nick Baronda.
english: He also compared the case filed by Nava with the case filed against his father, Councilor Nick Baronda.

text: Para sa mamalidha, mabasura man ini sa gihapon sang Office of the Ombudsman.
english: For the lawmaker, the Office of the Ombudsman will still reject it.

text: Ginlaragway man ni Baronda nga halin sang-una, ang tanan nga kaso nga ginapasaka batok sa ila pamilya ang lunsay pagpangguba lamang.
english: Baronda also described that since the beginning, all the cases filed against their family are all destruction.

text: Nagpanindugan man ini nga wala siya nakulbaan bangud indi man sila kawatan.
english: He also insisted that he was not nervous because they were not thieves.

text: Gin-athag man ni Baronda nga ang mga laragway nga ginpakigbahin ni Nava sa publiko nga ginapahayag sini nga ‘unexplained wealth’ ang lunsay ginhuram lamang niya.
english: Baronda also explained that the pictures that Nava shared with the public that he claimed to be 'unexplained wealth' were all borrowed by him.

text: Suno kay Baronda, ka damo sang mga may luyag nga magpahulam sa iya ilabi na nga indi lamang ila barangay ang iya igarepresentar sa tion sang State of the Nation Address (SONA) sang president.
english: According to Baronda, there are many people who want to lend to him especially since he will not only represent their barangay during the president's State of the Nation Address (SONA).

text: Para sa natungdan, kinahanglan lang nga dapat preparado ang representative sang syudad sa dako nga kahiwatan rason man nga dapat presentable sa publiko.
english: For the concerned, the representative of the city should be prepared for the big event and should be presentable to the public.

text: Tuman ka sakit kag mabudlay para sa pila ka mga driver ang pagsaka sang produktong petrolyo subong nga adlaw.
english: The increase in petroleum products today is very painful and difficult for some drivers.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Alyas T oto, isa ka delivery truck driver, iya ginpahayag nga dako nga epekto para sa ila kag sa ila kompanya ang pagtaas sang presyo sang gatong.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Alyas T oto, a delivery truck driver, said the increase in fuel prices has had a big impact on them and their company.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga kagab-i pa lang nagakaubusan na sang ordinaryo nga diesel nga iya ginatughong sa iya ginadrive nga truck, rason nga special diesel ang iya ginabakal nga nagadugang pa sang iya palaligban kun sa diin kuhaon ang kwarta sa pagbakal sang mahal nga gatong.
english: He said that since last night, he is running out of ordinary diesel in his truck, which is why he is buying special diesel, which adds to his concern about where to get the money to buy expensive fuel.

text: Ginpahayag pa sini nga nagalab-ot sang 60 ka litro ang kapasidad sang tangke sang truck nga iya ginabyahe kag kun magapadayon pa ang mataas nga presyo sang gatong, buhinan man sang kompanya ang ginahatag sa ila nga pang-gatong kag depende na lang sa ila kun paano nila ini paiguon.
english: He said that the tank capacity of the truck he is driving is 60 liters and if the high price of fuel continues, the company will reduce the amount of fuel given to them and it is up to them how they will manage it.

text: Dugang pa sini nga magluwas nga nabudlayan na sila, masakit man sa ila bulsa ang nagakatabo nga ila ginakonsidera bilang halit sa ila pangabuhian.
english: He added that besides being difficult, it is also painful in their pockets what is happening which they consider as a damage to their livelihood.

text: Masobra sa 100 ka tawo ang napatay kag masobra 700 ang pilason matapos nga gin-alegar nagpinalupok ang pwersa-militar sang Israel sa mga tawo sa Gaza nga nagpunsok agud kuntani nga makapangayo sang ayuda.
english: More than 100 people were killed and more than 700 wounded after Israeli military forces allegedly opened fire on people in Gaza who had gathered to seek help.

text: Suno sa health ministry sa Palestine, nagsaka na sa 112 ang numero sang patay (as of presst time) kag 750 naman ang nasamaran kag subong padayon pa nga ginabulong sa Al-Shifa Hospital nga haluson man makagana bangud sa epekto sang gyera.
english: According to the Palestinian health ministry, the death toll has risen to 112 (as of press time) and 750 are injured and are still being treated at Al-Shifa Hospital, which is almost overwhelmed by the effects of the war.

text: Sandig sa mga nakasaksi kag mga medics sa Al-Nabulsi sa south sang Gaza City, natabo ang ginapahayag nga “massacre” bangud sa Israeli Defense Forces, apang sabat naman sang militar, natabo ang casualties bangud sang bayolente nga pagtipon sang mga residente sa palibot sang mga truck nga nagaunod sang ayuda.
english: According to witnesses and medics in Al-Nabulsi south of Gaza City, the alleged “massacre” occurred because of the Israeli Defense Forces, but the military responded that the casualties occurred because of the violent gathering of residents around the trucks carrying aid.

text: Ini ang rason suno sa militar nga nagsampawanay ang mga ini kag nasamaran.
english: This is the reason, according to the military, that they fought each other and were injured.
