text: Makaligad sini, may opisyal ang Israeli Defense Forces nga nag-ako nga napalupok sila bilang warning kag sang ulihi napilitan na nga magtiro bangud sang mga nagdalalagan padulong sa mga truck kag sa tangke sang militar nga nagaupod man sa convoy.
english: Later, an Israeli Defense Forces officer admitted that they were fired as a warning and were later forced to shoot because of those who ran towards the trucks and the military tank that was also accompanying the convoy.

text: Suno sa opisyal, ang gintiro lamang amo ang mga ginlantaw nga delikado.
english: According to the official, only those who were considered dangerous were shot.

text: Ginsiling naman sang spokesman sang opisina ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga kadam-an sa mga napatay ang naipit sa mga truck.
english: A spokesman for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office said most of the dead were trapped in trucks.

text: Gina-review pa subong kun ano gid ang natabo apang para kay United States President Joe Biden, sigurado nga ini nga hitabo ang magapa-kumplikado pa sang negosasyon sa paghilway sang mga bihag.
english: What exactly happened is still being reviewed but for US President Joe Biden, this incident is sure to complicate negotiations on the release of the hostages.

text:
Ginahaboy na subong ang Israel sang wala-tuo nga pagpakamalaot halin sa Palestinian leaders kag iban pa nga mga pungsod bangud sa amo nga “massacre.”

Kumpirmado man nga magapatigayon sang meeting ang top body sang United Nations — sandig sa request sang Algeria — agud maistoryahan ang amo nga hitabo.#
english:
Israel is now being hurled with left-wing condemnation from Palestinian leaders and other countries over such a “massacre.”

It is also confirmed that the top body of the United Nations will hold a meeting — at the request of Algeria — to discuss the incident.

text: Nangako ang Pamahalaang Hapon na magbibigay ng suporta sa Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) at sa lalawigan ng Sulu para maisulong ang digital birth registration sa mga komunidad na nanganganib maging stateless o walang legal na pagkakakilanlan.
english: The Government of Japan has pledged to provide support to the Bangsamoro Autonomous Region in Muslim Mindanao (BARMM) and Sulu province to promote digital birth registration in communities at risk of becoming stateless or without legal identity.

text: Ayon sa Embahada ng Japan sa Maynila, ang programang pinamagatang “Project for Promoting Digital Birth Registration of Populations at Risk of Statelessness in BARMM” ay naglalayong gawing digital ang proseso ng civil registration ng mga lokal na tanggapan sa rehiyon.
english: According to the Embassy of Japan in Manila, the program entitled “Project for Promoting Digital Birth Registration of Populations at Risk of Statelessness in BARMM” aims to digitize the process of civil registration of local offices in the region.

text: Kabilang sa proyekto ang mobile birth registration na ihahatid sa mga liblib at mahihirap na lugar upang mas mapadali ang pagkuha ng birth certificate, lalo na para sa mga katutubo gaya ng Sama Bajau at mga pamilyang apektado ng armadong tunggalian.
english: The project includes mobile birth registration to be delivered to remote and difficult areas to facilitate the obtaining of birth certificates, especially for the indigenous people of Sama Bajau and families affected by armed conflict.

text: “Ang Official Development Assistance (ODA) na ito ay nagpapakita ng mataas na tiwala ng Japan sa pagpapalaganap ng human security na isinasaalang-alang ang pagkakaiba-iba ng mamamayan sa rehiyon,” pahayag ni Japanese Ambassador to the Philippines Endo Kazuya.
english: “This Official Development Assistance (ODA) demonstrates Japan's high confidence in promoting human security that takes into account the diversity of citizens in the region,” said Japanese Ambassador to the Philippines Endo Kazuya.

text: Ang proyekto ay ipinatutupad ng UNHCR (UN Refugee Agency) sa tulong ng grant mula sa Japan na nagkakahalaga ng JPY 858 milyon o humigit-kumulang USD 5.5 milyon.
english: The project is being implemented by UNHCR (UN Refugee Agency) with the help of a grant from Japan worth JPY 858 million or approximately USD 5.5 million.

text: Ayon sa embahada, ang proyekto ay makatutulong upang mapabilis ang pagproseso ng birth registration, lalo na sa mga batang hindi pa nairehistro mula sa mga pamilyang lumikas dahil sa gulo o karahasan sa rehiyon.
english: According to the embassy, ​​the project will help speed up the processing of birth registration, especially for children who have not yet been registered from families who have fled due to unrest or violence in the region.

text: Tinatayang 130,000 unregistered individuals mula sa 50 komunidad sa mga lalawigan ng Lanao del Sur, Maguindanao del Norte, Maguindanao del Sur, Basilan, Sulu, at Tawi-Tawi ang direktang makikinabang sa programa.
english: An estimated 130,000 unregistered individuals from 50 communities in the provinces of Lanao del Sur, Maguindanao del Norte, Maguindanao del Sur, Basilan, Sulu, and Tawi-Tawi will directly benefit from the program.

text: Ayon pa kay Kazuya, aabot sa 800,000 katao ang inaasahang indirect beneficiaries sa susunod na sampung taon.
english: According to Kazuya, up to 800,000 people are expected to be indirect beneficiaries in the next ten years.

text: Bilang bahagi ng implementasyon, personal na iniabot ni Ambassador Kazuya ang mga sasakyan, isang motorbangka, at advocacy kits sa lokal na pamahalaan sa Bongao, Tawi-Tawi upang palakasin ang kampanya sa kahalagahan ng birth registration.
english: As part of the implementation, Ambassador Kazuya personally handed over vehicles, a motorboat, and advocacy kits to the local government in Bongao, Tawi-Tawi to strengthen the campaign on the importance of birth registration.

text: Hindi kumbinsido ang economic think tank na Ibon Foundation na maaabot ng administrasyon ni Pangulong Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The economic think tank Ibon Foundation is not convinced that the administration of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang target nitong ibaba sa 3.8% ang budget deficit sa pagtatapos ng kanyang termino.
english: his target is to reduce the budget deficit to 3.8% by the end of his term.

text: Ayon kay Sonny Africa, Executive Director ng Ibon Foundation, mahihirapan ang pamahalaan na pababain ang budget deficit hangga’t nananatili ang kasalukuyang prioridad sa paggasta at pagbubuwis.
english: According to Sonny Africa, Executive Director of the Ibon Foundation, the government will find it difficult to reduce the budget deficit as long as the current priorities in spending and taxation remain.

text: “Pinapababa ang pondo para sa mga pangunahing serbisyo, habang binabawasan ang buwis ng mayayaman at ipinamumudmod ang bilyon-bilyong pisong ayuda.
english: “Funds for basic services are being reduced, while taxes on the rich are being cut and billions of pesos in aid are being cut.

text: Kung ganito ang focus ng gobyerno, hindi talaga bababa ang budget deficit,” ani Africa.
english: If this is the focus of the government, the budget deficit will not really go down,” Africa said.

text: Idinagdag niya na isang malinaw na palatandaan ng kakulangan sa pondo ng gobyerno ang tuloy-tuloy na pag-utang ng bansa para matustusan ang mga gastusin.
english: He added that a clear sign of the government's lack of funds is the country's continuous borrowing to meet expenses.

text: Ang budget deficit ay nangyayari kapag mas malaki ang ginagastos ng gobyerno kaysa sa kabuuang kinikita nito mula sa buwis at iba pang pinagkakakitaan.
english: A budget deficit occurs when the government spends more than the total revenue it receives from taxes and other sources.

text: Sa kasalukuyan, patuloy na lumalaki ang agwat sa pagitan ng kita at gastusin ng gobyerno.
english: Currently, the gap between government revenue and spending continues to widen.

text: Layunin ng administrasyon na mapababa ang deficit ratio sa 3.8% ng gross domestic product (GDP) pagsapit ng 2028.
english: The administration aims to bring the deficit ratio down to 3.8% of gross domestic product (GDP) by 2028.

text: Ngunit ayon sa Ibon Foundation, malabong makamit ito kung hindi babaguhin ang kasalukuyang polisiya sa buwis at paggasta.
english: However, according to the Ibon Foundation, this is unlikely to be achieved unless the current tax and spending policies are changed.

text: Binanggit din ni Africa na ang pagbawas sa pondo para sa basic services, gaya ng edukasyon, kalusugan, at pabahay ay nagpapahina sa kakayahan ng gobyerno na tumugon sa pangangailangan ng mamamayan.
english: Africa also mentioned that cuts in funding for basic services, such as education, health, and housing are weakening the government's ability to respond to the needs of the people.

text: Kasabay nito, aniya, ay ang patuloy na pagbibigay ng pabor sa mayayaman sa pamamagitan ng tax breaks.
english: At the same time, he said, is the continued favor of the rich through tax breaks.

text: “Habang pinapasan ng karaniwang Pilipino ang bigat ng buwis at mataas na presyo ng bilihin, lumalawak ang agwat sa yaman.
english: “As the average Filipino bears the burden of taxes and high prices, the wealth gap widens.

text: At ang kapalit nito ay mas malalim na utang para sa susunod na henerasyon,” dagdag pa ni Africa.
english: And the replacement is deeper debt for the next generation,” Africa added.

text: Hinimok ng Ibon Foundation ang pamahalaan na baguhin ang direksyon ng economic policy at bigyang-priyoridad ang mas makatarungan at inklusibong pag-unlad upang mapanatili ang fiscal sustainability nang hindi isinasakripisyo ang kapakanan ng mamamayan.
english: The Ibon Foundation urged the government to change the direction of economic policy and prioritize more equitable and inclusive development in order to maintain fiscal sustainability without sacrificing the welfare of the people.

text: Igo sa na-wala nga bahin sang truck nga may karga nga tubo matapos nga nagpalupok sang armas ang isa ka barangay kagawad nga sakay sa Mitsubishi Xpander sa Brgy.
english: A barangay kagawad aboard a Mitsubishi Xpander in Brgy.

text: Quinolpan San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: They are located in San Enrique, Iloilo.

text: Ang barangay kagawad ang residente sang Brgy.
english: The barangay kagawad is a resident of Brgy.

text: Imbang Pequeño, San Enrique, Iloilo, samtang ang driver sang truck ang residente sang Brgy.
english: Imbang Pequeño, San Enrique, Iloilo, while the driver of the truck is a resident of Brgy.

text: Abaca, San Enrique, Iloilo.
english: Abaca, San Enrique, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Cristi Val Dalde, hepe sang San Enrique Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga naghalin ang duha ka salakyan sa syudad sang Passi kag padulong kontani sa banwa sang San Enrique.
english: Police Lieutenant Cristi Val Dalde, chief of the San Enrique Municipal Police Station, said the two vehicles left Passi City and were heading to San Enrique town.

text: Suno kay Dalde, nagit-gitanay ang duha ka salakyan sa dalan rason nga nagtuga sang komosyon sa mga driver sini.
english: According to Dalde, the two vehicles collided on the road causing commotion among the drivers.

text: Sang nag-abot na ang duha ka salakyan sa nasambit nga barangay, gilayon nga ginpanaog sang driver sang Mitsubishi Xpander ang iya windshield kag gintiro padalom ang truck nga may karga nga tubo.
english: When the two vehicles arrived in the said barangay, the driver of the Mitsubishi Xpander immediately lowered his windshield and shot down the truck loaded with pipes.

text: Gintuad ni Dalde nga ang trajectory sang bala ang nag-igo sa na-wala nga bahin sang truck.
english: Dalde admitted that the trajectory of the bullet hit the left side of the truck.

text: Gilayon naman nga nagpalagyo ang driver sang Mitsubishi Xpander, apang, natandaan ini sang driver sang truck lakip na ang plate number.
english: The driver of the Mitsubishi Xpander immediately fled the scene, but the driver of the truck remembered the plate number.

text: Nagpatuman naman sang hot pursuit operation ang San Enrique PNP kag naabtan ang barangay kagawad nga driver nga yara na sa ila balay.
english: San Enrique PNP conducted a hot pursuit operation and found the barangay kagawad driver who was already at his house.

text: Natukiban man nga may impluwensya sang makahulubog nga ilimnon ang nasambit nga kagawad.
english: The kagawad was also found to be under the influence of alcohol.

text: Ginpasakaan ini sang kaso nga attempted murder apang gilayon man nga nakapiyansa sa balor nga P40,000 to P50,000.
english: He was charged with attempted murder but was immediately released on bail of P40,000 to P50,000.

text: Wala naman narekober sang kapulisan ang armas nga gingamit sang barangay kagawad, kag wala man sang narekober nga bala sa lugar kon sa diin nagluntad ang insidente.
english: Police did not recover the weapon used by the barangay kagawad, nor did they recover any ammunition from the scene of the incident.

text: Ini man ang rason kon ngaa attempted murder lang ang napasaka sa barangay kagawad kag indi paglapas sa RA 10591 ukon ang Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act in relation to Commission on Elections (COMELEC) gun ban.
english: This is also the reason why only attempted murder was filed against the barangay kagawad and not violation of RA 10591 or the Comprehensive Firearms and Ammunition Regulation Act in relation to Commission on Elections (COMELEC) gun ban.

text: Mas naglapad pa ang nahalitan sang wildfire nga nagakatabo subong sa Texas Panhandle sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag amo na ang ginakabig nga ikaduha sa pinakadaku nga sunog nga nagluntad sa bug-os nga maragtas sang amo nga estado.
english: The wildfire that is currently raging in the Texas Panhandle in the United States of America is considered the second largest fire in the history of the state.

text: Ang Texas Panhandle amo ang rehiyon sa Texas nga ginabug-usan sang 26 ka counties sa northern nga bahin sang state.
english: The Texas Panhandle is the region in Texas that consists of 26 counties in the northern part of the state.

text: Kaiping sini ang New Mexico sa west kag ang Oklahoma sa north kag east.
english: It is bordered by New Mexico to the west and Oklahoma to the north and east.

text: Sa lima ka major wildfires sa amo nga rehiyon, malapit na sa 900,000 ka ektarya ang nalamon sang kalayo nga rason sang pagbakwit sang mga tawo, ginpasirado ang mga dalan, kag gindeklarar na ang emerhensya.
english: Of the five major wildfires in the region, nearly 900,000 hectares have been engulfed in flames, causing evacuations, road closures, and declarations of emergency.

text: Sa latest nga impormasyon, ang pinakadaku nga sunog amo ang sa Smokehouse Creek, north sang Amarillo, nga nakahalit na sa 850,000 ka ektarya kag tres porsyento pa lamang sini ang napalong.
english: According to the latest information, the largest fire is in Smokehouse Creek, north of Amarillo, which has already damaged 850,000 hectares and is only three percent contained.

text: Nagpaguwa naman si Texas Gov.
english: Texas Gov.

text: Greg Abbott sang disaster declaration sa 60 ka counties kag ginhingyo man ang Texans nga limitahan ang mga aktibidad nga makabutang sa ila nga pamilya kag mga abyan sa risgo.
english: Greg Abbott of the disaster declaration in 60 counties and also urged Texans to limit activities that could put their family and friends at risk.

text:
Ginakahangaw-an nga maglala pa ang sitwasyon bangud sa mabaskog nga huyop sang hangin, mataas nga temperatura kag laya nga mga hilamon nga amo pa ang rason kun ngaa madasig nga nagalapta ang kalayo.#

(Photo: NBC News)
english:
The situation is feared to worsen due to strong winds, high temperatures and dry grass which is the reason why the fire is spreading quickly.

(Photo: NBC News)

text: Manogtapos na ang negotiation stage sang Aboitiz Group kag sang Committee on Public Private Partnership sang Iloilo City Government kaangot sa proposal nga bulk water supply.
english: The negotiation stage of the Aboitiz Group and the Committee on Public Private Partnership of the Iloilo City Government regarding the proposed bulk water supply is coming to an end.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Dave Garcia, vice chairman sang Committee on Public Private Partnership, iya gin-athag nga nakatalana kontani nga matapos ang ika-80 nga adlaw sang negosasyon sa Abril 28, 2025.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Dave Garcia, vice chairman of the Committee on Public Private Partnership, explained that the 80th day of negotiations was scheduled to end on April 28, 2025.

text: Suno kay Garcia, okay naman ang price range nga gintanyag sang nasambit nga kompanya nga nagadalagan sa P37 to P41 per cubic meter.
english: According to Garcia, the price range offered by the company is okay which runs from P37 to P41 per cubic meter.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ‘reasonable’ man ang balor sang tubig bangud mahimo nga 2029 ukon 2030 pa mag-epekto.
english: He also said that the value of water is also 'reasonable' because it could take effect in 2029 or 2030.

text: Gintuad man ni Garcia nga manageable na man ang obligasyon sang syudad sa pagproseso sang water permit and rights.
english: Garcia also acknowledged that the city's obligation to process water permits and rights is manageable.

text: Nag-resign sa posisyon si Palestinian Prime Minister Mohammad Shtayyeh nga amo ang nagapamuno lakip sa okupado nga West Bank bangud sa padayon nga kalakasan sa nasakpan nga teritoryo kag amo man ang gyera sa Gaza.
english: Palestinian Prime Minister Mohammad Shtayyeh, who is in charge of the occupied West Bank, has resigned due to continued violence in the occupied territory and the war in Gaza.

text: Sa resignation letter sini nga ginpasa kay Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas, ginsiling sini nga ang rason amo ang paglala sang away sa West Bank kag Jerusalem kag ang genocide kag kagutom sa Gaza Strip.
english: In its resignation letter submitted to Palestinian Authority President Mahmoud Abbas, it said the reason was the escalating conflict in the West Bank and Jerusalem and genocide and hunger in the Gaza Strip.

text: “I see that the next stage and its challenges require new governmental and political arrangements that take into account the new reality in Gaza and the need for a Palestinian-Palestinian consensus based on Palestinian unity and the extension of unity of authority over the land of Palestine,” pahayag sini.
english: “I see that the next stage and its challenges require new governmental and political arrangements that take into account the new reality in Gaza and the need for a Palestinian-Palestinian consensus based on Palestinian unity and the extension of unity of authority over the land of Palestine,” it said.

text: Ginbaton ni Abbas ang resignation sang opisyal apang gin-hingyo ini nga magpabilin anay nga caretaker tubtub nga may ma-appoint nga permanente nga replacement.
english: Abbas accepted the official's resignation but asked him to remain as caretaker until a permanent replacement is appointed.

text: Ang tikang ni Shtayyeh ang kasunod sang pag-pressure sang US kay Abbas nga i-reorganize ang Palestinian Authority (PA) kag magsugod na sa pag-establisar sang political structure nga amo ang magapamuno sa Palestinian state kasunod sang gyera.
english: Shtayyeh's move follows US pressure on Abbas to reorganize the Palestinian Authority (PA) and begin establishing the political structure that will lead the Palestinian state following the war.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, sulit-sulit naman nga ginbasura ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ang panawagan sang PA sa idalom ni Abbas nga amo ang magakontrol sa Palestinian state kag magpamuno sa Gaza.
english: Meanwhile, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has repeatedly rejected the PA's call under Abbas to take control of the Palestinian state and lead Gaza.

text:
Sang nagligad nga semana, ginsuportahan man sang Israeli lawmakers ang rejection ni Netanyahu sa anuman nga “unilateral” recognition sang Palestinian state.#

([Anna Szilagyi/EPA])
english:
Last week, Israeli lawmakers also supported Netanyahu’s rejection of any “unilateral” recognition of a Palestinian state.#

([Anna Szilagyi/EPA])

text: Nanindigan ang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) sa kahalagahan ng mapanuring pag-iisip at pagiging mapagmatyag ng mga kabataang Pilipino, bilang tugon sa panawagan ng China para sa “dayalogo at pagkakaibigan” sa kabila ng patuloy na tensyon sa West Philippine Sea.
english: The Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) stressed the importance of critical thinking and sensitivity of Filipino youth, in response to China's call for “dialogue and friendship” despite the ongoing tensions in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Sa pagdiriwang ng ika-50 anibersaryo ng ugnayang diplomatiko ng Pilipinas at China, sinabi ni Chinese Minister Councilor Wang Yulei, na kumatawan kay Ambassador Huang Xilian, na inaasahan ng China na ang mga kabataang Pilipino ay magiging “ambassadors of peace” o tagapagdala ng kapayapaan sa pagitan ng dalawang bansa.
english: In celebration of the 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations between the Philippines and China, Chinese Minister Councilor Wang Yulei, who represented Ambassador Huang Xilian, said that China expects Filipino youth to become “ambassadors of peace” between the two countries.

text: “To view bilateral relations objectively and rationally, and to become messengers of friendship between our two countries,” ani Wang sa event na inorganisa ng Federation of Filipino Chinese Chambers of Commerce & Industry, Inc.
english: “To view bilateral relations objectively and rationally, and to become messengers of friendship between our two countries,” Wang said at the event organized by the Federation of Filipino Chinese Chambers of Commerce & Industry, Inc.

text: (FFCCCII).
english: (FFCCCII).

text: Hinimok din niya ang kabataan na “malampasan ang misinformation at prejudice upang makita ang tunay na China.” Gayunman, hindi tinukoy ng Chinese Embassy kung anong klase ng “misinformation” ang tinutukoy nito.
english: He also urged the youth to “overcome misinformation and prejudice to see the real China.” However, the Chinese Embassy did not specify what kind of “misinformation” it was referring to.

text: Bilang tugon, iginiit ng DFA na mas mahalaga ang pagiging kritikal at mapanuri sa mga isyu.
english: In response, DFA stressed the importance of being critical and critical of issues.

text: “The youth should be vigilant, focused, and develop a sharp mind and discernment of events to fight against all forms of misinformation.
english: “The youth should be vigilant, focused, and develop a sharp mind and discernment of events to fight against all forms of misinformation.

text: The DFA will continue to work with partners to strengthen resilience among our youth,” ayon sa pahayag ng ahensya.
english: The DFA will continue to work with partners to strengthen resilience among our youth,” the agency said in a statement.

text: Dagdag pa ng DFA, sang-ayon naman ang lahat sa kahalagahan ng dayalogo at diplomasya, ngunit matagal na umano itong isinusulong ng mga Pilipino, hindi isang bagong panukala mula sa China.
english: The DFA added that everyone agrees on the importance of dialogue and diplomacy, but it has been advocated by the Filipinos for a long time, not a new proposal from China.

text: Samantala, nananatiling mainit ang tensyon sa pagitan ng Pilipinas at China dahil sa agawan ng teritoryo sa South China Sea, lalo na’t hindi kinikilala ng Beijing ang 2016 arbitral ruling na pumabor sa Pilipinas at ibinasura ang malawak na “ten-dash line” claim ng China.
english: Meanwhile, tensions between the Philippines and China remain hot over territorial disputes in the South China Sea, especially since Beijing does not recognize the 2016 arbitral ruling that favored the Philippines and rejected China's extensive "ten-dash line" claim.

text: Kamakailan, kinondena ng gobyerno ng Pilipinas ang paggamit ng water cannon ng Chinese Coast Guard laban sa isang barko ng Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) na nagsasagawa ng operasyon sa loob ng exclusive economic zone (EEZ) ng bansa.
english: The Philippine government has recently condemned the use of a water cannon by the Chinese Coast Guard against a Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) ship conducting operations within the country's exclusive economic zone (EEZ).

text: Habang pinalalakas ng China ang mga aktibidad sa social media upang akitin ang kabataan, ipinapakita ng DFA na hindi sapat ang pagkakaibigan o pag-asa lamang.
english: As China steps up its social media activities to attract young people, the DFA shows that friendship or hope alone is not enough.

text: Sa halip, ang kritikal na pag-unawa sa regional affairs ang dapat magsilbing gabay ng susunod na henerasyon ng mga Pilipino.
english: Instead, a critical understanding of regional affairs should guide the next generation of Filipinos.

text: Mapasa sang petition letter sa Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) ang pila ka transport cooperatives agud nga indi pagpabalikon-byhae ang mga unconsolidated jeepneys.
english: Some transport cooperatives will submit a petition letter to the Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) to prevent the return of unconsolidated jeepneys.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Raymundo “Boyet” Parcon, presidente sang Iloilo City Loop Alliance of Jeepney Operators and Drivers Association (ICLAJODA) kag chairman sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC), iya ginpahayag nga magapatuman siya pagsinapol kaupod ang myembro sang ila alliance nga kooperatiba agud nga mahugpong sila sa amo nga plano.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Raymundo “Boyet” Parcon, president of the Iloilo City Loop Alliance of Jeepney Operators and Drivers Association (ICLAJODA) and chairman of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC), said he will hold a meeting with members of their alliance to cooperate on the plan.

text: Suno kay Parcon, ang numero sang mga units nga na-consolidate sa syudad ang yara sa 91% kon sa diin, may yara naman sang Local Public Transport Route Plan (LPTRP).
english: According to Parcon, the number of units consolidated in the city is at 91% where there is a Local Public Transport Route Plan (LPTRP).

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang LPTRP ang indi na dapat pagtandugon kag kon pahanugotan ang mga unconsolidated jeepney nga magbyahe, mangin dako nga palamangkutanon kon diin sila magabyahe.
english: He also said that the LPTRP should not be touched and if unconsolidated jeepneys are allowed to operate, it will be a big question where they will operate.

text: Dugang ni Parcon, tinghuwaan sang ila grupo nga mabalabagan ang tikang nga hatagan sang kahigayunan nga makabyahe ang mga wala na-consolidate nga mga jeepneys.

text: Ginpangguba sang Amerika ang tatlo ka attack drones sang Houthi malapit sa mga commercial ships sa Red Sea amo man ang pito ka anti-ship cruise missiles nga naka-pwesto sa amo nga teritoryo.
english: The United States destroyed three Houthi attack drones near commercial ships in the Red Sea as well as seven anti-ship cruise missiles stationed in the territory.

text: Suno sa Central Command, bangud nakauna sa paghulag ang pwersa sang Amerika, wala sang may nahalitan sa mga barko sa Red Sea.
english: According to Central Command, because American forces were able to move first, none of the ships in the Red Sea were damaged.

text: Ginsaad man sa statement nga ginahanda na kuntani sang rebelde nga Houthi nga ilunsar ang missiles sa Red Sea ukon ang global trade route.

text: Ang strikes naman sang Amerika ang gintawag lamang nila nga self-defense.
english: The American strikes were called self-defense.

text: Antes sini, gin-igu man sang American forces ang apat ka drones sang Houthi lakip na ang duha ka anti-ship cruise missiles.
english: Earlier, American forces also shot down four Houthi drones including two anti-ship cruise missiles.

text: Matandaan nga Nobyembre sang nagligad nga tuig sang nagsugod ang Houthis sa pag-atake sa Red Sea kun sa diin ang mga ginapuntariya sini amo ang mga barko nga naangot sa Israel.
english: It can be recalled that in November last year, the Houthis began attacking the Red Sea where they targeted ships linked to Israel.

english: The United States and the United Kingdom retaliated with major strikes against the Yemen-based, Iranian-backed rebels.

text: Inanunsyo ni Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla na magsisimula ngayong linggo ang operasyon sa paghahanap ng mga nawawalang sabungero sa Taal Lake.
english: Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla announced that the operation to search for the missing sabungero in Taal Lake will begin this week.

text: Ayon kay Remulla, humingi na sila ng tulong mula sa Philippine Coast Guard at iba pang ahensiya upang tuklasin ang lugar, matapos umanong aminin ng isa sa mga akusado na doon itinapon ang mga bangkay ng mga biktima.
english: According to Remulla, they have already asked for help from the Philippine Coast Guard and other agencies to search the area, after one of the accused allegedly admitted that the bodies of the victims were dumped there.

text: Sinabi ni Remulla na mahalaga ang pagma-mapa ng lawa para maayos ang plano sa operasyon.
english: Remulla said mapping the lake is important for proper operation planning.

text: Ayon sa Department of Science and Technology (DOST), may posibilidad pa ring marekober ang mga buto kung tunay na sa lawa sila ibinaon.
english: According to the Department of Science and Technology (DOST), there is still a possibility of recovering the bones if they were actually thrown into the lake.

text: Samantala, hiniling na rin ng DOJ ang tulong ng Japan para sa mga advanced equipment gaya ng remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) upang galugarin ang lalim ng lawa na umaabot sa 170 metro.
english: Meanwhile, the DOJ has also requested Japan's assistance for advanced equipment such as remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) to measure the depth of the lake, which reaches 170 meters.

text: Kasabay nito, sinabi rin ni Remulla na iniimbestigahan na ng Korte Suprema ang posibleng pagkakasangkot ng ilang miyembro ng hudikatura, matapos pangalanan ng suspek na si Julie Patidongan ang isang dating hukom at ilang kilalang personalidad.
english: Meanwhile, Remulla said the Supreme Court is investigating the possible involvement of some members of the judiciary, after the suspect, Julie Patidongan, named a former judge and some well-known personalities.

text: Patuloy ang koordinasyon ng DOJ, PNP, NBI, at iba pang ahensiya sa imbestigasyon sa likod ng pagkawala ng higit 30 sabungero noong 2021 hanggang 2022.
english: DOJ, PNP, NBI, and other agencies continue to coordinate the investigation behind the disappearance of more than 30 sabungero from 2021 to 2022.

text: Mas nagapalapit pa si anay US President Donald Trump sa presidential nomination sang Republican Party matapos sini ginlutos ang kasumpong nga si Nikki Haley sa iya mismo home state sa South Carolina.
english: Former US President Donald Trump is getting closer to the Republican Party's presidential nomination after defeating his opponent Nikki Haley in his home state of South Carolina.

text: Nagdaog ang 77-anyos nga anay presidente nga may 20-point margin batok kay Haley nga isa anay ka United Nations ambassador kag two-term governor sang South Carolina halin sang 2011 tubtub sang 2017.
english: The 77-year-old former president won by a 20-point margin over Haley, a former United Nations ambassador and two-term governor of South Carolina from 2011 to 2017.

text: Ini na ang ikapaat nga sunod-sunod nga kadalag-an ni Trump matapos nga nakuha man ang kadam-an sang mga boto sa estado sang Iowa, New Hampshire, kag Nevada.
english: This is Trump's fourth consecutive victory after also winning a majority of votes in the states of Iowa, New Hampshire, and Nevada.

text: Apisar sini nga kalutusan, nagpasalig si Haley bilang nabilin nga challenger ni Trump nga magapadayon ini sa pagpangampanya tubtub sa Super Tuesday ukon sa Marso 5 kun sa diin magaboto ang mga botante sa 16 ka states sa sulod lamang sang isa ka adlaw.
english: Despite this defeat, Haley promised as Trump's remaining challenger that she will continue campaigning until Super Tuesday or March 5 when voters in 16 states will vote in just one day.

text: “There are huge numbers of voters in our Republican primaries who are saying they want an alternative.
english: “There are huge numbers of voters in our Republican primaries who are saying they want an alternative.

text: I’m not giving up this fight when a majority of Americans disapprove of both Donald Trump and Joe Biden,” suno kay Haley.
english: I’m not giving up this fight when a majority of Americans disapprove of both Donald Trump and Joe Biden,” according to Haley.

text: Sa victory speech naman ni Trump, wala na sini gin-mensyonar si Haley bangud mas nakatutok na ini sa general election nga matabo sa Nobyembre kun sa diin daku ang posibilidad nga may rematch sila ni US President Joe Biden.
english: In his victory speech, Trump did not mention Haley because he was more focused on the general election in November where there is a high possibility of a rematch with US President Joe Biden.

text: Liwat nga ginpasalig ni Trump nga palayason sini ang Democrat nga si Biden sa White House.
english: Trump reiterated his commitment to kick Democrat Biden out of the White House.

text: “We’re going to look Joe Biden right in the eye.
english: “We’re going to look Joe Biden right in the eye.

text: He’s destroying our country – and we’re going to say ‘get out Joe, you’re fired’,” pahayag ni Trump.
english: He’s destroying our country – and we’re going to say ‘get out Joe, you’re fired’,” Trump said.

text: Ginsiling man sini nga subong pa lang sini na kita kun daw ano ka pag-on ang pag-isa sang Republican Party: “I just want to say that I have never seen the Republican party so unified as it is right now.
english: He also said that we are just now seeing how united the Republican Party is: “I just want to say that I have never seen the Republican party so unified as it is right now.

text: This is a fantastic evening.
english: This is a fantastic evening.

english: It’s an early evening, and fantastic.”#

text: Ginpaidalom sa psychiatric evaluation subong nga adlaw ang lalaki nga nagtuyo nga mag-vlog sa ibabaw sang signage tower sang Plazuela De Iloilo sa Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: A man who tried to vlog on top of the signage tower of Plazuela De Iloilo in Mandurriao, Iloilo City was subjected to psychiatric evaluation today.

text: Ini amo si Alyas Joms, residente sang Janiuay, Iloilo kag isa ka vlogger.
english: This is Alyas Joms, resident of Janiuay, Iloilo and a vlogger.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Cosmeflor Marco, Jr., Deputy Chief of Police sang Iloilo City Police Station 10, iya ginpahayag nga ginpaidalom na sa psychiatric evaluation ang vlogger sa Western Visayas Medical Center – Psychiatric Section.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Cosmeflor Marco, Jr., Deputy Chief of Police of Iloilo City Police Station 10, said the vlogger has already undergone psychiatric evaluation at the Western Visayas Medical Center – Psychiatric Section.

text: Suno kay Marco, gin-updan ang vlogger sang Women and Children’s Protection Desk (WPCD) kag sang iya utod nga babaye sa nasambit nga hospital.
english: According to Marco, the vlogger was accompanied by the Women and Children's Protection Desk (WPCD) and his sister to the said hospital.

text: Kon makumpirma naman nga nagasuprer ang vlogger sang depresyon, gilayon ini i-refer sa Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).
english: If it is confirmed that the vlogger is suffering from depression, he will be immediately referred to the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).

text: Ginkumpirma man sini nga ginpabulong man ang anak sang vlogger nga una na gintuad niya nga may sakit sa tutonlan.
english: He also confirmed that the vlogger's son, who had previously admitted to having a sore throat, was also treated.

text: Kon balikan, napuhag ang mga tawo kahapon nga adlaw ang pagsaka sang vlogger sa signage tower kon sa diin, gilayon man nga ginrespondehan sang Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) kag sang kapulisan.
english: Looking back, people were shocked yesterday when the vlogger climbed the signage tower where the Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) and the police immediately responded.

text: Liwat nga naghingyo si Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky sa Kongreso sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga aprubahan na ang dugang nga ayuda para sa Ukraine bangud posible nga mas madamo pa ang mapatay kun indi mag-abot ang bulig.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has once again asked the US Congress to approve more aid for Ukraine because more people may die if the aid does not arrive.

text: “Will Ukraine survive without Congress’ support?

english: The president's statement follows what is happening in the US where Republican lawmakers are preventing the House of Representatives from approving $60 billion or P3.4-trillion in aid to Ukraine.

text: Nagpaandam man ang Ukrainian leader nga mas mahapos na ang pagbulig sa Kyiv ipaanggid sa pagkumpronta kay Russian President Vladimir Putin pananglitan magmadinalag-on ini sa pag-atake sa bug-os nga Ukraine.
english: The Ukrainian leader also warned that it would be easier to help Kyiv than to confront Russian President Vladimir Putin if he succeeds in attacking the whole of Ukraine.

english: In addition, former US President Donald Trump, who is the likely Republican nominee in the presidential elections in November, is opposed to helping Kyiv.

text: Nagaplano ang World Health Organization (WHO) nga sayluhon ang ginabanta 140 ka mga pasyente nga stranded sa Nasser hospital sa Gaza bangud sa pahayag sang Palestinian officials nga may mga bangkay na nga nagakadunot bangud sa padayon nga pag-utod sang suplay sang kuryente sa tunga sang gyera sang Israel kag Hamas.
english: The World Health Organization (WHO) plans to evacuate an estimated 140 patients stranded at Nasser hospital in Gaza following claims by Palestinian officials that some bodies are already decomposing due to ongoing power cuts between the war between Israel and Hamas.

english: According to the WHO, the hospital, the second largest in Gaza, stopped functioning last week after Israeli military forces entered it and dug up mass graves on suspicion of Hamas militants.

text: Padayon suno sa organisasyon ang ila himuon nga pagsaylo sang kritikal na kag pilason nga mga pasyente agud mas matatapan sila sa iban nga pasilidad sa south.
english: The organization said it will continue to transfer critical and injured patients to other facilities in the south.

text: “The WHO will continue to try evacuation of those critically ill and critically wounded patients from the Nasser hospital to other hospitals in the south, including the field hospitals that have been established in Rafah.
english: “The WHO will continue to try evacuation of those critically ill and critically wounded patients from the Nasser hospital to other hospitals in the south, including the field hospitals that have been established in Rafah.

text: Matandaan nga nagsugod ang Holy Year sang Disyembre 2024 sa pagpanguna ni Pope Francis sang ginbuksan man sini ang Holy Door.
english: The Holy Year began in December 2024 under the leadership of Pope Francis when he also opened the Holy Door.

text: Ang bilog nga tuig ginkabig nga selebrasyon kag tion sang repleksyon kag penitensya para sa masobra 1.4-billion ka mga Katoliko sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: The whole year has been considered celebration and a time of reflection and penance for more than 1.4-billion Catholics around the world.

text: Masobra man sa 33 milyones nga mga tumuluo halin sa 185 ka mga pungsod ang nagbisita sa Roma sa sini nga espesyal nga tuig.
english: More than 33 million believers from 185 lands also visited Rome during this special year.

text: Sa kada Jubilee Year nga gina-organisar sang Simbahan sa kada 25 ka tuig, ang kada tumuluo nga nagaagi sa holy doors ang nagabenepisyo sa “plenary indulgence” ukon ang sahi sang pagpatawad sa ila nga mga sala.
english: Every Jubilee Year organized by the Church every 25 years, every believer who passes through the holy doors benefits from a “plenary indulgence” or a kind of forgiveness of their sins.

text: Pinasahi man ini nga Jubilee bangud si Pope Francis ang nag-inagura, apang bangud sa iya kamatayon, si Pope Leo ang nagtapos.
english: This Jubilee is also special because Pope Francis inaugurated it, but due to his death, Pope Leo ended it.

text: Katapusan nga natabo ini nga senaryo sa Catholic Church sang 1700.
english: This scenario last happened in the Catholic Church in the 1700s.

text: Ginmando ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco P. Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: ang mas hugot nga pagbantay sa mga supermarket kag wet market agud masiguro ang husto nga pag-label sang frozen meat.
english: tighter supervision of supermarkets and wet markets to ensure accurate labeling of frozen meat.

text: Ini bilang kabahin sang tikang sang Department of Agriculture (DA) nga protektahan ang mga consumer kag local nga manugbaboy.
english: This is part of the Department of Agriculture (DA)'s efforts to protect consumers and local pig farmers.

text: Direktiba ni Laurel sa Agribusiness and Marketing Assistance Service (AMAS), Bureau of Animal Industry (BAI), kag National Meat Inspection Service (NMIS) nga magpatigayon sang nationwide inspection agud sekyaron ang pagsunod sang mga tindahan kag balaklan sa food safety kag fair trade regulations.
english: Laurel directed the Agribusiness and Marketing Assistance Service (AMAS), Bureau of Animal Industry (BAI), and National Meat Inspection Service (NMIS) to conduct nationwide inspections to ensure compliance of shops and markets with food safety and fair trade regulations.

text: Kadungan ini sang tikang sang DA kag mga local hog producer para i-stabilize ang presyo sang karne sang baboy kag buligan ang mga nagasagod sang baboy nga apektado sang pagnubo sang farmgate prices.
english: This is in line with the move by the DA and local hog producers to stabilize the price of pork and help pig farmers affected by the reduction in farmgate prices.

text: Nagsaka ang Pinoy boxing icon nga si Manny Pacquiao sa number one sa World Boxing Council (WBC) welterweight ranking.
english: Pinoy boxing icon Manny Pacquiao has risen to number one in the World Boxing Council (WBC) welterweight ranking.

text: Ini matapos ang iya nga comeback fight batok sa American boxer nga si Mario Barrios nga nagtakop sa majority draw sang nagligad nga bulan sa Las Vegas, Nevada, USA.
english: This follows his comeback fight against American boxer Mario Barrios which ended in a majority draw last month in Las Vegas, Nevada, USA.

text: Kasunod sini nga ranking sa WBC, posible nga may matabo nga rematch batok kay Barrios.
english: Following this WBC ranking, a rematch against Barrios is likely.

text: 46-anyos na ang eight-division world champion kag sa iya hampang batok sa 30-anyos nga American fighter, siya ang underdog, apang sa aktwal na nga sambuwa, leading pa siya sa tanan nga scorecards sa nine rounds kag kun nagdaog kuntani ini sang amo nga tion, siya ang mangin second-oldest world champion sa boxing history.
english: The 46-year-old eight-division world champion and in his match against the 30-year-old American fighter, he was the underdog, but in the actual fight, he was still leading in all scorecards in the nine rounds and if he had won at that time, he would have been the second-oldest world champion in boxing history.

text: Gina-uyatan sini ang record nga 62 wins, 8 losses, kag 2 draws, nga may 39 knockouts.
english: It holds a record of 62 wins, 8 losses, and 2 draws, with 39 knockouts.

text: Una na nga naghatag sang clue ang Hall-of-Famer nga maga-away siya liwat sa Disyembre, apang wala ini sang kumpirmasyon kun sa Estados Unidos sa gihapon ang iya hampang.
english: The Hall-of-Famer has previously hinted that he will fight again in December, but has not confirmed whether he will still fight in the United States.

text: Sinuspinde ng Land Transportation Office (LTO) ang driver’s license ng internet personality at negosyanteng si Josh Mojica, 21-anyos.
english: The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has suspended the driver’s license of internet personality and businessman Josh Mojica, 21-years-old.

text: Ito ay matapos masangkot sa isang paglabag sa batas trapiko ang kilalang personalidad.
english: This is after the well-known personality was involved in a traffic violation.

text: Kinumpirma ng LTO sa kanilang opisyal na pahayag na kuha sa video ang aktong pagmamaneho ni Mojica habang kinukuhanan ang sarili gamit ang cellphone —malinaw na paglabag umano sa Anti-Distracted Driving Act.
english: The LTO confirmed in its official statement that Mojica was caught on video driving while filming himself with a cellphone — a clear violation of the Anti-Distracted Driving Act.

text: Ayon kay LTO Chief Assistant Secretary Vigor Mendoza II, hindi dahilan ang uri o halaga ng sasakyan para balewalain ang batas.
english: According to LTO Chief Assistant Secretary Vigor Mendoza II, the type or value of the vehicle is not a reason to ignore the law.

text: Makikita pa sa video na in-upload mismo ni Mojica na siya ay nagmamaneho ng isang mamahaling sasakyan habang may hawak na cellphone.
english: The video uploaded by Mojica himself shows him driving an expensive car while holding a cellphone.

text:
May caption pa ito na, ”Life’s so fckn good when u stay masipag & pogi.”

Umani ito ng matinding batikos mula sa netizens, na tinawag ang kanyang kilos na iresponsable.
english:
It even has the caption, ”Life’s so fckn good when u stay hardworking & handsome.”

This was followed by strong criticism from netizens, who called his actions irresponsible.

text: Marami ang nagsabing bilang isang public figure, dapat ay nagsisilbi siyang huwaran sa kanyang mga tagasubaybay.
english: Many said that as a public figure, he should serve as an example to his followers.

text: Batay sa Show Cause Order (SCO) na inisyu ng LTO-Intelligence and Investigation Division sa pangunguna ni Chief Renante Melitante, nahaharap si Mojica sa Reckless Driving, Paglabag sa Anti-Distracted Driving Act (Sec.
english: According to the Show Cause Order (SCO) issued by the LTO-Intelligence and Investigation Division led by Chief Renante Melitante, Mojica is facing charges of Reckless Driving, Violation of the Anti-Distracted Driving Act (Sec.

text: 4 ng R.A. No.
english: 4 of R.A. No.

text: 10913, at Being an Improper Person to Operate a Motor Vehicle (Sec.
english: 10913, and Being an Improper Person to Operate a Motor Vehicle (Sec.

text: 27(a) ng R.A. No.
english: 27(a) of R.A. No.

text: Ang huling kaso ay maaaring magresulta sa tuluyang pagkansela ng kanyang lisensiya.
english: The latter case could result in the permanent revocation of his license.

text: Bukod sa suspensiyon, inatasan din si Mojica na humarap sa LTO upang ipaliwanag kung bakit hindi siya dapat patawan ng karampatang administrative penalties.
english: Besides the suspension, Mojica was also ordered to appear before the LTO to explain why he should not be given appropriate administrative penalties.

text: Samantala, isinailalim na rin sa alarm list ng LTO ang kanyang Porsche habang nagpapatuloy ang imbestigasyon.
english: Meanwhile, the LTO has also placed his Porsche on the alarm list while the investigation continues.

text: Matatandaang si Mojica ay unang nakilala noong 2021 matapos mag-viral ang kanyang kwento kung paano siya kumita mula sa pagbebenta ng homemade kangkong chips.
english: Mojica was first recognized in 2021 after her story of how she earned money from selling homemade kangkong chips went viral.

text: Mula noon ay naging kilala siya bilang isang batang negosyante at influencer.
english: Since then, he has become known as a young entrepreneur and influencer.

text: Muling iginiit ng LTO na ang kasikatan at karangyaan ay hindi sapat na dahilan upang isantabi ang kaligtasan sa kalsada.
english: The LTO once again stressed that fame and glory are not enough reasons to neglect road safety.

text: Gin-veto na naman sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika ang draft resolution sang United Nations Security Council kaangot sa Israel-Hamas war.
english: The United States of America has vetoed a draft resolution of the United Nations Security Council on the Israel-Hamas war.

text: Paagi sa sini nga tikang, ginabalabagan sang Amerika ang demand sa immediate humanitarian ceasefire bangud ang mas ginaduso sini sa 15-member body amo ang temporaryo nga ceasefire.
english: With this move, America is blocking the demand for an immediate humanitarian ceasefire because what it is pushing for more in the 15-member body is a temporary ceasefire.

text: 13 ka mga council members ang nagboto-pabor sa amo nga draft nga himo sang Algeria; samtang nag-abstain naman ang Britanya.
english: 13 council members voted in favor of the draft made by Algeria; while Britain abstained.

text: Ini na ang ikatatlo nga tion nga nag-veto ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika halin sang natabo ang gyera sa Gaza.
english: This is the third time the United States of America has vetoed since the war in Gaza.

text: Para kuntani nga maadoptar ang isa ka UN Security Council resolution, dapat nga makakuha ini sang at least siyam ka mga boto nga naga-pabor kag dapat nga indi ini pag-i-veto sang sin-o man sa lima ka mga permanent members nga amo ang United States, United Kingdom, France, Russia, kag China.
english: For a UN Security Council resolution to be adopted, it must receive at least nine votes in favor and must not be vetoed by any of the five permanent members namely the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Russia, and China.

text: Suno kay US Ambassador to the UN Linda Thomas-Greenfield, una na nga nag-signal ang Estados Unidos nga iga-veto nila ang resolution bangud posible ini nga makabalabag sa mga istoryahanay subong sang US, Egypt, Israel kag Qatar para sa temporary ceasefire kag pagpaguwa sang hostages nga gindala sang Hamas sa Gaza Strip.
english: According to US Ambassador to the UN Linda Thomas-Greenfield, the United States has previously signaled that it will veto the resolution because it could hinder the current talks between the US, Egypt, Israel and Qatar for a temporary ceasefire and the release of hostages taken by Hamas in the Gaza Strip.

text: “Any action this council takes right now should help, not hinder these sensitive, and ongoing negotiations.
english: “Any action this council takes right now should help, not hinder these sensitive, and ongoing negotiations.

text: And we believe that the resolution on the table right now would, in fact, negatively impact those negotiations,” pahayag ni Thomas-Greenfield sa atubang sang council.” Demanding an immediate, unconditional ceasefire without an agreement requiring Hamas to release the hostages will not bring about a durable peace.
english: And we believe that the resolution on the table right now would, in fact, negatively impact those negotiations,” Thomas-Greenfield said before the council.” Demanding an immediate, unconditional ceasefire without an agreement requiring Hamas to release the hostages will not bring about a durable peace.

text:
Instead, it could extend the fighting between Hamas and Israel.”

Matandaan nga may yara man sang resolution nga gin-file ang US kun sa diin nagapanawagan ini sang temporaryo nga ceasefire kag nagapamalabag sa opensiba sang Israel sa Rafah kun sa diin may masobra isa ka milyon nga mga sibilyan.
english:
Instead, it could extend the fighting between Hamas and Israel.”

The US also filed a resolution calling for a temporary ceasefire and opposing Israel's offensive in Rafah, where there are more than a million civilians.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga tion halin sang Oktubre 2023 nga nag-duso ang US sang Security Council resolution sa Gaza.
english: This is the second time since October 2023 that the US has pushed forward a Security Council resolution on Gaza.

text:
Ang una sini nga resolution ang ginbalabagan sang Russia kag China.#

(Mike Segar/Reuters via CNN)
english:
Its first resolution was blocked by Russia and China.

(Mike Segar/Reuters via CNN)

text: Isa na gid lamang ka Pinoy ang nagapabilin sa Gaza.
english: Only one Filipino remains in Gaza.

text: Suno sa Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), ini amo ang madre nga nag-desisyon nga magapabilin sa amo nga teritoryo sa Palestine apisar pa nga ginsakop na ini sang Israel kag wala na sang hilway nga palanaguan sa amo nga area.
english: According to the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), this is the nun who decided to stay in the territory in Palestine despite the fact that it has been occupied by Israel and there is no free refuge in the area.

text: Suno pa kay Foreign Affairs Undersecretary Eduardo de Vega, may 14 ka latest Filipino evacuees nga naghalin sa Gaza kag pagadal-on sa Cairo sa Egypt kun sa diin pagabuligan sila sang Philippine Embassy agud nga mapapauli diri sa Pilipinas.
english: According to Foreign Affairs Undersecretary Eduardo de Vega, there are 14 latest Filipino evacuees from Gaza and will be taken to Cairo in Egypt where they will be assisted by the Philippine Embassy to return to the Philippines.

text: Bangud sini nga bag-o nga evacuees, 136 na sa 137 ka mga Pinoy ang nakabiya sa Gaza.
english: With these new evacuees, 136 of the 137 Filipinos have left Gaza.

text: Sang 2023 pa lamang, na-report na sang DFA nga ini nga madre sang Missionaries of Charity ang nagapangindi sa paghalin sa Gaza.
english: As early as 2023, the DFA was able to report that this Missionaries of Charity nun was refusing to leave Gaza.

text: Wala ini ginhingadlan apang ginpahayag nga naga-edad ini sang 63-anyos.
english: He was not named but was said to be 63-years-old.

text: Una man nga ginpahayag ni De Vega nga indi maghalin ang Missionaries of Charity sa Gaza apisar sang gyera bangud nagapati sila nga spiritual ang ila nga ginahimo.
english: Earlier, De Vega said the Missionaries of Charity will not leave Gaza despite the war because they believe what they are doing is spiritual.

text:
Ginsiling man nga ang madre ang simbolo sang Filipino spirituality kag kun paano nagapangamuyo ang mga Pilipino para sa mga tawo nga naga-antos amo man para sa kalinong.#

(Photo: [Said Khatib/AFP])
english:
It was also said that the nun is a symbol of Filipino spirituality and how Filipinos pray for people who are suffering as well as for peace.

(Photo: [Said Khatib/AFP])

text: Bukas ang Malacañang nga suportahan ang hagna nga nagatuyo nga i-regulate ang paggamit sang internet sang mga kabataan.
english: Malacañang is open to support the bill that aims to regulate the use of the internet by children.

text: Ini kasunod sa gin-file nga hagna ni Senador Ping Lacson nga hugton ang internet access sang mga menor de edad bangud sa potential nga epekto sini sa ila mental health.
english: This follows the bill filed by Senator Ping Lacson to tighten internet access for minors due to its potential impact on their mental health.

text: Suno kay Palace Press Officer Claire Castro, handa ang administrasyon nga suportahan ang mga tikang nga nagatuyo nga maprotektahan ang ikaayong-lawas kag interes sang publiko, labi na gid sang mga kabataan.
english: Palace Press Officer Claire Castro said the administration is ready to support measures aimed at protecting the health and interests of the public, especially children.

text: Dugang pa niya, kun mapamatud-an nga ini nga hagna ang epektibo kag makabulig sa mental well-being sang kabataan, may posibilidad nga ini suportahan sang Presidente.
english: He added that if the bill is proven to be effective and help the mental well-being of children, there is a possibility that the President will support it.

text: ILOILO – Magahiwat sang Visayas Motorcycle Road Safety Convention ang Motorcycle Philippines Federation sa Abril 13, 2025 sa Santa Barbara National Comprehensive High School sa banwa sang Sta.
english: ILOILO – The Motorcycle Philippines Federation will hold a Visayas Motorcycle Road Safety Convention on April 13, 2025 at the Santa Barbara National Comprehensive High School in Sta.

text: Barbara, Iloilo.
english: Barbara, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Felix Serisola, Regional Director sang Motorcycle Philippines Federation, iya ginpahayag nga ang katuyuan sang aktibidad amo ang pag-edukar sa mga motorista kaangot sa safety sa dalanon, kag kung paano malikawan ukon matapna ang aksidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Felix Serisola, Regional Director of the Motorcycle Philippines Federation, said the purpose of the activity is to educate motorists on road safety, and how to avoid or prevent accidents.

text: Suno kay Serisola, libre ang pagpaparehistro kag may libre nga pamahaw man para sa tanan nga mga magatambong sa palaabuton nga convention.
english: According to Serisola, registration is free and there will be free breakfast for all those who will attend the upcoming convention.

text: Lakip sa mangin topiko sa convention amo ang Strategic Formulation nga ipasa sa Kongreso para mapahagan-hagan ang aksidente nga ginakaulamiran sang mga motorsiklo.
english: Among the topics of the convention will be the Strategic Formulation to be submitted to Congress to alleviate the accidents caused by motorcycles.

text: Ginapaabot nga magatambong ang mga tiglawas halin sa Department of Transportation (DOTR), Land Transportation Office (LTO) kag Philippine National Police (PNP) Highway Patrol Group kag pila ka mga mamalidha, agud istoryahang ang konreto nga mga tikang bahin sa sini nga aktibidad.
english: Representatives from the Department of Transportation (DOTR), Land Transportation Office (LTO) and Philippine National Police (PNP) Highway Patrol Group and several lawmakers are expected to attend, to discuss concrete steps regarding this activity.

text: Sa katapusan, may yara man sang raffle ukon door prizes, lakip ang mga bag-o nga motorsiklo kag riding gear.
english: Finally, there will also be raffle or door prizes, including new motorcycles and riding gear.

text: Ginabanta 340 ka mga tawo sa 30 ka nagkalain-lain nga syudad sa Russia ang gin-detain kadungan sang ila nga mga aktibidad nga nagapakita sang pagprotesta, paglalaw, kag paghatag sang tribute kay Alexei Navalny, ang pinakamatunog nga kritiko ni Russian President Vladimir Putin.
english: Approximately 340 people in 30 different Russian cities have been detained in connection with their activities showing protests, mourning, and tributes to Alexei Navalny, the most vocal critic of Russian President Vladimir Putin.

text: Si Navalny, 47-anyos nga abogado, ang gulpi lamang nga nalipong samtang nga nagalakat ini sa sulod sang “Polar Wolf” Arctic penal colony kun sa diin nagatinir ini ara sa iya sentensya nga nagalawig sang tatlo ka dekada.
english: Navalny, a 47-year-old lawyer, suddenly fainted while walking inside the “Polar Wolf” Arctic penal colony where he is serving his three-decade sentence.

text: Ginpahayag nga sang nag-abot ang iloy ni Navalny sa presuhan, ginsilingan ini nga napatay ang iya bata bangud sa ‘sudden death syndrome’.
english: When Navalny's mother arrived in prison, she was told that her son had died of sudden death syndrome.

text: Ini isa ka general term para sa cardiac syndromes nga rason sang cardiac arrest kag gulpyada nga kamatayon.
english: It is a general term for cardiac syndromes that cause cardiac arrest and sudden death.

text: Ginsiling man sa iloy nga indi pa pag-ihatag ang lawas ni Navalny samtang nga wala pa natapos ang imbestigasyon.
english: The mother was also told that Navalny's body would not be handed over until the investigation was completed.

text: Suno naman sa OVD-Info nga amo ang naga-report sang freedom of assembly sa Russia, ang pinakadamo nga gin-aresto sang Sabado ang natabo sa St Petersburg kag Moscow kun sa diin madamo gid man ang taga-suporta sang kritiko ni Putin.
english: According to OVD-Info, which reports on freedom of assembly in Russia, the highest number of arrests on Saturday occurred in St Petersburg and Moscow, where there are many supporters of Putin's critics.

text: Ginpahayag nga 74 kag 49 ang ginpang-detain sa amo nga mga syudad.
english: It was reported that 74 and 49 were detained in these cities.

text: May yara man sang nagaguwa nga footage nga nagdala ang mga tawo sang bulak kag kandila kag may nagkanta pa sang hymno samtang nagahaksanay, apang pagkatapos sang kanta, ginabanta 30 sa ila ang ginpang-aresto.
english: Footage also emerged of people carrying flowers and candles and some even singing the national anthem while hugging each other, but after the song, about 30 of them were arrested.

text: Ginakabig ang kamatayon ni Navalny nga daku nga kadulaan sang lider sa opposition ilabi na bangud naga-preparar si Putin sa eleksyon kag nagaplano nga magtinir sa iya pwesto tubtub sa 2030.
english: Navalny's death is seen as a major loss for the opposition leader, especially since Putin is preparing for elections and plans to stay in office until 2030.

text: Bangud wala sang ka-klaruhan kun ano gid ang rason sang kamatayon sini kag madamo ang nagapati nga hungod ini nga ginpatay, madamo ang nag-kondenar sa hitabo lakip na ang international leaders, senior western officials kag Russian opposition figures.
english: With the cause of his death unclear and many believing he was killed deliberately, many have condemned the incident including international leaders, senior western officials and Russian opposition figures.

text: Gintawag man ini sang iban nga senyales kun ano ka-brutal si Putin.
english: Others also called it a sign of how brutal Putin is.

text:
Ang G7 foreign ministers nga nagtipon sa tuigan nga Munich security conference ang nagpanawagan man sa Russia nga athagon ang mga sirkumstansya sa kamatayon ni Navalny.#

(Photo: PBS)
english:
G7 foreign ministers gathered at the annual Munich security conference also called on Russia to clarify the circumstances surrounding Navalny's death.

(Photo: PBS)

text: Ginaduso ni Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar nga ginikanan ang dapat nga magpanguna nga magsaway sa ila nga kabataan nga nagamaneho sang motorsiklo agud nga malikawan ang disgrasya sa dalan.
english: Iloilo 2nd District Board Member June Mondejar suggested that parents should take the lead in disciplining their children who drive motorcycles to avoid road accidents.

text: Ini kasunod man sang sunod-sunod nga kaso sang vehicular accident nga involved ang mga menor-de-edad.
english: This also follows a series of vehicular accident cases involving minors.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Board Member Mondejar, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan nga maplanohan na ang mga tikang agud ma-address ang amo nga problema ilabi na sa mga reckless kon mag-drive.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Board Member Mondejar said that measures should be planned to address the problem especially for those who are reckless when driving.

text: Suno kay Mondejar, dapat lang nga makahimo ang Iloilo Provincial Government kag iban nga concern agencies sang estratehiya agud nga mabuhinan ang vehicular accident sa probinsya.
english: According to Mondejar, the Iloilo Provincial Government and other concerned agencies should develop a strategy to reduce vehicular accidents in the province.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga dako ang impluwensya sang tagsa ka ginikanan agud nga mapalayo ang ila anak sa makahalanusbo nga insidente sa dalan.
english: He also explained that each parent has a great influence to keep their child away from the tragic incident on the road.

text: Ginpunto man sang natungdan ang mga dalan nga wala sang signages ukon early warning devices nga mahimo makatuga sang huol kag mangin rason sang disgrasya.
english: He also pointed out the roads that do not have signages or early warning devices that can cause inconvenience and cause accidents.

text: Naghinugyaw kag naghilibion pa ang mga human rights advocates kag LGBTIQA+ (lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender, intersex, queer/questioning, asexual) couples matapos nga ginpasar na sang Greek parliament ang layi nga nagahimo sang same-sex marriage nga legal sa Greece.
english: Human rights advocates and LGBTIQA+ couples cheered and cried after the Greek parliament passed a law legalizing same-sex marriage in Greece.

text: Ini ang labing-una sa southeastern Europe kag labing-una man nga Orthodox Christian country nga naka-establisar sang marriage equality para sa tanan.
english: It was the first in southeastern Europe and also the first Orthodox Christian country to establish marriage equality for all.

text: Ini nga desisyon ang suportado sang 176 sa 300 ka mga mamalidha sa parliament kun sa diin 76 naman ang nagpamatok, duha ang nag-abstain, kag 46 ang absent.
english: The decision was supported by 176 of the 300 lawmakers in parliament with 76 against, two abstaining, and 46 absent.

text: Mangin si Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis ang nag-abi-abi sa amo nga development kag gintawag ini nga “milestone” para sa kinamatarong sang mga tawo kag isa ka pagpakita sang paminatasan sa Greece nga isa ka progresibo kag demokratiko nga pungsod sa Europa.
english: Even Prime Minister Kyriakos Mitsotakis welcomed such a development and called it a “milestone” for people’s rights and a demonstration of ethics in Greece which is a progressive and democratic country in Europe.

text: Matandaan nga gin-introduce man sa Greece ang civil partnerships halos isa ka dekada na ang nagligad sa idalom sang left-wing Syriza government, apang sa idalom sini, ang biological parents lamang sang kabataan sa amo nga relationships amo ang mahimo kilalahon nga legal guardians.
english: It can be recalled that Greece also introduced civil partnerships nearly a decade ago under the left-wing Syriza government, but under it, only the biological parents of children in such relationships can be recognized as legal guardians.

text: Sa subong, sa idalom sa bag-o nga layi, mangin ang same-sex parents ang mahimo man makilala nga legal nga ginikanan sang ila kabataan.
english: Currently, under the new law, even same-sex parents can also be recognized as the legal parents of their children.

text: Nahibaluan nga sandig sa pinakaulihi nga opinion polls, natunga ang Greeks sa isyu sa same-sex marriage.
english: According to the latest opinion polls, Greeks are divided on the issue of same-sex marriage.

text:
Ang pinakamatunog nga nagapamatok diri amo ang gamhanan nga Orthodox Church nga nagapati nga isa ka sala ang homosexuality.#

(Photo: Reuters)
english:
The most vocal opponent here is the powerful Orthodox Church which believes that homosexuality is a sin.#

(Photo: Reuters)

text: Ginsumiter ang isa ka hagna sa Kamara agud siguruhon ang 20%nga diskwento para sa mga senior citizen kag persons with disabilities (PWDs), subong man ang exemption halin sa 12 porsyento nga Value Added Tax (VAT), ang mahimo nga ma-apply sa mga promo offers sang mga negosyo.
english: A bill has been submitted in the House to ensure a 20% discount for senior citizens and persons with disabilities (PWDs), as well as an exemption from the 12 percent Value Added Tax (VAT), can be applied to promo offers by businesses.

text: Ang House Bill 16, nga ginpangunahan nanday House Speaker Martin Romualdez, Tingog Party-list Representatives Andrew Romualdez, kag Rep.
english: House Bill 16, led by House Speaker Martin Romualdez, Voice Party-list Representatives Andrew Romualdez, and Rep.

text: Jude Acidre, ang gin-file sang Lunes, Hunyo 30.
english: Jude Acidre, filed on Monday, June 30.

text:
Ang hagna ginatawag nga “An Act Enhancing the Discount on the Purchase of Goods and Services of Senior Citizens and Persons with Disabilities.”

Suno kay Romualdez, tinutuyo sang hagna nga ang mga baisay sa tunga sang mga negosyo kag sang mga senior citizens kag PWDs kaangot sa nagakadapat nga interpretasyon sang mga naga-eksister nga layi.
english:
The bill is called “An Act Enhancing the Discount on the Purchase of Goods and Services of Senior Citizens and Persons with Disabilities.”

According to Romualdez, the bill aims to ensure that disputes between businesses and senior citizens and PWDs are related to the proper interpretation of existing laws.

text: Sa isa ka pahayag, ginsiling ni Romualdez nga ang nasambit nga hagna ang may katuyuan nga mapabilin ang espesyal nga pagtratar sa mga senior citizens kag persons with disabilities pamaagi sang pag-angkon sang isa ka gintingub nga approach agud mas madali nga makuha ang mga programa kag serbisyo nga kinahanglanon.
english: In a statement, Romualdez said the bill aims to maintain the special treatment of senior citizens and persons with disabilities by having an integrated approach to more easily access the programs and services needed.

text: Pila sa mga ginaduso nga hagna nga kapareho sini amo ang House Bill 9850 sang ika-19 nga Kongreso, nga nagasiguro nga ang 20 porsyento nga diskwento kag Value Added Tax exemption ang sa gihapon magadayon apisar pa nga may mga promotional discount rates, kasubong sang sa domestic sea kag air transport services, mga hotel, mga restawran, kag pati man sa mga bill sang tubig kag kuryente.
english: Some of the proposed bills are House Bill 9850 of the 19th Congress, which ensures that the 20 percent discount and Value Added Tax exemption will continue despite promotional discount rates, such as on domestic sea and air transport services, hotels, restaurants and water bills.

text: Nakapending pa sa gihapon ang nasambit nga hagna sa komite tubtuob sa katapusan sang ika-19 nga Kongreso.
english: The bill is still pending in committee until the end of the 19th Congress.

text: Ang pag-file sang House Bill 16 nagapakita sang patuloy nga pagsuporta sa mga tikang nga magahatag sang mas mamag-an kag mas maayos nga kalidad sang pagpangabuhi para sa mga senior citizens kag PWDs sa pungsod.
english: The filing of House Bill 16 shows continued support for measures that will provide a lighter and better quality of life for senior citizens and PWDs in the country.

text: Ginpaguwa sang Department of Education ang DepEd Order No.
english: The Department of Education issued DepEd Order No.

text: 020, s. 2025 nga naga-mando nga ang Filipino kag English na ang gamiton nga primary mode of instruction halin Kindergarten tubtob Grade 3.
english: 020, p. 2025 mandating that Filipino and English be used as the primary mode of instruction from Kindergarten to Grade 3.

text: Samtang, ang mga regional nga linggwahe himuon nga auxiliary media of instruction, para buligan ang mga kabataan nga mas maayo nga makasugpon halin sa ila first language pakadto sa Filipino kag English.
english: Meanwhile, regional languages ​​will be made auxiliary media of instruction, to help children better connect from their first language to Filipino and English.

text: Para naman sa mga deaf kag hard-of-hearing nga estudyante, gamiton ang Filipino Sign Language.
english: For deaf and hard-of-hearing students, Filipino Sign Language will be used.

text: Nadala sini ang tanan nga elementary schools public, private, state universities and colleges (SUCs), local universities and colleges (LUCs), and Philippine Schools Overseas (PSOs).
english: This includes all elementary schools public, private, state universities and colleges (SUCs), local universities and colleges (LUCs), and Philippine Schools Overseas (PSOs).

text: Suno sa DepEd, ang bag-o nga polisa ginbalay para masiguro nga ang ginagamit nga linggwahe sa pagtudlo nagakonekta kag wala nagapabudlay sa pagtuon sang mga kabataan.
english: According to the DepEd, the new policy is designed to ensure that the language used in teaching is connected and does not make it difficult for children to learn.

text: Ang order epektibo sa 15 ka adlaw matapos ang pag-publish kag approval sini.
english: The order is effective for 15 days after its publication and approval.

text:
Ang siling sa pinaka-popular nga linya sa kada wedding vow: “til death do us part.”

Apang para sa anay prime minister sang Netherlands nga si Dries van Agt kag sa iya asawa nga si Eugenie, mas maayo nga kun magkaupod sila sa kabuhi sa nagligad nga pito ka dekada, magkaupod man sila nga magabiya.
english:
The most popular line in every wedding vow says: “til death do us part.”

But for former Dutch prime minister Dries van Agt and his wife Eugenie, it is better that if they have lived together for the past seven decades, they will leave together.

text: Agaw-atensyon ang istorya sang mag-asawa bangud sa edad nga 93-anyos, ginpili nila nga mapatay paagi sa duo euthanasia — isa ka growing trend sa Netherlands kun sa diin gamay pa gid lamang nga numero sang mag-asawa ang napasugtan sang otoridad nga dungan nga mapatay paagi sa makamamatay nga bulong ukon droga.
english: The couple's story is noteworthy because at the age of 93, they chose to die by duo euthanasia — a growing trend in the Netherlands where only a small number of couples are allowed by the authorities to die together by lethal drugs.

text: Suno sa Rights Forum, isa ka pro-Palestinian group nga gin-establisar ni van Agt sang 2009, nagtaliwan ang mag-asawa sa ila hometown sa Nijmegen.
english: According to Rights Forum, a pro-Palestinian group founded by van Agt in 2009, the couple passed away in their hometown of Nijmegen.

text: Ginpahayag nga naga-uyatay pa sila sang kamot sang iya pinalangga nga asawa sang sila ang nadulaan sang ginhawa.
english: He was reportedly still holding hands with his beloved wife when they lost their breath.

text: Dungan man sila nga ginlubong kag nangin pribado ang amo nga hitabo.
english: They were buried together and the event was private.

text: Kilala si Van Agt nga prime minister halin sang 1977 tubtub sang 1982 kag siya man ang nangin una nga lider sang Christian Democratic Appeal party sang amo nga pungsod.
english: Van Agt is known as prime minister from 1977 to 1982 and was also the first leader of the country's Christian Democratic Appeal party.

text: Naka-serbe man siya nga ambassador sang European Union sa Japan kag sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: He has also served as European Union ambassador to Japan and the United States of America.

text: Suno naman sa reports sa Dutch media, nagaluya na ang ikaayong lawas sang mag-asawa halin pa sang nagliligad nga tuig.
english: According to reports in the Dutch media, the couple's health has been deteriorating since last year.

text: Sang 2019, nagsuprer ang anay prime minister sang brain hemorrhage samtang nga naga-deliver ini sang speech sa isa ka commemoration event para sa mga Palestinians.
english: In 2019, the former prime minister suffered a brain hemorrhage while delivering a speech at a commemoration event for the Palestinians.

text: Halin sang amo nga tion, wala ini naka-recover.
english: Since that time, it has not recovered.

text: Nangin pribado naman ang mga detalye kaangot sa ikaayong lawas ni Eugenie.
english: Details regarding Eugenie's health were kept private.

text: Nahibaluan nga yara lamang sa 29 ka mga mag-asawa ang gintugutan nga mapatay paagi sa duo euthanasia sang 2022 sandig sa datos sang Regional Euthanasia Review Committees sang Netherlands.
english: Only 29 couples were allowed to die by duo euthanasia in 2022 according to data from the Regional Euthanasia Review Committees of the Netherlands.

text: Ginapanan-aw man sang Dutch organizations nga magdamo pa ini nga numero apisar nga may makit-an sa mga doktor nga pagpangduha-duha sa paghatag sang euthanasia base sa accumulation sang age-related conditions.
english: Dutch organizations also expect this number to increase despite doctors' reluctance to perform euthanasia based on the accumulation of age-related conditions.

text: Apang santo sa legal guidelines sang pungsod, ginatugutan ini.
english: But according to the country's legal guidelines, it is allowed.

text: Ang assisted suicide ang nagakatabo kun ang tawo mismo ang nagatublok sang lethal dose sa iya kaugalingon samtang yara ang physician, samtang ang euthanasia naman ang nagakatabo kun ang medical professional ang naga-administer sang bulong sa isa ka pasyente.
english: Assisted suicide occurs when a person injects a lethal dose into themselves while a physician is present, while euthanasia occurs when a medical professional administers medication to a patient.

text:
Pareho ini nga legal sa Netherlands halin pa sang 2002 apang dapat nga may malab-ot nga partikular nga critera.#

(Credit: Radboud University via CTV News)
english:
Both have been legal in the Netherlands since 2002 but must meet specific critera.#

(Credit: Radboud University via CTV News)

text: Ginaduso nga mag-file sang complaint affidavit si Julie “Dondon” Patidongan alyas Totoy, matapos niya ginpangalanan ang pila ka pulis sa kontrobersyal nga kaso nga ‘Missing Sabungeros’.
english: Julie “Dondon” Patidongan alias Totoy is proposed to file a complaint affidavit, after she named some policemen in the controversial case as 'Missing Sabungeros'

text: Si alyas Totoy amo ang isa sa mga ginpasakaan sang kaso nga may kaangtanan sa mga nadula nga manugbulang.
english: Alias ​​Totoy is one of those charged in connection with the missing witches.

text: Suno kay NAPOLCOM Vice Chairperson Atty. Rafael Calinisan, kun sa ila opisina mismo ipasaka ang affidavit, mas mapaayo kag mapasangkad ang imbestigasyon batuk sa mga nadalahig nga pulis.
english: According to NAPOLCOM Vice Chairperson Atty. Rafael Calinisan, if the affidavit is filed in their office, it will improve and expand the investigation against the involved policemen.

text: Ginalauman sang komisyon nga magapasaka sang affidavit si Totoy.
english: The commission expects Totoy to file an affidavit.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sang NAPOLCOM nga may yara sila sang listahan sang mga pulis nga ginatudlo nga nalakip sa insidente, kag ginahanda na ang administrative investigation.
english: NAPOLCOM also revealed that it has a list of police officers allegedly involved in the incident, and an administrative investigation is being prepared.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla nga ginbutang na sa restricted duty ang 15 ka pulis nga ginatudlo nga may kaangtanan sa ginapatihan nga pagpatay sa mga nadula nga manugbulang.
english: Earlier, Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla said 15 policemen allegedly involved in the alleged murder of the missing migrants have been placed on restricted duty.

text: Ginsulod na sang militar sang Israel ang Nasser Hospital, ang pinakadaku nga nagagana pa nga ospital sa Gaza matapos ang apat ka bulan nga gyera.
english: The Israeli military has entered Nasser Hospital, the largest still functioning hospital in Gaza after four months of war.

text: Mismo ang statement ni Israel Defense Forces spokesperson Daniel Hagari ang nagkumpirma sa ila nga operasyon kun sa diin suno sa iya, may yara sila sang nabaton nga intelligence report nga may mga hostages nga gina-uyatan ang Hamas sa sulod sang amo nga ospital sa Khan Yunis.
