english: Israel Defense Forces spokesperson Daniel Hagari confirmed the operation, saying they had received an intelligence report that Hamas was holding hostages inside the Khan Yunis hospital.

text: Ginpahayag man nga lawas na lang sang iban nga hostages ang yara ginpangtago sa amo nga pasilidad.
english: It was also reported that only the bodies of other hostages were hidden in the facility.

text: Suno naman sa mga doktor kag medical officials sa amo nga ospital, ginpangluthang-patay sang Israeli snipers ang pila ka mga tawo samtang nagakaran-karan ang mga ini nga magpalagyo.
english: According to doctors and medical officials at the hospital, Israeli snipers shot dead several people as they tried to escape.

text: Tuman ka gamo kag makamamatay ang sitwasyon base sa footages.
english: The situation was very chaotic and deadly based on the footage.

text: Mangin ang direktor sang ospital ang nagsiling nga nagapila na lang sa wards ang mga pasyente nga may kritikal nga mga samad kag kinahanglan na subong ang bulig sang United Nations kag Red Cross agud maluwas ini nga mga pasyente kag ang mga staff.
english: Even the director of the hospital said that patients with critical injuries are already queuing up in the wards and the help of the United Nations and the Red Cross is now needed to save these patients and staff.

text: Makit-an man kun paano nagadali-dali ang medical staff nga makadalagan samtang dala ang stretchers sang mga pasyente sa tunga sang corridor nga puno sang yab-ok kag guba na ang mga kisame.
english: Medical staff can also be seen hurrying to run while carrying stretchers of patients in the middle of the corridor that is full of dust and broken ceilings.

text: Mangin ang mass graves sa sulod sang compound sang ospital ang ginpangkutkot man gamit ang military bulldozers sang Israel.
english: Even the mass graves inside the hospital compound were dug up using Israeli military bulldozers.

text: Suno naman kay Ashraf Al Qedra, spokesperson sang Hamas-run Gaza Ministry of Health, nagsulod ang IDF forces sa Nasser medical complex kag ginhimo ini nga “military barracks”.
english: Ashraf Al Qedra, spokesperson for the Hamas-run Gaza Ministry of Health, said IDF forces entered the Nasser medical complex and turned it into “military barracks”.

text: “The occupation targets the ambulance headquarters and the tents of the displaced, and bulldozes the mass graves inside the Nasser Medical Complex,” pahayag sini sa isa ka statement online.
english: “The occupation targets the ambulance headquarters and the tents of the displaced, and bulldozes the mass graves inside the Nasser Medical Complex,” it said in a statement online.

text:
Nagpanawagan naman ang humanitarian organization nga Doctors Without Borders nga untaton na sang Israel ang operasyon sa ospital bangud ginabutang sini sa risgo ang sitwasyon sang staff kag mga pasyente nga yara sa sulod sang pasilidad.##

[File: Stringer/AFP]
english:
The humanitarian organization Doctors Without Borders called on Israel to stop operating at the hospital because it puts the situation of staff and patients inside the facility at risk.##

[File: Stringer/AFP]

text: GINDAUG sang ordinaryo nga congresswoman nga si Leni Robredo si Ferdinand Marcos Jr., nga may daku nga ngalan bilang senador, sa ila encuentro sa pagka-Bise Presidente sadtong eleksyon sang Mayo 2016.
english: ordinary congresswoman Leni Robredo defeated Ferdinand Marcos Jr., who has a big name as a senator, in their encounter for Vice President in the May 2016 elections.

text: Kag ina bisan pa nga napierde sing daku ang kandidato ni Leni sa pagka-Presidente, samtang nagdaug sing daku ang kasumpong nga si Duterte nga dapat tani nagtib-ong kay Marcos Jr.
english: And that's despite the fact that Leni's presidential candidate lost big, while Duterte's opponent, who should have boosted Marcos Jr., won big.

text: batok kay Leni pero wala.
english: against Leni but no.

text: Nagpakita lang ini nga ginboto sang mga pumuluyo si Leni tungod sa iya gid kapinasahe kag kon ano kahuyang nga kandidato si Marcos Jr.
english: This only shows that the people voted for Leni because of her really niceness and how weak a candidate Marcos Jr. is.

text: kay pierde siya bisan todo bulig pa sa iya si Duterte.
english: because he lost even though Duterte helped him.

text: In fact, wala man naglain ang kapinasahe sang pagkatawo ni Leni agud indi saligan sang mga pumuluyo sa mas mataas na nga pwesto.
english: In fact, Leni's personality has not changed so that the people do not trust her in higher positions.

text: Kon isipon gani, mas makasarang pa siya kay Marcos Jr.
english: In fact, he is more capable than Marcos Jr.

text: bilang abogada kag tapos sa Economics.
english: as a lawyer and then in Economics.

text: Napakita man niya ang iya ikasarang bilang Bise Presidente bisan wala sing bulig sang administrasyon ni Duterte kay yara siya sa oposisyon.
english: He also showed his ability as Vice President even without the help of the Duterte administration because he is in opposition.

text: Napakita niya ini nga ikasarang sa pagbulig sa mga kubos bisan sa diutay nga budget sang iya upisina tungod sa iya kapisan kag sa bulig sang iya mga abyan sa NGOs nga nagapati sa iya kawsa.
english: He has shown this ability to help the poor even with the small budget of his office because of his hard work and the help of his friends in NGOs who believe in his cause.

text: Samtang si Marcos Jr.
english: Meanwhile, Marcos Jr.

text: wala sing nahimo kundi mag-waslik poder, katulad sang indi pagbayad sing buhis halin sadtong 1982 tubtub 1985.
english: has done nothing but seize power, such as not paying taxes from 1982 to 1985.

text: Nagbutig man ini sa sa pag-aku nga siya ang author, samtang indi, sang isa ka importante nga kasuguan angot sa territorial sovereignty sang Filipinas.
english: He also lied in claiming to be the author, when he was not, of an important law on the territorial sovereignty of the Philippines.

text: May pagka-arogante man ini sa indi pagpasakop sa mga natalana nga mga debate nga daw may ginatago (kag may ginatago gid man!) nga baho, katulad sang indi pa mauli nga ill-gotten wealth sang ila pamilya nga na-confirm sang Korte Suprema.
english: There is also the arrogance of not participating in the scheduled debates as if there is a hidden (and there is!) a smell, such as the ill-gotten wealth of their family that has not yet been returned that was confirmed by the Supreme Court.

text:
***

Pero ngaa daw si Marcos Jr.
english:
***

But why does Marcos Jr.

text: pa ang paborito sang pila ka political survey?
english: still the favorite of some political survey?

text: Nag-reklamo gid gani ang mga kasumpong ni Marcos Jr.
english: Marcos Jr.'s opponents even complained.

text: Suspetso nila nga lutong macau ining pila ka mga survey.
english: They suspect that some of these surveys are cooked macau.

text: Kon sa bagay, wala gid man sing perfecto nga survey, labi na gid kay sa mga political survey diri sa Filipinas ang respondent wala pa sing isa ka porsyento sang mga botante.
english: In fact, there is no perfect survey, especially since in political surveys here in the Philippines the respondent is less than one percent of the voters.

text: Sa masami, ining mga survey tubtub lang sa pila ka libu sang respondents, katulad sang 2,000 lang ka libu samtang ang botante nagalab-ut na sing 65 ka milyon sa palaabuton nga Mayo 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: Often, these surveys are limited to a few thousand respondents, compared to only 2,000 thousand as the voter base reaches 65 million in the upcoming May 2022 elections.

text: Ang malain pa gid kay ang mga respondent possible halin sa mga “army of trolls” nga binayaran sang madaya nga mga kandidato ang ila serbisyo sa social media kag sa mga dalanon nga ma-identify bilang mga “political barker”.
english: What's worse is that the respondents are possibly from the “army of trolls” who have been paid by fraudulent candidates for their services on social media and on the streets to be identified as “political barkers”.

text:
***

Gani, to be fair sa kay VP Leni, yari ang resulta sang survey sang Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines (CEAP).
english:
***

So, to be fair to VP Leni, here are the results of the survey of the Catholic Educational Association of the Philippines (CEAP).

text: May total respondents ini nga 3,089.
english: It had a total of 3,089 respondents.

text: Ginpagwa ini sang CEAP sang sini lang, kon diin nagapanguna si VP Leni sing may 52.57% batok sa 24.4% lang ni Marcos Jr.
english: The CEAP released it recently, where VP Leni is leading with 52.57% against Marcos Jr.'s 24.4%.

text: Nagasunod si Manila Mayor Isko Moreno nga may 9.61%, Sen.
english: Manila Mayor Isko Moreno followed with 9.61%, Sen.

text: Ping Lacson nga may 3.53%, Sen.
english: Ping Lacson with 3.53%, Sen.

text: Manny Pacquiao nga may 0.87% kag si Ka Leody de Guzman nga may 0.26%.
english: Manny Pacquiao with 0.87% and Ka Leody de Guzman with 0.26%.

text: Nanguna man si VP Leni sa survey sang Veritas Truth Survey sa survey sini sadtong Enero 2022, kon diin nagkuha si VP Leni sing 42%.
english: VP Leni also topped the Veritas Truth Survey in its survey back in January 2022, where VP Leni took 42%.

text: Tanan nga rehiyon sa pungsod naghatag sing pinakataas nga boto sa sining survey sa kay VP Leni, luas lang sa Central Visayas, Northern Mindanao, Davao, Soccksargen, kag Caraga.
english: All regions in the country gave the highest votes in this survey to VP Leni, except for Central Visayas, Northern Mindanao, Davao, Soccksargen, and Caraga.

text: Si VP Leni nanguna sa survey batok sa iya mayor nga kasumpong nga si Marcos Jr.
english: VP Leni leads the poll against her main opponent Marcos Jr.

text: sa 11 ka rehiyon samtang nanguna si Marcos Jr.
english: in 11 regions while Marcos Jr. led.

text: sa apat lang ka rehiyon.
english: in just four regions.

text:
Nanguna si Vp Leni sa Region I – Ilocos Region, Region II – Cagayan Valley, Region III – Central Luzon, Region IV
A – CALABARZON, Region IV-B – MIMAROPA Region, Region V – Bicol Region, Region VI – Western Visayas, Region VIII – Eastern Visayas, Region IX – Zamboanga Peninsula, NCR – National Capital Region, CAR – Cordillera Administrative Region.
english:
Vp Leni leads in Region I – Ilocos Region, Region II – Cagayan Valley, Region III – Central Luzon, Region IV
A – CALABARZON, Region IV-B – MIMAROPA Region, Region V – Bicol Region, Region VI – Western Visayas, Region VIII – Eastern Visayas, Region IX – Zamboanga Peninsula, NCR – National Capital Region, CAR – Cordillera Administrative Region.

text: Samtang sige man ang mga pag-endorso kay VP Leni sang mga dean kag mga propesor sa law, mga ekonomista, mga religioso katoliko katulad sang mga madre, mga pari kag mga Couples for Christ, mga non-catholic nga katapo sang National Council of Christians in the Philippines (NCCP), mga kabataan, retirado nga mga opisyales, mga entertainer, kag ang madamo nga grupo sang mga kubos./PN
english: Meanwhile, VP Leni continues to be endorsed by deans and law professors, economists, Catholic religious such as nuns, priests and Couples for Christ, non-catholic members of the National Council of Christians in the Philippines (NCCP), children, retired officials, entertainers, many groups of the poor/PN.

text: Pagatunan-an sang Guimaras Provincial Government kun magahatag sila sang fuel subsidy matapos ang pagtimbuok sang mga produktong petrolyo sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: The Guimaras Provincial Government will study whether to provide fuel subsidy after the increase in petroleum products nationwide.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Guimaras Governor Lucille Nava, iya ginpahayag nga nagakinahanglan sang dako nga budget agud nga mapatuman ang paghatag sang fuel subsidy, rason nga paminsaran anay ini sang nasambit nga probinsya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Guimaras Governor Lucille Nava said that the implementation of the fuel subsidy requires a large budget.

text: Suno pa kay Nava, ila gina-engganyo ang mga residente sang Guimaras nga ipatuman sa ila tagsa ka mga balay ang pagbuhin sa paggamit sang mga appliances kun wala man halos ginagamit.
english: Nava said they are encouraging the residents of Guimaras to implement in their respective homes to reduce the use of appliances if they are not used.

text: Dugang pa niya dako gid ang apekto sang pagtaas sang presyo sang gatong, ilabi na sa ila nga mga pumulyo nga nagabyahe sakay sang mga fiberboats nga isa man sa mga apektado sang nasambit nga krisis.
english: He added that the increase in fuel prices has had a huge impact, especially on their residents who travel by fiberboats who are also affected by the crisis.

text: Nakadaog na gid man ang Gilas Pilipinas sa isa ka hampang sa nagapadayon nga 2025 FIBA Asia Cup!
english: Gilas Pilipinas has finally won a match in the ongoing 2025 FIBA ​​Asia Cup!

text: Makaginhawa na gamay ang Filipino basketball fans matapos nga na-secure na ang pwesto sang national team sa knockout playoffs kasunod sang kadalag-an batok sa Iraq, 66-57, sa do-or-die match subong nga hapon sa King Abdullah Sports City sa Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
english: Filipino basketball fans can breathe a sigh of relief after the national team secured its place in the knockout playoffs following its victory over Iraq, 66-57, in a do-or-die match this afternoon at the King Abdullah Sports City in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

text: Ginauyatan sang squad ni Coach Tim Cone ang No.
english: Coach Tim Cone's squad holds the No. 1 seed.

text: 3 seed sa Group D, kag atubangon sini ang second seed sang Group C sa knockout round.
english: 3 seed in Group D, and it will face the second seed of Group C in the knockout round.

text:
Kun sin-o man ang magadaog sa amo nga sambuwa, maga-abante ini sa quarterfinals kag maatubang sa top seed sang Group A.

Nanguna sa Nationals ang star guard nga si Dwight Ramos nga may 21 points kag five rebounds.
english:
Whoever wins the match will advance to the quarterfinals and face the top seed of Group A.

Star guard Dwight Ramos led the Nationals with 21 points and five rebounds.

text: Ginsalo sini ang masami nagapanguna nga si Justin Brownlee nga binudlayan subong nga matchup nga naka-skor lamang sang eight points sa 3-of-12 shooting from the field nga may seven boards kag four dimes.
english: He caught the often-leading Justin Brownlee who struggled this matchup scoring just eight points on 3-of-12 shooting from the field with seven boards and four dimes.

text: 33-33 ang skor sa halftime.
english: The score was 33-33 at halftime.

text: Si Ramos ang naghatag sang momentum sa Gilas paagi sa duha ka tres nga naghatag sa team sang 41-35 lead, tubtub nga nag-asud-asud na ang scores kag nakadangat sa 18-points ang abanse sang Pilipinas.
english: Ramos gave the Gilas momentum with two threes that gave the team a 41-35 lead, until the scores increased and the Philippines' lead reached 18-points.

text: Naglagas pa ang Iraq kag napanubo sa syete puntos ang lead, 57-50, paagi sa baslanay nanday Thulfiqar Hammoodi kag Mohammed Almahdi Abbas sa fourth quarter.
english: Iraq went on to reduce the lead to seven points, 57-50, with goals from Thulfiqar Hammoodi and Mohammed Almahdi Abbas in the fourth quarter.

text: Apang nagbalos si Calvin Oftana sang three-pointer agud mabalik ang 10-point lead, kag nangin kumportable na ini nga abanse sa Gilas agud dalayon nga ma-sustain ang hampang.
english: But Calvin Oftana responded with a three-pointer to restore the 10-point lead, and it became a comfortable lead over the Gilas to immediately sustain the game.

text: Antes ini nga showdown, duha ka beses nga nalutos ang Gilas sa kamot sang Chinese Taipei kag New Zealand.#
english: Before this showdown, the Gilas lost twice to Chinese Taipei and New Zealand.

text: Nalakip ang duha ka menor de edad sa tatlo nga gin-detain kaangot sa natabo nga pagpangluthang kadungan sang Super Bowl celebration rally sang Kansas City Chiefs sa Missouri, United States of America.
english: Two minors were among the three detained in connection with the shooting during the Super Bowl celebration rally of the Kansas City Chiefs in Missouri, United States of America.

text: Suno sa otoridad, na-recover man ang wala pa natumod nga numero sang mga armas.
english: Authorities said an unspecified number of firearms were also recovered.

text: Natalana pa nga ipasaka ang kaso suno sa pulis apang subong, nagapadayon pa ang imbestigasyon.
english: A case is scheduled to be filed, police said, but the investigation is still ongoing.

text: Pahayag naman sang Kansas City Police, natumod na tanan ang 23 ka mga biktima lakip na ang 43-anyos nga iloy nga amo ang isa nga napatay.
english: Kansas City Police said all 23 victims have been identified, including the 43-year-old mother who was the one who died.

text: Ang iban pa nga 22 ka mga biktima ang naga-edad otso tubtub 42 anyos, kun sa diin sandig sa datos nga ginauyatan sang otoridad, katunga sini nga numero ang mas manubo sa 16-anyos ang mga edad.
english: The other 22 victims are aged eight to 42 years old, where according to the data held by the authorities, half of this number are less than 16 years old.

text: Nagaguwa man sa imbestigasyon nga personal nga away sang pila ka tawo ang rason sang ginamo apang wala man sang report nga ini ang naangot sa terorismo ukon homegrown violent extremism.
english: The investigation also revealed that personal quarrels between some people were the cause of the riots but there were no reports that it was linked to terrorism or homegrown violent extremism.

text: Matandaan nga natabo ang insidente Myerkules (oras sa Missouri) sang nagtipon ang linibo-libo ka mga tawo para sa parada bangud sa kadalag-an sang Kansas City Chiefs sa bag-o lang nagtakop nga Super Bowl.
english: The incident occurred on Wednesday (Missouri time) when thousands of people gathered for a parade in honor of the Kansas City Chiefs' victory in the recently concluded Super Bowl.

text: Kasunod sini, nagpadala man sang mensahe sang simpatiya si US President Joe Biden kag liwat naghingyo sa Kongreso nga mas istriktuhon pa ang layi para sa pagdala sang mga tawo sang armas.
english: Subsequently, US President Joe Biden also sent a message of sympathy and again urged Congress to tighten the law for people carrying weapons.

text: “The epidemic of gun violence is ripping apart families and communities every day.
english: “The epidemic of gun violence is ripping apart families and communities every day.

text: Some make the news.
english: Some make the news.

text: Much of it doesn’t. But all of it is unacceptable,” suno sa presidente.
english: Much of it doesn’t. But all of it is unacceptable,” the president said.

text: “We have to decide who we are as a country.
english: “We have to decide who we are as a country.

text:
For me, we’re a country where people should have the right to go to school, to go to church, to walk the street — and to attend a Super Bowl celebration — without fear of losing your life to gun violence.”##

(Photo: JAMIE SQUIRE/GETT)
english:
For me, we’re a country where people should have the right to go to school, to go to church, to walk the street — and to attend a Super Bowl celebration — without fear of losing your life to gun violence.”##

(Photo: JAMIE SQIRE/GETT)

text: Na-eleher si Lipa Archbishop Most Rev.
english: Lipa was elected Archbishop Most Rev.

text: Gilbert Garcera bilang masunod nga presidente sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP).
english: Gilbert Garcera as the next president of the Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP).

text: Pormal siya nga magapungko sa amo nga posisyon sa Disyembre 1, 2025, bulos kay Cardinal Pablo Virgilio S. David nga magakumpleto sang iya nga second and final term bilang president sa Nobyembre.
english: He will formally assume the position on December 1, 2025, succeeding Cardinal Pablo Virgilio S. David who will complete his second and final term as president in November.

text: Natabo ang eleksyon subong nga hapon, Hulyo 5, sa una nga adlaw sang 130th plenary assembly sang mga obispo sa Anda, Bohol.
english: The election took place this afternoon, July 5, on the first day of the 130th plenary assembly of bishops in Anda, Bohol.

text: Si Garcera nga naga-edad 66-anyos ang nagaserbe subong sa CBCP Permanent Council bilang regional representative for Southeast Luzon.
english: Garcera, 66, is currently serving on the CBCP Permanent Council as the regional representative for Southeast Luzon.

text: Nagapungko siya bilang arsobispo sang Lipa halin sang 2017 kun sa diin may 3.3 million ka mga Katoliko.
english: He has been archbishop of Lipa since 2017, which has 3.3 million Catholics.

text: Nangin chairman man siya anay sang CBCP Commission on Mission kag sang Commission on Family and Life.
english: He also served as chairman of the CBCP Commission on Mission and the Commission on Family and Life.

text: Antes nangin obispo, nagserbe siya bilang assistant secretary general sang CBCP, executive secretary sang Episcopal Commission on Mission, kag national director sang Pontifical Mission Society.
english: Before becoming a bishop, he served as assistant secretary general of the CBCP, executive secretary of the Episcopal Commission on Mission, and national director of the Pontifical Mission Society.

text: Sa iya bag-o nga katungdanan, magapamuno siya sa collegial body sang mga obispo sa Pilipinas sa masunod nga duha ka tuig.
english: In his new role, he will head the collegial body of bishops in the Philippines for the next two years.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang CBCP officials mahimo makaserbe sang duha ka tuig nga termino, kag mahimo maeleher liwat sa isa pa gid ka termino.
english: CBCP officials can serve a two-year term, and can be re-elected for another term.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginpili naman sang CBCP si Most Rev.
english: Meanwhile, the CBCP elected Most Rev.

text: Julius Tonel D.D., ang Archbishop of Zamboanga, nga amo ang mangin Vice President kag magabulos kay Bishop Mylo Vergara sang Pasig.#
english: Julius Tonel D.D., the Archbishop of Zamboanga, who will be the Vice President and will succeed Bishop Mylo Vergara of Pasig.#

text: Handa ang Department of Science and Technology (DOST) nga magbulig agud nga pangitaon ang mga missing nga mga manugbulang nga gin-alegar nga ginpangtagbong na sa Taal Lake.
english: The Department of Science and Technology (DOST) is ready to help find the missing fishermen who were allegedly thrown into Taal Lake.

text: Suno kay DOST Secretary Renato Solidum, mahimo sila makapakig-angot sa iban nga mga scientist kag mahimo man nila magamit ang mga instrumento sang ahensya para sa marine monitoring.
english: According to DOST Secretary Renato Solidum, they can communicate with other scientists and can also use the agency’s instruments for marine monitoring.

text: “Of course makikipag-ugnayan kami sa ibang scientist, sa tingin naman baka may instrument na kakayahan.
english: “Of course we will contact other scientists, maybe they have instrument capabilities.

text: May pandagat kami na instrumento na pinondohan ng DOST for marine monitoring—para sa mga isda, mga corals, but we will have to find out kung ‘yung murky conditions ng Taal Lake kaya pa ng ibang mga camera na mayroon,” suno sa tiglikom .
english: We have a marine instrument funded by DOST for marine monitoring—for fish, corals, but we will have to find out if the murky conditions of Taal Lake can handle other cameras,” the secretary said.

text: Ginpaathag sang opisyal nga mahimo ihulog ang camera agud malantaw ang remains sang tawo.
english: The officer explained that the camera could be dropped to view the remains of the person.

text: Mas mahapos ini kag mas safe suno sa iya ipaanggid sa pag-dive ilabi na bangud indi pat-od ang kadalumon sang lugar.
english: He said it is easier and safer than diving especially since the depth of the area is uncertain.

text: Dugang ni Solidum, ang pinakadako nga pagpanghangkat para sa team nga maga-operate amo ang pagtumod kun sa diin gid nga lugar gintagbong ang mga bangkay.
english: Solidum added that the biggest challenge for the team to operate is to identify the exact location of the bodies.

text: Pahayag sini, kun matuod ang pahayag sang whistleblower nga didto ang mga bangkay sang mga manugbulang, posible gid nga ma-recover pa ang ila nga mga tul-an sa lake bangud wala ini nagakadunot.
english: He said that if the whistleblower's statement that the bodies of the hunters are true, it is possible that their bones will be recovered from the lake because they do not rot.

text: “Ang buto hindi made-decompose.
english: “Bone does not decompose.

text: Yung buto walang pakialam ang decomposition doon, ang laman ang nabubulok lang,” suno sa iya.
english: The bones don't care about decomposition, the flesh just rots,” he said.

text: Paathag pa sang tiglikom, magadepende sa kadalumon kag “oxidizing” content sang lake kun sa diin natagbong ang mga bangkay kun intact pa bala ang lawas sang mga manugbulang ukon yara na sa lebel sang decomposition.
english: The secretary explained that it will depend on the depth and oxidizing content of the lake where the bodies were buried whether the bodies of the fishermen are still intact or at the level of decomposition.

text: “‘Pag oxidizing, kunwari dito sa lupa, kung iwan mo ang dahon diyan made-decompose yan in time kasi may air ka pa – may oxygen, pag wala nang oxygen hindi na yan made-decompose, mape-preserve so depende ‘yan sa lokasyon,” pagpaathag sini.
english: “When oxidizing, pretend here on the ground, if you leave the leaf there it will decompose in time because you still have air – there is oxygen, when there is no oxygen it will not decompose, it will be preserved so it depends on the location,” he explained.

text: Una na nga naghingyo ang gobyerno sang technical assistance sa Japan para nga makabulig man sila sa pag-recover sa mga bangkay.
english: The government had earlier requested technical assistance from Japan to help recover the bodies.

text: Nagalapad sang 230 square kilometers ang Taal Lake kag may kadalumon nga 172 metros sa pila ka areas sini.#
english: Taal Lake covers an area of ​​230 square kilometers and is 172 meters deep in some areas.

text: Liwat nga ginpukaw ang paglaom sang mga himata sang mga nagkaladula nga mga sabungero matapos ang pagtuhaw sang testigo nga ginkilala kay alyas Totoy.
english: The hopes of the relatives of the missing sabungeros were rekindled after the appearance of a witness identified as alias Totoy.

text: Sa isa ka diyalogo nga ginpatigayon upod sa Department of Justice (DOJ), ginpahayag sang mga pamilya sang mga missing sabungeros nga nakaangkon sila sang pangibag-o nga paglaom bangud sang mga rebelasyon nga ginsambit ni alyas Totoy.
english: In a dialogue conducted with the Department of Justice (DOJ), the families of the missing sabungeros said they have gained new hope because of the revelations mentioned by alias Totoy.

text: Suno kay Janice Esplana, isa sa mga himata sang mga biktima, ang mga impormasyon nga ginbuyagyag sang testigo amo na ang ila gina-uyatan agud nga malab-ot ang hustisya para sa ila pinalangga sa kabuhi.
english: According to Janice Esplana, one of the relatives of the victims, the information revealed by the witness is what they are holding on to in order to achieve justice for their loved ones.

text: Dugang pa niya, positibo ang resulta sang ila pagpakigsapol upod sa DOJ kag nagapangayo sila sang padayon nga aksyon halin sa mga otoridad agud mapasangkad pa ang imbistigasyon.
english: He added that the results of their meeting with the DOJ were positive and they are seeking continued action from the authorities to expand the investigation.

text: Padayon pa subong ang imbistigasyon sang mga otoridad agud mahibaluan ang matuod-tuod nga natabo kag mahatag ang hustisya sa mga pamilya sang mga missing sabungeros.
english: The authorities are still investigating to find out the truth and bring justice to the families of the missing sabungeros.

text: Na-restore na ang mga rebolto sa station 13 sang Agony Hill sa banwa sang Alimodian, Iloilo, matapos nga ginlamhitan sang pinta sang mga kabataan.
english: The statues at station 13 of Agony Hill in Alimodian, Iloilo, have been restored after being painted by children.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Calson Alinday, pintor, iya ginpahayag nga mga lima ka mga menor de edad kag lunsay mga high shool student, ang naglamhit sang pinta sa rebolto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Calson Alinday, a painter, said about five minors, all high school students, applied the paint to the statue.

text: Suno kay Alinday, nakita niya nga ginbuksan sang mga menor ang lata sang pinta kag ginbasya ang unod sa imahen.
english: Alinday said she saw the minors open the paint can and sprinkle the contents on the image.

text: Ginalantaw nga tripping ang nagtulod sa mga kabataan para himuon ang nasambit nga akto.
english: It is believed that tripping led the children to commit the said act.

text: Gindala naman sa Alimodian Muncipal Police Station sa Muncipal Social Welfare Development Office (MSWDO) ang lima ka mga menor de edad, kag ginpaatubang kay Alimodian, Iloilo Mayor Ian Keneth Alfiche.
english: The five minors were brought to the Alimodian Municipal Police Station at the Municipal Social Welfare Development Office (MSWDO) and presented to Alimodian, Iloilo Mayor Ian Keneth Alfiche.

text: Nag-abot na ang walo ka mga Filipino caregivers sa pungsod gikan sa Israel.
english: Eight Filipino caregivers have arrived in the country from Israel.

text:
Sa isa ka pahayag, ginkumpirmar sang Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) nga naghugpa ang mga repatriated Filipinos sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) sang Miyerkules sang gab-i.

Gin-abi-abi sila sang mga opisyales gikan sa Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD), Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) kag mga medical teams gikan sa Manila International Airport Authority.
english:
In a statement, the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW) confirmed that the repatriated Filipinos landed at the Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA) on Wednesday night.

They were greeted by officials from the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW), Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD), Overseas Workers Welfare Administration (OWWA) and medical teams from the Manila International Airport Authority.

text: Ginhatagan sila sang temporaryo nga puluy-an, transportasyon kag pagpa-check-up sa ikaayong lawas.
english: They were provided with temporary housing, transportation and health check-ups.

text: Nagpasalig man ang DMW kag OWWA nga magahatag sang livelihood, employment kag health assistance para sa mga Filipino returnees.
english: The DMW and OWWA also promised to provide livelihood, employment and health assistance for the Filipino returnees.

text: Ini na ang ika-38 nga batch sang mga OFWs nga ginpabalik halin sa Israel humalin sang ginsugdan sang gobyerno ang ila voluntary repatriation program kasunod sang Oktubre 7 nga pag-atake sang 2023.
english: This is the 38th batch of OFWs repatriated from Israel since the government began its voluntary repatriation program following the October 7 attacks in 2023.

text: Ini na ang ikaduha nga grupo nga ginpabalik humalin sang nagbayluhanay sang missiles kag air strikes ang Iran kag Israel sang Hunyo 13 sini nga tuig antes ginpatuman ang ceasefire sang Hunyo 24, nga nagtapos sang ginatawag nga “12 days of war” sa tunga sang duha ka pungsod.
english: This is the second group to be sent back since Iran and Israel exchanged missiles and air strikes on June 13 this year before a ceasefire was imposed on June 24, ending the so-called “12 days of war” between the two countries.

text: Sa kabug-usan, base sa datos gikan sa Embahada sang Pilipinas sa Tel Aviv, 1,333 ang napauli gikan sa Israel halin Oktubre 7, 2023 tubtob Hunyo 12, 2025.
english: In total, based on data from the Philippine Embassy in Tel Aviv, 1,333 were repatriated from Israel from October 7, 2023 to June 12, 2025.

text: Nagsuspendi sang in-person classes ang tatlo ka Division Offices sang Negros Occidental kadungan sang paglupok sang Mt.
english: Three Division Offices of Negros Occidental suspended in-person classes in conjunction with the eruption of Mt.

text: Kanlaon kahapon nga adlaw.
english: Kanlaon yesterday.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., spokesperson sang Department of Education Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga ang mga eskwelahan nga nagsupendi sang klase ang nagshift sang Alternative Delivery Mode.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Hernani Escullar Jr., spokesperson of the Department of Education Region 6, said the schools that suspended classes shifted to the Alternative Delivery Mode.

text: Lakip sa mga apektado nga buluthuan amo ang sa La Carlota City nga may 30 ka schools kag may 17,642 nga learners, sa Negros Occidental nga may 34 ka mga eskwelahan kag ay 21,047 nga learners.
english: Among the affected schools are La Carlota City with 30 schools and 17,642 learners, Negros Occidental with 34 schools and 21,047 learners.

text: Samtang ang San Carlos City nga may 6 ka eswekalahan ang apektado man ang ila 1,960 ka mga learners.
english: Meanwhile, San Carlos City with 6 schools was also affected with 1,960 learners.

text: Sa kabug-usan may yara tanan sang 70 ka mga eskwelahan kon sa diin may 40,649 tanan ka total learners.
english: In total there are 70 schools with 40,649 total learners.

text: Dugang ni Escullar nga tinghuwaan sang talatapan nga makapadayon sang klase ang mga estudyante ilabi na nga nagahilapit na nga magtakop ang school year.
english: Escullar added that the office will try to ensure that students can continue their classes especially as the school year approaches.

text: Natul-id na sang Dumangas Municipal Police Station ang gunman nga nagtiro-patay sa isa ka lalaki sa Brgy.
english: The Dumangas Municipal Police Station has identified the gunman who shot dead a man in Brgy.

text: Sulangan, Dumangas, Iloilo.
english: Sulangan, Dumangas, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Angelo Gonzales, 23-anyos, single, residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The victim was identified as Angelo Gonzales, 23, single, resident of the said barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Master Sergeant Efren Gonzaga, Imbestigador sang Dumangas Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga indi na makita ang mga ‘whereabout’ sang mga suspek apang ginpadulongan sang talatapan ang puluy-an mismo sang nagpangamot sa krimen.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Master Sergeant Efren Gonzaga, Investigator of the Dumangas Municipal Police Station, said the whereabouts of the suspects were no longer visible but the office visited the house of the perpetrator.

text: Suno kay Gonzaga, gunman pa lang ang ila na-identify subong kag may ginasundan naman nga persona nga mahimo nagserbe nga driver sang motorsiklo.
english: Gonzaga said they have only identified the gunman and are following a person who may have served as the driver of the motorcycle.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga kakilala sang biktima ang mga suspek bangud nagapuyo sila sa isa ka barangay.
english: He said the victim knew the suspects because they lived in the same barangay.

text: Santo naman sa panaysayon sang witness, luwas sa pagbinaisay sang mga suspek kag sang biktima may daan na nga hiligut-anon sa tunga sang magtimbang nga kampo antes pa man natabo ang krimen.
english: According to the witness, besides the argument between the suspects and the victim, there was an old quarrel between the two camps before the crime.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakaagum sang pilas sa tiyan kag likod ang biktima nga gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: The victim sustained injuries to his stomach and back which led to his death.

text: Narecover naman sang kapulisan sa crime scene ang empty shell sang posible .45 caliber.
english: Police recovered an empty shell of a possible .45 caliber from the crime scene.

text: Halos 40 ang patay sa Iraq kag Syria bangud sang airstrikes nga ginlunsar sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika batok sa masobra 85 ka mga target nga naangot sa Iran Revolutionary Guard kag sa mga militias nga ginasuportahan sini.
english: Nearly 40 people have been killed in Iraq and Syria as a result of airstrikes launched by the United States of America against more than 85 targets linked to the Iranian Revolutionary Guard and the militias it supports.

text: Sa Iraq, ginsiling sang Popular Mobilization Forces nga 16 sa ila nga mga myembro ang napatay lakip na ang ila nga mga hangaway kag medics.
english: In Iraq, the Popular Mobilization Forces said 16 of their members were killed including their soldiers and medics.

text: Sa Syria, ang strikes ang nagpatay sang 23 ka mga tawo nga nagaguwardiya sang targeted locations.
english: In Syria, strikes killed 23 people guarding targeted locations.

text: Nahibaluan nga masobra tunga sa oras ang airstrikes sang Amerika sang nagligad nga gab-i gamit ang masobra 125 ka precision munitions.
english: The US airstrikes lasted more than half an hour last night using more than 125 precision munitions.

text: Pila sa strikes ang gingamitan sang B-1B bombers nga naghalin pa sa Dyess Air Force Base sa Texas kag nagbyahe sang 6,000-miles.
english: Some of the strikes were used by B-1B bombers that came from Dyess Air Force Base in Texas and traveled 6,000-miles.

text: Lakip sa ginpang-igu sini amo ang command kag control operation centers, intelligence centers, rockets kag missiles, unmanned aired vehicle storage warehouses, kag logistics kag munition supply chain facilities nga ginagamit sang mga militia grups nga lunsay suportado sang Iran.
english: Among the targets were command and control operation centers, intelligence centers, rockets and missiles, unmanned aired vehicle storage warehouses, and logistics and munition supply chain facilities used by militia groups all backed by Iran.

text: Ini nga pag-atake sang US amo ang ila nga una nga pagtimalos bangud sang drone attack sa ila nga military base sa Jordan kun sa diin tatlo ka mga soldado ang patay kag masobra 40 ang pilason.
english: The US attack is their first retaliation for a drone attack on their military base in Jordan that killed three soldiers and wounded more than 40 others.

text: Ang amo nga aerial attack ang una na nga ginpasibangod sang Amerika sa Iran — butang nga ginpanginwala naman sang amo nga pungsod.#
english: The aerial attack was previously blamed by the United States on Iran — something the country has denied.

text: Nakasulat na ang Pilipinas sa Japan agud magpangayo sang bulig nga makit-an ang bangkay sang mga manugbulang nga gin-alegar nga yara sa Taal Lake.
english: The Philippines has already written to Japan to ask for help in finding the bodies of the fishermen allegedly in Taal Lake.

text: Suno kay Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, kinahanglan ang technical expertise sang Tokyo para mausisa kun didto gid man ang mga biktima.
english: Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla said Tokyo's technical expertise is needed to verify whether the victims were there.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag sang isa sa mga akusado nga subong whistleblower nga si Julie “Dondon” Patidongan nga didto gintagbong ang mga bangkay, kag suno kay Remulla, may dugang nga mga testigo nga nagpanugid nga didto gid man ginhaboy ang mga manugbulang.
english: Earlier, one of the accused whistleblowers, Julie “Dondon” Patidongan, said that the bodies were dumped there, and according to Remulla, there were additional witnesses who testified that the doctors were thrown there.

text: 2022 sang nag-umpisa ang DOJ sa pagpangdakop sa mga police kag security personnel nga gin-alegar nga may kahilabtanan sa pagkadula sang 34 cockfight industry participants, apang sa pagguwa sang testigo subong nga 2025, ginbulgar sini nga masobra sa 100 ang mga biktima.
english: 2022 when the DOJ began arresting police and security personnel allegedly involved in the disappearance of 34 cockfight industry participants, but with the emergence of a witness in 2025, it revealed that there were more than 100 victims.

text: Matandaan nga gintudlo ni Patidongan ang iya anay amo nga si Charlie “Atong” Ang nga amo ang mastermind kag gin-tag man si Gretchen Barretto nga may ihibalo sa krimen.
english: Patidongan pointed out his former boss, Charlie “Atong” Ang, as the mastermind and also tagged Gretchen Barretto as having knowledge of the crime.

text:
Lunsay nanginwala ang negosyante kag ang aktres sa amo nga alegasyon.#

(Photo: Darlene Cay)
english:
Both the businessman and the actress denied the allegation.

(Photo: Darlene Jay)

text: Yara sa 100 ka mga ido kag kuring ang naka-avail sang libre nga neutering services halin sa Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office.
english: About 100 dogs and cats availed of free neutering services from the Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office.

text: Ini kadungan man sa pagselebrar sang 124th Semana sang Iloilo.
english: This is also in conjunction with the celebration of the 124th Week of Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Darel Tabuada, Veterinarian sa Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office, iya ginpahayag nga kaangot sang aktibidad, nag-imbetar ang talatapan sang mga veterinary halin sa Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) agud maka-augment sa amo nga programa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Darel Tabuada, Veterinarian at the Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office, said that in connection with the activity, the office invited veterinarians from the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) to augment the program.

text: Suno kay Tabuada, lakip sa mga libre nga ginatanyag sang provincial government amo ang bakuna, vitamins, purga, kag konsultasyon.
english: According to Tabuada, among the free services offered by the provincial government are vaccines, vitamins, purges, and consultations.

text: Naghatag naman sang sample sang dog foods ang mga kompanya nga partners Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office.
english: The companies partners Iloilo Provincial Veterinary Office also provided samples of dog foods.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga bukas sa tanan nga fur parents ang aktibidad ilabi na sa syudad sang Iloilo bisan pa nga ginadumala ini sang provincial government.
english: He also explained that the activity is open to all fur parents especially in Iloilo City even though it is run by the provincial government.

text: Tinutuyo sang aktibidad amo ang mapasangkad ang ihibalo sang mga responsible pet owners.
english: The purpose of the activity is to raise awareness among responsible pet owners.

text: Ginaseksyar sang 3rd Infantry Division Philippine Army ang posibilidad kon may mga kandidato nga konektado sa mga rebelde.
english: The 3rd Infantry Division Philippine Army is investigating the possibility if there are candidates connected to the rebels.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Colonel Erwin Rommel Lamzon, assistant division commander sang 3rd Infantry Division Philippine Army, iya ginpahayag nga nagapatuman na sang posturing ang talatapan para sa palaabuton nga national and local elections sa Mayo 12, 2025.
english: Colonel Erwin Rommel Lamzon, assistant division commander of the 3rd Infantry Division of the Philippine Army, said the office is already implementing posturing for the upcoming national and local elections on May 12, 2025.

text: Suno kay Lamzon, ginmanduan na ang tanan nga troops nga yara sa idalom sang 3rd Infantry Division nga i-handa ang ila kaugalingon kon kinahanglan sang pwersa sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC).
english: Lamzon said all troops under the 3rd Infantry Division have been ordered to prepare themselves if the Commission on Elections (COMELEC) forces are needed.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga mahimo ibutang sa duha ka tracks ang tikang nga ipatuman kon sa diin, ang isa amo ang paglantaw sa insurgency kon may relasyon pa ang politiko sa mga rebelde.
english: He also said that the measure can be put in two tracks where, one is to look at the insurgency if the politician still has a relationship with the rebels.

text: Lakip man diri ang intense political rivalry kon sa diin, mas pasangkaron ang public safety and security nga i-handle naman sang Philippine National Police (PNP).
english: This also includes the intense political rivalry where public safety and security will be handled by the Philippine National Police (PNP).

text: Gintuad man ni Lamzon nga wala nila ginadula ang posibilidad sang pagpatuman sang tax implementing group sa kabukiran ukon mas kilala sa tawag nga ‘permit to win’ kag ‘permit to conduct a campaign’ nga ginatanyag sang mga rebelde sa mga kandidato.

text: Siyam sa 12 ka nagdaog nga mga senador sa May 12 midterm elections ang naggasto sang masobra P100-million kada isa para sa ila pagpangampanya.

english: Others who spent more than P100-million were Senators Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan (P119.40-million), Rodante Marcoleta (P112.86-million), and Erwin Tulfo (P110.36-million).

text: Ginpangabay sang Department of Agriculture (DA) sa Department of Budget and Management (DBM) nga ipagwa na ang nabilin nga pondo halin sa rice tariff collections sang nagligad nga tuig nga nagalab-ot sa kapin P24 billion.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) has asked the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) to release the remaining funds from last year's rice tariff collections amounting to more than P24 billion.

text: Suno kay Agriculture Assistant Secretary kag spokesperson Arnel de Mesa, nagalaum ang DA nga ipagwa na ang alokasyon subong nga quarter agud nga mapuslan sang mga mangunguma sa tion pa lang sang dry season.
english: According to Agriculture Assistant Secretary and spokesperson Arnel de Mesa, the DA hopes to release the allocation this quarter so that farmers can benefit during the dry season.

text: Ang rice tariff collections ang kabahin sang Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund nga nagatuyo nga mapa-uswag kag ma-modernisar ang lokal nga industriya sang humay.
english: The rice tariff collections are part of the Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund which aims to develop and modernize the local rice industry.

text: Suno sa Bureau of Customs, may total nga P34.23 bilyon nga rice tariffs sang tuig 2024 nga mataas sang 14% ipaanggid sa P29.93 bilyon sang 2023.
english: According to the Bureau of Customs, there will be a total of P34.23 billion in rice tariffs in 2024, up 14% compared to P29.93 billion in 2023.

text: May yara na sang P10 bilyon para sa RCEF sa idalom sang General Appropriations Act 2025 kag na-release na ini sa DA.
english: There is already P10 billion for the RCEF under the General Appropriations Act 2025 and it has been released to the DA.

text: Bangud sini, may balanse nga P24.23 bilyon.
english: As a result, there is a balance of P24.23 billion.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni De Mesa nga P9 bilyon ang ipatupa para sa programa sa mekanisasyon kag P6 bilyon para sa inbred rice seeds halin sa total rice tariffs nga nakuha sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: De Mesa said P9 billion will be allocated for the mechanization program and P6 billion for inbred rice seeds from the total rice tariffs obtained last year.

text: Dugang pa, nagsumiter na ang DA sang ila proposal para sa pagbahin-bahin sang nabilin nga P19.23 bilyon nga rice tariff collections.
english: In addition, the DA has already submitted its proposal for the distribution of the remaining P19.23 billion rice tariff collections.

text: Ini ang ipanagtag sa pito ka mga programa nga amo ang training, pinansyal nga bulig, credit access, composting facilities, pest management, solar-powered irrigation, kag soil health improvement.#

text: Ginhingadlan sang isa sa mga akusado ang negosyante nga si Charlie “Atong” Ang nga amo ang mastermind sa pagkadula sang mga manugbulang sang 2021.
english: One of the accused named businessman Charlie “Atong” Ang as the mastermind behind the disappearance of the healers in 2021.

text: Sandig ini sa panaysayon ni Julie “Dondon” Patidongan nga nag-alegar man nga may ihibalo man ang beterana nga aktres nga si Gretchen Barretto sa mga natabo.
english: This is based on the testimony of Julie “Dondon” Patidongan who also alleged that veteran actress Gretchen Barretto was also aware of the incidents.

text: Si Patidongan amo anay ang nagapanguna sa seguridad sang cock farms ni Ang.
english: Patidongan used to be in charge of the security of Ang's cock farms.

text: Sa iya statement, ang ginhingadlan pa sini nga utok sa krimen luwas kay Atong Ang amo sanday Eric Dela Rosa kag Engineer Celso Salazar.
english: In his statement, he also named the masterminds of the crime besides Atong Ang as Eric Dela Rosa and Engineer Celso Salazar.

text: Suno kay Patidongan, si Dela Rosa ang nagpa-monitor sa mga manugbulang nga may “nagapangdaya”; sunod nga ini ang gin-report kay Atong; kag gin-diskusyunan kaupod kay Salazar.
english: According to Patidongan, Dela Rosa monitored the “cheaters”; next it was reported to Atong; and discussed with Salazar.

text: Ginpahayag ni Patidongan nga gintawagan siya agud i-hold ang mga manugbulang.
english: Patidongan said he was called to hold the practitioners.

text: Dugang sini, si Atong gid ang ginakabig niya nga “pinaka-mastermind” bangud ini ang nagsugo nga himuson na ang mga manugbulang.
english: He added that Atong is considered the “most mastermind” because he ordered the preparation of the manugbulang.

text: “Mr. Charlie Atong Ang and then Eric Dela Rosa, Engineer Celso Salazar, sila ang mastermind sa mga nawawalang sabungero,” pahayag sang whistleblower.
english: “Mr. Charlie Atong Ang and then Eric Dela Rosa, Engineer Celso Salazar, they are the masterminds of the missing sabungero,” the whistleblower said.

text:
“Si Mr. Atong Ang…siya ang pinaka-mastermind at siya naguutos na talagang iligpit ng mga ‘yan.”

Pahayag pa niya, 100% nga may ihibalo si Gretchen sa tanan nga ini ilabi na bangud masami ini nga kaupod ni Atong sang una.
english:
"Mr. Atong Ang...he's the mastermind and he's ordering that they be really tight."

He said Gretchen is 100% aware of all this especially since she was often with Atong in the past.

text: Nagpanawagan man ang akusado sa beterana nga aktres nga magbulig na lang para sa kaso.
english: The accused also appealed to the veteran actress to cooperate for the case.

text: Isa si Patidongan sa anum ka mga akusado sa pag-abduct sa mga manugbulang nga na-report nga missing halin sang 2021-2022.
english: Patidongan is one of six accused in the abduction of healers who were reported missing from 2021-2022.

text: Ginsiling sini nga sa sulod sang malawig nga tinuig, subong lang siya nagpangisog sa paghambal sang matuod bangud nagapati siya nga indi sarang mabayaran ukon mapahipos ni Atong si Philippine National Police chief General Nicolas Torre III.
english: He said that after many years, he only dared to tell the truth because he believes that Atong cannot pay or silence Philippine National Police chief General Nicolas Torre III.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, nagpahayag naman ang kampo ni Atong nga kasuhan nila si Patidongan sa Office of the Prosecutor sa Mandaluyong.
english: Meanwhile, Atong's camp said they will sue Patidongan at the Office of the Prosecutor in Mandaluyong.

text: Sabat naman ni Patidongan, wala siya nahadlok.
english: Patidongan said he was not afraid.

text: Nagpanawagan man ini kay President Ferdinand Marcos nga manduan ang mga awtorida nga resolbahon gilayon ang kaso para sa mga pamilya sang mga biktima.#
english: He also called on President Ferdinand Marcos to order the authorities to immediately resolve the case for the families of the victims.

text: Nagalaum ang Kabataan Partylist nga tsekyaron sang maayo sang Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC) ang mga campaign posters nga ila ginapangbaklas sa Iloilo City.
english: The Kabataan Partylist hopes that the Iloilo City Commission on Elections (COMELEC) will thoroughly check the campaign posters they are removing in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Crimson Labinghisa, Kabataan Partylist – 9th Nominee, Koalisyong Makabayan Panay, iya ginpahayag nga madamo man sang mga kandidato kag Partido ang nakapaskil ang ila tarpaulin sa La Paz Plaza apang, daw kaangay nga ila lang ang ginakuha.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Crimson Labinghisa, Kabataan Partylist – 9th Nominee, Koalisyong Makabayan Panay, said that many candidates and parties have posted their tarpaulins in La Paz Plaza but, it seems that they are the only ones taking them.

text: Ini bangud suno sa natungdan sa isa ka detail nga wala nakabutang ang ‘paid for by’ sa ila tarpaulin nga isa sa mga nakasaad sa patakaran sang COMELEC.
english: This is because, according to the concerned, in a detail that did not put 'paid for by' on their tarpaulin which is one of the rules of the COMELEC.

text: Suno kay Labinghisa, sugod sang Pebrero sa pagsugod sang campaign period sa bahin sang nasyonal, makaisa lang ka bes nga nagpakig-angot sa ila ang COMELEC kag wala na ini nasulit.
english: According to Labinghisa, since February at the beginning of the campaign period on the national side, the COMELEC has contacted them only once and it has not been repeated.

text: Gintuad sini nga kontani nagkoordinar sa ila ang COMELEC agud nga mapaathag kon may bayolasyon gidman sa ila mga campaign materials ilabi na nga limitado lamang ang mapaguwa nga tarpaulins sang ila nga partido.
english: He admitted that the COMELEC should have coordinated with them to clarify if there was any violation in their campaign materials especially since the tarpaulins of their party are limited.

text: Nagapaninghamot na ang rematch ukon round two sa tunga nanday US President Joe Biden kag anay President Donald Trump sa eleksyon sa pagka-presidente sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The rematch or round two between US President Joe Biden and former President Donald Trump in the presidential election in the United States of America is getting closer.

text: Ini matapos ang pagdaog ni Trump sa New Hampshire primary sang ginlutos sini ang nabilin nga challenger nga si Nikki Haley kag nagahilapit nga makuha ang presidential nomination sang Republican Party.
english: This comes after Trump won the New Hampshire primary when he defeated the remaining challenger Nikki Haley and comes close to clinching the Republican Party's presidential nomination.

text: Maragtas ini kay Trump nga amo ang labing-una nga kandidato sa Republicans sa modern era nga indi incumbent apang nagdaog sa Iowa kag New Hampshire Republican contests.
english: This is history with Trump being the first Republican candidate in the modern era who was not an incumbent but won Iowa and New Hampshire Republican contests.

text: Indi pa tapos ang away para kay Haley bangud nagapreparar man ini sa primary sa iya nadak-an nga state sa South Carolina, apang kun basehan ang maragtas sang Republicans, wala sang kandidato nga nagdaog na sang duha ka imbukada nga contests apang napaslawan pa nga makuha ang nominasyon sang partido.
english: The fight is not over for Haley as she also prepares for the primary in her home state of South Carolina, but based on the history of Republicans, no candidate has won two inaugural contests but failed to get the party's nomination.

text: Para naman sa 81-anyos nga si Biden, tuman na ka klaro nga si Trump ang mangin nominee sang Republicans sa eleksyon sa Nobyembre.
english: As for the 81-year-old Biden, it is already very clear that Trump will be the Republican nominee in the November election.

text: May T-shirt na subong nga naga-guluwa sa kampo ni Biden kun sa diin nakasaad: “Together, we will beat Trump.
english: There is now a T-shirt coming out of the Biden camp that says: “Together, we will beat Trump.

text:
Again.”

Bilog nga kalibutan ang nagalantaw sa eleksyon sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika ilabi na sa gyera nga ginakaulamiran sang mga kaalyado sang Amerika nga Israel kag Ukraine kag mga problema nga nagapalibot sa mga plano ni Trump sa foreign policy lakip na ang posible pagguwa sini sa North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO).#



Courtesy: Getty Images via CNBC
english:
Again.”

The whole world is watching the election in the United States of America especially the war between America's allies Israel and Ukraine and the problems surrounding Trump's foreign policy plans including his possible withdrawal from the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO).#



Courtesy: Getty Images via CNBC

text: Maabtik nga ginpasibangod sang Russia sa Ukraine ang pagpatibusok sa isa ka military transport plane nga may sakay nga Ukrainian prisoners of war.
english: Russia quickly blamed Ukraine for the bombing of a military transport plane carrying Ukrainian prisoners of war.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa southern region sang Belgorod kun sa diin sandig sa kumpirmasyon sang Russian ministry of defence, patay gid ang tanan nga sakay lakip ang 65 ka mga preso nga amo kuntani ang i-swap sa Ukraine, anum ka crew, kag tatlo ka Russian servicemen.
english: The incident occurred in the southern region of Belgorod where, according to the confirmation of the Russian ministry of defense, all on board were killed including 65 prisoners who were supposed to be swapped to Ukraine, six crew, and three Russian servicemen.

text: Suno pa sa Russia, nagpalupad ang Ukraine sang duha ka anti-craft missiles halin sa Lyptsi area south sang Ukrainian border nga amo ang rason sa pagtibusok sang Russian Ilyushin-76 military transport plane.
english: According to Russia, Ukraine fired two anti-craft missiles from the Lyptsi area south of the Ukrainian border, which caused the Russian Ilyushin-76 military transport plane to crash.

text: Ini isa ka Soviet-era military transport aircraft nga gindesinyo agud nga makakarga sang mabug-at nga mga equipment.Wala sang direkta nga kumpirmasyon kag pagpanginwala halin sa Ukraine nga sila matuod ang nag-igu sa eroplano, apang halangpon ang ila statement nga amo naman ang nagabasol sa Russia bangud sa pagbutang sa risgo sa kabuhi sang prisoners of war.
english: It is a Soviet-era military transport aircraft designed to carry heavy equipment. There is no direct confirmation or denial from Ukraine that they indeed hit the plane, but their statement blames Russia for putting the lives of prisoners of war at risk.

text: Suno sa Ukrainian military intelligence, wala nagpaandam ukon nagpahibalo ang Russia nga dapat safe anay ang airspace sa Belgorod.
english: According to Ukrainian military intelligence, Russia did not warn or inform that the airspace in Belgorod should be safe first.

text: Una pa nga ginpahayag sang general staff nga karga sang eroplano ang missiles halin sa S-300 air defence systems sang Russia kag wala ini sang na-mensyonar nga may karga man ang eroplano nga mga prisoners of war.
english: The general staff earlier said the plane was carrying missiles from Russia's S-300 air defense systems and did not mention that the plane was also carrying prisoners of war.

text: Base pa sa statement sang Ukraine, responsibilidad kuntani sang Russia nga siguruhon ang safety sang mga prisoners sa idalom sang mga nakasugtan sang duha ka nasyon.
english: According to Ukraine's statement, it was Russia's responsibility to ensure the safety of the prisoners under the agreements between the two countries.

text: Ginpahayag naman sang Ukrainian Ministry of Defense, Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War kag Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights nga ginatipon pa subong kag gina-analisa ang tanan nga impormasyon.
english: The Ukrainian Ministry of Defense, Coordination Headquarters for the Treatment of Prisoners of War and the Ukrainian Parliament Commissioner for Human Rights said they are still gathering and analyzing all information.

text: Nagpaandam man ini nga nagapadayon ang Russia sa information attacks sini batok sa Kyiv.
english: He also warned that Russia is continuing its information attacks against Kyiv.

text: Maga-apply si Department of Justice (DOJ) Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla sa posisyon sang Ombudsman.
english: Department of Justice (DOJ) Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla will apply for the position of Ombudsman.

text: Ginkumpirma ini sang tiglikom samtang nagahilapit na ang pagretiro ni Ombudsman Samuel Martires.
english: The secretary confirmed this as Ombudsman Samuel Martires' retirement approaches.

text: Isa ang Ombudsman sa primary anti-corruption bodies sang gobyerno.
english: The Ombudsman is one of the primary anti-corruption bodies of the government.

text: Gintukod ini sa idalom sang 1987 Constitution agud matapna ang kurapsyon sa gobyerno.
english: It was established under the 1987 Constitution to curb corruption in government.

text: May awtoridad ini nga magpasaka sang kaso sa Sandiganbayan batok sa ma-anomaliya nga high-ranking officials.
english: It has the authority to file cases in the Sandiganbayan against anomalous high-ranking officials.

text: Apisar nga isa ini ka independent body, ang applicants sa Ombudsman ang nagapasa sang ila nga aplikasyon sa Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) nga kaangay sa proseso sa high-ranking members sang judiciary.
english: Although it is an independent body, applicants to the Ombudsman submit their applications to the Judicial and Bar Council (JBC) which is similar to the process of high-ranking members of the judiciary.

text: Kun madala si Remulla sa shortlist kag pilion siya ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., magaserbe siya tubtub sa 2032 ukon tubtub sa ka-tunga sang termino sang masunod nga presidente sang Pilipinas.
english: If Remulla is shortlisted and chosen by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., he will serve until 2032 or until half the term of the next Philippine president.

text: Si Martires nga appointee ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sang 2018 ang natalana nga mag-retiro gikan sa serbisyo sa Hulyo 27, 2025.
english: Martires, who was an appointee of former President Rodrigo Duterte in 2018, is scheduled to retire from service on July 27, 2025.

text: Ginalantaw ni Senator Risa Hontiveros ang posibilidad nga magtukod ukon mag-upod sa independent bloc sa 20th Congress.
english: Senator Risa Hontiveros is looking at the possibility of forming or joining the independent bloc in the 20th Congress.

text: Halin si Hontiveros sa minority bloc sang 19th Congress kaupod si former Senate Minority Leader Aquilino “Koko” Pimentel III nga subong wala na sa upper chamber.
english: Hontiveros is from the minority bloc of the 19th Congress along with former Senate Minority Leader Aquilino “Koko” Pimentel III who is no longer in the upper chamber.

text: Gin-ako sini nga napinsaran sini nga magpadalagan bilang senate president, bangud ang second highest candidate amo ang mangin minority leader.
english: He admitted that he thought about running for senate president, because the second highest candidate will be the minority leader.

text: Apang kun lantawon ang numero sang possible majority and minority groups sa Senate, mas “realistic” suno sa iya nga maga-upod siya sa lain pa gid nga grupo nga amo ang independent bloc.
english: But looking at the number of possible majority and minority groups in the Senate, he said it is more “realistic” that he will join another group, the independent bloc.

text: “Based lang on the numbers, unless may dramatic shift in numbers na usually hindi nagkakaroon ng dramatic shift sa ganyan sa Philippine politics.
english: “Based on the numbers, unless there is a dramatic shift in numbers which usually does not happen in Philippine politics.

text: Just based on the numbers, pangarap ko man kami ‘yung maging minority, mas realistic sa tingin ko lang, just based on the numbers of the probable majority and the possible minority,” pahayag sini sa isa ka press conference.
english: Just based on the numbers, I dream that we will be the minority, more realistic in my opinion, just based on the numbers of the probable majority and the possible minority,” he said in a press conference.

text:
Dugang niya: “Based on the numbers, mas realistic na maging bahagi ako ng isang independent bloc or basta maging isang independent senator.”

Indi pa ini pinal bangud nagapadayon pa subong ang ila pag-istoryahanay kaupod kanday Bam Aquino kag Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan nga pareho niya nga kaalyado.
english:
He added: “Based on the numbers, it is more realistic for me to be part of an independent bloc or just be an independent senator.”

This is not yet final because they are still in talks with Bam Aquino and Francis “Kiko” Pangilinan who are both his allies.

text: Apang kun may klaro man subong suno kay Hontiveros, ini amo ang indi niya pag-upod sa mayorya — kaangay sang indi niya pag-upod diri sa halos siyam ka tuig sini sa Senado.
english: But if there is anything clear now, Hontiveros said, it is that he will not be in the majority — just as he has not been here in his nearly nine years in the Senate.

text: “And tingin ko, consistent sa pagiging miyembro ko ng minority—either manatili sa minority or magbuo ng isang independent bloc o maging independent.
english: “And I think, consistent with my being a member of the minority—either stay in the minority or form an independent bloc or be independent.

text: Hindi lang dahil sa nakaraan, pero dahil din sa kinabukasan.
english: Not just because of the past, but also because of the future.

text: Gusto ko talagang magsalamin kami o magsalamin ako dito sa loob ng Senado, do’n sa mas malakas na oposisyon na gusto kong buuin namin, tulungan naming buuin sa labas ng Senado,” paathag sini.
english: I really want us to mirror or I mirror here inside the Senate, there in the stronger opposition that I want us to build, help us build outside the Senate,” he explained.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad nga bulan, nagpahayag man si Hontiveros nga wala niya ginasiradhan ang mga posibilidad kag handa siya nga mangin standard-bearer sang opposition group sa 2028 presidential race.#
english: Last month, Hontiveros also said that he is not closing the possibilities and he is ready to be the standard-bearer of the opposition group in the 2028 presidential race.

text: Pabaskugon pa nanday United States President Joe Biden kag Vice President Kamala Harris ang pagduso sang kinamatarong sang mga tawo sa abortion paagi sa serye sang ila nga mga events subong nga semana nga amo man ang ginakabig pangontra sa kampanya ni anay President Donald Trump.
english: US President Joe Biden and Vice President Kamala Harris will intensify their push for abortion rights through a series of events this week that are also seen as opposition to former President Donald Trump's campaign.

text: Si Harris amo ang gina-promote sang Biden campaign nga amo ang nawong sang reproductive rights issue nga amo ang nagadala sang mensahe nga pananglitan magbalik sa puwesto ang Republican former president nga si Trump, magapatuman ini sang istrikto nga mga tikang agud balabagan ang abortion.
english: Harris is being promoted by the Biden campaign as the face of the reproductive rights issue that carries the message that if Republican former president Trump returns to office, he will implement strict measures to restrict abortion.

text: Kadungan sang ika-51 nga anibersaryo sang maragtason nga Roe v. Wade court decision nga amo ang naga-legalize sang abortion, nagbyahe man si Harris sa swing state sang Wisconsin agud ilunsar ang nationwide tour sa amo nga kontrobersyal nga isyu.
english: On the occasion of the 51st anniversary of the historic Roe v. Wade decision, Wade court decision that legalizes abortion, Harris also traveled to the swing state of Wisconsin to launch a nationwide tour on the controversial issue.

text: Matandaan nga sang 2022, may panibag-o nga landmark ruling ang Korte Suprema sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika nga nagabaliskad sa amo nga desisyon — isa ka desisyon nga gintawag ni Biden nga “tragic error” sa bahin sang mga Republicans.
english: It can be recalled that in 2022, there was a new landmark ruling by the Supreme Court of the United States of America that overturned that decision — a decision that Biden called a “tragic error” on the part of Republicans.

text: Subong naman nga bulan, nagapakigsapol si Biden sa mga eksperto sa reproductive healthcare sa White House.
english: This month, Biden is meeting with reproductive healthcare experts at the White House.

text: Subong man nga adlaw natalana nga nga magpatigayon sanday Harris kag Biden sang ila labing-una nga joint appearance sa 2024 campaign.
english: On the same day, Harris and Biden are scheduled to make their first joint appearance of the 2024 campaign.

text:
Matabo ini sa Virginia kaupod kay First Lady Jill Biden kag “Second Gentleman” Douglas Emhoff nga amo ang bana ni Harris.#

(Photo by Drew Angerer/Getty Images via CNN)
english:
It will take place in Virginia with First Lady Jill Biden and “Second Gentleman” Douglas Emhoff, Harris’ husband.

(Photo by Drew Angerer/Getty Images via CNN)

text: Padayon sa karon nga ginapangita ang 16-anyos nga Pinoy nga si Kean Kaizer Talingdan sang mga awtoridad sa Switzerland matapos ang sunog nga nagluntad sa isa ka bar sa Crans-Montana sang Enero 1, 2026.
english: Swiss authorities are still searching for 16-year-old Filipino Kean Kaizer Talingdan after a fire broke out in a bar in Crans-Montana on January 1, 2026.

text: Nabilin sa sulod sang nasunog nga establisyemento ang cellphone kag iban pa nga personal nga kagamitan sang biktima, nga ginakabig subong kabahin sang imbestigasyon agud matukiban ang mga natabo antes ang sunog.
english: The victim's cellphone and other personal belongings were left inside the burned establishment, which is being considered as part of the investigation to determine the events leading up to the fire.

text: Wala sang opisyal nga kumpirmasyon sa karon nahanungod sa iya kahimtangan bangud ginahulat pa ang resulta sang DNA test.
english: There is currently no official confirmation regarding his condition as the results of the DNA test are still pending.

text: Tuman ang pagkabalaka sa karon sang iloy ni Kean, nga padayon nga nagahulat sang klaro kag opisyal nga impormasyon halin sa mga awtoridad samtang nagalaum nga matagaan sang kasanag ang matuod nga natabo sa amo nga trahedya.
english: Kean's mother is now very worried, who continues to wait for clear and official information from the authorities while hoping to shed light on the truth of the tragedy.

text: Pinaghahanda ng Department of Agriculture (DA) ang mga mangingisda sa epekto ng bagyong Tino sa sektor ng pangisdaa, lalo na ang dulot nitong mga serye ng pagbaha.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) is preparing fishermen for the impact of Typhoon Tino on the fisheries sector, especially the series of floods.

text: Sa abisong inilabas ng DA Disaster Risk Reduction Management Operations Center, pinapayuhan nito ang mga mangingisda na agahang dalhin ang mga bangkang pangisda sa at iba pang gamit pangisda sa mataas at ligtas na lugar.
english: In a notice issued by the DA Disaster Risk Reduction Management Operations Center, it advises fishermen to move their fishing boats and other fishing gear to higher and safer places.

text: Pinapayuhan din ng ahensiya ang fisherfolks na planuhin o ipagpaliban ang paglalakbay sa karagatan.
english: The agency also advises fisherfolks to plan or postpone trips to the sea.

text: Ito ay dahil na rin sa banta ng storm surge o matataas na daluyong na tiyak na makaka-apekto sa paglalakbay at pangingisda.
english: This is also due to the threat of storm surge or high waves that will certainly affect travel and fishing.

text: Sa mga mayroong palaisdaan, ipinayo ng DA ang early harvest o maagang pag-harvest sa mga alagang isda, alimango, atbpang aquatic products, dahil sa banta ng biglaang pagbaha.
english: For those who have fisheries, the DA advised early harvest of farmed fish, crabs, and other aquatic products, due to the threat of flash floods.

text: Ipinahahanda rin ng ahensiya ang post-harvest facilities na maaaring magamit, kasunod ng early o forced harvest.
english: The agency is also preparing post-harvest facilities that can be used, following early or forced harvest.

text: Nagsuprer ang Gilas Pilipinas sang ikaduha nga sunod-sunod nga kalutusan sa FIBA Asia Cup 2025.
english: Gilas Pilipinas suffered a second consecutive defeat in the FIBA ​​Asia Cup 2025.

text: Ginkabos ang national team sa comeback attempt sini batok sa New Zealand, 94-86, sa group clash sa Pool D sang tournament, Agusto 8 (PST).
english: The national team was humbled in its comeback attempt against New Zealand, 94-86, in the group clash in Pool D of the tournament, August 8 (PST).

text: Gintinguhaan pa kuntani sang Pilipinas nga makalagas sa second half matapos naglab-ot sa 18-puntos ang abanse sang Tall Blacks nga nagpaulan sang tres sa second period.
english: The Philippines tried to catch up in the second half after the Tall Blacks took an 18-point lead and rained three in the second period.

text: 37 points, 5 rebounds, kag three assists ang nahimo ni Justin Brownlee samtang may 19 points, 4 rebounds, 3 steals naman si Dwight Ramos, apang wala nakasarang sa Kiwis nga subong 2-0 na kaangay sa Chinese Taipei sa group stage.
english: Justin Brownlee had 37 points, 5 rebounds, and three assists while Dwight Ramos had 19 points, 4 rebounds, and 3 steals, but the Kiwis were now 2-0 up against Chinese Taipei in the group stage.

text: Buhi pa ang paglaom nga maka-abante ang Gilas sa masunod nga round kun malutos sini ang Iraq sa Sabado, alas kuwatro sang hapon.
english: The Gilas are still hopeful of advancing to the next round if they beat Iraq on Saturday, 4 pm.

text:
Kun magdaog ang national team, ibutang sila sa classification para sa quarterfinals.#

Box scores:

New Zealand 94 – Ngatai 22, Britt 19, Cameron 12, King 11, Darling 8, Smith-Milner 8, Gold 6, Davison 5, Andrew 3, Murray 0.
english:
If the national team wins, they will be placed in the classification for the quarterfinals.#

Box scores:

New Zealand 94 – Ngatai 22, Britt 19, Cameron 12, King 11, Darling 8, Smith-Milner 8, Gold 6, Davison 5, Andrew 3, Murray 0.

text: Gilas Pilipinas 86 – Brownlee 37, Ramos 19, Fajardo 11, Newsome 8, Quiambao 5, Tamayo 4, Thompson 2, Edu 0, Oftana 0.
english: Gilas Pilipinas 86 – Brownlee 37, Ramos 19, Fajardo 11, Newsome 8, Quiambao 5, Tamayo 4, Thompson 2, Edu 0, Oftana 0.

text: Gin-athag ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas nga wala siya nakamensyonar sang pangalan ni former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog kag Iloilo City Lone District Representative Jamjam Baronda nga nagaangot bilang protector kag pinansyer sang iligal nga druga sa syudad.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas clarified that he did not mention the names of former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog and Iloilo City Lone District Representative Jamjam Baronda who are linked as protectors and financiers of illegal drugs in the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginkatingala kon ngaa daw apektado gid ang duha ka mga lideres sang Team Sulong Gugma.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said he wondered why the two leaders of Team Sulong Gugma seem to be so affected.

text: Suno sa alkalde, ang pagbalik sang protektor kag pinansyer sang iligal nga druga sa Iloilo ang iya ginakabalak-an ilabi na nga nabansagan na ang syudad nga “Most Shabulized City”.
english: The mayor said he is concerned about the return of the protector and financier of illegal drugs to Iloilo especially since the city has been dubbed the “Most Shabulized City”.

text: Ginlaragway man sang natungdan nga kon sin-o lang ang nakabatyag sa iya nangin pahayag, sila ang naiguan.
english: He also described that those who felt his statement, they were hit.

text: Nagdepensa man ini sa mga ginapahayag trolls sang ila kampo, kon sa diin, gintumod sini nga ang kampo ni Baronda ang may madamo nga trolls sa social media.
english: He also defended the alleged trolls of his camp, pointing out that Baronda's camp has many trolls on social media.

text: TUNGOD indi sila kumporme sa desisyon sang Comelec 1st Division nga naga-dismiss sang disqualification (DQ) case ni BongBong Marcos, ginapreparar na sa karon sang mga petitioners ang pagpasaka sang ila reklamo sa Comelec en banc.
english: The petitioners are now preparing to file their complaint with the Comelec en banc.

text: Tubtub pa gani sa Korte Suprema, kon kinahanglan.
english: Even to the Supreme Court, if necessary.

text: Sa nasiling na ni Vice President Leni Robredo, mas gustuhon niya nga dag-on si BongBong Marcos  (BBM) sa presidential election sa Mayo  9, 2022, kag indi tungod ma-disqualify lang ini.
english: Vice President Leni Robredo has already said that she would rather defeat BongBong Marcos (BBM) in the presidential election on May 9, 2022, and not just because he will be disqualified.

text: Katulad ini sang dag-on niya si BBM sadtong eleksyon sang 2016 sa pagka-bise presidente.
english: This is similar to when he defeated BBM in the 2016 vice presidential election.

text: Subong man sina ang luyag matabo ni presidential aspirant Senador Ping Lacson, nga dag-on ang eleksyon sa “merits” sang kandidato.
english: Presidential aspirant Senator Ping Lacson also wants to win the election on the merits of the candidate.

text: Pero, wala makapugong si VP Leni sang iya kaham-ot sa  pagpangatarungan ni Commissioner Aimee Ferolino sa iya pagsulat sang “ruling” sang majority decision sang 1st Division sa DQ case ni BBM.
english: However, VP Leni could not hold back her anger at Commissioner Aimee Ferolino's reasoning in writing the ruling of the majority decision of the 1st Division in BBM's DQ case.

text: “Mahirap siyang intindihin kasi pag sinabing walang crime…[eh] kasi may conviction na sa RTC (Regional Trial Court) saka sa Court of Appeals.
english: “It's hard to understand him because when he says there's no crime...[eh] because there's a conviction in the RTC (Regional Trial Court) and the Court of Appeals.

text: Pag sinabi mong walang enough na batas [para magparusa ng non-filing ng income tax return], magwa-wonder ka bakit naconvict kung wala palang enough na batas,” siling gani ni Robredo, nga isa man ka abogada.
english: When you say there is not enough law [to punish non-filing of income tax return], you wonder why he was convicted if there is not enough law,” said Robredo, who is also a lawyer.

text: Ang majority decision ginhimo ni Ferolino upod ang isa pa ka commissioner minus si Commissioner Rowena Guanzon nga nagboto kontra.
english: The majority decision was made by Ferolino with one other commissioner minus Commissioner Rowena Guanzon who voted against.

text: Ugaling wala na ini maisip tungod nagtapos na ang iya termino sadtong Pebrero 2 nga wala pa masulat ni Ferolino tubtub sa schedule sini nga yara pa sa pwesto si Guanzon.
english: However, it was not counted because his term expired on February 2 and Ferolino did not write until his schedule that Guanzon was still in office.

text: Suspetso gani ni Guanzon nga ginhungod gid ni Ferolino nga i-delay ang pagsulat sang “ruling” agud indi na ma-recognize ang iya boto on record.
english: Guanzon suspected that Ferolino deliberately delayed the writing of the ruling so that his vote would not be recognized on record.

text: May tugda man si Guanzon sa sining “ruling” ni Ferolino.
