english: Guanzon also had a suggestion for Ferolino's ruling.

text: Sunu kay Guanzon, katingalahan ang pangatarungan ni Ferolino sa sinang “ruling” nga ginsulat niya.
english: According to Guanzon, Ferolino's reasoning in that “ruling” he wrote is strange.

text: Paano, siling niya, nga wala sing krimen sa indi pagbayad sang buhis ni BBM halin sadtong 1982-1985 kay convicted si BBM sang Trial Court kag sang Court of Appeals sa iya “repeated non-filing of income tax returns”?
english: How, he said, was there no crime in BBM's failure to pay taxes from 1982-1985 because BBM was convicted by the Trial Court and the Court of Appeals of his “repeated non-filing of income tax returns”?

text:
Gin-dispute man ni Guanzon ang pagtudlo ni Ferolino sa kasal-anan ni BBM nga isa lang ka malum prohibito, ukon indi “inherently wrong and immoral” tungod kuno “there is no law punishing non-filing of ITR?”

Kon may ara man kuno isa lang ka mamag-an nga multa (fine), kag tungod sini indi ini malum in se, ukon “inherently wrong”.
english:
Guanzon also disputed Ferolino's pointing to BBM's crime as a malum prohibito, or not “inherently wrong and immoral” because “there is no law punishing non-filing of ITR?”

If there is only one light fine (fine), and therefore it is not malum in se, or “inherently wrong”.

text: Gin-kwestyon ni Guanzon ining “reasoning” n Ferolino.
english: Guanzon questioned Ferolino's reasoning.

text: “There is no law punishing non-filing of ITR?
english: “There is no law punishing non-filing of ITR?

text: Why was BBM (BongBong) convicted then?
english: Why was BBM (BongBong) convicted then?

text: Any bright-bright n’yo naman (You guys are so smart),” dugang ni Guanzon.
english: Any bright-bright n’yo naman (You guys are so smart),” Guanzon added.

text: Sa aton pa, ngaa wala ma-punish si BBM kay, sa matuod, convicted si BBM sang trial court kag mismo sang Court of Appeals, kon diin wala na ini nag-appeal sa Korte Suprema tungod seguro kay nagapati ang iya mga abogado nga basi madugangan pa ang iya sentensya.
english: In other words, why BBM was not punished because, in fact, BBM was convicted by the trial court and the Court of Appeals itself, where he did not appeal to the Supreme Court because his lawyers probably believed that his sentence might be increased.

text: Siling pa ni Guanzon nga ang isa ka suspetsado pwede maakusahan sing moral turpitude bisan pa sa kaso nga malum prohibito, sunu mismo sa Korte Suprema.
english: Guanzon said a suspect can be charged with moral turpitude even in a case that is malum prohibito, according to the Supreme Court itself.

text: Kon mapamatud-an nga “harmful to people or property”, por ejemplo, pwede siya maakusahan sing moral turpitude, sunu sa aton man nabasahan.
english: If proven to be “harmful to people or property”, for example, he can be charged with moral turpitude, as we have also read.

text: Katulad sang indi pagbayad sang buhis, labi na gid kon ang nagahimo sini isa ka opisyal sang gobyerno.
english: Like not paying taxes, especially if the perpetrator is a government official.

text: Sa nahibal-an na sang publiko, wala nagbayad sing buhis si BongBong Marcos samtang Bise-Gobernator kag Gobernador sang Ilocos Norte sadtong 1982 tubtub 1985.
english: As far as the public knows, BongBong Marcos did not pay taxes while he was Vice-Governor and Governor of Ilocos Norte from 1982 to 1985.

text: Ini naman ang matugda ni anay Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) Commissioner Kim Henares.
english: This was proposed by former Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) Commissioner Kim Henares.

text: “Moral turpitude does not even come in,” pamat-ud gani ni Henares.
english: “Moral turpitude does not even come in,” Henares concluded.

text: Ginpahayag ni Henares nga maathag (clear) ang Tax Code parti sini.
english: Henares said the Tax Code is clear on this.

text: “I think the discussion on moral turpitude is just confusing the whole issue,” siling niya.
english: “I think the discussion on moral turpitude is just confusing the whole issue,” he said.

text: “The law itself is very clear: If you are a government official, you violated any provision of the tax code, whatever those provision[s] are and you got convicted, you are perpetually disqualified,” pamat-ud pa niya.
english: “The law itself is very clear: If you are a government official, you violated any provision of the tax code, whatever those provision[s] are and you got convicted, you are perpetually disqualified,” he concluded.

text: Gintudlo niya ang Chapter III, Sec.
english: He pointed to Chapter III, Sec.

text: 269 sang Tax Code kon diin ang isa ka opisyal sang gobyerno dapat magbayad sing buhis nga indi kinahanglan kon san-o wala siya nagbayad.
english: 269 ​​of the Tax Code where a government official has to pay tax which is not necessary when he has not paid.

text: “Ang kasal-anan diri, retroactively,” dugang niya.
english: “The guilt here, retroactively,” he added.

text: Kag ina kon ngaa na-convict si BBM sa indi pagbayad niya sing buhis./PN
english: And that's why BBM was convicted of not paying taxes./PN

text:
Nagalantaw ka man bala sang mga bantog nga Mukbang ukon “eating show?”

Sa mukbang, nagapreparar ang mga vlogger sang tuman ka damo nga pagkaon kun sa diin mabatian man ang tunog sang ila pag-usap.
english:
Do you also watch popular Mukbang or “eating shows?”

In the mukbang, the vloggers prepare a lot of food where the sound of their chewing can be heard.

text: Makalilingaw man ini nga mga eating show apang suno sa mga eksperto, nagakadapat likawan ang masami nga paglantaw sang mukbang bangud dako ang risgo nga mahatag sini sa ikaayong lawas.
english: These eating shows are also entertaining but according to experts, frequent viewing of mukbang should be avoided because it poses a serious risk to health.

text: Suno kay Sydney Lappe, registered dietician sa Missouri, ang masami nga paglantaw sa mga tawo nga nagakaon sang tuman kadamo ang maka-promote sang overeating kag poor eating habits.
english: According to Sydney Lappe, registered dietician in Missouri, frequently watching people eat too much can promote overeating and poor eating habits.

text: Santo sa pagtuon, sa sulod sang 21 ka adlaw nga paglantaw sang isa ka indibidwal sa mga vlogger nga nagakaon sa atubang sang camera, natukiban nga naga-form sang poor eating habit ang tumalan-aw.
english: According to the study, during 21 days of watching an individual vloggers eat in front of the camera, it was found that the viewer formed a poor eating habit.

text: Pahayag sang dietician, dako ang psychological effect sang paglantaw sa mga tawo nga nagakaon sang madamo bangud nagaresulta ini sa pag-overeat sang tumalan-aw gani nagasaka man ang risgo sa pag-angkon sini sang weight-related health kaangay sang type 2 diabetes kag heart disease.
english: According to the dietician, the psychological effect of watching people eating a lot is great because it results in the viewer overeating and thus increasing the risk of developing weight-related health such as type 2 diabetes and heart disease.

text: Indi kumporme ang iban nga mga kongresista sa mga paagi ni 4th District Quezon City Rep.
english: Some congressmen disagree with the methods of 4th District Quezon City Rep.

text: Bong Suntay sa pagdepensa kay Vice President Sara Duterte kaangot sa ginaatubang sini nga mga impeachment complaints.
english: Bong Suntay in defense of Vice President Sara Duterte regarding the impeachment complaints she is facing.

text: Gin-play kahapon sa Kamara ang isa ka parte sang online press briefing ni Sara sang Nobyembre 2024 kun sa diin nagpaandam ini nga kun ipapatay siya, naka-kontak naman siya sang hitman agud patyon si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos, kag former Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez.
english: A part of Sara's online press briefing in November 2024 was played in the House of Representatives yesterday in which she warned that if she is killed, she has contacted a hitman to kill President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., First Lady Liza Araneta Marcos, and former Speaker Ferdinand Martin Romualdez.

text: Nagsabat si Suntay kag ginsal-ot sa eksena ang iya misis nga suno sa iya masami man nagapamahog nga patyon siya bangud gab-i na siya nagapauli.
english: Suntay responded and brought his wife into the scene who he said often threatened to kill him because he came home late.

text: Common sense lang suno kay Suntay nga kun seryoso gid man ang isa ka tawo kaangot sa pagpatay, indi man niya ini pag-i-anunsyo sa kalibutan.
english: Suntay said it is common sense that if a person is serious about murder, he will not announce it to the world.

text: Ginkontra naman ni 6th District Manila Representative Benny Abante ang statement ni Suntay.
english: 6th District Manila Representative Benny Abante contradicted Suntay's statement.

text: Pahayag sini, private citizen ang asawa ni Suntay, samtang indi naman pribado nga tawo si Sara.
english: He said Suntay's wife is a private citizen, while Sara is not a private person.

text: May gahum ang Office of the Vice President suno sa iya kaangay sang access, impluwensya, kag security resources.
english: The Office of the Vice President has powers, he said, such as access, influence, and security resources.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang amo nga pahayag ni Sara sa “kill order” amo ang isa sa ginbasehan sang pag-file sang impeachment complaint batok sa iya.
english: It was learned that Sara's statement on the “kill order” was one of the grounds for the filing of an impeachment complaint against her.

text: Makaguwa na sa ospital subong nga adlaw, Hulyo 1, si former Negros Oriental Representative Arnolfo Teves Jr.
english: Former Negros Oriental Representative Arnolfo Teves Jr. will be discharged from the hospital today, July 1.

text: matapos nagpaidalom sa emergency appendectomy sang Hunyo 18.
english: after undergoing an emergency appendectomy on June 18.

text: Suno sa iya abogado nga si Ferdinand Topacio, magabalik na ang kongresista sa iya selda nga nahamtang sa Annex 2 sang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP).
english: His lawyer, Ferdinand Topacio, said the congressman will return to his cell located in Annex 2 of the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP).

text: Dugang ni Topacio, apisar nagabatyag pa si Teves sang kasakit sa tiyan, ginbaton niya ang clearance nga magaguwa na ini sa ospital kag magabalik sa iya selda agud nga maghipos na ang sala kag malisyoso nga mga kritiko.
english: Topacio said that although Teves is still feeling pain in his stomach, he accepted the clearance that he will be discharged from the hospital and return to his cell so that the wrong and malicious critics will be silent.

text: Nagpasalamat man si Teves sa mga doktor nga nag-atipan sa iya sang maayo samtang yara siya sa ospital, kag sa tanan nga nagpalab-ot sang mensahe para sa iya pag-ayo.
english: Teves also thanked the doctors who took such good care of him while he was in the hospital, and everyone who conveyed messages for his recovery.

text: Padayon nga pagabantayan ang iya kahimtangan sa Annex 2 agud masiguro ang iya ikaayong-lawas.
english: His condition will continue to be monitored in Annex 2 to ensure his health.

text:
Matandaan nga Hunyo 17 sang na-ospital si Teves nga nagresulta sang rekomendasyon para sa “major surgery.”

Nahibaluan nga si Teves ang ginatudlo nga utok sa pagpatay kay anay Negros Oriental Gov.
english:
Teves was hospitalized on June 17, which resulted in a recommendation for major surgery.

Teves is the alleged mastermind behind the murder of former Negros Oriental Gov.

text: Roel Degamo kag iban pa sang Marso 2023.
english: Roel Degamo and others in March 2023.

text: Magluwas diri, gina-akusaran man sa iya sa iban pa nga kaso sang pagpatay sa amo nga probinsya kag gin-tag man bilang terorista.#
english: He is also accused of other murder cases in the province and has been tagged as a terrorist.

text: Lain ang gahum sang gugma — ano man nga tion kag bisan diin man nga lugar, may ginahimo gid ini nga mahika.
english: The power of love is different — whatever the time and wherever it is, it always does something magical.

text: Kaangay sang magkahagugma sa Gaza nga pareho nga nagtalal-as sa ila nga lugar sa Palestine sang nagtimalos na ang Israel kag naglunsar sang aistrikes bangud sa kaakig sini sa ginhimo sang Hamas militants sang Oktubre 7.
english: Like the lovers in Gaza who both fled their homes in Palestine when Israel took revenge and launched aistrikes in anger over the actions of Hamas militants on October 7.

text: Sang amo nga tion, naguba gid ang balay ni Mohammed al-Ghandour kag sang iya nobya nga si Shahad.
english: At that time, the house of Mohammed al-Ghandour and his girlfriend Shahad was completely destroyed.

text: Nadulaan man sila sang mga pinalangga sa kabuhi kag sang amo nga tion, daw sigurado na gid nga indi na madayon ang ila ginahandum nga kasal.
english: They had also lost loved ones in life and by that time, it seemed pretty certain that their dream wedding would never happen.

text: Lakip sila sa ginpunsok sa “tent city” ukon ang lugar sa Rafah sa southern nga bahin sang Gaza malapit sa Egypt kun sa diin linibo ka mga tents ang naka-plastar nga amo ang puluy-an sang mga tawo sa sulod na sang binulan nga gyera.
english: They are among those gathered in the “tent city” or area of ​​Rafah in the southern part of Gaza near Egypt where thousands of tents have been set up to house people during the months-long war.

text: Bisan amo sini ang sitwasyon, gintinguhaan gid ni Ghandour nga makasal sila ni Shahad.
english: Despite the situation, Ghandour tried her best to get her and Shahad married.

text: Sa bulig sang ila pamilya, nadekorahan sang lights ang tent kag ginpasuukan man ang bride sang puti nga bayo nga disente para sa kasal.
english: With the help of their family, the tent was decorated with lights and the bride was dressed in a white dress decent for the wedding.

text: Sa sulod man mismo sang tent ginpasuksokan sang singsing ang bride nga amo ang tanda sang ila paghigugma nga wala sang katapusan.
english: Inside the tent, the bride was given a ring as a sign of their eternal love.

text: Nagpanguna man ang iloy ni Shahad sa mga babayi nga nag-selebrar sang ila kasal kag may yara man sang nag-kinot sang ila batteries agud nga may yara sila sang gamiton para sa gamay nga portable music player.
english: Shahad's mother also led the women who celebrated their wedding and some also saved their batteries so that they could have something to use for a small portable music player.

text: Limitado ang pagkaon sa amo nga lugar gani kuntento na ang bride kag groom sa snaks nga nakabutang sa plastic nga nakaplastar sa sulod sang tent.
english: Food is limited in the area so the bride and groom are content with snacks in plastic bags placed inside the tent.

text: “We are a people that love life, despite death, murders and destruction,” suno kay Mohamed Jibril nga amay sang bride.
english: “We are a people that love life, despite death, murders and destruction,” said Mohamed Jibril, the bride’s father.

text: Samtang may gamay nga wedding party kag may matunog nga nagapalakpak, padayon naman ang iban nga mga tawo sa kaiping nga tents sa ila nga mga ulubrahon kaangay sang pagpangita sang pagkaon kag pagpanglaba.
english: While there was a small wedding party and loud applause, other people in the neighboring tents continued their chores such as looking for food and doing laundry.

text: Gin-ako sang groom nga kasunod sang mga hitabo sa gyera, halos tres porsyento lang gid ang iya kalipay nga nabatyagan apang luyag gid sini nga mangin malipayon ang iya asawa rason nga gindayon ang kasal.
english: The groom admitted that following the events of the war, he felt only about three percent happiness but he really wanted his wife to be happy so he went ahead with the wedding.

text: Nahibaluan nga sandig sa data sa Paletinian health authorities, lapaw na sa 24,700 ang napatay sa Gaza halin sang naglunsar ang Israel sang airstrikes bilang balos sa Hamas militants nga amo ang nagpatay sang masobra man 1,200 ka tawo sa southern Israel.# (AFP)
english: According to data from the Palestinian health authorities, more than 24,700 people have been killed in Gaza since Israel launched airstrikes in retaliation for Hamas militants who killed more than 1,200 people in southern Israel.# (AFP)

text: Mas hugton sang Iloilo Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) ang pagbantay sa mga pantalan sa probinsya kasunod sang dalagko-an nga recoveries sang iligal nga druga.
english: The Iloilo Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU) will tighten surveillance at ports in the province following the large recoveries of illegal drugs.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Dadje Delima, Head sang Iloilo Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit, iya ginpahayag nga padayon ang ila koordinasyon Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) kag pila ka ahensya sang gobyerno agud nga hugot nga mabantayan ang mga entry points sang probinsya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Dadje Delima, Head of the Iloilo Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit, said they are continuing to coordinate with the Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) and several government agencies to strictly monitor the entry points of the province.

text: Suno kay Delima, padayon man ang hugot nga pagpakig-angot sang talatapan sa Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) agud nga mapasanyog ang pagkampanya batok sa iligal nga druga.
english: Delima said the office also continues to work closely with the Philippine Drug Enforcement Agency (PDEA) to promote the campaign against illegal drugs.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga tayuyon ang monitoring sang PDEU sa probinsya ilabi na sa northern part sang Iloilo.
english: He also said that the PDEU is continuously monitoring the province especially in the northern part of Iloilo.

text: Gintumod man sang natungdan nga kalabanan sa mga druga nga nagasulod sa Iloilo ang nagahalin sa Manila kag ginapadala lamang sa probinsya, rason man nga nagakadapat nga mas pasangkaron ang pagbantay sa mga pantalan.
english: He also pointed out that most of the drugs entering Iloilo come from Manila and are sent only to the province, which is why it is necessary to strengthen the security at the ports.

text:
Naghatag ang Department of Health (DOH) sang libre nga human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) testing, konsultasyon kag iban pa sa ginpatigayon nga “Love Loud Love Safe: Pride Run 2025”

Suno sa DOH, nag-offer sila sang libre nga HIV testing kag konsultasyon, libre nga condoms, lubricants, pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP), at HIV self-testing kits, kag pagpasanyog sang impormasyon tuhoy sa HIV/AIDS.
english:
The Department of Health (DOH) provided free human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) testing, consultation and others during the “Love Loud Love Safe: Pride Run 2025”

According to the DOH, they offered free HIV testing and consultation, free condoms, lubricants, pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP), and HIV self-testing kits, and information dissemination about HIV/AIDS.

text: Samtang, available man ang libre sa nagkalain-lain nga mga testing hubs sa bilog nga pungsod halin 3 am tubtob 9 am.
english: Meanwhile, it is also available for free at various testing hubs across the country from 3 am to 9 am.

text: Sa pihak sini, nagapawagan naman ang DOH kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr., nga ideklara ang HIV bilang isa ka national public health emergency bangud sa madasig nga pagtaas sang mga bag-o nga kaso sa pungsod.
english: Meanwhile, the DOH is calling on President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to declare HIV a national public health emergency due to the rapid increase in new cases in the country.

text: Nagkalain-lain ang mga reaksyon sang mga pungsod kasunod sang paglunsar sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika kag United Kingdom sang airstrikes sa Yemen batok sa Houthi rebels nga suportado sang Iran kag amo ang nagapang-atake sang mga nagalabay nga barko sa Red Sea.
english: International reactions have been mixed following the United States of America and the United Kingdom’s launch of airstrikes in Yemen against Iranian-backed Houthi rebels who have been attacking passing ships in the Red Sea.

text: Suno sa Iran, ang strikes sang US kag UK ang maathag nga paglapas sa soberanya kag territorial integrity sang Yemen.
english: Iran said the US and UK strikes were a clear violation of Yemen’s sovereignty and territorial integrity.

text: “The attacks are happening in an effort to extend the full support of the US and UK in approximately the past 100 days for the war crimes of the Zionist regime against the Palestinian people and the besieged citizens of Gaza,” suno sa Ministry of Foreign Affairs.
english: “The attacks are happening in an effort to extend the full support of the US and UK in approximately the past 100 days for the war crimes of the Zionist regime against the Palestinian people and the besieged citizens of Gaza,” according to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

text: Sa Turkey naman, ginkondenar ni President Recep Tayyip Erdogan ang strikes kag ginsiling sini nga daw kaangay nga ginatinguhaan sang US kag UK nga himuon ang Red Sea nga dagat sang dugo bangud sa ila nga ginhimo.
english: In Turkey, President Recep Tayyip Erdogan condemned the strikes and said it was as if the US and UK were trying to turn the Red Sea into a sea of ​​blood because of their actions.

text: “All of these acts are disproportionate use of force,” pahayag sang presidente.
english: “All of these acts are disproportionate use of force,” the president said.

text:
“Israel also resorts to this disproportionate use of force in Palestine.”

Sa Jordan, ginbasol naman ni Jordanian foreign minister Ayman Safadi ang pagpang-atake sang Israel sa Gaza nga amo ang rason kun ngaa nagsaka ang tensyon sa rehiyon.
english:
“Israel also resorts to this disproportionate use of force in Palestine.”

In Jordan, Jordanian foreign minister Ayman Safadi blamed Israel's attacks on Gaza for the rise in tensions in the region.

text: Nagdepensa naman ang NATO kag gindampigan ang US kag UK paagi sa pagsiling nga ini nga strikes ang depensa lamang kag ginhimo agud mapabilin ang freedom of navigation sa Red Sea.
english: NATO defended itself and sided with the US and UK by saying that the strikes were only defensive and were done to maintain freedom of navigation in the Red Sea.

text: Ginalantaw man sang military alliance nga paagi ini agud tapuson ang mga pagpang-atake sang Houthis.
english: The military alliance also sees it as a way to end Houthis attacks.

text:
Ginmensyonar man sini ang Iran nga amo ang nagasuporta sa rebelde: “Houthi forces are supported, supplied and equipped by Iran, so Tehran has a special responsibility to rein in its proxies.”

Nahibaluan nga indi involved ang NATO sa amo nga airstrikes apang myembro sang amo nga alyansa ang US kag UK samtang naghatag naman sang surporta ang duha ka iban pa nga myembro sang alyansa nga the Netherlands kag Canada.
english:
It also mentioned Iran as the rebel backer: “Houthi forces are supported, supplied and equipped by Iran, so Tehran has a special responsibility to rein in its proxies.”

NATO is not involved in the airstrikes but the US and UK are members of the alliance while two other members of the alliance, the Netherlands and Canada, have provided support.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ang Hezbollah nga isa ka grupo sa Lebanon kag kaalyado sang Iran kag Houthi, ang nagsiling nga ang pagpang-atake sang US ang nagakumpirma lamang sang ila nga “full partnership” sa Israel.
english: Meanwhile, Hezbollah, a group in Lebanon and an ally of Iran and the Houthis, said the US attack only confirmed its "full partnership" with Israel.

text: “The US is a full partner in the tragedies and massacres committed by the Zionist enemy in Gaza and the region,” suno sa gin-release nga statement sang grupo.
english: “The US is a full partner in the tragedies and massacres committed by the Zionist enemy in Gaza and the region,” the group said in a statement released.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag ni U.S. President Joe Biden nga ang “targeted” strikes nga ila ginhimo sa Yemen ang nagapakita nga wala nila ginatolerar ang mga pagpang-atake sang Houthis sa mga barko sa Red Sea.
english: Earlier, U.S. President Joe Biden said the “targeted” strikes they carried out in Yemen showed that they do not tolerate Houthis attacks on ships in the Red Sea.

text: Matandaan nga lakip sa gin-atake amo ang Galaxy Leader nga may sakay nga 17 ka mga Pinoy — isa ang Ilonggo.
english: Among those attacked was the Galaxy Leader carrying 17 Filipinos — one Ilonggo.

text:
“These targeted strikes are a clear message that the United States and our partners will not tolerate attacks on our personnel or allow hostile actors to imperil freedom of navigation,” suno kay Biden.#

(Photo: CNN)
english:
“These targeted strikes are a clear message that the United States and our partners will not tolerate attacks on our personnel or allow hostile actors to imperil freedom of navigation,” Biden said.#

(Photo: CNN)

text: Gin-dismiss sang Korte ang pagka-alkalde ni Alice Guo matapos magpagwa sang desisyon si Judge Liwliwa S. Hidalgo sang Manila Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 34 sang Hunyo 27, 2025.
english: The court dismissed Alice Guo's mayoralty after Judge Liwliwa S. Hidalgo of the Manila Regional Trial Court (RTC) Branch 34 issued a decision on June 27, 2025.

text: Ginpaboran sang korte ang quo warranto petition nga ginpasaka sang Office of the Solicitor General batok kay Guo.
english: The court upheld the quo warranto petition filed by the Office of the Solicitor General against Guo.

text: Madumduman nga ginbuyagyag ni Senator Risa Hontiveros sa isa ka Senate inquiry nga natukiban sang National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) nga si Guo Hua Ping kag si Alice Guo ang may kaangay nga fingerprints, apang ang ila relasyon sa isa kag isa ang ginpanginwala sang abogado sang na-dismiss nga Bamban mayor.
english: Senator Risa Hontiveros revealed in a Senate inquiry that the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) found that Guo Hua Ping and Alice Guo had similar fingerprints, but their relationship was denied by the dismissed Bamban mayor's lawyer.

text: Ginpahayag pa sang korte nga pareho nga mga Chinese citizens ang ginikanan ni Guo, gani wala siya sang legal nga basehan nga magpakilala bilang Filipino.
english: The court said Guo's parents are both Chinese citizens, so he has no legal basis to identify himself as a Filipino.

text: Ang iya Philippine passport kag birth certificate ginbaliwala sang korte bilang ebidensya sa iya pagka-Pilipino.
english: His Philippine passport and birth certificate were rejected by the court as evidence of his Filipino citizenship.

text: Suno sa korte nga ang iya mga ginikanan nag-abot sa Pilipinas halin sa Fujian, China sang Hulyo 12, 1999, kag wala sang ebidensya nga nag-agi sila sa legal nga proseso para mangin Filipino citizens.
english: The court said his parents arrived in the Philippines from Fujian, China on July 12, 1999, and there was no evidence that they went through the legal process to become Filipino citizens.

text: Ginpunto sang desisyon nga ang iya pagka-alkalde “void ab initio” ukon wala sang bisa halin pa sa umpisa.
english: The decision pointed out that his mayoralty was “void ab initio” or void from the beginning.

text: Ginklaro man sang korte nga apisar pa nga siya naproklamar kag nanumpa sa puwesto, wala ini sang epekto bangud diskwalipikado siya sa pagka-kandidato pa lang.
english: The court also clarified that although he was proclaimed and sworn in, it had no effect because he was disqualified from being a candidate.

text: Matandaan nga sang Agusto 2024, ginmanduan sang Office of the Ombudsman ang iya dismissal bangud sa pagkalakip sini sa Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO).
english: It can be recalled that in August 2024, the Office of the Ombudsman ordered his dismissal for his involvement in the Philippine Offshore Gaming Operators (POGO).

text: Hilway sa katalagman nga nakapauli sa Pilipinas kaina sang aga ang anum ka overseas Filipino workers (OFW) nga naghalin sa Iran.
english: Six overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) from Iran returned safely to the Philippines this morning.

text: Sandig sa Department of Migrant Workers, lima sa ila ang nagtrabaho bilang shrimp hatchery technicians kag may isa ka domestic worker halin sa Dubai nga nag-upod lang sa iya employer sa Iran bilang tourist.
english: According to the Department of Migrant Workers, five of them worked as shrimp hatchery technicians and one domestic worker from Dubai just accompanied his employer to Iran as a tourist.

text: Ang ginhimo nga repatriation ang kasunod sang 12-day conflict sa tunga sang Iran kag Israel nga gin-intrahan pa anay sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: The repatriation follows the 12-day conflict between Iran and Israel in which the United States of America was involved.

text: May yara na subong sang ceasefire.
english: There is now a ceasefire.

text: Padayon nga na-rekord ang aftershocks sa pila ka bahin sang Mindanao, matapos nga nagluntad ang 6.1 magnitude nga linog sa baybayon sang Davao Occidental.
english: Aftershocks continue to be recorded in parts of Mindanao, after a 6.1 magnitude earthquake struck off the coast of Davao Occidental.

text: Humalin sang nagluntad ang mayor nga linog, 22 na ka mga aftershocks ang na-record, sa diin lima diri ang gin-plot ukon na-detect sang duha ukon kapin pa nga mga pasilidad.
english: Since the main quake occurred, 22 aftershocks have been recorded, of which five were plotted or detected by two or more facilities.

text: Isa diri ang nabatyagan sang mga residente.
english: One of these is felt by the residents.

text: Ang mga aftershock may magnitude sa tunga sang 2.4 kag 5.2, nga isa ka kinaandan nga bahin sang aktibidad pagkatapos sang mabaskog nga linog.
english: The aftershocks had a magnitude between 2.4 and 5.2, which is a common feature of activity after a strong earthquake.

text: Ang epicenter sang linog yara sa 85 kilometros southeast sang Isla sang Sarangani, kag may kadalumon nga 79 kilometros, gani wala ini nagtuga sang tsunami.
english: The epicenter of the quake was 85 kilometers southeast of Sarangani Island, and had a depth of 79 kilometers, so it did not cause a tsunami.

text: Apisar nga wala sang nareport nga kahalitan, nabatyagan ang linog sa madamo nga mga lugar sa Mindanao lakip na ang syudad sang Davao, General Santos, kag mga banwa sa Sarangani kag South Cotabato.
english: Although no damage was reported, the quake was felt in many parts of Mindanao including Davao City, General Santos, and the towns of Sarangani and South Cotabato.

text: Padayon ang monitoring sang PHIVOLCS sa mga aftershocks kag nagapanugyan sa publiko nga mangin alerto kag magsunod sa mga paandam sang mga otoridad.
english: PHIVOLCS continues to monitor the aftershocks and advises the public to remain alert and follow the warnings of the authorities.

text: Ginsakaan sang armado nga kalalakinhan, ginkontrol, kag gindala sa direksyon sang Iran ang isa tanker nga pakadto kuntani sa Turkey, may karga nga krudo halin sa Iraq, kag may sakay nga 18 ka mga Pinoy seafarers kag isa ka Greek national.
english: Armed men boarded, controlled, and took in the direction of Iran a tanker bound for Turkey, loaded with crude oil from Iraq, and carrying 18 Filipino seafarers and a Greek national.

text: Sa report sang Iranian state media, ginpahayag nga ang “Navy of the Islamic Republic of Iran” mismo ang may kahimuan sa amo nga “American oil tanker” sa Gulf of Oman — malapit sa Strait of Hormuz sa tunga sang Oman kag Iran.
english: In a report by Iranian state media, it was claimed that the “Navy of the Islamic Republic of Iran” itself was involved in the “American oil tanker” in the Gulf of Oman — near the Strait of Hormuz between Oman and Iran.

text: Ang tanker nga involved sa insidente amo ang St.
english: The tanker involved in the incident was the St.

text: Nikolas nga amo man ang ginkumpiskar anay sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sang nagligad nga tuig nga sang amo nga tion nagakarga sang langis halin sa Iran.
english: Nikolas which was also confiscated by the United States of America last year which at the time was carrying oil from Iran.

text: Nagaguwa man sa pahayag sang navy nga isa ini ka pagtimalos sang Iran bangud sa ginhimo sang Amerika sa amo man nga vessel sang 2023.
english: It also appears from the navy statement that this is an Iranian retaliation for what America did to the same vessel in 2023.

text: “After the theft of Iranian oil by the United States last year, St Nikolas tanker was seized by Iran’s Navy”, pahayag sang navy nga gin-cite sang Iranian news agency nga Fars.
english: “After the theft of Iranian oil by the United States last year, St Nikolas tanker was seized by Iran’s Navy”, the navy said quoted by Iranian news agency Fars.

text: Suno sa British maritime security firm nga Ambrey, pila ka armado nga lalaki ang nagtaklas sa tanker sang nahamtang ini sa 50 nautical miles east sang Sohar sa Oman, kag halin didto, gin-diretso ang vessel sa Bandar-e-Jask sa Iran.
english: According to the British maritime security firm Ambrey, several armed men boarded the tanker when it was located 50 nautical miles east of Sohar in Oman, and from there, the vessel was directed to Bandar-e-Jask in Iran.

text: Sang nakasakay na ang kalalakinhan sa vessel, ila gintabunan ang surveillance cameras kag sang ulihi, ginpatay ang tracking system.
english: Once the men boarded the vessel, they covered the surveillance cameras and later, turned off the tracking system.

text: Indi subong maathag kun ano ang sitwasyon sang 19 ka crew sang barko.
english: The condition of the 19 crew members is unclear.

text: Suno naman sa TankerTrackers.com nga amo ang naga-track kag naga-report sang global shipments sang crude oil, may karga ang amo nga tanker nga “Iraqi oil” kag antes ini ginhingadlan nga St Nikolas, ang tanker ang may pangalan anay nga Suez Rajan.
english: According to TankerTrackers.com, which tracks and reports global shipments of crude oil, the tanker was carrying “Iraqi oil” and before it was named St Nikolas, the tanker was formerly named Suez Rajan.

text: Pahayag sang Ambrey, ini nga tanker ang gin-prosecute anay kag ginmultahan sang 2023 bangud sang pagkarga sang langis halin sa Iran nga sang ulihi gin-kumpiskar sang otoridad sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Ambrey said the tanker was previously prosecuted and fined in 2023 for loading oil from Iran that was later confiscated by authorities in the United States of America.

text: Sang amo nga tion, nagpaandam ang Iran nga magabalos ini sa Amerika bangud sa amo nga insidente.
english: At the time, Iran warned that it would retaliate against America over the incident.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang gintabuan sang latest incident nga Gulf of Oman — mayor nga ruta sang oil industry nga amo ang nagaseparar sa Iran kag Oman — amo man ang lugar kun sa diin masami nagakatabo ang mga pagpang-atake kag pagpang-hijack halin pa sang nagliligad nga tinuig.
english: It is known that the latest incident occurred in the Gulf of Oman — a major route of the oil industry that separates Iran and Oman — is also the place where attacks and hijackings have been frequent since last year.

text: Ang US kag ang mga kaalyado sini ang nagsugod man sa pagpangdakop kag pagkontrol sang Iranian oil cargoes halin sang 2019 nga amo ang nagresulta sa serye sang mga pagpang-atake sa Middle East nga masami gina-angot sa Iran.# (Daisuke Nimura/Handout via REUTERS)
english: The US and its allies have also begun seizing and controlling Iranian oil cargoes since 2019 which has led to a series of attacks in the Middle East often linked to Iran.# (Daisuke Nimura/Handout via REUTERS)

text: Ginkondena kag ginapangayuan sang public apology si Quezon City 4th District Representative Bong Suntay kasunod sang nangin pahayag sini sa hearing sang Kamara nga ginalantaw nga isa ka pagbastos sa mga babaye.
english: Quezon City 4th District Representative Bong Suntay has been condemned and asked for a public apology following his statement at the House of Representatives hearing that is seen as an insult to women.

text: Lakip sa nagpakamalaot sang statement ni Suntay amo si Gabriela Party List Rep.
english: Among those who condemned Suntay's statement were Gabriela Party List Rep.

text: Sarah Elago nga nagsiling nga isa ka maathag nga pagpangbastos kag pag-objectify sa mga kababainhan ang ginhimo sang kongresista.
english: Sarah Elago said the congressman committed a blatant insult and objectification of women.

text: Para naman kay House Committee on Women and Gender Equality Chairperson Ann Matibag, indi simple nga lahog ukon harmless nga komento ang ginhimo ni Suntay kundi “sexist”, makahuluya, kag wala sang lugar sa anuman nga institusyon kun sa diin dapat may respeto kag propesyonalismo.
english: For House Committee on Women and Gender Equality Chairperson Ann Matibag, Suntay's comment was not a simple joke or harmless comment but “sexist”, shameful, and has no place in any institution where there should be respect and professionalism.

text: Mangin si Quezon City Mayor Joy Belmonte ang nagtulod sa kongresista nga mangin accountable kag magpangayo sang pasensya kasunod sa amo nga statement.
english: Even Quezon City Mayor Joy Belmonte pushed the congressman to be accountable and apologize following the statement.

text: Natabo ang komento ni Suntay samtang nagatutok ang deliberasyon sang House Committee on Justice sa impeachment complaints batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Suntay's comments came as the House Committee on Justice's deliberations focused on the impeachment complaints against Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Gindepensahan ni Suntay si Duterte kag ang mga nagligad nga statement sini kaangay sang pag-imagine sini nga utdan sang ulo si President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: Suntay defended Duterte and his past statements such as his imagining that President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr. would be beheaded.

text: Diri kag ginsal-ot ni Suntay ang iya kaugalingon nga imagination.
english: This is where Suntay inserted his own imagination.

text: Suno sa iya, nakit-an sini anay sa isa ka mall si Anne Curtis, kag bangud tuman ini kagwapa, may “desire” siya suno sa iya nga nabatyagan kag na-“imagine” na lang niya kun ano ang iya himuon.
english: He said he saw Anne Curtis in a mall, and because she was so beautiful, he felt a desire and imagined what he would do.

text: Diri na kag gilayon nga nagsabat si Committee Vice Chair Ysabel Maria Zamora nga panason sa rekord ang pahayag ni Suntay, apang nagpanindugan pa si Suntay.
english: Committee Vice Chair Ysabel Maria Zamora immediately replied that Suntay's statement should be erased from the record, but Suntay insisted.

text: May yara naman sang nag-object sa amo nga manipestasyon.
english: There were those who objected to the demonstration.

text: Nagboto pa ang panel kun sa diin 13 ang nagpabor nga kakason sa rekord ang pahayag ni Suntay, duha ang nagboto nga indi pagkakason lakip na mismo si Suntay, kag duha naman ang nag-abstain.
english: The panel voted with 13 in favor of removing Suntay's statement from the record, two voting not to remove it including Suntay himself, and two abstaining.

text: Sang ulihi, nag-reklamo pa gid ang kongresista kun ngaa may gina-censor nga mga manifestation sa House hearing.
english: Later, the congressman complained about why some manifestations are being censored in the House hearing.

text: Nagpanindugan ini nga indi man imoral kag indi iligal ang iya komento.
english: He insisted that his comment was neither immoral nor illegal.

text: Diri na kag nagsabat si Zamora kag ginpahanumdom pa kay Suntay nga pamuno pa lang gani sang Women’s Month apang may amo na sini nga mga komento.
english: Zamora responded and reminded Suntay that it was only the beginning of Women's Month but there were already such comments.

text: Ginpaathag pa sini nga ang kaangay sini nga mga pahayag wala nagabulig agud nga masuportahan kag ma-empower ang mga kababainhan.
english: She further explained that such statements do not help to support and empower women.

text: Apisar sang amo nga hitabo sa panel, nagpanindugan naman si Suntay nga wala siya sang sala: “Only a dirty mind can impute something which is dirty.”#
english: Despite the incident at the panel, Suntay insisted that he was innocent: “Only a dirty mind can impute something which is dirty.”#

text: Nagsaka ang pwesto sang Gilas Pilipinas samtang nga nagahilapit ang pag-umpisa sang FIBA Asia Cup 2025 sa Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
english: Gilas Pilipinas' rankings have risen as the 2025 FIBA ​​Asia Cup approaches in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.

text: Halin sa ika-walo nga pwesto, nagapang-anum na subong ang national team base sa ginlista sang FIBA sa latest Asia Cup Power Rankings.
english: From eighth place, the national team is now sixth based on FIBA's latest Asia Cup Power Rankings.

text: 16 ka teams ang yara sa tournament.
english: 16 teams are in the tournament.

text: Ang paglukso sang Gilas ang kasunod man sang duha ka sunod-sunod nga kadalag-an sini sa tune-up games nga amo ang hampang batok sa Macau kag mangin sa Jordan nga semifinalist sa FIBA Asia Cup sang 2022.
english: The Gilas' leap also follows two consecutive wins in tune-up games against Macau and Jordan, a semifinalist in the FIBA ​​Asia Cup in 2022.

text: Suno pa sa rankings, nagapakita ini nga yara sa porma ang Gilas kag bisan wala si Kai Sotto, delikado gihapon sila nga kasumpong.
english: According to the rankings, it shows that the Gilas are in shape and even without Kai Sotto, they are still a dangerous opponent.

text: Nagapabilin naman sa numero uno nga pwesto ang Australia samtang nagasunod ang Japan.
english: Australia remains at number one while Japan follows.

text: 2:00 buwas sa kaagahon (oras sa Pilipinas) ang imbukada nga hampang sang Gilas sa group stage batok sa Chinese Taipei.
english: 2:00 tomorrow morning (Philippine time) the Gilas' opening match in the group stage against Chinese Taipei.

text: Matabo naman sa Huwebes, 11:00 sa gab-i ang rematch vs.
english: The rematch will take place on Thursday, 11:00 pm vs.

text: New Zealand kag ang katapusan nga hampang sa group stage sa Sabado, 4:00 sa hapon.
english: New Zealand and the final group stage game on Saturday, 4:00 pm.

text: GINPAKAMALAIN sang pila sa aton, lakip ni Presidente Duterte, ang United States tungod wala ini nag-akto dayon agud depensahan ang Filipinas sang agawon sang China sadtong 2012 ang Scarborough (Panatag) Shoal nga sakop sang aton 200-nautical mile (nm) Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ).
english: SOME of us, including President Duterte, have criticized the United States for not acting immediately to defend the Philippines when China seized in 2012 the Scarborough (Panatag) Shoal within our 200-nautical mile (nm) Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ).

text: May Mutual Defense Pact (MDP) kita sa US, indi bala?
english: We have a Mutual Defense Pact (MDP) with the US, right?

text: Pero, mabasol gid bala naton ang US sa indi dayon pag-akto agud tapnaon ang “aggression”sang China sa Panatag Shoal?
english: But, can we really blame the US for not acting immediately to stop China's aggression in the Panatag Shoal?

text: Indi man seguro.
english: Probably not.

text: Nahangpan man seguro ni anay Presidente Aquino ang pagpang-alag-ag sang US tungod ang na-involver diri amo ang “sovereignty” claim sang China nga indi basta ma-violate sang iban nga pungsod bisan pa nga may kinamatarong man ang Filipinas sa 200 nm EEZ sini.
english: Former President Aquino probably understood the US's hesitation because what was involved was China's sovereignty claim that could not be violated by other countries even though the Philippines had rights to its 200 nm EEZ.

text: Isa pa, samtang myembro ang China kag Filipinas sang UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), ang US indi.
english: Furthermore, while China and the Philippines are members of the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS), the US is not.

text: Gani nag-file na gid lang si Presidente Noy sang kaso sa Hague Tribunal batok sa sining “aggression” sang China sa Panatag Shoal.
english: So President Noy filed a case in the Hague Tribunal against this “aggression” of China in the Panatag Shoal.

text: Fortunately, nagdaug ang aton kaso sadtong 2016.
english: Fortunately, our case won in 2016.

text: Gin-deklarar sang Hague ang nine-dash-line claim sang China nga “illegal”.
english: The Hague declared China’s nine-dash-line claim “illegal”.

text: Kon may aksyon man sadto ang US ina lang ang indirekta nga pagbantay sa Filipinas, kag iban nga kaalyado nga may claim sa South China Sea, paagi sa paglabay-labay sa High Seas sa tunga sang China kag Filipinas, nga magamit sing libre sang mga nasyon kag kon nagahimo sang “innocent passage” sa maritime territorial limit nila.
english: If there was any action by the US, it would be indirect surveillance of the Philippines, and other allies with claims to the South China Sea, through the passage of the High Seas between China and the Philippines, which can be used freely by countries and when making “innocent passage” in their maritime territorial limit.

text: Ang UNCLOS nagapanugyan lang sang 12 nautical mile nga maritime territorial limit sa tagsa ka pungsod kag sang 200 nm nga EEZ halin sa ila baybayon.
english: UNCLOS only proposes a 12 nautical mile maritime territorial limit to each country and a 200 nm EEZ from their coast.

text: Ang distansya sang Manila sa Hongkong, China mga 694 nm sunu sa travelmath, which means may mga 200 nm pa dira nga libre agyan sa tunga sang EEZ sang China kag sang Filipinas.
english: The distance between Manila and Hong Kong, China is about 694 nm according to travelmath, which means there are about 200 nm of free passage between the EEZ of China and the Philippines.

text: Ang claim sang China ugaling sakop ang halos 90 ka porsyento gid sang SCS nga nagasakop na sang aton EEZ sa West Philippine Sea, kon diin na-locate ang Pag-asa Island, kag pila pa ka isla, nga gina-okupar na naton halin pa sadto.
english: China's claim, however, covers almost 90 percent of the SCS, which already covers our EEZ in the West Philippine Sea, where Pag-asa Island is located, and several other islands, which we have occupied since then.

text: Salamat kay nagpagwa sang sining ulihi lang ang US State Department sang isa ka pagtuon nga naga-affirm sang “findings” sang Hague Tribunal nga “illegal” inang nine-dash-line claim sang China.
english: Thankfully, the US State Department recently released a study affirming the Hague Tribunal's findings that China's nine-dash-line claim is illegal.

text: Tungod sini, nagapati kita nga indi na kita dale-dale ma-“bully” sang China sa 200 nm EEZ naton kay bisan ang US may legal na nga tindug angot sa aton pag-okupar sang bug-os naton nga EEZ.
english: Because of this, we believe that we will not be bullied by China in our 200 nm EEZ because even the US has a legal position regarding our occupation of our entire EEZ.

text: Segurado mas “assertive” na ang role sang US sa pagbulig pabakud sang aton “defense posture” dira mismo sa WPS sa idalom sang aton MDP.
english: Surely the role of the US is more assertive in helping to strengthen our defense posture right here in the WPS under our MDP.

text:
***

WALA nag-attend si BongBong Marcos (BBM) sa interbyu ni Jessica Soho sadtong Enero 22.
english:
***

BongBong Marcos (BBM) did not attend Jessica Soho's interview on January 22.

text: “Biased” ukon “unfair” kuno ini sa Marcos family.
english: It is said to be “biased” or “unfair” to the Marcos family.

text: Gindugang pa ni BBM nga indi siya luyag sang “negative and hateful campaigning” nga pwede matabo sa pagbayluhanay sang pamangkot ni Jessica kag sabat sang mga presidential aspirants.
english: BBM added that he does not want the “negative and hateful campaigning” that could happen in the exchange of Jessica's questions and answers of the presidential aspirants.

text: Pakot gid ni BBM kon ano ang natabo sa interbyu ni Jessica!
english: BBM really guessed what happened in Jessica's interview!

text: Pero, indi katulad ni BBM, wala nanalaw ang apat ka presidential aspirant – VP Leni, Lacson, Moreno kag Pacquiao – kag ginsabat ang panungkad nga mga pamangkot ni Jessica.
english: However, unlike BBM, the four presidential aspirants – VP Leni, Lacson, Moreno and Pacquiao – did not hesitate to answer Jessica's probing questions.

text: Pero ngaa indi si BBM luyag magsabat sa mga pamangkot nga nagatungkad sang iya pagkatawo kag ikasarang?
english: But why is BBM unwilling to answer questions that probe his identity and ability?

text: Indi bala dapat mahibal-an sang mga pumuluyo kon ano nga klase gid ang ila presidente?
english: Shouldn't the people know what kind of person their president really is?

text: Indi kita maka-intiendi sini.
english: We cannot understand it.

text: Nagapati na gani ang madamo nga luyag niya likawan ang mga isyu nga makapahuyang sang iya kandidatura.
english: Many even believe that he wants to avoid issues that could weaken his candidacy.

text: Well, risgo ina sang sin-o man nga kandidato kay dapat bukas siya sa mga kritisismo sa aton Demokrasya.
english: Well, that's a risk for any candidate because he should be open to criticism of our Democracy.

text: Unless, huyog niya diktahan ang mga pumuluyo sang iya luyag katulad sang iya amay sa panahon sang martial law.
english: Unless, he tends to dictate to the people what he wants like his father during martial law.

text: Indi man dapat magkataka ang mga kandidato kon ginasulit-sulit i-pamangkot ang mga isyu.
english: Candidates should not be surprised if the issues are repeatedly asked.

text: Para ini sa kaayuhan sang mga botante – agud indi sila malipat sa mga isyu sa ila na final nga paghimo sang desisyon.
english: This is for the benefit of the voters – so that they do not forget the issues in their final decision-making.

text: Pagtilaw man ining pasulit-sulit nga interbyu sa “patience” kag “emotional maturity” sang mga kandidato, labi na gid sa may luyag mag-Presidente.
english: This repeated interview is also a test of the patience and emotional maturity of the candidates, especially those who want to be President.

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text: Otherwise, indi siya bagay mangin Presidente kay isa siya ka “weak leader” nga indi bagay mag-Presidente, katulad sang pagtan-aw sa iya ni Presidente Duterte.
english: Otherwise, he is not fit to be President because he is a “weak leader” who is not fit to be President, as President Duterte sees him.

text: Ano abe sa inyo?
english: What do you think?

text: Bagay bala si BBM mag-Presidente sa aton Demokrasya ukon indi?/PN
english: Is BBM fit to be President of our Democracy or not?/PN

text: Ang iban sa aton ang nagahandum gid nga maka-set sang record agud nga makilala kita sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Some of us are eager to set a record so that we can be known worldwide.

text: Indi ini imposible bangud sa iban nga mga Pinoy nga nagmarka na sang ila pangalan sa world records — sa sports, sa pageant, sa paalam-alam, abilidad, kag sa iban pa nga mga patag.
english: This is not impossible because of other Filipinos who have already marked their names in world records — in sports, in pageants, in farewell, skills, and in other fields.

text: Apang may isa ka lalaki nga lain pa gid nga lebel sang record ang iya gusto nga malab-ot.
english: But there is one guy who wants to reach a whole other level of record.

text: Ini amo si Ryuta Watanabe, 36-anyos kag residente sang northern prefecture sang Hokkaido, Japan nga gusto gid kilalahon bilang “god of marriage.
english: This is Ryuta Watanabe, 36-year-old and resident of the northern prefecture of Hokkaido, Japan who is eager to be known as the “god of marriage.

text: Gin-istorya sini nga nakabatyag siya anay sang depression kag ginbayaan siya sang iya nobya, kag amo ini ang nagtulod sa iya nga magpangilala sa bag-o nga mga babaye gamit ang dating applications.
english: He said he once felt depressed and his girlfriend left him, and this led him to meet new women using dating applications.

text: May ara na siya subong sang apat ka mga asawa kag duha ka mga nobya kag bisan trentahon pa lamang ang iya edad, 10 na ang iya kabataan.
english: He now has four wives and two girlfriends and although he is only 30 years old, he has 10 children.

text: Ang mga babaye nga gina-upod ni Ryuta ang makabig nga common-law in nature bangud iligal sa Japan ang polygamy.
english: The women Ryuta is dating are considered common-law in nature because polygamy is illegal in Japan.

text: Ginakilala sila nga mag-partner kag daw set-up man sang kasado nga mga indibidwal ang ila relasyon, apang wala lang sang formal registration.
english: They are recognized as partners and their relationship seems to be a set-up of married individuals, but there is no formal registration.

text: Wala man sang trabaho si Ryuta sa sulod na sang isa ka dekada kag nagasalig lang siya sa mga sweldo sang iya mga asawa.
english: Ryuta has also been unemployed for a decade and relies on his wives' salaries.

text: Bilang bulig sa ila, siya ang in-charge sa mga ulubrahon sa balay lakip na sa pagluto kag pagtatap sa mga bata.
english: To help them, she is in-charge of household chores including cooking and taking care of the children.

text: Nagalab-ot ang ila expenses sa 914,000 yen (P350,000) kada bulan apang wala ini sang problema bangud ginatunga-tunga ini sang iya mga asawa kag mga nobya.
english: Their expenses amount to 914,000 yen (P350,000) per month but he has no problem because his wives and girlfriends share it.

text: Ginsiling ni Ryuta nga nanamian gid siya sa mga babaye, kag wala man sila sang problema basta nagapalanggaanay lamang sila.
english: Ryuta says that he really likes women, and they don't have any problems as long as they love each other.

text: Kada babaye ang may yara sang kuwarto sa ila balay, kag nagasaylo-saylo lang siya kada gab-i kun sin-o ang iya tupadan.
english: Each woman has a room in her house, and she changes every night with whom she sleeps.

text: Ginpadayaw pa sini nga 28 ka beses siya nga nagapakighilawas sa kada semana kag wala man nagapangimon ang iya mga babaye bangud mag-abyanay man sila tanan.
english: He also boasted that he has sex 28 times a week and his women are not jealous because they are all friends.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, gusto pa ni Ryuta nga makakita sang bag-o nga palangasaw-on.
english: In fact, Ryuta still wants to find a new bride.

text: Okay na sa iya nga makabata sang 54 ka bilog bangud ang gusto sini gub-on nga record amo ang iya sang Japanese shogun nga si Tokugawa Ienari nga napatay sang 1841.
english: It is okay for her to have 54 children because the record she wants to break is that of Japanese shogun Tokugawa Ienari who died in 1841.

text: Si Tokugawa nga amo ang longest-serving shōgun sang Tokugawa shogunate sang Japan ang ginareport nga may 53 ka bata kag may 27 ka ginapuyo nga babaye sang Edo Period ukon tunga-tunga sang 1603 kag 1868.
english: Tokugawa, the longest-serving shōgun of the Tokugawa shogunate of Japan, is reported to have had 53 children and 27 concubines during the Edo Period or between 1603 and 1868.

text: Nag-abot na sa Poland sanday Tarah Valencia kag Anna Valencia Lakrini sang Pilipinas para sa nagahilapit nga Miss Supranational 2025.
english: Tarah Valencia and Anna Valencia Lakrini of the Philippines have arrived in Poland for the upcoming Miss Supranational 2025.

text: Si Tarah ang mangin tiglawas sang Pilipinas matapos ginrepresentar sini ang Baguio sa Miss Universe Philippines 2024 kag napilian bilang delegado sang pungsod sa Miss Supranational pageant.
english: Tarah will represent the Philippines after she represented Baguio at Miss Universe Philippines 2024 and was selected as the country's delegate to the Miss Supranational pageant.

text: Samtang si Anna naman nga isa ka half-Filipina ang nangin pambato sang Pilipinas sa Miss Globe 2023, kag natapos sa 2nd runner up.
english: Meanwhile, Anna, who is half-Filipina, became the Philippines' representative in Miss Globe 2023, and finished 2nd runner up.

text: Sang Abril, ginhingadlan siya bilang Miss Supranational Germany.
english: In April, she was named Miss Supranational Germany.

text: Ang coronation night sang Miss Supranational 2025 ang hiwaton sa Hunyo 28 sa Malopolska, Poland.
english: The coronation night of Miss Supranational 2025 will be held on June 28 in Malopolska, Poland.

text: Nag-file si Acting Chairperson sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee, Sen.
english: Acting Chairman of the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee, Sen.

text: Erwin Tulfo, sang Senate Bill No.
english: Erwin Tulfo, of Senate Bill No.

text: 1409 nga nagatuyo nga kakson ang travel tax sang mga Pilipino nga naga-byahe saguwa sang pungsod.
english: 1409 which aims to waive the travel tax on Filipinos traveling abroad.

text: Suno kay Tulfo, ang pagpatuman sang travel tax makapamalabag sa kinamatarong sang mga Pilipino nga magbiyahe kag indi angay nga mangin dugang nga pabug-at sa ila bulsa.
english: According to Tulfo, the implementation of the travel tax will interfere with the right of Filipinos to travel and should not be an additional burden on their pockets.

text: Tuyo sang amo nga hagna nga mangin mas accessible ang pagbyahe para sa mga Pilipino, kasunod sang ASEAN Tourism Agreement nga ginpirmahan sang Pilipinas sang 2002.
english: The bill aims to make travel more accessible for Filipinos, following the ASEAN Tourism Agreement that the Philippines signed in 2002.

text: Sa subong, ang koleksyon halin sa travel tax amo ang nagapondo sa nagkalain-lain nga ahensya kaangay sang, Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Zone Authority nga may 50%, 40% naman sa Commission on Higher Education (CHED), kag 10% sa National Commission for Culture and the Arts (NCCA).
english: Currently, the collection from the travel tax funds various agencies such as the Tourism Infrastructure and Enterprise Zone Authority with 50%, 40% with the Commission on Higher Education (CHED), and 10% with the National Commission for Culture and the Arts (NCCA).

text: Base sa subong nga travel tax rates, nagalab-ot ini sa, P1,620 tubtob P2,700 ang economy, P810 tubtob P1,350 naman para sa standard reduced, at P300 tubtob P400 para sa mga dependents sang overseas Filipino workers (OFWs).
english: Based on the current travel tax rates, it ranges from P1,620 to P2,700 for economy, P810 to P1,350 for standard reduced, and P300 to P400 for dependents of overseas Filipino workers (OFWs).

text: Ginkaalarma sang United Nations ang nagasaka pa nga numero sang mga journalists nga napatay sa Gaza sa sulod sang tatlo ka bulan nga gyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas militants.
english: The United Nations has expressed alarm over the rising number of journalists killed in Gaza during the three-month war between Israel and Hamas militants.

text: Ang statement sang UN ang kasunod sang kamatayon sang duha ka Palestinian reporters sang Al Jazeera — sanday Hamza Wael Dahdouh kag Mustafa Abu Thurianga — nga naigu sang rockets sang Israel samtang yara sila sa ila nga salakyan sa Rafah.
english: The UN statement follows the deaths of two Palestinian reporters for Al Jazeera — Hamza Wael Dahdouh and Mustafa Abu Thurianga — who were hit by Israeli rockets while they were in their vehicle in Rafah.

text: Suno sa UN rights office, dapat nga may “independent” nga imbestigasyon sa pagpamatay sa journalists agud mahibaluan kun may istrikto man nga pagsunod sa international law.
english: According to the UN rights office, there should be an “independent” investigation into the killing of journalists to see if there is strict compliance with international law.

text: Suno sa Committee to Protect Journalists nga naka-base sa New York, U.S.A., at least 79 na ka journalists kag media professionals ang napatay halin sang nagsugod ang gyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas sang Oktubre 7.
english: According to the New York, U.S.A.-based Committee to Protect Journalists, at least 79 journalists and media professionals have been killed since the war between Israel and Hamas began on October 7.

text: Sa amo nga report, nakasaad nga Palestinians ang kadam-an sa sini nga mga biktima.
english: The report said most of the victims were Palestinians.

text: Kun balikan, sang nangibot ang Hamas kag nag-atake sa southern Israel sang Oktubre 7, yara sa 1,140 ang napatay — kalabanan mga sibilyan.
english: When Hamas launched an attack on southern Israel on October 7, 1,140 people were killed — mostly civilians.

text: Nagtimalos ang Israel, ginsakop ang bilog nga Gaza, ginpudpod ang Hamas, kag subong — suno sa rekord sang Ministry of Health — lapaw na sa 23,000 ang ila nga napatay kun sa diin kalabanan amo ang mga kababainhan kag kabataan.#
english: Israel retaliated, occupied all of Gaza, crushed Hamas, and now — according to Ministry of Health records — has killed more than 23,000 of them, mostly women and children.

text: PASSI CITY – Makatalandog balatyagon ang ginhimo sang isa ka lalaki nga estudyante para sa iya classmate nga babaye sa Passi City National High School sa diin ginregaluhan niya ini sang bag-o nga sapatos para sa iya graduation.
english: PASSI CITY – A male student made a touching gesture for his female classmate at Passi City National High School where he gave her new shoes for her graduation.

text: Ang lalaki nga estudyante amo si Julian Maratas sang Población Ilawod, Passi City, sa diin ang iya amay ang Principal sa Gines Viejo Elementary School kag Principal naman sang iloy sini sa Passi 1 Elementary School.
english: The male student was identified as Julian Maratas of Población Ilawod, Passi City, where his father is the principal of Gines Viejo Elementary School and his mother is the principal of Passi 1 Elementary School.

text: Ang babaye naman nga estudyante naman amo si Gwen Soncio sang Dacal, San Enrique, Iloilo sa diin ang iya iloy ang nagatrabaho sa kampo sang tubo kag ang amay naman sini ang nagabaligya sa Lapuz Port sa Iloilo City.
english: The female student was identified as Gwen Soncio of Dacal, San Enrique, Iloilo where her mother works in a sugarcane field and her father sells at Lapuz Port in Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ferlie Joy Manejo-Lanaria, manunudlo sa nasambit nga eskwelahan, ginpakigbahin sini ang istorya nanday Maratas kag Soncio nga lunsay honor students kag classmates sa ABM 12 – Integrity class.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ferlie Joy Manejo-Lanaria, a teacher at the said school, shared the story of Maratas and Soncio who are both honor students and classmates in ABM 12 – Integrity class.

text: Suno kay Lanaria, nagpadala sang mensahe sa iya si Maratas kag gin-usisa kun ano nga sapatos ang mahimo gamiton sang mga babaye sini nga classmates bangud nakit-an sini nga wala si Soncio sang sapatos.
english: According to Lanaria, Maratas sent her a message and asked what shoes her female classmates could wear because she saw that Soncio did not have shoes.

text: Samtang suno naman kay Maratas, naghingyo ini sa iya iloy kun may yara ini sang daan nga sapatos nga mahimo sini mahatag kay Soncio, apang sa ulihi, nagdesisyon nga baklan na lang ini sang bag-o nga sapatos.
english: Meanwhile, Maratas said he asked his mother if she had any old shoes that he could give to Soncio, but later decided to buy him new shoes.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga nakit-an niya si Soncio nga nagahimakas sa pagtuon kaangay sang iya ginikanan gani nagdesisyon ini nga buligan pinaagi sa paghatag sang sapatos agud magamit sa iya graduation.
english: He said he saw Soncio struggling in his studies like his parents so he decided to help him by giving him shoes to use for his graduation.

text: Nagalaom man si Maratas nga dungan sila nga makatapos ni Soncio sa kolehiyo.
english: Maratas also hopes that he and Soncio will graduate from college together.

text: Plano ni Maratas nga magkuha sang kurso nga Bachelor of Science in Information Technology.
english: Maratas plans to pursue a Bachelor of Science in Information Technology degree.

text: Emosyonal naman nga nagpasalamat si Soncio sa kaayo nga ginpakita ni Maratas sa iya.
english: Soncio emotionally thanked Maratas for the kindness shown to him.

text: Suno kay Soncio, apisar pigado lang ini, nagahimakas ini nga makatapos sa pagtuon.
english: According to Soncio, although he is poor, he is struggling to finish his studies.

text: Plano naman sini nga magkuha sang kurso nga Bachelor of Science in Business Administration sa kolehiyo.
english: He plans to pursue a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration in college.

text: Masobra 10 ka kabataan sa Gaza ang nagaka-utdan sang isa ukon duha gid ka tiil kada adlaw halin sang nagsugod ang gyera sa tunga sang Hamas kag Israel sang Oktubre 7.
english: More than 10 children in Gaza have lost one or both limbs every day since the war between Hamas and Israel began on October 7.

text: Ini sandig sa statement sang charity nga Save the Childen nga may reference sa statistics nga ginpaguwa sang United Nations.
english: This is according to a statement by the charity Save the Child with reference to statistics released by the United Nations.

text: Suno kay Jason Lee nga amo ang Country Director sang Save the Children sa Gaza, indi halos malaragway ang pag-antos sang mga bata sa Palestine — hitabo nga iya ginsiling nga isa ka “grave violation” kag dapat nga manabat ang may kahimuan.
english: According to Jason Lee who is the Country Director of Save the Children in Gaza, the suffering of children in Palestine is almost indescribable — event he said is a “grave violation” and should hold those responsible accountable.

text: Mangin ang eksperyensyado nga mga propesyunal kaangay sang mga doktor kag nurse suno kay Lee ang nagalalain bangud kinahanglan nga bulngon ang mga bata nga wala sang bastante nga equipment.
english: Even experienced professionals such as doctors and nurses, Lee said, are suffering because they have to treat children without enough equipment.

text: Ginhimo sang grupo nga reference ang statement ni UNICEF spokesperson James Elder sang Disyembre 19 nga ginabanta 1,000 ka kabataan sa Gaza ang nakumpol halin sang nag-ibwal ang inaway.
english: The group referenced a statement by UNICEF spokesperson James Elder on Dec. 19 that an estimated 1,000 children in Gaza have been gathered since the conflict broke out.

text: Nagsiling man ang World Health Organization nga kalabanan sa mga operasyon sa Gaza ang ginahimo nga wala sang anesthesia bangud kulang gihapon ang mga bulong kag medical supplies nga nagaabot sa strip.
english: The World Health Organization also said that most operations in Gaza are performed without anesthesia because there is still a shortage of medicines and medical supplies arriving in the strip.

text: Sulit-sulit nga ginpahayag sang Israel Defense Forces nga wala sini gina-target ang mga sibilyan apang ang militante nga grupo amo ang nagagamit sang mga civilian infrastructure kaangay sang ospital agud nga tamingan ang ila kaugalingon batok sa militar.
english: The Israel Defense Forces have repeatedly said they are not targeting civilians but the militant group is using civilian infrastructure such as hospitals to shield themselves against the military.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Palestinian Ministry of Health sa Gaza nga 22,835 na ka Palestinians ang napatay kag masobra 58,000 ang nasamaran sa strip sa sulod na sang tatlo ka bulan halin sang natabo ang pagtimalos sang Israel.
english: Earlier, the Palestinian Ministry of Health in Gaza said 22,835 Palestinians had been killed and more than 58,000 injured in the strip in the three months since Israel's retaliation.

text: # (Photo: Arafat Barbakh/Reuters)
english: # (Photo: Arafat Barbakh/Reuters)

text: Ginpanginbulahan ni National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) Executive Director Rafael Vicente Calinisan si PNP Chief, PGen.
english: National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM) Executive Director Rafael Vicente Calinisan congratulated PNP Chief, PGen.

text: Nicolas Torre III, matapos niya ini tagaan sang gradong 9.9 para sa halos isa ka bulan nga pagserbisyo bilang hepe sang Philippine National Police (PNP) halin sang siya ang gin-appoint sang Mayo 29, 2025.
english: Nicolas Torre III, after he gave him a grade of 9.9 for nearly a month of service as chief of the Philippine National Police (PNP) since his appointment on May 29, 2025.

text: Suno kay Calinisan ang halos perfect nga grado ginbase sa malawig kag epektibo nga mga inisyatiba ni Gen.
english: Calinisan said the almost perfect grade is based on the long and effective initiatives of Gen.

text: Torre nga nakatukib sang panginahanglanon sang publiko kag sang organisasyon sang pulisya.
english: Torre who discovered the needs of the public and the police organization.

text: Ginpabutyag sang opisyal nga nabatyagan gid ni Torre ang pulso sang publiko, kag may kapasidad siya nga sabton ini paagi sa aktibo kag tampad nga pagpanguna.
english: The official expressed that Torre really feels the pulse of the public, and he has the capacity to respond to it through active and honest leadership.

text: Ginsaysay man sang NAPOLCOM chief nga ang kulang nga 0.1 puntos hindi bangud may kulang si Torre, kundi bilang inspirasyon pa gid sa iya para magpadayon sa maayo nga pagserbisyo kag pagkabig sang PNP nga masaligan sang pumuluyo.
english: The NAPOLCOM chief also explained that the lack of 0.1 points is not because Torre is missing something, but as an inspiration to him to continue to serve well and consider the PNP to be trusted by the people.

text: Si PGen.
english: The PGen.

text: Nicolas Torre III amo ang una nga graduate sang Philippine National Police Academy (PNPA) nga natungdan bilang PNP Chief, matapos ang madugay nga pagpungko sang mga graduate sang Philippine Military Academy (PMA) sa pinaka-mataas nga pwesto sa kapulisan.
english: Nicolas Torre III is the first graduate of the Philippine National Police Academy (PNPA) to be appointed as PNP Chief, after a long tenure of graduates of the Philippine Military Academy (PMA) in the highest position in the police.

text: Nagsaka na sa 100 ang numero sang mga tawo nga napatay kasunod sang magnitude 7.6 nga linog nga nagtay-og sa Noto Peninsula kag sa kaiping nga mga lugar sa central Japan sa imbukada sang 2024.
english: The death toll has risen to 100 following a magnitude 7.6 earthquake that shook the Noto Peninsula and neighboring areas of central Japan on the eve of 2024.

text: Sa latest data sang gobyerno, 211 pa ka mga tawo ang missing samtang nga ginalagas sang rescuers ang tyempo agud nga maluwas ang posible dugang nga mga residente nga posible nagkalaipit sa natumba nga mga building sa Ishikawa Prefecture.
english: According to the latest government data, 211 people are still missing while rescuers are chasing the weather to rescue possible additional residents who may have been trapped in collapsed buildings in Ishikawa Prefecture.

text: Ginalantaw nga mas mangin malala ang sitwasyon subong nga Domingo bangud sa ulan kag posible pag-yelo sa rehiyon.
english: The situation is expected to worsen this Sunday due to rain and possible ice in the region.

text: Nagmandu naman si Prime Minister Fumio Kishida sa mga opisyal sang gobyerno nga dasigon ang pagpatigayon sang rescue operations agud mas madamo nga kabuhi ang maluwas.
english: Prime Minister Fumio Kishida has ordered government officials to expedite rescue operations to save more lives.

text: Nabudlayan man ang otoridad sa pagdul-ong sang ayuda bangud guba ang mga dalan padulong sa Ishikawa kun sa diin 31,000 pa ka mga tawo ang nagatinir sa masobra 300 ka mga evacuation shelters.
english: Authorities are also having difficulty delivering aid because the roads to Ishikawa are damaged where 31,000 people are still staying in more than 300 evacuation shelters.

text: Magluwas diri, nagakapuhag man ang mga tawo sa Noto region bangud sa aftershocks.# (Photo: Reuters)
english: In addition, people in the Noto region are also suffering from aftershocks.# (Photo: Reuters)

text: Arestado ang 36-anyos nga Pinay sa North Las Vegas, Nevada, USA matapos ginluthang ang isa ka pastor sa atubang mismo sang iya asawa kag duha ka kabataan.
english: A 36-year-old Filipina was arrested in North Las Vegas, Nevada, USA after shooting a pastor in front of his wife and two children.

text: Ang biktima nga napatay gid amo si Nick Davi, 46-anyos nga pastor sa Grace Point Church sa Las Vegas.
english: The victim who was actually killed was Nick Davi, 46-year-old pastor at Grace Point Church in Las Vegas.

text: Gindala man sa ospital ang iya asawa nga si Sara bangud nakaangkon man sang mga samad kasunod sang insidente.
english: His wife, Sara, was also taken to the hospital after sustaining injuries following the incident.

text: Suno sa North Las Vegas Police, nag-away ang biktima kag ang suspek nga si Joe Junio kag sang ulihi naglab-ot na sa pagtiro sang babayi sa pastor, apang indi pa subong matul-id kun ano gid ang motibo sa krimen.
english: According to North Las Vegas Police, the victim and the suspect, Joe Junio, had a fight and the woman eventually shot the pastor, but the motive of the crime is still unknown.

text: Suno naman kay Ty Neal, isa pa ka pastor halin sa Grace Point Church, madugay na nga ginagamo sang suspek ang pamilya sang pastor nga iya man lang kasilingan.
english: Ty Neal, another pastor from Grace Point Church, said the suspect had been harassing the pastor's family for a long time.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, naka-apply na ang pamilya sang biktima sang temporary protection order batok kay Junio kag natalana na sa Enero 8 ang court hearing sa amo nga order.
english: In fact, the victim's family has already applied for a temporary protection order against Junio ​​and the court hearing on the order is scheduled for January 8.

text: Naka-detain subong ang Pinay sa Clark County Detention Center kag natalana nga pasakaan sang kaso nga murder, attempted murder, discharge of firearms, kag two counts of child abuse.
english: The Filipina is currently detained at the Clark County Detention Center and is scheduled to face charges of murder, attempted murder, discharge of firearms, and two counts of child abuse.

text: Gin-ako sang Islamic State nga sila ang responsable sa duha ka magkasunod nga pagpamomba sa Iran kun sa diin 84 ka tawo ang patay kag madamo ang pilason.
english: The Islamic State has claimed responsibility for two consecutive bombings in Iran that killed 84 people and wounded many others.

text: Ginhimo ang pagpang-atake kadungan sa ikaapat nga anibersaryo sang kamatayon sang military commander sang Iran nga si Qassem Soleimani nga napatay sang US drone sa Iraq sang 2020.
english: The strike coincided with the fourth anniversary of the death of Iranian military commander Qassem Soleimani who was killed by a US drone in Iraq in 2020.

text: Suno sa militante nga Sunni Muslim group, duha sa ila nga mga myembro ang naghaboy sang bomba sa mga tawo nga nagatilipon sa patyo sa syudad sang Kerman kag ginpatigayon ang ikaduha ang pag-atake kinse minutos ang makaligad.
english: According to the militant Sunni Muslim group, two of its members threw a bomb at a crowd gathered in a courtyard in Kerman City and carried out a second attack 15 minutes later.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Iranian First Vice President Mohammad Mokhber nga dapat paabuton sang terorista nga grupo ang pagtimalos sang mga soldado sang Iran.
english: Iranian First Vice President Mohammad Mokhber said the terrorist group should expect retaliation from Iranian soldiers.

text: “Cruel criminals must know that they will be strongly dealt with from now on and undoubtedly there will be a harsh response,” suno naman sa statement ni Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei.
english: "Cruel criminals must know that they will be strongly dealt with from now on and undoubtedly there will be a harsh response," Iranian Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei said in a statement.

text: Ginkondena man sang United Nations Security Council ang amo nga “terrorist attack”.
english: The United Nations Security Council also condemned the terrorist attack.

text: Nagpanawagan man ang Iranian authorities sang mass protests sugod subong nga adlaw kadungan man sang lubong sang mga biktima sang amo nga pagpamomba.
english: Iranian authorities have also called for mass protests starting today in conjunction with the funerals of the victims of the bombing.

text: Ginbulgar sang isa ka suspek nga may isa ka popular nga babaye nga showbiz personality nga lakip sa “alpha members” nga involved sa pagkadula sang 100 ka mga manugbulang sang 2021.
english: A suspect has revealed that a popular female showbiz personality was among the “alpha members” involved in the disappearance of 100 healers in 2021.

text: Ini ang santo sa panaysayon ni alias “Totoy” nga isa sa akusado sa amo nga kidnapping case.
english: This is according to the statement of alias “Totoy” who is one of the accused in the kidnapping case.

text: Ini nga pangalan sang artista ang nalakip sa affidavit ni Totoy nga natalana nga ipasa sa awtoridad.
english: The name of the artist is included in Totoy's affidavit that is scheduled to be submitted to the authorities.

text: Nagpamalibad anay ang suspek nga isapubliko ang pangalan sang artista subong, apang suno sa iya, nagatambong ang babaye sa kada meeting.
english: The suspect previously declined to disclose the name of the current artist, but he said the woman attends every meeting.

text: Posible suno sa iya nga isa ini sa mangin alagyan ilabi na bangud mas madamo ini sang nahibaluan.
english: He said it is possible that this will be one of the ways especially since he knows more.

text: Apang, gindugang sini nga dapat nga pasakaan sang kaso ang amo nga female celebrity kaupod sa 30 ka iban pa mga sibilyan kag mga pulis.
english: However, he added that the female celebrity should be charged along with 30 other civilians and policemen.

text: Sa subong gina-imbestigaran na sang National Police Commission (Napolcom) ang mga alegasyon ni alias Totoy lakip na ang claim sini nga ginpanglubong ang lawas sang mga manugbulang sa Taal Lake.
english: The National Police Commission (Napolcom) is currently investigating the allegations of alias Totoy including his claim that the bodies of the healers were buried in Taal Lake.

text: Suno naman kay Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla, nagapangayo na sila sang bulig halin sa Japanese government para sa gamiton nga equipment sa pag-retrieve sang bangkay sang mga manugbulang.
english: Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin Remulla said they are already seeking assistance from the Japanese government for the equipment to be used to retrieve the bodies of the doctors.

text: Nagpahayag man ang tiglikom nga tuman ka damo sang kuwarta nga yara sa mastermind nga mahimo pa gani maka-infiltrate sa mga korte sa Pilipinas.
english: The secretary also said that there is so much money in the mastermind that it can even infiltrate the courts in the Philippines.

text: “Ang bigat ng kalaban dito kasi ang perang iyan nakakapasok iyan even sa judiciary and that is one thing that we might have to talk with the Chief Justice about kasi mabigat ang pera ng e-sabong, hindi ito basta-bastang kalaban,” suno sa opisyal.
