english: “The weight of the opponent here because that money can even enter the judiciary and that is one thing that we might have to talk with the Chief Justice about because the money of e-sabong is heavy, it is not just an opponent,” the official said.

text: “Basta ang sinasabi ng mastermind, narinig ko iyong kanyang ano, in his own words, kaya natin iyan, kahit Supreme Court daw kaya niya eh sinasabi niya, kaya kakausapin natin ang Chief Justice tungkol dito,” dugang sini.
english: "Just what the mastermind says, I heard what he said, in his own words, we can do it, even the Supreme Court can do it, he says, so we will talk to the Chief Justice about it," he added.

text: Nagpamalibad na ang tiglikom nga idetalye ang dugang nga impormasyon kaangot sa mastermind.
english: The secretary declined to elaborate on the mastermind.

text: Apang sa pahayag man sang Justice official, may police officers, government officials, kag mga indibidwal nga involved nga nagikan sa Visayas region.
english: However, according to the Justice official, there are police officers, government officials, and individuals involved from the Visayas region.

text: Nagdangat sa 103 ka mga tawo ang napatay sa duha ka magkasunod nga pagpamomba sa Iran kadungan sang pagkomemorar sang ika-apat nga anibersaryo sang pagpatay sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika sa Iranian kag Revolutionary Guards general nga si Qasem Soleimani.
english: At least 103 people have been killed in two consecutive bombings in Iran as the United States commemorates the fourth anniversary of the assassination of Iranian and Revolutionary Guards general Qasem Soleimani.

text: 15 ka minutos ang antad sang pagpamomba nga nag-igu malapit sa Martyrs Cemetery sa Saheb al-Zaman Mosque sa Kerman nga lugar nga ginda-an sang amo nga heneral nga napatay sa 2020 US drone strike sa Baghdad.
english: The bombings occurred 15 minutes apart near the Martyrs Cemetery at the Saheb al-Zaman Mosque in Kerman, the area where the general was killed in a 2020 US drone strike in Baghdad.

text: Gin-report man sang state media nga magluwas sa masobra 100 ka patay, may masobra 200 nga pilason kag pila diri ang kritikal ang kondisyon.
english: State media also reported that besides more than 100 dead, there were more than 200 injured and some of them were in critical condition.

text: Sunod nga ginbasol sang Iranian supreme leader nga si Ayatollah Ali Khamenei ang ila “evil and criminal enemies” kag nagbuya nga magatimalos sila kasunod sang amo nga “terrorist attack”.
english: Iranian supreme leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei next blamed their "evil and criminal enemies" and threatened to take revenge following the "terrorist attack".

text: Wala pa sang nag-ako kun sin-o ang may kahimuan sa pagpang-atake apang ginakahangaw-an nga mas magapaibwal pa ini sang gamo sa Middle East magluwas pa sa gyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas, ang militante nga grupo nga suportado sang Iran.
english: No one has claimed responsibility for the attack but it is feared that it will further fuel unrest in the Middle East in addition to the war between Israel and Hamas, the militant group backed by Iran.

text: Natabo ini nga pagpamomba kasunod sang kamatayon man sang deputy leader sang Palestinian group nga Hamas bangud sang Israeli drone strike sa Lebanon.# (Mahdi Karbakhsh Ravari/Mehr News Agnecy via AP)
english: The bombing followed the death of the deputy leader of the Palestinian group Hamas in an Israeli drone strike in Lebanon.

text: Nagalagas na sa tiyempo ang mga rescuers sa Japan agud indi na madugangan pa ang 73 ka mga tawo nga napatay kag masobra 400 nga nasamaran kasunod sang 7.5 magnitude nga linog nga nagtay-og sa amo nga pungsod kadungan sang imbukada sang 2024.
english: Rescuers in Japan are running out of time to prevent more than 73 people from being killed and more than 400 injured following a 7.5 magnitude earthquake that struck the country during the 2024 earthquake.

text: Suno kay Prime Minister Fumio Kishida, isa ini ka “critical” nga tion para sa tanan ilabi na bangud sa reports nga may mga tawo pa nga naipit sa nag-collapse nga mga building kag nagahulat sang rescue.
english: Prime Minister Fumio Kishida said this is a “critical” time for everyone especially given reports that there are still people trapped in collapsed buildings and waiting for rescue.

text: Bangud sini, triple-paninguha ang Japanese rescuers apisar sang mabatyagan nga aftershocks, mabaskog nga ulan, kag dalan nga nabalabagan sang mga debris.
english: As a result, Japanese rescuers tripled their efforts despite the aftershocks, heavy rains, and roads blocked by debris.

text: Gin-doble man ang mga military personnel nga gin-deploy sa mga lugar nga nalinugan kag gindugangan man ang rescue dogs nga ginpadala.
english: The number of military personnel deployed in the quake-hit areas has also been doubled and the number of rescue dogs has been increased.

text: Magluwas nga ginalantaw pa nga magataas ang numero sang casualties sa pungsod, may 33,400 pa subong ka tawo nga nagapabilin sa shelters.
english: Besides the expected increase in the number of casualties in the country, there are still 33,400 people remaining in shelters.

text: Ginabanta 200 man ka mga building ang nag-collapse.
english: About 200 buildings also collapsed.

text: Yara man sa 30,000 ka mga balay sa Ishikawa prefecture ang wala sang suplay sang kuryente kag masobra 110,000 ka mga puluy-an ang wala sang tubig.
english: There are also 30,000 houses in Ishikawa prefecture without electricity supply and more than 110,000 homes without water.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Noto Peninsula amo ang pinakanahalitan kasunod sang linog kag daw nahimo nga war zones ang port towns sang Wajima kag Suzu bangud puno sang lunang ang mga dalan, hapay ang mga balay, kag nagalulutaw ang mga sakayan.# (Kyodo News via AP)
english: The Noto Peninsula was the worst affected after the quake and the port towns of Wajima and Suzu seemed to have become war zones with muddy roads, destroyed houses, and floating boats.# (Kyodo News via AP)

text: KON WALA nagasabat ukon “silent” lang ang akusado sa akusasyon sa iya, sunu sa aton amigo nga abogado, indi pa ang hwes maka-“conclude” nga “admission of guilt” na niya ini bisan pa sa mabug-at na nga ebidensya sang prosecution.
english: IF the accused does not answer or is “silent” to the accusation against him, according to our friend the lawyer, the judge cannot “conclude” that it is his “admission of guilt” despite the heavy evidence of the prosecution.

text: Dapat makuha gid anay ang iya “assertive” nga sabat sa akusasyon tungod sa iya kinamatarong sa “due process”.
english: His “assertive” response to the accusation must be obtained first because of his right to “due process”.

text: Apang kon indi siya gihapon maghatag sang iya pang-depensa nga sabat sa idalom sang iya “duty to speak”, pwede na siya ma-“estoppel” nga indi na mahatagan sang kinamatarong nga mag-“speak out” pa.
english: However, if he still does not give his defense under his duty to speak, he may be estoppelled and not be given the right to speak out.

text: Tungod sini, mapilitan na ang hwes nga maghulog sang iya sentensya, kon tion na nga pamatbatan siya, kon “damning” na gid man ang mga ebidensya sang prosecution kontra sa iya.
english: Because of this, the judge will be forced to drop his sentence, when it is time to sentence him, if the evidence of the prosecution against him is “damning”.

text: Mahimo na ina sang hwes tungod mapensar na sini nga ang “silence” sang akusado isa na ka pag-admitir sang akusasyon sa iya sang prosecution.
english: The judge can do that because he will think that the accused's “silence” is an admission of the prosecution's charges against him.

text:
***

Lain ugaling ang sitwasyon sa isa ka electoral contest nga ang magahusgar sa imo amo ang ordinaryo nga botante, nga ginabasehan amo lang ang “common sense” ukon sentido komon.
english:
***

The situation is different in an electoral contest where the judge is the ordinary voter, who is based on common sense.

text: In fact, sang wala pa mauso ang “forensic evidence” amo gid lang man ini ang ginasaligan sang hwes – ang pag-upod sa kinaalam gid lang sang kadam-an nga pumuluyo sandig sa indi na masuay nga “common evidences”.
english: In fact, before forensic evidence became fashionable, the judge relied on it – to go with the wisdom of the majority of the people based on indisputable common evidence.

text: Sa eleksyon ang mga isyu nagatumod gid lang sa “good governance” kag indi kinahanglan nga hwes gid ang mag-desisyon.
english: In elections, the issues are all about “good governance” and there is no need for a judge to decide.

text: Bastante na nga mahibal-an sang mga pumuluyo ang bagay mahibal-an nila parti sa mga kandidato – kon ano ang pagkatawo nila kag kon sin-o ang mas masaligan sa pagdala sang ila kaayuhan sa pangabuhi kag sa pag-protejer sang ila ginakilala nga mga kinamatarong.
english: It is enough for the people to know what they need to know about the candidates – what they are like and who is more trustworthy to bring their welfare and protect their recognized rights.

text: Angot diri, isa sang luyag nila mahibal-an amo kon ano ang masabat sang mga kandidato sa mga akusasyon angot sa ila “honesty and integrity”, isyu sang corruption sa pwesto, ihibalo sa pagdumala kag pagsabat sa problema sang mga pumuluyo, kag ang kasubong pa nga ihibalo nga makahatag kumpyansa sang mga pumuluyo sa pagpatuman nila sang ila mga katungdanan.
english: In this regard, one of the things they want to know is what the candidates will answer to the accusations regarding their “honesty and integrity”, issues of corruption in office, knowledge of management and responding to the problems of the people, and similar knowledge that will give confidence to the people in carrying out their duties.

text:
***

Partikular sa isyu batok kay BongBong Marcos, sa ila mainit nga isyuhanay ni VP Leni Robredo sa ila pagdalagan sa pagka-Presidente, isa sang pamangkot amo ang: Matuod bala nga “golden age” gid ang sobra 10 ka tuig nga martial law regime sunu sa pagpabugal ni BBM, ukon rehimen ini sang indi mapatawad nga mga torture, disappearance, kag paghingabot kag panglupig sa kinamatarong sang oposisyon kag independent media?
english:
***

Particularly on the issue against BongBong Marcos, in their heated debate with VP Leni Robredo in their run for President, one of the questions was: Is it true that the more than 10 years of martial law regime is a “golden age” as BBM boasts, or is it a regime of unforgivable torture, torture, persecution and persecution? on the rights of the opposition and independent media?

text: Matuod man bala ang siling sang korte nga wala makabayad si BBM sang iya buhis sadtong 1982-1985?
english: Is it true that the court said that BBM did not pay its taxes in 1982-1985?

text: Matuod bala ang siling niya nga gradwet siya sa kurso nga Economics sa Harvard?
english: Is it true that he graduated from Harvard with a degree in Economics?

text: Matuod bala nga siya ang “author” sang R.A. 9522, ukon ang Philippine Archipelagic Baseline Law, sunu sa iya claim?
english: Is it true that he is the “author” of R.A. 9522, or the Philippine Archipelagic Baseline Law, according to his claim?

text: Kon indi matuod ang akusasyon ni VP Leni Robredo, siya gali ang butigon.
english: If VP Leni Robredo's accusation is not true, she is a liar.

text: Ugaling may mga pamatuod si VP Leni sa ining iya akusasyon kay BBM.
english: But VP Leni has proof in her accusation against BBM.

text:
***

Sa akusasyon ni VP Leni nga “liar” si BBM, wala sing masabat si BBM, luas lang sa sabat sang iya taghambal nga indi siya luyag sing “negative and hateful campaigning”.
english:
***

To VP Leni's accusation that BBM is “liar”, BBM has no answer, except for the answer of his spokesman that he does not want “negative and hateful campaigning”.

text: Ang matuod, sa nasiling ta na sa ibabaw, may pamatuod si VP Leni sa ining iya akusasyon batok kay BBM nga indi ma-deny ni BBM.
english: In fact, as we have already said above, VP Leni has proof in this accusation against BBM that BBM cannot deny.

text: Indi man magsiling ang taghambal ni BBM nga siya gid lang ang naisgan atakehon sang iya mga kasumpong kag makaluluoy gid kuno siya.
english: BBM's spokesperson did not say that he was the only one who dared to be attacked by his opponents and that he was very pitiful.

text: Ang matuod, sunu kay VP Leni, siya ang ginkamasaan sang wala kag tuo nga atake sang mga trolls ni BBM sa ila mga panghikay, pangyaguta, kag binastos nga propaganda.
english: In fact, according to VP Leni, she was the victim of left and right attacks by BBM's trolls in their arrangements, ridicule, and obscene propaganda.

text:
***

Indi pareho sa kay BBM ang iya mga kasumpong.
english:
***

His opponents are not like BBM.

text: Wala ini sila nahadlok sabton ang mga “damning” nga mga akusasyon ni Jessica Soho sa iya interbyu.
english: They were not afraid to answer Jessica Soho's “damning” accusations in her interview.

text: Gin-admitir ni Pacquiao nga naka-violar man siya sang traffic regulations.
english: Pacquiao admitted that he also violated traffic regulations.

text: Si Lacson nagsabat man sa akusasyon nga kuno nalagyo siya sa kasuguan sa iya kaso angot sa Baleleng massacre.
english: Lacson also responded to the accusation that he was running away from the law in his case regarding the Baleleng massacre.

text: Gin-ako man ni Moreno nga ginbulsa niya ang P50 ka milyon nga excess contribution sa iya kampanya sadtong 2016 tungod wala man sing may nag-claim kag ginbayaran man niya ini sing buhis.
english: Moreno also admitted that he pocketed the P50 million excess contribution in his 2016 campaign because no one claimed it and he paid taxes on it.

text: Samtang, si BBM wala iya gana magsabat sa mga akusasyon batok sa iya.
english: Meanwhile, BBM has refused to respond to the accusations against him.

text: Nahibal-an na ninyo seguro kon ngaa./PN
english: You probably already know why./PN

text: Ginakabig ni Gilas Pilipinas coach Tim Cone nga ang kadalag-an nila batok sa Jordan sa exhibition game ang isa ka challenge sa ila para sa FIBA Asia Cup.
english: Gilas Pilipinas coach Tim Cone considers their victory against Jordan in the exhibition game a challenge for them for the FIBA ​​Asia Cup.

text: Ginpahayag ni Cone nga apisar nagdaog sila batok sa Jordan sa score nga 75-61 ang indi pa sagihapon sila kampante sa pag-atubang nila batok sa Chinese Taipei sa Myerkules.
english: Cone said that despite winning 75-61 against Jordan, they are still not confident in their match against Chinese Taipei on Wednesday.

text: Dugang pa sini, tuman kadako ang kinalain sang mga hampang sa mismo nga Asia Cup kag ang duha ka exhibition games ang isa ka talaksan sang ila preparasyon.
english: He added that the difference between the games in the Asia Cup itself is very big and the two exhibition games are a benchmark of their preparation.

text: Sa subong, may yara na sang duha nga kadalag-an kag wala pa sang pyerde ang Gilas sa exhibition games bag-o ang FIBA Asia Cup.
english: So far, the Gilas have two wins and no losses in exhibition games before the FIBA ​​Asia Cup.

text: Ang asin ang isa sa pinakabantog nga panakot sa nanuhay-tuhay nga linuto.
english: Salt is one of the most popular spices in a variety of cuisines.

text: Apang natestingan mo man bala ini nga simhutan?
english: But have you tried to smell it?

text: Suno kay Dr. Alan Carter, clinical pharmacist sa Estados Unidos, aprubado sang Food and Drug Administration (FDA) ang pagsimhut sang asin agud ma-revive ang isa ka indibidwal nga nadulaan sang pangalibutan.
english: According to Dr. Alan Carter, clinical pharmacist in the United States, the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) approved the inhalation of salt to revive an individual who has lost consciousness.

text: Ini bangud ang baho sang asin ang nagabulig paggwa sang ammonia gas nga nagapakatol sang nasal kag lung membranes kag naga-restore sang senses sang isa ka indibidwal.
english: This is because the smell of salt helps to release ammonia gas that irritates the nasal and lung membranes and restores an individual's senses.

text: Naga-increase man ang respiration kag heart rate sang isa ka indibidwal kun makasimhot ini sang baho sang asin rason nga nagabalik ang consciousness.
english: An individual's respiration and heart rate also increase when they smell salt, causing consciousness to return.

text: Nakaandan naman sang professional athletes ang pagsimhut sang asin antes ang iya hampang ukon training agud mapasanyog ang ila nga performance.
english: Professional athletes are used to sniffing salt before their game or training to improve their performance.

text: Pahayag sang doktor, ang baho sang asin ang nagahatag sang placebo effect nga nagaresulta sa pagtaas sang kumpyansa rason nga nagabulig ini sa pagsangkad sang performance sang isa ka atleta.
english: According to the doctor, the smell of salt provides a placebo effect that results in increased confidence and thus helps to enhance the performance of an athlete.

text: Wala sang side-effects ang long-term ukon short-term use sang pagsimhut sang asin.
english: There are no side-effects of long-term or short-term use of salt inhalation.

text: Apang suno sa eksperto, nagakadapat nga indi tuman kalapit sa ilong kun magsimhut sang asin agud malikawan man ang pagkaguba sang nasal membranes.
english: However, according to experts, salt should not be too close to the nose to avoid damage to the nasal membranes.

text: Impossible sa karun ang repatriation sang mga Pilipino nga naipit sa mainit nga tensyon sa Middle East suno kay President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: The repatriation of Filipinos trapped in the Middle East is impossible, according to President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Ini ang ginpahayag sang Presidente kadungan sang press briefing sa Malacañang, may kaangtanan sa sitwasyon sang mga Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) sa Middle East.
english: The President said this during a press briefing in Malacañang, regarding the situation of Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) in the Middle East.

text: Suno man sa record sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), yara sa 1,460 ka mga Pilipino sa karun nga tion ang nagpanawagan nga makapauli sa Pilipinas, kun sa diin, may halos 586 ang naghingyo nga magpauli halin sa Dubai, 297 sa Israel, 270 sa Abu Dhabi, 231 sa Bahrain, 22 sa Jordan kag 10 sa Iran.
english: According to the records of the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA), there are currently 1,460 Filipinos who have called to return to the Philippines, of which nearly 586 have requested to return from Dubai, 297 to Israel, 270 to Abu Dhabi, 23 to Bahrain, 12 to Jordan and Iran.

text: Ginhingyo man ni Marcos ang mga Pilipino nga temporaryo nga magsaylo sa mas hilway nga lugar agud masikyar ang ila seguridad.
english: Marcos also urged Filipinos to temporarily move to safer areas to ensure their security.

text: Madumduman nga may narekord na ang Pilipinas nga casualty sa Israel, kun sa diin ginbawian sang kabuhi ang isa ka Pinay caregiver nga si Marry Anne Velasquez sang Pangasinan, nga nahibaluan man nga nagadala sang iya subang kun tani nga bata sang ini ang nadalahig sa isa ka missile attack sang Iran sa Israel.
english: The Philippines has already recorded a casualty in Israel, where a Filipina caregiver named Marry Anne Velasquez of Pangasinan, who was also known to be carrying her youngest child, died when she was involved in an Iranian missile attack on Israel.

text: Sa pihak naman nga bahin, nagpasiguro si Department of National Defense Sec.
english: Meanwhile, Department of National Defense Sec.

text: Gibo Teodoro, nga wala sang direkta nga pamahog sa seguridad sang Pilipinas ang nagakatabo nga tensyon sa Middle East.
english: Gibo Teodoro, that the ongoing tensions in the Middle East do not pose a direct threat to Philippine security.

text: Ini nga pahayag ni Secretary Teodoro ang kasunod man sang ginapahayag “wala sang basehan” nga mga huring-huring nga posible atakihun sang Iran ang Pilipinas bangud kaalyado sang pungsod ang Amerika.
english: Secretary Teodoro's statement also follows allegedly “unfounded” rumors that Iran may attack the Philippines because the country is an ally of the United States.

text: Words by: Bombo Ian Gajete
english: Words by: Bombo Ian Gajete

text: Tuman nga ginkaalarma sang United Nations ang ginpatigayon nga U.S. strikes kag ang pagdakop kay President Nicolás Maduro sa Venezuela.
english: The United Nations is deeply alarmed by the U.S. strikes and the arrest of President Nicolás Maduro in Venezuela.

text: Suno sa United Nations, ang natabo isa ka paglapas sa international law.
english: According to the United Nations, what happened was a violation of international law.

text: Ginsiling ni Stéphane Dujarric, spokesman for the U.N. secretary-general nga ang ini nga mga developments ang nagahatag sang mas dako nga implikasyon para sa Latin America kag sa Caribbean.
english: Stéphane Dujarric, spokesman for the U.N. secretary-general that these developments have greater implications for Latin America and the Caribbean.

text: Nagpanawagan man si Dujarric sa tanan nga involved nga respetuhon ang tawhanon nga kinamatarung kag ang layi.
english: Dujarric also called on all involved to respect human rights and the law.

text: Kahapon sang gindakop sang United States si Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro kag ginlupad ini pagwa sa iya nga pungsod.
english: Yesterday, the United States arrested Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro and flew him out of his country.

text: Ini ang gindunganan sang serye sang strikes sa kapital nga Caracas kasunod sang binulan nga pag-escalate sang pressure sang Trump administration sa amo nga South American nation.
english: This coincided with a series of strikes in the capital Caracas following months of escalation of pressure by the Trump administration in the South American nation.

text: Ang pag-atake sang US kahapon ang naglawig sang 30 minutos kag indi magnubo sa pito ang serye sang pagsigabong nga nagtuga sang kakugmat sa mga tawo.
english: Yesterday's US attack lasted 30 minutes and at least seven series of explosions caused panic among people.

text: Kasunod sang insidente, ginsiling ni President Donald Trump nga ang U.S. magadesisyon kun ano ang masunod nga tikang para sa Venezuela.
english: Following the incident, President Donald Trump said the U.S. would decide what to do next for Venezuela.

text: Suno naman kay U.S. Attorney General Pam Bondi, si Maduro kag iya asawa ang mangatubang sang charges matapos ang indictment sa New York.
english: U.S. Attorney General Pam Bondi said Maduro and his wife will face charges after the indictment in New York.

text: Nagpasalig si Bondi nga mangatubang gid sang bug-os nga pwersa sang American justice sa American soil sa American courts sanday Maduro.
english: Bondi assured that Maduro will face the full force of American justice on American soil in American courts.

text: Apisar nga si Vice President Delcy Rodríguez ang magabulos bilang presidente, apang wala pa sang kumpirmasyon nga natabo ini.
english: Although Vice President Delcy Rodríguez will take over as president, there is no confirmation that this has happened.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala ginakilala sang Trump administration nga si Maduro ang lehitimo nga leader sang Venezuela kag ginsiling nga ginhimo ni Maduro ang Venezuela bilang isa ka criminal enterprise kag hulukmungan sang drug traffickers kag terrorist groups.
english: The Trump administration does not recognize Maduro as the legitimate leader of Venezuela and says Maduro has turned Venezuela into a criminal enterprise and a haven for drug traffickers and terrorist groups.

text: Tuman naman ang pagdayaw ni Trump sa amo nga pag-atake sa Venezuela kag ang pagdakop kay Maduro.
english: Trump praised the attack on Venezuela and the arrest of Maduro.

text: Nabiktima sang pagpameke sang kwarta ang pila manobaligya sang panakot sa Banate, Iloilo.
english: Some spice vendors in Banate, Iloilo have been victims of money laundering.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Randy Lambungan, Chief of Police sang Banate Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagbayad ang mga suspek sang libohon nila nga kwarta kon sa diin, ginkambyohan sila sang vendors sang matuod nga kwarta.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Randy Lambungan, Chief of Police of Banate Municipal Police Station, said the suspects paid thousands of pesos where the vendors exchanged them for real money.

text: Suno kay Lambungan, naga-tagalog pa ang mga suspek sa tion sang ila ang nagabakal sang ahos, bombay kag iban pa.
english: According to Lambungan, the suspects were still speaking Tagalog when they were buying garlic, bombay and others.

text: Apang, ginalantaw man ini sang natungdan nga mahimo estrahitiya lamang ini sang mga suspek agud nga indi sila gilayon nga matiktikan.
english: However, he also believes that this may be a strategy of the suspects so that they will not be immediately detected.

text: Gintuad man sini nga apat tanan ka mga suspek ang natumod nga nagpameke sang kwarta apang, duha lang diri ang nadakpan, samtang ang duha ang nakapalagyo.
english: He also admitted that four suspects were identified as counterfeiters but only two of them were arrested, while the other two escaped.

text: Nagpanugyan man ang Banate PNP sa publiko nga mangin mahinalongon kag mabusisi sa pagbaton sang kwarta.
english: Banate PNP also advised the public to be cautious and careful in receiving money.

text: Lima na ka mga tawo ang kumpirmado nga patay kag masobra 70 ang nasamaran bangud sang 7.5 magnitude nga linog nga nagtay-og sa Japan.
english: Five people have been confirmed dead and more than 70 injured in a 7.5 magnitude earthquake that shook Japan.

text: Suno kay Prime Minister Fumio Kishida, natipon sang local authorities ini nga data Martes sang kaagahon apang wala pa subong na-consolidate ang tanan nga impormasyon bangud natabo ang linog pasado ‘las kuatro kahapon sang hapon oras sa Japan.
english: According to Prime Minister Fumio Kishida, local authorities collected the data Tuesday morning but have not yet consolidated all the information because the quake occurred around 4 pm yesterday Japan time.

text: Nagbakwit man ang linibo ka mga tawo kag nagtinir sa evacuation centers kasunod sang tsunami warning nga ginpaguwa kasunod sang mabaskog nga linog.Ini nga warning ang ginkanselar sa coastal regions sang western Japan apang nagpabilin ang advisories kag gin-abisuhan gihapon ang mga residente nga magbiya anay sa ila nga balay.
english: Thousands of people were also evacuated and stayed in evacuation centers following the tsunami warning issued following the strong earthquake. This warning was canceled in the coastal regions of western Japan but advisories remained and residents were still advised to leave their homes.

text: Sa western coast sang pungsod, nagalab-ot sa 1.2 metros ang kataason sang tsunami waves.
english: On the west coast of the country, tsunami waves reached 1.2 meters high.

text: May na-report naman nga nagkalahalitan nga mga dalan kag building, naatrasar ang serbisyo sa transport kag komunikasyon, kag nagpaandam man ang mga opisyal sang dugang nga pagkadula sang suplay sang kuryente sa linibo ka mga puluy-an.
english: Damaged roads and buildings were reported, transport and communication services were delayed, and officials warned of further power outages to thousands of homes.

text: May na-record na nga aftershocks — butang nga ginsiling sang weather agency nga posible magpadayon tubtub sa masunod nga inadlaw.#
english: Aftershocks have already been recorded — something the weather agency said is likely to continue into the next day.

text: Liwat nga ginbuksan sang Philippine Airlines ang ila byahe padulong sa Middle East umpisa subong nga adlaw, Hunyo 25, matapos ang temporaryo nga pagkansela sang mga flight bangud sa tension sa tunga sang Iran kag Israel.
english: Philippine Airlines has reopened its flights to the Middle East starting today, June 25, after the temporary cancellation of flights due to tensions between Iran and Israel.

text: Lakip sa mga naapektuhan nga byahe ang mga flight pa-Doha, Dubai kag Riyadh, kasunod sang pag-atake sang Iran sa AI Udeid airbase sa Qatar kag ang temporaryo nga pagsarado sang airspace sa rehiyon.
english: Among the affected flights were flights to Doha, Dubai and Riyadh, following Iran’s attack on the AI ​​Udeid airbase in Qatar and the temporary closure of airspace in the region.

text: Suno sa PAL, pwedi na na mga book sang mga apektado nga mga pasahero ang ila flight sa sulod sang 60 ka adlaw, i-convert ini sa travel credits, ukon magparefund sang wala penalty except sa service charge.
english: According to PAL, affected passengers can book their flights within 60 days, convert them to travel credits, or refund without penalty except for the service charge.

text: Nagdangat sa 170 ka mga tawo ang ginpangbitay sa Saudi Arabia sang 2023 lakip na ang apat ka mga tawo kadungan sa bisperas sang bag-ong tuig.
english: A total of 170 people were hanged in Saudi Arabia in 2023, including four people on New Year's Eve.

text: Mas mataas ini nga rekord ipaanggid sa 147 ka convicts nga ginpatay sang 2022, apang mas manubo naman ipaanggid sa 187 ka mga executions sa kingdom sang 2019.
english: This record is higher than the 147 convicts executed in 2022, but lower compared to the 187 executions in the kingdom in 2019.

text: Ang apat nga ginbitay sa New Year’s eve ang na-convict bangud sa kaso nga murder.
english: The four who were hanged on New Year’s eve were convicted of murder.

text: Lakip diri ang duha sa north-western city sang Tabuk, isa sa Riyadh, kag isa sa Jazan sa south-west.
english: These include two in the north-western city of Tabuk, one in Riyadh, and one in Jazan in the south-west.

text: Sa bilog man nga rekord sang 2023, nalakip ang 33 nga gin-akusaran sa krimen nga naangot sa terorismo kag duha ka soldado nga napreso bangud sa pag-traidor sa otoridad.
english: The 2023 record also includes 33 charged with terrorism-related crimes and two soldiers imprisoned for treason.

text: Sa bulan lamang sang Disyembre, may yara gid sang 38 ka executions.
english: In the month of December alone, there were actually 38 executions.

text: Kun matandaan, sang 2022, sandig sa data sang Amnesty International, mas madamo nga tawo ang ginpang-execute sa Saudi Arabia ipaanggid sa iban nga mga pungsod magluwas lamang sa China kag Iran.
english: In 2022, according to Amnesty International data, more people were executed in Saudi Arabia than in any other country except China and Iran.

text: Kilala ang kingdom sa pagpangpugot sang ulo.
english: The kingdom is known for beheading.

text: Kun matandaan, sang 2022, sa sulod lamang sang isa adlaw, 81 gid ka mga tawo ang ginpang-execute — hitabo nga nakabaton sang wala-tuo nga pagkondenar halin sa iban nga mga pungsod.
english: In 2022, in just one day, 81 people were executed — an event that drew widespread condemnation from other countries.

text: Ginakonsiderar naman sang otoridad nga nagaangot ang ila tikang sa sharia law, ang Islamic law code nga naka-base sa pagpanudlo sang Koran.
english: Authorities consider their move to be in line with sharia law, the Islamic law code based on the teachings of the Koran.

text:
Ginpahayag man nga kinahanglanon ini agud mapabilin ang “public order.”# (with reports from Agence France-Presse)

Alamy Stock Photo
english:
It was also said that this was necessary to maintain “public order.”# (with reports from Agence France-Presse)

text: Hugton sang Iloilo City Task Force on Morals and Values ang monitoring sa prostitusyon ukon pagbaligya sang hingalit nga kalipay.
english: The Iloilo City Task Force on Morals and Values ​​will tighten monitoring of prostitution.

text: Ini kasunod man sang report sang pagpangsaputi sa isa ka ice cream vendor sa City Proper bangud sa amo nga hitabo.
english: This follows a report of assault on an ice cream vendor in City Proper over the incident.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Nestor Canong, head sang Task Force on Morals and Values, iya ginpahayag nga kon basehan lamang ang layi, tuman ini ka sakit para sa mga nagapakigbahin sa amo nga aktwasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Nestor Canong, head of the Task Force on Morals and Values, said that if the law is the only basis, it is very painful for those who participate in such actions.

text: Suno kay Canong, ang mga indibidwal nga makit-an sa tion sang kagab-ihon nga naga-engage sa amo nga buluhaton ang ila na lamang nga gina-istorya kag ginapapauli.
english: According to Canong, individuals who are found engaged in such activities at night are the only ones they talk to and send home.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga indi manegar nga kalabanan sa mga napartisipar sa hingalit nga kalipay ang ginahimo na nga palangabuhian.
english: He also said that there is no denying that most of those who participated in the sudden celebration are already making a living.

text: Nagpasalig man si Canong sang koordinasyon sang talatapan sa kapulisan agud malikawan ang gamo bangud lamang sa paghingalit sang madasig nga kalipay.
english: Canong also assured the office's coordination with the police to avoid riots just for the sake of quick pleasure.

text: 200 ang numero sang patay bangud sang serye sang pagpang-atake sang armado nga kalalakihan sa central Nigeria kadungan sang gab-i antes ang Paskuwa.
english: At least 200 people have been killed in a series of attacks by armed men in central Nigeria on the night before Easter.

text: Suno pa sa local government sa Bokkos, posible nga madugangan pa ang numero sang patay sa masunod nga mga inadlaw bangud kritikal man ang kondisyon sang iban nga mga biktima sa ospital.
english: According to the local government in Bokkos, the death toll is likely to rise in the coming days as some of the victims are in critical condition in hospital.

text: Sabado tubtub sang Domingo sang kaagahon sang gin-atake sang gangs ang 20 ka komunidad sa amo nga pungsod kun sa diin ginpangpatay ang mga residente, ginsunog ang masobra 200 ka mga balay kag 30 ka mga salakyan, kag ginkawat ang mga produkto sa amo nga kaumhan.
english: From Saturday to Sunday morning, gangs attacked 20 communities in the country where residents were killed, more than 200 houses and 30 vehicles were burned, and products were stolen from the countryside.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginapugaran sang bandit militia ang North-west kag central Nigeria kun sa diin naga-operate sila sa mga kagulangan kag masami nga nagpangawat kag nagapangkidnap sang mga residente agud makakuha sang kuwarta.
english: It is known that the bandit militia is based in North-west and central Nigeria where they operate in the forests and often rob and kidnap residents to get money.

text: # (Photo Credit: Kim Masara/AFPTV/AFP via Getty Images)
english: # (Photo Credit: Kim Masara/AFPTV/AFP via Getty Images)

text: Gin-utod na sang Philippine National Police (PNP) ang koneksyon sini sa fitness vlogger nga si Rendon Labador may kaangtanan sa kontrobersiya nga natuga sang weight loss program sang organisasyon.
english: The Philippine National Police (PNP) has cut ties with fitness vlogger Rendon Labador in connection with the controversy caused by the organization's weight loss program.

text: Inisyal nga gin-tap sang Police Community Affairs and Development Group (PCADG) si Labador agud pangunahan ang 93-day weight loss program, apang sa June 21 PNP memorandum , gin-athag nga wala ginhatagan sang obligasyon ang vlogger nga pangunahan ang inisyatibo.
english: The Police Community Affairs and Development Group (PCADG) initially tapped Labador to lead the 93-day weight loss program, but in a June 21 PNP memorandum, it was clarified that the vlogger was not given the obligation to lead the initiative.

text: Suno kay Fajardo, may natabo lang nga indi pag-intindihanay.
english: According to Fajardo, there was just a misunderstanding.

text: “I understand na parang naputol na yung engagement ng PCADG sa kanya.
english: “I understand that it seems that PCADG has broken off its engagement with him.

text: That is what Director General Marvin Saro mentioned to me when I called him the other day.
english: That is what Director General Marvin Saro mentioned to me when I called him the other day.

text: According to General Saro, there was a misunderstanding in terms of the engagement with the concerned individual.
english: According to General Saro, there was a misunderstanding in terms of the engagement with the concerned individual.

text:
Probably, na-excite lang siguro si Rendon nung magkausap sila, and the topic was brought up.”

Sa isa naman ka interview antes ginlunsar ang programa, ginsiling ni Labador nga ginpangabay siya ni Saro nga pangunahan ang inisyatibo kag nagpasugot ini nga himuon kag wala sang bayad.
english:
Probably, Rendon was just excited when they talked, and the topic was brought up.”

In another interview before the launch of the program, Labador said Saro asked him to lead the initiative and he agreed to do so free of charge.

text: Ini nga fitness drive ang kasunod sang direktiba halin kay PNP Chief Gen.
english: This fitness drive is in line with the directive from PNP Chief Gen.

text: Nicolas Torre III nga ang mga pulis nga mapaslawan sang duha ka beses sa physical fitness ang magapaidalom sa retraining kag indi eligible para sa promosyon.
english: Nicolas Torre III said policemen who fail twice in physical fitness will undergo retraining and will not be eligible for promotion.

text: Nanguna ang Betlehem sa ginmensyonar ni Pope Francis sa tuigan nga Christmas Day “Urbi et Orbi” ukon sa “To the City and the World” mass sa Vatican.
english: Bethlehem took the lead in what Pope Francis mentioned in the annual Christmas Day “Urbi et Orbi” or “To the City and the World” mass at the Vatican.

text: Ang Bethlehem amo ang lugar sa West Bank kun sa diin nabun-ag si Hesus masobra 2,000 ka tuig na ang nakaligad.
english: Bethlehem is the place on the West Bank where Jesus was born more than 2,000 years ago.

text: Sa mismo adlaw sang Paskuwa, nahimo ini nga ghost town kag wala sang public celebrations bangud sa nagapadayon nga gyera sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas.
english: On Easter itself, it became a ghost town and there were no public celebrations due to the ongoing war between Israel and Hamas.

text: Wala sang higante nga Christmas tree, wala sang naga-martsa nga mga banda, kag wala sang bisan ano nga mga aktibidad nga amo ang masami nga naga-ganyat sa linibo ka mga turista.
english: There was no giant Christmas tree, no marching bands, and none of the activities that usually draw thousands of tourists.

text: Sa iya misa sa Vatican, nagpahayag ang Santo Papa sang iya liwat nga panawagan nga tapuson na ang gyera sa Israel kag Palestine.
english: In his mass at the Vatican, the Pope reiterated his call for an end to the war between Israel and Palestine.

text: Liwat man ini nga naghingyo nga hilwayon ang mga kabataan kag tapuson na ang military operations nga amo ang naga-apekto sa inosente nga mga sibilyan.
english: He also called for the release of the children and an end to military operations that affect innocent civilians.

text: “I reiterate my urgent appeal for the liberation of those still being held hostage.
english: “I reiterate my urgent appeal for the liberation of those still being held hostage.

text: I plead for an end to the military operations with their appalling harvest of innocent civilian victims, and call for a solution to the desperate humanitarian situation by an opening to the provision of humanitarian aid”, pahayag sang Santo Papa.
english: I plead for an end to the military operations with their appalling harvest of innocent civilian victims, and call for a solution to the desperate humanitarian situation by an opening to the provision of humanitarian aid”, the Pope said.

text: Sa “Urbi et Orbi” speech, namensyonar man sini ang mga kinagamo sa Armenia, Azerbaijan, Syria, Yemen, Ukraine, South Sudan, Congo, Cameroon, kag sa Korean peninsula.
english: In the “Urbi et Orbi” speech, he also mentioned the unrest in Armenia, Azerbaijan, Syria, Yemen, Ukraine, South Sudan, Congo, Cameroon, and the Korean peninsula.

text: “I implore peace for Ukraine.
english: “I implore peace for Ukraine.

text:
Let us renew our spiritual and human closeness to its embattled people.”

Nag-apelar ang Santo Papa sa humanitarian initiatives, dialogue kag security nga mangibabaw labaw pa sa nakatabo subong nga kalakasan kag pagpamatay.
english:
Let us renew our spiritual and human closeness to its embattled people.”

The Pope appealed for humanitarian initiatives, dialogue and security to prevail beyond the current violence and killings.

text: # Photo: Gregorio Borgia via wbaltv
english: # Photo: Gregorio Borgia via wbaltv

text: Gin-relieve sa pwesto ang hepe sang Pavia Municial Police Station nga si Police Major Harold Rendora kag temporaryo nga magaserbe bilang Officer in Charge (OIC) si Police Major Dadje Delima nga chief man sang Iloilo Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU).
english: Pavia Municipal Police Station chief Police Major Harold Rendora has been relieved of his post and Police Major Dadje Delima, who is also chief of the Iloilo Provincial Drug Enforcement Unit (PDEU), will temporarily serve as Officer in Charge (OIC).

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Dadje Delima, iya ginpahayag nga nakabaton siya sang verbal instruction gikan kay Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) Director Police Colonel Bayani Razalan nga temporary nga i-oversee ang Pavia Municial Police Station.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Dadje Delima said he received verbal instructions from Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) Director Police Colonel Bayani Razalan to temporarily oversee the Pavia Municipal Police Station.

text: Suno kay Delima, wala pa siya sang order ukon mandu nga ginakaptan kag ang hingyo lamang sa iya ni Col.
english: According to Delima, he has no order or order and the only request to him is Col.

text: Razalan amo ang mag-oversee sang talatapan.
english: Razalan will oversee the office.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga subong mismo nga gab-i masugod siya pungko bilang OIC sang Pavia PNP.
english: He also said that tonight he will take office as OIC of Pavia PNP.

text: Nagalaum naman si Delima nga makadugang-istorya kay Razalan agud maplastar ang mga plano kag masunod nga mga tikang.
english: Delima hopes to have further talks with Razalan to lay out plans and next steps.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa nga ginahibalo kay Razalan kung ano ang posible rason sa pag-relieve sa nasambit nga pulis.
english: Razalan is still investigating the possible reason for the relief of the policeman.

text: Kanselado ang public celebrations sang Pakuwa sa Bethlehem, ang lugar nga nahamtang sa West Bank, kag ang lugar kun sa diin ginapatihan nga ginbun-ag si Hesukristo.
english: Public celebrations of Easter in Bethlehem, the place located in the West Bank, and the place where Jesus Christ is believed to have been born, have been cancelled.

text: Una na nga gin-desisyunan sang local leaders sa amo nga Christian town nga ipaiway anay ang public Christmas festivities bilang pagpakita sang simpatiya sa mga Palestinians nga nagasuprer bangud sang gyera sang Israel kag Hamas sa Gaza Strip.
english: Earlier, local leaders in the Christian town decided to postpone public Christmas festivities as a show of sympathy for the Palestinians suffering from the war between Israel and Hamas in the Gaza Strip.

text: “It’s impossible to celebrate when so many — on both sides — have lost so much,” suno kay Rami Asakrieh, isa ka Franciscan friar kag pastor sa St.
english: “It’s impossible to celebrate when so many — on both sides — have lost so much,” said Rami Asakrieh, a Franciscan friar and pastor at St.

text: Catherine’s Church.
english: Catherine’s Church.

text:
“We canceled the festivities as a sign of solidarity with the victims of the war.”

Limitado ang Christmas activities sa worship kag prayer kag wala na ang nakaandan nga Christmas lights kag Christmas trees kag wala man ang nakaandan nga linibo ka mga tawo nga nagadugok sa mga dalanon kag ang maduagon nga mga dekorasyon.
english:
“We canceled the festivities as a sign of solidarity with the victims of the war.”

Christmas activities are limited to worship and prayer and there are no usual Christmas lights and Christmas trees as well as the usual thousands of people flocking to the streets and colorful decorations.

text: Halimbawa sang makit-an subong sa Bethlehem amo ang Nativity scene kun sa diin nakaputos si baby Jesus kag nabutang sa nakatangkas-tangkas nga mga debris.
english: An example of what can be seen today in Bethlehem is the Nativity scene where baby Jesus is wrapped and placed in loose debris.

text: Ginpahayag nga ini nga artwork ang naga-representar sang displacement sang Palestinian families nga ginapaanggid man sa pagpalagyo nanday Jesus, Mary kag Joseph sa mandu ni King Herod.
english: The artwork is said to represent the displacement of Palestinian families which is also compared to the flight of Jesus, Mary and Joseph on the orders of King Herod.

text: Nahibaluan nga halin sang Oktubre 7, limitado lang ang hulag sa Bethlehem amo man sa iban nga Palestinian towns sa West Bank kag may yara sang military checkpoints nga amo ang istrikto sa mga Palestinians nga nagaguwa-sulod.# (Photo: AP via NYPost)
english: Since October 7, movement has been limited in Bethlehem as well as in other Palestinian towns in the West Bank and there are military checkpoints that are strict on Palestinians moving in and out.# (Photo: AP via NYPost)

text: Ginpatigayon subong nga adlaw ang groundbreaking ceremony sang Iloilo Integrated Solid Waste Management Facility sa Brgy.
english: The groundbreaking ceremony of the Iloilo Integrated Solid Waste Management Facility was held today in Brgy.

text: Ingore, La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: Ingore, La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Ginpangunahan ang nasambit nga aktibidad ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, Mr. Jose Maria Niño Madara, President kag CEO sang Metpower Venture Partners Holdings Inc.
english: The activity was led by Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, Mr. Jose Maria Niño Madara, President and CEO of Metpower Venture Partners Holdings Inc.

text: and Iloilo Waste Recovery Venture Corp., Iloilo Provincial Governor Arthur Defensor Jr, kag DENR Secretary Maria Antonia Yulo-Loyzaga.
english: and Iloilo Waste Recovery Venture Corp., Iloilo Provincial Governor Arthur Defensor Jr., and DENR Secretary Maria Antonia Yulo-Loyzaga.

text: Ang waste to energy ang maka process sang 475 ka tonelada sang Municipal Solid Waste nga maga-separar sang organic kag non-organic waste.
english: The waste to energy will process 475 tons of Municipal Solid Waste which will separate organic and non-organic waste.

text: Ang energy nga ma-produce halin sa basura ang ibaligya sa Private Public Partnership (PPP) partners sang syudad ilabi na sa mga nagakinahanglan sang kuryente.
english: The energy produced from the waste will be sold to the city's Private Public Partnership (PPP) partners especially those who need electricity.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Jose Maria Niño Madara, President kag CEO sang Metpower Venture Partners Holdings Inc.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Jose Maria Niño Madara, President and CEO of Metpower Venture Partners Holdings Inc.

text: and Iloilo Waste Recovery Venture Corp., iya ginpahayag nga posible magalawig sang 20 ka bulan ang konstruksyon sang pasilidad, ang target matapos sa Disyembre sa masunod nga tuig.
english: and Iloilo Waste Recovery Venture Corp., he said the construction of the facility is likely to take 20 months, with the target being completed by December next year.

text: Suno sa iya, ginapasiguro nga ma-meet sang proyekto ang environmental standard sang Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR).
english: He said the project is being ensured to meet the environmental standard of the Department of Environment and Natural Resources (DENR).

text: Sa patag naman sang impact sa kinahanglanon sang syudad, indi gid siya fully maka-cover bilang highly urbanized city, kon sa diin, 100 or thousands of megawatts ang mahimo sini mahatag nga energy.
english: In terms of impact on the city's needs, it cannot fully cover as a highly urbanized city, where it can provide 100 or thousands of megawatts of energy.

text: Posible naman nga tubtob magdugay ang amo nga pasilidad, mahimo nga ma-expand kag maka-accomodate ang iban nga munisipalidad.
english: It is possible that as long as the facility lasts, it can be expanded and accommodate other municipalities.

text: Suno naman kay Atty. Dave Garcia, Committee Head, Public Private Partnership ukon PPP, iya ginpahayag nga ang landfill sa Calajunan ang wala pa sang definite nga plano, bangud isa sa primary concern sang mga environmental groups amo ang palangabuhian sang mga waste picker.
english: According to Atty. Dave Garcia, Committee Head, Public Private Partnership or PPP, he said that the landfill in Calajunan does not have a definite plan, because one of the primary concerns of environmental groups is the livelihood of waste pickers.

text: Dugang ni Garcia nga nga i-absorb pa sang pagatukuron nga pasilidad ang mga napalab-ot nga concern.
english: Garcia added that the facility will absorb the concerns.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang waste nga pagadal-on sa pasilidad ang fresh waste kag indi ang yara na nga daan sa landfill kon sa diin, wala pa sang definite plan sa amo nga sanitary landfill kag sa mga basura nga nahamtang diri.
english: It is known that the waste that will be brought to the facility is fresh waste and not the one that is already in the landfill where, there is no definite plan for the sanitary landfill and the garbage located here.

text: Ginlunsyar na ang libre nga dialysis center sa Iloilo Provincial Hospital nga ginakabig nga dako nga bulig para sa mga pasyente nga naga-antos sang sakit sa kidney.
english: The free dialysis center at the Iloilo Provincial Hospital has been launched which is considered a big help for patients suffering from kidney disease.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Dr. Alberto Cordero, chief sang Iloilo Provincial Hospital, iya ginpahayag nga bangud sa nagadamo nga kaso sang mga pasyente nga may Chronic Kidney Disease nga nagakinahanglan sang regular nga dialysis, dako gid nga bulig ang pag-abri sang dialysis center sa Pototan, Iloilo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Dr. Alberto Cordero, chief of the Iloilo Provincial Hospital, said that due to the increasing number of patients with Chronic Kidney Disease who need regular dialysis, the opening of the dialysis center in Pototan, Iloilo is a big help.

text: Nagpasalamat man si Cordero sa Iloilo Provincial Government bangud natigayon ang pagtukod sang dialysis clinic nga makabulig sa madamo nga pasyente sa nasambit nga banwa amo man sa mga kaiping sini nga kabanwahanan.
english: Cordero also thanked the Iloilo Provincial Government for the establishment of a dialysis clinic that will help many patients in the town as well as in neighboring towns.

text: Suno pa sa iya, may ginpatuman nga scheduling system para sa mga pasyente agud maorganisa ang pagserbisyo sang dialysis center.
english: He said a scheduling system has been implemented for patients to organize the services of the dialysis center.

text: Katuyuan man sang programa nga mapanubo ang gasto sang mga pasyente nga nagakinahanglan sang dialysis bangud libre ini nga serbisyo nga ginahatag sang gobyerno.
english: The program also aims to reduce the cost of patients in need of dialysis as it is a free service provided by the government.

text: Sa tunga sang nagapadayon nga pandemya, masami nga nagakabalaka ang kadam-an kun paano mapabilin ang mataas ang immunity agud ma-angkon ang masanyog nga ikaayong-lawas.
english: In the midst of the ongoing pandemic, many are often concerned about how to maintain high immunity in order to achieve good health.

text: Apang wala sang dapat kahangaw-an suno sa mga eksperto bangud nagabulig sa pagpalikaw sa nanuhay-tuhay nga balatian ang simple nga pagkaon sang citrus fruits kaangay sang Pomelo nga puno sang powerful immune-boosting antioxidant.
english: But there is nothing to worry about, according to experts, because a simple diet of citrus fruits such as pomelo, which is rich in powerful immune-boosting antioxidants, helps prevent various diseases.

text: Suno kay SaVanna Shoemaker, registered dietician kag nutritionist sa Estados Unidos, ang prutas nga Pomelo ukon kabugaw ang manggaranon man sa vitamin C, potassium, protein kag fiber nga nagapalikaw sa cellular damage halin sa harmful compounds nga ginatawag nga free radicals.
english: According to SaVanna Shoemaker, registered dietician and nutritionist in the United States, grapefruit is also rich in vitamin C, potassium, protein and fiber that prevent cellular damage from harmful compounds called free radicals.

text: Ang kabugaw ang puno man sang lycopene — isa ka anti-inflammatory anti-aging antioxidant nga nagapanami sang supat.
english: Pumpkin is also rich in lycopene — an anti-inflammatory anti-aging antioxidant that improves sweetness.

text: Ang duga naman sang panit kag dahon sang Pomelo ang natukiban nga makapatay sang cancer cells kag nagapalikaw sa paglapta sini sandig sa test-tube studies.
english: The juice of the peel and leaves of the grapefruit has been found to kill cancer cells and prevent the spread of cancer cells based on test-tube studies.

text: BY THE WAY, wala naton ginpaabot nga mabatian ining isa ka komersyal sa TV.
english: BY THE WAY, we didn’t expect to hear this one TV commercial.

text: Ang aton Olympic gold medalist nga si Hidilyn Diaz sponsor gali sang isa ka makahulubog nga ilimnon!
english: Our Olympic gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz is actually the sponsor of an alcoholic drink!

text: Pensar naton makapalain sa isa ka atleta ang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: We think that alcohol can make an athlete feel bad.

text: Aba, kag daw ga-toast pa siya sining ilimnon sa ina nga komersyal!
english: Oh, and it looks like he's even toasting this drink in that commercial!

text: Ma-imagine na gani naton nga hubog si Hidilyn sa isa ka pagtililipon upod ang iya mga kabarkada nga tomador.
english: We can even imagine Hidilyn drunk at a gathering with her tomador friends.

text: Kag basi hugsoy gid sa kahulugbon kag front page pa sa pamantalaan nasyonal pagka-aga.
english: And maybe it's really drunk and front page in the national newspaper the next morning.

text: Huwag naman!
english: Don't!

text: Dapat role model ka sang mga tsampyon nga mga atleta sang pungsod.
english: You should be a role model for the nation's champion athletes.

text: Buyukon mo na gid lang bala sila sa maayo nga pag-praktis kag buligan sila sang bagay mo nga mabulig agud basi maka-gold man sila sa Olympics.
english: Would you just encourage them to practice well and help them with what you can to help them so that they can win gold in the Olympics.

text: Indi ka magsiling nga ga-sponsor ka lang sining ilimnon pero wala ka imo gainom sini.
english: Don't say you're sponsoring this drink but you don't drink it.

text: Indi sina magpati ang mas madamo.
english: More people wouldn't believe that.

text: Pensaron gid nila nga ga-enjoy ka man sa pag-inom sini.
english: They'll think you're enjoying drinking it too.

text: Kag ngaa mag-sponsor ka sini kon wala ka gid man gainom sing makahulubog nga ilimnon?
english: And why sponsor it if you don’t actually drink alcohol?

text: Indi bala?
english: Isn't it?

text:
***

Wala nag-ulhot si presidential aspirant BongBong Marcos (BBM) sa interbyu ni Jessica Soho sadtong Sabado sang gab-i sa GMA TV.
english:
***

Presidential aspirant BongBong Marcos (BBM) did not appear in an interview with Jessica Soho on Saturday night on GMA TV.

text: Kuno “biased”, ukon indi “fair”, si Jessica kon mag-interbyu sa Marcos family gani wala siya nag-ulhot sa sinang interbyu.
english: Jessica is said to be “biased”, or not “fair”, when she interviews the Marcos family so she did not appear in that interview.

text: Ang matuod nahadlok siya sa landong sang mapintas nga pagginahum martial law sang amay nga diktador sa sobra 10 ka tuig sa pungsod.
english: In fact, he was afraid of the shadow of the brutal martial law rule of his father, a dictator, for more than 10 years in the country.

text: Lakip na dira sang iya mismo mga kasal-anan sa mga pumuluyo katulad sang indi pagbayad sang buhis sadtong 1982-1985 kag binutig sa kon ano ang iya naangkon nga dungog kag hinimuan.
english: This includes his own sins against the people such as not paying taxes in 1982-1985 and lying about what he has gained honor and achievements.

text: Mas gusto gali niya ang interbyu sang iya ihada kon diin pagusto siya dayaw sa iya diktador nga amay kag sang ila bug-os nga pamilya.
english: He prefers his daughter-in-law's interview where he likes to praise his dictatorial father and their entire family.

text: Ina ya ang indi “fair” sa publiko nga luyag gid mahibal-an ang atubang, likod, kag wala kag tuo niya para lubos mahibal-an kon sin-o kag ano siya sa iya pagdalagan sa pagka-Presidente.
english: That is not fair to the public who want to know the front, back, and left and right of him to fully know who and what he is in his run for President.

text: Ang nahibal-an sang publiko nga multi-awarded ini si Jessica kag nahingadlan pa nga “Most Trusted Media Personality”, indi lang sang mga respetado nga mga grupo diri sa pungsod kundi lakip na sa luas.
english: The public knows that Jessica is multi-awarded and named “Most Trusted Media Personality”, not only by respected groups here in the country but also abroad.

text: Kilala man si Jessica sa mga “no-holds barred” nga pagpamangkot.
english: Jessica is also known for “no-holds barred” questioning.

text: Labi na gid kon ang ginapamangkutan may mga pwesto nga sensitibo nga kinahanglan ang lubos nga pagkilala sa ila sang publiko, katulad sinang interbyu sadtong Sabado sa mga presidential aspirant para sa Mayo 2022 nga eleksyon.
english: Especially when the person in question has sensitive positions that require full public recognition, such as that interview on Saturday with presidential aspirants for the May 2022 elections.

text: Ang nag-abot lang amo sanday Bise Presidente Leni Robredo, Senador Ping Lacson, Senador Manny Pacquiao kag si Manila Mayor Isko Moreno.
english: The only ones who arrived were Vice President Leni Robredo, Senator Ping Lacson, Senator Manny Pacquiao and Manila Mayor Isko Moreno.

text:
***

Sa paglikaw ni BBM sa sinang interbyu, nagagwa nga may mga bagay nga indi siya luyag mahibal-an sang publiko, samtang importante nga lubos makilala siya nila kon ano gid ang iya pagkatawo kag masarangan kon makapungko na bilang presidente.
english:
***

With BBM avoiding that interview, it turns out that there are things that he does not want the public to know, while it is important that they fully know him for what he really is and can do when he sits as president.

text: Indi lang basta magsalig ang publiko sa ginapangako sang kandidato.
english: The public does not simply trust the candidate's promises.

text: Dapat matuman niya ini sa klase sang iya karakter kag sang iya nahimuan na kag mahimo pa.
english: He must accomplish it in the class of his character and what he has done and can do.

text: Gani, dapat tani nga kalakip si BBM sa sinang interbyu ni Jessica agud mahibal-an sang publiko kon ano gid nga klase ang iya pagkatawo kag masarangan nga himuon, nga masanagan sa sinang interbyu.
english: Therefore, BBM should have been included in that interview with Jessica so that the public would know what kind of person she is and what she is capable of doing, which would be reflected in that interview.

text: Kay wala siya magtambong sa sinang interbyu, ano na lang ayhan ang pensaron sang publiko?
english: Since he did not attend that interview, what would the public think?

text: Nga may mga bagay nga indi niya mapahayag sa publiko kay makapalain ini sa iya kandidatura?
english: That there are things he can't say publicly because it will hurt his candidacy?

text: Laban-laban!
english: Fight back!

text: Pensar ko maalam siya kag kayang-kaya niya sabton ang ano man nga akusasyon batok sa iya.
english: I think he is smart and can answer any accusation against him.

text: Daw maayo man gani kuno siya nga debatedor.
english: He seems to be a good debater.

text: Pero, indi man gali!
english: But, it turns out not!

text: Katulad bala ni Senador Ping Lacson nga nangisug gid nga sabton ang mabug-at nga mga akusasyon batok sa iya sa interbyu ni Jessica.
english: Like Senator Ping Lacson who dared to answer the serious accusations against him in Jessica's interview.

text: In fact, ginpangapinan pa niya si Jessica, nga ginpatungod kay BBM, nga kon ano man ang ginapamangkot ni Jessica kabahin lang ina sang iya trabaho kag indi tungod “bias” siya.
english: In fact, she even defended Jessica, attributed to BBM, saying that whatever Jessica was asking was part of her job and not because she was “biased”.

text: Ti ano karon kay naglikaw ka sa sinang interbyu, Mr. BongBong Marcos?
english: So what now that you avoided that interview, Mr. BongBong Marcos?

text: Luyag ka mag-Presidente pero nahadlok ka man mahibal-an gid kon ano ka.
english: You want to be President but you're also afraid to really know what you are.

text: Indi ayhan magduha-duha na ang mga pumuluyo sa credibilidad kag ikasarang mo agud mag-Presidente?/PN
english: Wouldn't the people doubt your credibility and ability to be President?/PN

text: Natukiban nga nagabusong sang iya subang nga bata ang 32-anyos nga Pinay caregiver nga si Mary Anne Velasquez de Vera nga napatay matapos ang missile attack sang Iran sa Israel.
english: Mary Anne Velasquez de Vera, a 32-year-old Filipina caregiver who died after an Iranian missile attack on Israel, was found to be pregnant with her youngest child.

text: Suno ini sa iya previous employers nga sanday Barbara Wachspress kag Janice Prawer nga amo ang una sini nga gin-obrahan sang nag-abot siya sa Tel Aviv.
english: This is according to his previous employers Barbara Wachspress and Janice Prawer who were his first employers when he arrived in Tel Aviv.

text:
Espesyal para sa duha si Mary Anne nga gintawag nila nga “angel on Earth.”

Nag-abot si Mary Anne sa Israel sang 2019 kag ang una sini nga nangin alaga amo ang iloy nanday Wachspress kag Pawer nga si Doris Gurin nga isa ka former nurse.
english:
Mary Anne, whom they called an “angel on Earth,” was special to the two.

Mary Anne arrived in Israel in 2019 and its first pet was Wachspress and Pawer’s mother Doris Gurin who is a former nurse.

text: Suno kanday Wachspress kag Prawer, nag-alang-alang pa anay ang ila iloy nga magkuha sang live-in carer kag ang kaupod lamang sini amo ang iya ido nga Shih Tzu nga si Wally.
english: According to Wachspress and Prawer, their mother was reluctant to hire a live-in carer and was accompanied only by her Shih Tzu dog, Wally.

text:
Sang ulihi, sang nagdesisyon na ini nga kinahanglan gid man sini sang caregiver, naglantaw sila sa potensyal nga makuha nila, kag palareho man sila nga nagpili kay De Vera bangud nagpanugid ini nga isa siya ka “puppy-lover.”

“Our mom was the first person that Mary Anne cared for in Israel,” suno kay Wachspress.
english:
Later, when she decided she really needed a caregiver, they looked at the potential they could get, and they both chose De Vera because she told them she was a “puppy-lover.”

“Our mom was the first person that Mary Anne cared for in Israel,” according to Wachspress.

text: “She had the most wonderful smile.
english: “She had the most wonderful smile.

text:
We brought her to our mom’s apartment, and they both started hugging, and it was love at first sight.”

“She doted on our mom like a loving granddaughter and called her Mother Earth,” suno naman kay Prawer.
english:
We brought her to our mom’s apartment, and they both started hugging, and it was love at first sight.”

“She doted on our mom like a loving granddaughter and called her Mother Earth,” Prawer said.

text: “She also loved Wally.
english: “She also loved Wally.

text:
When he got sick, she would wake up in the middle of the night to make sure he took his pills.”

Dugang ni Prawer, “She was part of our family, a ray of sunshine — so special, caring, and devoted.”

Na-ospital anay si Gurin kag na-infect sang coronavirus.
english:
When he got sick, she would wake up in the middle of the night to make sure he took his pills.”

Prawer added, “She was part of our family, a ray of sunshine — so special, caring, and devoted.”

Gurin was previously hospitalized and infected with the coronavirus.

text: “The agency recommended that Mary Anne leave, but she insisted on staying to care for Mom,” suno kay Wachspress.
english: “The agency recommended that Mary Anne leave, but she insisted on staying to care for Mom,” according to Wachspress.

text: Sang ulihi, nagtaliwan gid si Gurin bangud sa COVID-related complications, apang nagpabilin nga suod si de Vera sa pamilya sini.
english: Eventually, Gurin did pass away due to COVID-related complications, but de Vera remained close to his family.

text: Suno sa mag-utod, nabatian nila ang balita nga napatay si Mary Anne paagi man sa isa ka Filipino national nga suod man sa ila.
english: According to the brothers, they heard the news of Mary Anne's death through a Filipino national who was also close to them.

text: “It took me a long time to believe this had actually happened,” suno kay Wachspress.
english: “It took me a long time to believe this had actually happened,” according to Wachspress.

text: “I couldn’t absorb it,” pahayag naman ni Prawer.
english: “I couldn’t absorb it,” Prawer said.

text: “We were up crying all night.
english: “We were up crying all night.

text:
It’s devastating.”

Pahayag nila, nalugpayan sila kun ila panumdumon ang ginhambal anay ni De Vera sa lubong ni Gurin sadtong 2021: “She said, ‘Until we meet again, and I’ll continue to take care of you in the afterlife.'”

Nahibaluan nga tumandok sang Basista, Pangasinan si De Vera.
english:
It’s devastating.”

They said they are comforted when they remember what De Vera said at Gurin's funeral in 2021: “She said, 'Until we meet again, and I'll continue to take care of you in the afterlife.'”

De Vera is a native of Basista, Pangasinan.

text: Siya ang una nga Filipino casualty sa Israel sang nag-ibwal ang tension batok sa Iran sang weekend.
english: He was the first Filipino casualty in Israel when tensions against Iran flared over the weekend.

text: Nakumpirma ang iya identity paagi sa biometric records sa Abu Kabir Forensic Institute.
english: His identity was confirmed through biometric records at the Abu Kabir Forensic Institute.

text: Naga-trabaho man ang bana ni de Vera sa Israel, kag ini mismo ang positibo nga nag-identify sa bangkay sang iya asawa.
english: De Vera's husband also works in Israel, and he himself positively identified his wife's body.

text: Ginapahayag nga ginabuligan sini ang iya alaga nga makasaylo sa bomb shelter, apang antes pa man sila makapanago, naigo na ini sang shrapnel sang nagtupa nga bomba sa ila apartment sa Tel Aviv.
english: She was reportedly helping her dog move into the bomb shelter, but before they could take cover, she was hit by shrapnel from a bomb that landed in their Tel Aviv apartment.

english: United States President Donald Trump ordered attacks on military sites inside Venezuela.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang US officials ang strikes nga ginhimo.
english: US officials also confirmed the strikes carried out.

text: Nabatian man ang serye sang pagsinigabong sa kapital sang Venezuela nga Caracas.
english: A series of explosions were also heard in the Venezuelan capital Caracas.

english: No information has come in on whether anyone was injured or killed.

english: In an official statement from the Venezuelan government, it condemned and opposed the military aggression of the US military.

english: It can be recalled that before this, there was a U.S. military buildup in the region where among those sent to the Caribbean were the USS Gerald R. Ford aircraft carrier and other warships.

english: Tensions between the two countries are high over the issue of drug trafficking.

english: The Trump administration has accused Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro of smuggling drugs, and working with gangs that are terrorist organizations but Maduro has denied it.

text: Ginbotohan sang parliament sang Iran nga saraduhon ang Strait of Hormuz, kun sa diin nagaagi ang 20 percent sang langis sang bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: Iran's parliament voted to close the Strait of Hormuz, through which 20 percent of the world's oil passes.

text: Kun mapatuman ang nasambit nga desisyon, ginalauman sang mga analyst nga magasaka ang presyo sang gatong sang 30-50 percent ukon masobra pa nga mahimo nga magtuga sang tuman nga global inflation depende sa kadugayon sang pagsarado.
english: If the decision is implemented, analysts expect fuel prices to rise by 30-50 percent or more, which could lead to extreme global inflation depending on the duration of the shutdown.

english: Military tensions are also threatened, especially as the US Navy and its allies are on alert to respond.

english: Delays in the sailing of oil tankers will affect not only oil and LNG shipments, but also vital products around the world — further straining economies.

text: Sa Pilipinas, nga nagadepende sa gina-export nga langis, mabatyagan gilayon ang epekto sa pagsaka sang presyo sang gasolina, kasunod sang pagmahal sang mga nagapanguna nga balaklon.
english: In the Philippines, which depends on oil exports, the impact of rising gasoline prices will be felt immediately, following the rise in prices of basic commodities.

english: Houthi rebels based in Yemen have warned that they will attack all ships bound for Israel — regardless of the nationality of those on board.

text: Suno sa mga opisyal sang amo nga grupo nga suportado sang Iran, paagi nila ini agud ipakita ang ila nga suporta sa mga Palestinians.
english: According to officials of the Iran-backed group, it is their way to show their support for the Palestinians.

text: Pahayag pa sang Houthi military spokesperson, ginadumilian sa Red Sea kag sa Arabian Sea ang tanan nga barko nga nagapakadto sa mga pantalan sa Israel.
english: The Houthi military spokesperson said all ships bound for Israeli ports are banned in the Red Sea and the Arabian Sea.

text: “If Gaza does not receive the food and medicine it needs, all ships in the Red Sea bound for Israeli ports, regardless of their nationality, will become a target for our armed forces,” pahayag sang spokesperson.
english: “If Gaza does not receive the food and medicine it needs, all ships in the Red Sea bound for Israeli ports, regardless of their nationality, will become a target for our armed forces,” the spokesperson said.

text: Ipatuman gilayon ini nga paandam suno pa sa statement.
english: This warning will be implemented immediately, the statement said.

text: Ang Houthis nga nagapugad sa kadam-an nga bahin sa Yemen kag sa Red Sea coast amo man ang nagbangga kag nag-hijack sa isa ka barko nga naangot sa Israeli company sang nagligad nga bulan.
english: The Houthis based largely in Yemen and the Red Sea coast also rammed and hijacked a ship linked to the Israeli company last month.

text: Ang amo nga commercial ship nga ginatawag “Galaxy Leader” ang may yara sang 17 ka Filipino crew nga tubtub subong bihag gihapon sang mga rebelde sa Yemen.
english: The commercial ship, called the Galaxy Leader, had 17 Filipino crew members who are still held captive by rebels in Yemen.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag ang Israel nga ang pagpang-atake sa mga barko ang makabig nga “Iranian act of terrorism” nga may daku nga kunsekwensya sa international maritime security.
english: Israel had earlier said the attack on the ships was considered an "Iranian act of terrorism" with serious consequences for international maritime security.

text: Nag-file ang PDP-Laban sang petisyon sa Supreme Court nga nagapangabay para sa manual recount sang senatorial votes sa 2025 elections.
english: The PDP-Laban has filed a petition in the Supreme Court seeking a manual recount of senatorial votes in the 2025 elections.

english: The petition was filed by the party represented by National Vice Chairman Alfonso Cusi.

text:

The petition reads: “Whether such manual counting or recount be partial, targeted, or nationwide, petitioners humbly leave the same to the sound discretion of his Honorable Court, with due regard to the extent of necessity, efficiency, and economy or cost-effectiveness in implementing the pertinent election laws.”

The party said it called for a recount based on Republic Act No.

english: Buhangin, Davao City, highlighting a “potential conflict of interest.”

english: Mamamayang Liberal (ML) Party-list Representative-elect Leila De Lima criticized the three senator-judges in the impeachment trial because they are clearly defending Vice President Sara Duterte.

text: Gintumod ni De Lima sanday Senador Imee Marcos, Robin Padilla, kag Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa.
english: De Lima referred to Senators Imee Marcos, Robin Padilla, and Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa.

english: De Lima said Marcos and Padilla accompanied Duterte on his trip to Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia even after the Senate impeachment court convened while Dela Rosa had already quashed the Articles of Impeachment before the trial.

english: Remember there were two senators who accompanied VP Sara to Kuala Lumpur.

Imagine that.”
