text: Na-intercept sang border officials ang 40 ka mga bus nga nagakarga sang ginatos ka mga kabataan halin sa Zimbabwe nga ginapatihan nga nga i-traffic kuntani sa South Africa.
english: Border officials intercepted 40 buses carrying hundreds of children from Zimbabwe believed to be trafficked to South Africa.

text: Suno sa South African Border Management Agency, 443 ka mga kabataan nga nga lunsay menor de edad ang unod sang mga bus kag nagabyahe sila nga wala sang guardian ukon ginikanan ukon iban nga hamtong nga kaupdanan.
english: According to the South African Border Management Agency, 443 children who were all minors were on board the buses and were traveling without a guardian or parent or other adult companion.

text: Wala ginpasulod sa South Africa ang mga bus, ginkontak ang Zimbabwean officials, kag ginproseso agud nga mapabalik ini sa Zimbabwe.
english: The buses were not allowed into South Africa, Zimbabwean officials were contacted, and processed so that they could be returned to Zimbabwe.

text: Todo-depensa naman ang organisasyon nga naga-tiglawas sang foreign nationals sa South Africa nga ginpadala kuntani ang mga kabataan agud nga makigkita sa ila ginikanan nga naga-trabaho sa amo nga pungsod.
english: The organization representing foreign nationals in South Africa defended the fact that the children were sent to meet their parents who work in the country.

text: Nahibaluan nga masobra isa ka milyon nga Zimbabweans ang nagapuyo sa South Africa, kag kadam-an diri ang iligal lamang bangud nagtal-as sila halin sa ila orihinal nga puluy-an sa kaiping nga pungsod sang natabo ang kinagamo kag krisis sa ekonomiya.
english: It is known that more than one million Zimbabweans live in South Africa, and most of them are illegal because they fled their original homes in the neighboring country during the unrest and economic crisis.

text: May isa pa ka bulan antes matapos ang 2023 apang gin-anunsyo na sang United Nations (U.N.) nga ini nga tuig ang pinakamainit sa bilog nga maragtas sang kalibutan.
english: There is still one month before the end of 2023 but the United Nations (U.N.) has already announced that this year will be the hottest in the entire history of the world.

text: Ginpahayag ini ni U.N. Secretary-General António Guterres sa atubang sang mga world leaders nga nagtipon sa global climate summit sa Dubai, United Arab Emirates.
english: This was announced by U.N. Secretary-General António Guterres in front of world leaders gathered at the global climate summit in Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

text: Suno kay Guterres, sandig ini sa kumpirmasyon sang UN World Meteorological Organization kun sa diin nakit-an nga nagasaka ang global temperatures sang 1.4 degrees Celsius lapaw sa pre-industrial levels.
english: According to Guterres, this is based on the confirmation of the UN World Meteorological Organization which found that global temperatures are rising by 1.4 degrees Celsius above pre-industrial levels.

text: Sa report pa sang amo nga organisasyon, ang period halin sang 2015 tubtub sa 2023 amo ang may pinakamataas nga temperatura sa human history.
english: According to the organization, the period from 2015 to 2023 will have the highest temperature in human history.

text:
© Michael Probst/AP via RFI

“We are living through climate collapse in real time – and the impact is devastating,” kabahin sang video statement ni Guterres.
english:
© Michael Probst/AP via RFI

“We are living through climate collapse in real time – and the impact is devastating,” Guterres said in a video statement.

text: “Record global heat should send shivers down the spines of world leaders.
english: “Record global heat should send shivers down the spines of world leaders.

text:
And it should trigger them to act.”

TEMPRANO NGA KADALAG-AN

Makabig man nga madinalag-on ang una nga adlaw sang duha ka semana nga climate summit bangud sang pagpasalig sang mga nasyon nga maghatag sang pondo para sa pigado nga mga pungsod agud magamit sa tunga sang nagakatabo nga climate disasters.
english:
And it should trigger them to act.”

EARLY SUCCESS

The first day of the two-week climate summit was also considered a success because of the commitment of countries to provide funds for poor countries to be used in the midst of climate disasters.

text: Madamo ang nagdayaw sa sini nga damage fund bangud dinekada man ang gindugay antes ini mapatigayon.
english: Many praised the damage fund because it took decades to be implemented.

text: Kabahin sang naghatag sang kontribusyon amo ang United Arab Emirates nga may $100 million ukon P5.5-billion; $51 million ukon P2.8-billion halin sa Britain; $17.5 million ukon P971.7-million halin sa United States; kag $10 million ukon P555.3-million halin sa Japan.
english: Among the contributors were the United Arab Emirates with $100 million or P5.5-billion; $51 million or P2.8-billion from Britain; $17.5 million or P971.7-million from the United States; and $10 million or P555.3-million from Japan.

text: Sang ulihi, nagpasalig man ang European Union sang $245.39 million ukon P13.6-billion lakip na ang $100 million ukon P5.5-billion halin sa Germany.
english: Later, the European Union also pledged $245.39 million or P13.6-billion including $100 million or P5.5-billion from Germany.

text: “This sends a positive signal of momentum to the world and to our work here in Dubai,” suno kay Cop28 president Sultan Al Jaber nga nagtawag pa sang desisyon sang world leaders bilang “historic”.
english: “This sends a positive signal of momentum to the world and to our work here in Dubai,” said Cop28 president Sultan Al Jaber, who called the decision of the world leaders “historic”.

text: Gin-athag ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga wala ini sang kalain sang buot kay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte clarified that she has no grudge against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga nakita lamang niya nga may problema ang presidente sa iya nga pagatrabaho.
english: He said he only saw that the president had a problem with his job.

text: Pila sa mga gintumod sini amo ang paglapas sa layi kun sa diin gintugyan ni Marcos sa iban nga pungsod ang kaso ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Among the allegations were the violation of the law where Marcos handed over the case of former President Rodrigo Duterte to another country.

text: Dugang niya, wala man lang gintuman ni Marcos ang mga nangin promisa niya sang tion sang kampanya.
english: He added that Marcos did not even keep the promises he made during the campaign.

text: ‘No comment’ ang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) – Dumangas kaangot sa nangin pahayag sang duha ka mga subject nga nadakpan sa buy-bust operation sa Barangay Balantang, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: The Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) – Dumangas has no comment on the statement of two subjects arrested in a buy-bust operation in Barangay Balantang, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Ang mga naaresto amo sanday Hazel Losare, 36-anyos, single kag residente sang 7th St., Lawaan Village, Brgy.
english: The arrested were identified as Hazel Losare, 36, single and resident of 7th St., Lawaan Village, Brgy.

text: Balantang, Jaro, Iloilo City kag Jose Ariel Brito, 41-anyos, kasado, minibus driver, kag residente sang Brgy.
english: Balantang, Jaro, Iloilo City and Jose Ariel Brito, 41, married, minibus driver, and resident of Brgy.

text: Palaypay, Anilao, Iloilo.
english: Palaypay, Anilao, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, head sang Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (ICDEU), iya ginpahayag nga padayon nga gina-verify ang nangin statement sang duha ka mga subject matapos ini sila nadakpan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, head of the Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit (ICDEU), said they are continuing to verify the statements of the two subjects after they were arrested.

text: Suno kay Inot, on going ang coordination sang Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit sa nasambit nga talatapan kag nagahulat na lang sila sang reply sa kon ano ka matuod nga katapo nila ang supplier sang iligal nga druga.
english: According to Inot, the coordination of the Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit with the said office is on going and they are just waiting for a reply on whether the supplier of illegal drugs is really a member of them.

text: Gintuad man sang natungdan nga mahimo may relasyon ang duha ka subject apisar nga kasado na si Brito.
english: He also admitted that the two subjects may have had a relationship despite the fact that Brito is married.

text: Una na nga natukiban nga lunsay naga-operate ang duha sa syudad kag probinsya sang Iloilo.
english: Earlier, it was discovered that the two were both operating in Iloilo City and Iloilo province.

text: Nahibaluan nga natigayon nga nakuha sa posisyon sang mga subject ang 350 grams sang suspected shabu nga may standard drug price nga P2,380,000.
english: It was learned that 350 grams of suspected shabu with a standard drug price of P2,380,000 were recovered from the suspects.

text: Gin-ako sang Hamas militants nga sila ang responsable sa likod sang pagpang-atake sa estasyon sang bus sa Jerusalem nga ginkamatay sang tatlo ka mga Israelis kag pito ang nasamaran.
english: Hamas militants claimed responsibility behind an attack on a bus station in Jerusalem that killed three Israelis and wounded seven.

text: Suno sa militante nga grupo, ang duha nga nag-atake ang miyembro sang ila military wing nga Al-Qassam Brigades.
english: The militant group said the two attackers were members of its military wing, the Al-Qassam Brigades.

text: Sang ulihi, sila ang ginpatay man sang duha ka soldado kag isa ka sibilyan.
english: Later, they were also killed by two soldiers and a civilian.

text:
Photo courtesy: Ronen Zvulun/Reuters via CNN

Ini nga shooting sa Jerusalem ang natabo apisar sang ceasefire sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas nga ginkasugtan nga palawigon pa gid sang isa ka adlaw.
english:
Photo courtesy: Ronen Zvulun/Reuters via CNN

The shooting in Jerusalem came despite a ceasefire between Israel and Hamas that was agreed to be extended for another day.

text: Gin-selebrar man sang Hamas ang amo nga pagpang-atake kag ginsiling nga ila ini nga direkta nga balos sa mga krimen nga ginahimo sa Gaza Strip kag ang mga kalakasan batok sa mga preso nga Palestinian.
english: Hamas also celebrated the attack and said it was their direct retaliation for the crimes committed in the Gaza Strip and the atrocities against Palestinian prisoners.

text: Kasunod sini, nagpaandam naman si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga tuod-tuuron ang iya promisa nga papason ang amo nga Palestinian militant group.
english: Subsequently, Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu warned that his promise to eliminate the Palestinian militant group will be kept.

text: Ginpahayag ni Vice President Sara Duterte nga indi pa handa ang Pilipinas sa gyera ukon sa anuman nga “global shock” bangud wala sang direksyon ang Marcos Administration.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte said the Philippines is not ready for war or any “global shock” because the Marcos Administration has no direction.

text: Ini ang ginpabutyag ni Duterte sa iya speech sa “Free Duterte Now” rally sa Melbourne, Australia kun sa diin, nag-apelar sia sa iya tagasuporta nga buligan ang iya tikang nga pagwaon sa prisohan sa The Hague ang iya amay nga si anay president Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Duterte said this in his speech at the “Free Duterte Now” rally in Melbourne, Australia where he appealed to his supporters to support his move to release his father, former president Rodrigo Duterte, from jail in The Hague.

text: Nagpabutyag man si Duterte sang iya disapproval sa pag-deploy sang Estados Unidos sang Typhon missile system sa Pilipinas.
english: Duterte also expressed his disapproval of the US deployment of the Typhon missile system in the Philippines.

text: Ginpanindugan niya nga indi dapat mag-intra ang Pilipinas kay sin-o man kag nagakadapat nga ibalanse ang foreign relations sa nagkalain-lain nga mga pungsod.
english: He insisted that the Philippines should not get involved with anyone and should balance foreign relations with different countries.

text: Nag-desisyon ang isa ka Ilongga sa Jerusalem nga indi anay magpauli sa Pilipinas apisar sang nagasingki nga away sa tunga sang Iran kag Israel nga gin-intrahan pa sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: An Ilongga in Jerusalem has decided not to return to the Philippines despite the escalating conflict between Iran and Israel in which the United States of America is involved.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Hanna Marie Kimberly Cabiles, tumandok sang Barangay Zona Sur, Banate, Iloilo, iya ginpahayag nga Hunyo 19 pa sang katapusan nga may nag-inulan nga missiles malapit sa ila nga area.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Hanna Marie Kimberly Cabiles, a native of Barangay Zona Sur, Banate, Iloilo, said it was June 19 when missiles fell near their area.

text: Tatlo ka tuig na si Cabiles sa Jerusalem kag nagatrabaho siya bilang caregiver sang isa ka Moroccan-Israeli nga naga-edad na sang 90-anyos.
english: Cabiles has been in Jerusalem for three years and works as a caregiver for a Moroccan-Israeli who is in his 90s.

text: Suno kay Cabiles, apisar may voluntary repatriation nga ginatanyag matapos ginpasaka sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) ang crisis alert level sa Iran kag Israel sa Level 3, indi anay siya magbiya sa trabaho kag desidido ini nga tapuson ang iya nga lima ka tuig nga kontrata.
english: Cabiles said that although voluntary repatriation is being offered after the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) raised the crisis alert level in Iran and Israel to Level 3, he will not leave his job and is determined to finish his five-year contract.

text: Pahayag pa sini, handum niya nga makapatindog sang balay.
english: He said he dreams of building a house.

text: Magluwas diri, ginapa-eskwela pa sini ang iya nga manghod.
english: Besides, he is also sending his younger brother to school.

text: Dugang ni Cabiles, isa siya ka solo parent kag kinahanglan niya mag-trabaho para sa iya pito ka tuig nga bata nga subong yara na sa Grade 2.
english: Cabiles said she is a solo parent and has to work for her seven-year-old son who is now in Grade 2.

text: “Indi pa ko magsugot nga mag-repatriate.
english: “I don’t agree to repatriate yet.

text: I need this job.
english: I need this job.

text: Kag I feel safe man sa Jerusalem.
english: And I feel safe in Jerusalem.

text: Holiest place ini, kag ginpangamuyo ko gid sa Ginuo nga ibutang ako sa safe place, so I am thankful gid nga ari ako diri,” suno kay Cabiles.
english: This is the holiest place, and I prayed to the Lord to put me in a safe place, so I am very grateful to be here,” Cabiles said.

text:
Dugang sini, “kinahanglan magtrabaho para sa  future sang akon bata.”

Sa kada may nagapadulong nga missiles, nagaalerto man ang Ilongga nga madala ang iya alaga pasulod sa mamad ukon sa bomb shelter.
english:
She added, “need to work for my child’s future.”

Every time there are missiles coming, the Ilongga is also alert to take his dog into the mamad or bomb shelter.

text: Ang problema suno sa iya, masami nga kaagahon nagaabot ang missiles gani nga kinahanglan pa pukawon ang iya alaga.
english: The problem, he said, is that the missiles often arrive in the morning so he has to wake up his dog.

text: As of press time, sa 30,000 ka mga Pilipino sa Israel, masobra na sa 220 ang nag-request sang repatriation.
english: As of press time, of the 30,000 Filipinos in Israel, more than 220 have requested repatriation.

text: Walo naman sa mga Pinoy ang nasamaran sa Iranian missile strikes kun sa diin isa ang nagapabilin sa kritikal nga kondisyon.#
english: Eight Filipinos were injured in Iranian missile strikes, one of whom remains in critical condition.

text: Nakita na ang lalaki nga ginaalegar naglumpat sa Iloilo River kaina sang kaagahon matapos ginpulihan kag ginapahayag nga nabun-an sang mga lalaki sa Iloilo City Proper bangud sa isyu nga nag-ugat sa transaksyon sa commercial sex workers.
english: The man who allegedly jumped into the Iloilo River this morning after being replaced and allegedly beaten by men in Iloilo City Proper over an issue that stemmed from a transaction with commercial sex workers was found.

text: Ini amo si alias Archie, 38, nga isa ka manugbaligya sang ice cream.
english: This is alias Archie, 38, who is an ice cream vendor.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay alias Darwin, manghod ni alias Archie, dako ang pilas sa ulo sang iya manghud.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, alias Darwin, brother of alias Archie, said his brother sustained serious head injuries.

text: Suno kay Darwin, nakapauli na sa iya balay si alias Archie kag naga-inom-inom.
english: According to Darwin, alias Archie had returned to his house and was drinking.

text: Antes na-missing si Archie, naglabay sila sa downtown area kag sa alegasyon ni Darwin, naga-istorya sila sa commercial sex workers sang may nagpalapit nga mga lalaki kag ginpulihan sila ukon ginsapote.
english: Before Archie went missing, they were passing through the downtown area and according to Darwin's allegation, they were talking to commercial sex workers when some men approached them and raped them.

text: Ginaalegar nga nagbaisay pa sila sa presyo kag may natabo pa nga ayu-anay apang wala nag-intindihanay.
english: They allegedly argued about the price and had a fight but did not understand each other.

text: Wala nakilala ni Darwin kun sin-o ang mga lalaki pero nagapati ini nga mga bana ini ukon nobyo sang mga commercial sex worker.
english: Darwin did not identify the men but believes they are husbands or boyfriends of commercial sex workers.

text: Sang ulihi, nabun-an si Archie sa ulo kag ginsakay ini sa tricycle.
english: Later, Archie was shot in the head and put on a tricycle.

text: Ginaalegar nga sang malapit na sa taytay, nagdalagan ini sa suba kag naglumpat.
english: It is alleged that when near the bridge, he ran into the river and jumped.

text: Nadakpan sang United States Navy ang armado nga kalalakinhan nga nagtuyo nga ma-hijack ang isa na naman ka barko sa kadagatan nga sakop sang Middle East.
english: The United States Navy has arrested armed men who attempted to hijack another ship in Middle Eastern waters.

text: Ini nga Liberian-flagged chemical tanker ang una na nga ginhingadlan nga Central Park, may karga nga phosphoric acid halin sa port sang Safi sa Morocco, kag gina-manage sang Zodiac Maritime nga isa ka international ship management company nga naka-base sa London kag kabahin sang Zodiac Group sang Israeli billionaire nga si Eyal Ofer.
english: This Liberian-flagged chemical tanker previously named Central Park, was loaded with phosphoric acid from the port of Safi in Morocco, and was managed by Zodiac Maritime an international ship management company based in London and part of the Zodiac Group of Israeli billionaire Eyal Ofer.

text:
Zodiac Maritime via New York Times

Lakip sa crew sang amo nga tanker amo ang Russian, Vietnamese, Bulgarian, Indian, kag Georgian nationals kag may yara man sang duha ka Filipino seafarers samtang Turkish naman ang kapitan.
english:
Zodiac Maritime via New York Times

The crew of the tanker included Russian, Vietnamese, Bulgarian, Indian, and Georgian nationals and two Filipino seafarers while the captain was Turkish.

text: Suno sa US Central Command, sang yara na ang barko sa Gulf of Aden, nagpangayo sang bulig ang crew bangud may naga-atake sa ila.
english: According to the US Central Command, once the ship was in the Gulf of Aden, the crew called for help because they were being attacked.

text: Nag-responde gilayon ang guided-missile destroyer nga USS Mason kag iban pa nga barko nga nagabug-os sang counter-piracy task force sa amo nga Gulf kag sa kadagatan sang Somalia.
english: The guided-missile destroyer USS Mason and other ships that make up the counter-piracy task force in the Gulf and Somali waters immediately responded.

text: Nagpanaog ang lima ka armado nga mga indibidwal kag nagtuyo nga magpalagyo gamit ang ila gamay nga sakayan apang ginlagas sang warship kag sang ulihi, nagsungka sila apang wala ginhingadlan sang US Navy kun sanday sin-o ang attackers.
english: The five armed individuals disembarked and tried to escape using their small boat but were chased by the warship and later, they surrendered but the US Navy did not name the attackers.

text: Gin-report man sang US Central Command nga samtang yara pa ang ila nga warship sa Gulf of Aden, may duha ka missile nga ginpalupad halin sa Yemen nga teritoryo sang rebelde nga Houthis apang nagtupa lamang ini dies nautical miles halin sa kalayuon sang Central Park kag USS Mason.
english: The US Central Command also reported that while its warship was still in the Gulf of Aden, two missiles were launched from Yemeni territory by the Houthis rebels but landed only ten nautical miles from Central Park and USS Mason.

text: Nagpaguwa naman sang statement ang Zodiac Maritime nga wala sang napilasan sa 22 nga crew sang chemical tanker.
english: Zodiac Maritime issued a statement saying none of the 22 crew members of the chemical tanker were injured.

text: Ini nga insidente ang katapusan sa serye sa mga pagpang-atake sa mga barko sa dagat sa amo nga rehiyon halin sang nagluntad ang Israel-Hamas war.
english: This incident is the latest in a series of attacks on maritime vessels in the region since the outbreak of the Israel-Hamas war.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, may yara man sang cargo ship nga naglabay lamang sa Red Sea apang gin-hijack sang Houthi rebels kag gindala sa port sa Yemen.
english: Last week, there was also a cargo ship that just passed through the Red Sea but was hijacked by Houthi rebels and taken to port in Yemen.

text: May 17 ka Filipino seafarers sa amo nga cargo ship lakip ang isa ka Ilonggo kag wala gihapon nahilway sang mga rebelde tubtub subong.
english: There were 17 Filipino seafarers on board the cargo ship including an Ilonggo and the rebels have not yet released them.

text: Mahimo nga makasulod ang mga turista nga taga-Taiwan sa Pilipinas nga wala sang visa sa sulod sang 14 ka adlaw umpisa Hulyo 1 suno sa Manila Economic and Cultural Office (MECO).
english: Taiwanese tourists can enter the Philippines without a visa for 14 days starting July 1, according to the Manila Economic and Cultural Office (MECO).

text: Sa isa ka advisory nga napetsahan Hunyo 19, ang MECO nagsiling nga ang mga pagsulundan para sa mga nagahupot sang pasaporte sa Taiwan ginbag-o suno sa nagapadayon nga pagrepaso sang mga kinahanglanon sa pagpatigayon sang pagsulod.
english: In an advisory dated June 19, MECO said the rules for passport holders in Taiwan have been revised in line with the ongoing review of entry facilitation requirements.

text: Ang reciprocation kasunod sang pag-anunsyo sang Taiwan sang one-year-extension sang ila visa-free entry scheme para sa mga turista nga Pilipino.
english: The reciprocation follows Taiwan’s announcement of a one-year-extension of its visa-free entry scheme for Filipino tourists.

text: Ang mga turista nga Taiwanese kinahanglan lamang magpresentar sang ila pasaporte nga balido sa indi magkubos sa anom ka bulan halin sa ginplano nga panahon sang pagtener, kumpirmado nga akomodasyon/pag-book sa hotel, pamatuod sang pinansyal nga kapasidad, kag isa ka tiket pabalik ukon onward pakadto sa masunod nga pungsod nga kaladtuan.
english: Taiwanese tourists only need to present their passport valid for at least six months from the planned period of stay, confirmed accommodation/hotel booking, proof of financial capacity, and a return or onward ticket to the next country of destination.

text:
Para sa mga Taiwan passport holders nga luyag magbisita sa Pilipinas sa sulod sang kapin sa 14 ka adlaw ukon para sa mga katuyuan magluwas sa turismo, kinahanglan gihapon ang visa, nga may masunod nga mga panguna nga kinahanglanon:

Natuman kag napirmahan nga pormas sang aplikasyon para sa visa; – Passport nga balido sa indi magnubo sa anum ka bulan halin sa ginplano nga panahon sang pagtinir sa Pilipinas (orihinal kag photocopy sang bio-data page);

Taiwan ID (photocopy sa atubang kag likod); – Pamatuod sang round-trip ticket reservation; kag- Visa application fee

Naghingyo sang reciprocity ang Taiwan matapos ginlakip sini ang mga Philippine passport holders sa ila visa-free program sa sulod sang masobra lima ka tuig.
english:
For Taiwan passport holders who wish to visit the Philippines for more than 14 days or for purposes other than tourism, a visa is still required, with the following basic requirements:

Completed and signed visa application form; – Passport valid for at least six months from the planned period of stay in the Philippines (original and photocopy of bio-data page);

Taiwan ID (photocopy on front and back); – Proof of round-trip ticket reservation; and- Visa application fee

Taiwan has asked for reciprocity after it included Philippine passport holders in its visa-free program for more than five years.

text: Sang 2018, ang Taipei Economic and Cultural Office nagsiling nga ang pagpakilala sang kaanggid nga iskema sa Taiwan indi lamang makapauswag sang turismo kundi pati man sang mga pamuhunan sa sulod.
english: In 2018, the Taipei Economic and Cultural Office said that introducing a similar scheme in Taiwan would not only boost tourism but also inward investments.

text: Base sa datos gikan sa Department of Tourism, ang Taiwan amo ang seventh top source market sang Pilipinas para sa pag-abot sang mga bisita, nga may 213,833 ka mga turista nga taga-Taiwan nga narekord sang 2024.
english: Based on data from the Department of Tourism, Taiwan is the Philippines’ seventh top source market for visitor arrivals, with 213,833 Taiwanese tourists recorded in 2024.

text: LUAS sa problema sang ill-gotten wealth sang mag-asawa Ferdinand kag Imelda Marcos – in fact, pati na sang mga kabataan nga Imee, Irene kag BongBong nga mga eredero nila – madamo pa nga problema nga ginaatubang ni BongBong sa iya pagdalagan sa pagka-Presidente.
english: IN ADDITION to the problem of the ill-gotten wealth of the couple Ferdinand and Imelda Marcos – in fact, as well as the children Imee, Irene and BongBong who are their heirs – there are many other problems that BongBong faces in his run for President.

text: Sa ill-gotten wealth nga P328 ka bilyon sang mga Marcos, sunu sa retired SC senior justice Antonio Carpio, may nabilin pa nga P125B ang wala ma-kolekta sang gobyerno, nga salabton pa ni  BongBong Marcos, ukon BBM, kag sang ila pamilya sa mga pumuluyo.
english: Of the ill-gotten wealth of P328 billion of the Marcoses, according to retired SC senior justice Antonio Carpio, there is still P125 billion that the government has not collected, which is still the responsibility of BongBong Marcos, or BBM, and their families to the people.

text: Ginakahadlukan pa gani ni Carpio nga indi na gid ini mabayaran kon magdaug si BBM sa Mayo 9, 2022 nga eleksyon, kon matabo nga malimbungan nila ang mga botante parti sini tungod sang binutig nga propaganda.
english: Carpio even fears that it will not be paid at all if BBM wins the May 9, 2022 elections, in case they mislead voters about it because of false propaganda.

text: Isa pa ka problem ni BBM ang madamo nga disqualification case nga gin-file batok sa iya sa Comelec, labi na gid ang kaso sang indi pagbayad sang iya income tax sadtong 1982 tubtub 1985, nga gin-confirm mismo sang korte.
english: Another problem of BBM is the many disqualification cases filed against him in the Comelec, especially the case of non-payment of his income tax from 1982 to 1985, which was confirmed by the court itself.

text: Isa pa gid ka problema ni BBM ang kuno pag-suporta ni anay Presidente Fidel V. Ramos (1992-1998) sa iya kandidatura.
english: Another problem of BBM is the alleged support of former President Fidel V. Ramos (1992-1998) for his candidacy.

text: Sa nahibal-an na sang madamo, kandidato si Sara Dutere-Carpio sa pagka-Bise Presidente sang Lakas CMD, nga gintukod (founded) ni FVR.
english: As many know, Sara Dutere-Carpio is a candidate for the post of Vice President of Lakas CMD, which was founded by FVR.

text: Understandable nga suportado ni FVR si Sara bilang kandidato sang ila partido nga Lakas CMD sa iya pagdalagan sa pagka-Bise Presidente.
english: Understandably, FVR supported Sara as their party's Lakas CMD candidate in her run for Vice President.

text: Si BBM kandidato sa pagka-Presidente sang Partido Federal ng Pilipinas (PFP).
english: BBM is a candidate for the presidency of the Federal Party of the Philippines (PFP).

text: Tungod bulag nga ginaboto sa Filipinas ang Presidente kag Bise Presidente, indi man katingalahan nga mag-tandem sa isa lang ka tiket si BBM kag Sara bisan indi pareho ang ila partido.
english: Since the President and Vice President are elected separately in the Philippines, it is not surprising that BBM and Sara will tandem on the same ticket even though they are not from the same party.

text: Tungod sini nahisugtan nanday BBM kag Sara nga mag-upod sa isa ka tiket.
english: Because of this, BBM and Sara agreed to share a ticket.

text: Wala lang kita, ugaling, kahibalo kon sugot si FVR sa kay BBM bilang kandidato sa pagka-Presidente sang Lakas CMD kay wala man siya nagatugda parti sini.
english: However, we do not know whether FVR agrees with BBM as a candidate for President of Lakas CMD because he does not suggest it.

text: Pero, kon  sugot gid man si FVR kay BBM, basi balos lang ini sa kay President Duterte nga todo atake gid kay FVR sa diutay lang sini nga pagtugda batok sa iya administrasyon, bisan pa si FVR gid ang nag-endorso sa iya sa eleksyon sadtong 2016.
english: However, if FVR really agrees with BBM, maybe it's just a retaliation against President Duterte who attacked FVR for his little suggestion against his administration, even though FVR endorsed him in the 2016 election.

text: Remember man nga wala gid luyag si Duterte sa kay BBM nga mangin Presidente.
english: Remember that Duterte did not want BBM to be President.

text: Problema man ugaling ini ni FVR, nga mangin problem man ini ni BBM,  kay indi maga-upod sa iya ang 23 niya anay myembro sang gabinete.
english: However, this is also a problem for FVR, which will also be a problem for BBM, because his 23 former cabinet members will not join him.

text: In fact, nagpahayag gid sa publiko ini sila sa isa ka Statement of Support para kay VP Leni Robredo sa pagka-Presidente.
english: In fact, they made it public in a Statement of Support for VP Leni Robredo for President.

text: Isa pa ka problema ni BBM amo nga luyag na gid lang ni Sara nga pabay-an ang iya mga supporter nga magboto sa lain nga kandidato nga indi si BBM.
english: Another problem with BBM is that Sara just wants to let her supporters vote for a different candidate other than BBM.

text: “I respect it…,” siling gani niya sa isa ka forum.
english: “I respect it…,” he even said in one forum.

text: Ang malain pa kay may mga personal pa nga isyu sa “honesty” si BBM – nga kuno graduate sa Economics sa Harvard, nga indi man gali, kag may claim man siya nga author sang isa ka importante nga kasuguan nga indi man matuod.
english: Unfortunately, BBM still has personal issues with “honesty” – he is supposed to be a graduate of Economics from Harvard, which he is not, and he also claims to be the author of an important law that is not true.

text: Ang “About” page ni BBM sa iya campaign website, kag pati sa iya “senate biography page”, nagasiling nga siya ang author sang Republic Act (R.A.) 9522, ang Philippine Archipelagic Baseline Law.
english: BBM’s “About” page on his campaign website, as well as his “senate biography page”, says he is the author of Republic Act (R.A.) 9522, the Philippine Archipelagic Baseline Law.

text: Apang ang mga record sang Senado kag House of Representatives ngasiling nga indi siya ang author sini.
english: But Senate and House of Representatives records say he was not the author.

text: Ang matuod nga author sini amo ang nagtaliwan na nga si Rep.
english: Its real author was the late Rep.

text: Antonio Cuenco – isa sang mga kaupod ni Marcos sa 14th Congress, nga ang version amo ang gin-aktuhan gid sang bicameral committee sa panahon ni Presidente Arroyo.
english: Antonio Cuenco – one of Marcos’ colleagues in the 14th Congress, whose version was actually acted upon by the bicameral committee during President Arroyo’s time.

text: Kon may amot man si BBM sa ining kasuguan, ina bilang kabulig lang sa pagdihon sang report sang bicameral committee, although ginsiling man niya nga suportado niya ang ining kasuguan.
english: If BBM has any contribution to this bill, it is only as an assistant in drafting the report of the bicameral committee, although he also said that he supports this bill.

text: Ining false claim ni BBM naggwa gani sadtong Setyembre 2016 pa sa Facebook page nga ginhingadlan “Filipino Fighting For Freedom of Information 4FoI” nga nagasiling nga si BBM ang author sang RA 9522 upod pa si nagtaliwan nga Senadora Miriam Defensor Santiago.
english: This false claim of BBM even appeared in September 2016 on a Facebook page called “Filipino Fighting For Freedom of Information 4FoI” which says that BBM is the author of RA 9522 along with the late Senator Miriam Defensor Santiago.

text: Ini nga artikulo na-edit, kon gin-koreheran, na.
english: This article has been edited, if corrected, already.

text: Nagasiling na ini nga ““As legislator, one of the most important pieces of legislation that BBM was a part of…” amo ang RA 9522, ukon ang Archipelagic Baseline Law, nga nagaathag kon ano ang dangat sang “Philippine territorial sea.”/PN
english: It already states that ““As a legislator, one of the most important pieces of legislation that BBM was a part of…” is RA 9522, or the Archipelagic Baseline Law, which clarifies the fate of the “Philippine territorial sea.”/PN

text: ILOILO CITY- Mapati ka kag sa indi, ang temper tantrums ukon pagmaoy sang bata ang importante nga bahin sang ila emotional health kag well-being.
english: ILOILO CITY- Believe it or not, children's temper tantrums are an important part of their emotional health and well-being.

text: Isa man ini sa pinaka-challenging nga aspeto sang imo pagka-ginikanan,apang isa ini ka butang nga maayo para sa imo kag sa imo bata.
english: It is also one of the most challenging aspects of your parenting,but it is something that is good for you and your child.

text: Suno kay Kate Orson, isa ka iloy,parent educator sa Basel, Switzerland, kag author sang Tears Heal: How to Listen to Our Children, ang luha naga- contain sang cortisol nga amo ang stress hormone gani ang paghibi nagapagwa sang stress gikan sa lawas kag kun maobserbahan, ang mga bata nga natapos na sa pagmaoy ang nagakalma man lang.
english: According to Kate Orson, a mother, parent educator in Basel, Switzerland, and author of Tears Heal: How to Listen to Our Children, tears contain cortisol which is the stress hormone so crying releases stress from the body and if observed, children who have finished crying calm down.

text: Suno naman kay Deborah MacNamara, Ph.D., isa ka parent educator, ang tantrums nagabulig sa bata sa pag-angkon sang maayo nga tulog bangud nga napautwas niya ang iya nabatyagan kag indi niya ini madala sa pagtulog.
english: According to Deborah MacNamara, Ph.D., a parent educator, tantrums help a child get a good night's sleep because he can express his feelings and can't take them to sleep.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Michelle Pate, parenting instructor kag program manager sang Hand in Hand Parenting sa Oregon, mas madamo nga oras ang mahatag naton sa pagpamati sa ila tantrums samtang yara sa balay, mas gamay nga natago nga emosyon ang ila madala sa tion nga maggwa sa balay kag malikawan nga magmaoy sila sa publiko.
english: Michelle Pate, parenting instructor and program manager of Hand in Hand Parenting in Oregon, said the more time we can spend listening to their tantrums while at home, the less hidden emotions they will carry when they leave the house and the less they will be angry in public.

text: Nagkampeon ang pambato ng bansa sa E-Sport World Cup na ginanap sa Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.
english: The country's football team won the E-Sport World Cup in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

text: Tinalo ng Team Liquid Philippines ang Selangor Red Giants ng Malaysia sa score na 4-1 sa exclusive Mobile legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) Mid Season Cup.
english: Team Liquid Philippines defeated Selangor Red Giants of Malaysia 4-1 in the exclusive Mobile legends: Bang Bang (MLBB) Mid Season Cup.

text: Pinangunahan ni Sanford Marin “Sanford” Vinuya ang Pilipinas para mahigitan ang back-to-back na hanggang semifinals lamang ng bansa mula 2023 hanggang 2024.
english: Sanford Marin “Sanford” Vinuya led the Philippines to overcome the country's back-to-back semifinals from 2023 to 2024.

text: Kasama nito si Karl Gabriel “KarlTzy” Nepomuceno, Alston “Sanji” Pabico, Jaypee “Jaypee” Gonzales dela Cruz at Kiel Calvin “OHEB” Soriano.
english: This includes Karl Gabriel “KarlTzy” Nepomuceno, Alston “Sanji” Pabico, Jaypee “Jaypee” Gonzales dela Cruz and Kiel Calvin “OHEB” Soriano.

text: Dahil dito ay lalaban sila para makamit ang ikalawang Southeast Asiang Games gold medal na gaganapin sa Bangkok sa buwan ng Disyembre.
english: Because of this, they will fight to win the second Southeast Asian Games gold medal to be held in Bangkok in December.

text: Ito ang unang MSC na award ng Team Liquid at pang-apat na kabuuang ng bansa matapos na magwagi noogn 2018 ang Aether Main; noong 2021 ay Execration at noong 2022 ay nagkampeon ang RSG Philippines.
english: This is Team Liquid's first MSC award and fourth national award after Aether Main won in 2018; in 2021 was Execration and in 2022 RSG Philippines was champion.

text: Mas na-excite pa ang fans matapos nanotisyaran nga naka-Instagram follow sa isa kag isa sanday Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray kag Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto.
english: Fans were even more excited after noticing that Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray and Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto followed each other on Instagram.

text: Wala man sang statement sanday Mayor Vico kag Catriona kun may yara sila sang possible project ukon engagement.
english: Mayor Vico and Catriona also did not state if they have a possible project or engagement.

text: Apang bisan wala sang klaro kun ano ang ila koneksyon, todo ang excitement sang netizens sa potential pair.
english: But even though it is not clear what their connection is, netizens are very excited about the potential pair.

text: Matandaan nga karelasyon anay ni Cat ang actor-singer nga si Sam Milby kag natalana pa kuntani nga kaslon sang 2024, apang sini lang nga 2025 sang opisyal nga ginkumpirma ni Sam nga sila ang nagbulaganay.
english: Cat was previously dating actor-singer Sam Milby and was scheduled to get married in 2024, but it was only in 2025 that Sam officially confirmed that they had separated.

text: Wala man sang third party nga involved sa ila breakup suno sa actor.
english: There was no third party involved in their breakup, according to the actor.

text: Sa bahin naman sang personal life ni Mayor Vico, wala ini sang nasugid sa publiko apang gin-athag sini sang makapila ka beses nga indi sini prayoridad ang pag-angkon sang relasyon.
english: As for Mayor Vico's personal life, he did not tell the public but he explained several times that he does not prioritize having a relationship.

text: Mangin ang iloy sini nga si Coney Reyes nga isa ka beterana nga aktres ang nagpahayag man anay nga wala ini nagapahilabot sa personal affairs sang iya anak.
english: Even his mother, Coney Reyes, a veteran actress, said she does not interfere in her son's personal affairs.

text: Si Mayor Vico amo ang bata ni Coney sa veteran actor-comedian nga si Vic Sotto.
english: Mayor Vico is Coney’s son to veteran actor-comedian Vic Sotto.

text: Magapakig-angot si Vice President Sara Duterte sa Department of Justice (DOJ) agud isaad ang iya panindugan nga indi dapat magkooperar ang Pilipinas sa International Criminal Court (ICC) sa imbestigasyon sini sa kontrobersyal nga war on drugs sa idalom sang administrasyon sang amay sang bise-presidente nga si former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte will meet with the Department of Justice (DOJ) to express her position that the Philippines should not cooperate with the International Criminal Court (ICC) in its investigation into the controversial war on drugs under the administration of the vice president's father, former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Suno kay VP Duterte, iplastar niya ang legal nga mga basehan sang iya nga panindugan.
english: VP Duterte said he will lay out the legal basis for his position.

text: Sang nagligad nga adlaw, matandaan nga nagpahayag si President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Last day, President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga ginatun-an sang gobyerno ang posible pagbalik sang Pilipinas bilang myembro sang ICC.
english: that the government is studying the possible return of the Philippines as a member of the ICC.

text: Pahayag naman ni Sara Duterte, ginatahod niya ang pahayag ni Marcos bangud ang presidente amo ang architect sang foreign policy sa pungsod.
english: Sara Duterte said she respects Marcos' statement because the president is the architect of foreign policy in the country.

text: “We all should respect the position of the President, being the chief architect of foreign policy.
english: “We all should respect the position of the President, being the chief architect of foreign policy.

text:
His position should be the position of all.”

Dugang sini, “But we will continue to reach out to DOJ regarding our position on this matter… and we will lay down the legal basis of our position.”

(Karl Norman Alonzo/Presidential Communications Operations Office)

Matandaan nga nagkalas si anay Presidente Duterte sa international tribunal sang 2018 kag nangin epektibo ang nasambit nga withdrawal sang 2019.
english:
His position should be the position of all.”

It added, “But we will continue to reach out to DOJ regarding our position on this matter… and we will lay down the legal basis of our position.”

(Karl Norman Alonzo/Presidential Communications Operations Office)

Former President Duterte withdrew from the international tribunal in 2018 and the withdrawal became effective in 2019.

text: Kun basehan ang rekord sang gobyerno, ginapahayag nga 6,200 ka drug suspects ang napatay sa operasyon sang mga pulis sa “war on drugs” halin sang Hunyo 2016 tubtub sang Nobyembre 2021.
english: According to government records, 6,200 drug suspects were killed in police operations in the war on drugs from June 2016 to November 2021.

text: Kun lantawon naman ang mga pahayag sang human rights groups, nagatupa sa 12,000 tubtub 30,000 ka mga tawo ang napatay sa amo nga tion.#
english: According to human rights groups, between 12,000 and 30,000 people were killed during that period.

text: Wala pa nakasumiter sang sabat si Vice President Sara Duterte sa summons nga gin-issue sang Senate Impeachment Court.
english: Vice President Sara Duterte has yet to submit a response to the summons issued by the Senate Impeachment Court.

text: May tsansa pa ang kampo ni Duterte nga magsumiter sang ila sabat tubtob alas 11:59 sang gab-i sa Lunes, Hunyo 23.
english: Duterte's camp still has a chance to submit its response until 11:59 pm on Monday, June 23.

text: Natapos na ang napulo ka adlaw nga ginhatag sang impeachment court agud magsabat si Duterte kahapon, Hunyo 21, apang bangud ini ang nagtupa sa Sabado, ginahatagan sila sang dugang nga oras tubtob Lunes.
english: The 10 days given by the impeachment court for Duterte to respond yesterday, June 21, expired, but since it fell on Saturday, they are given more time until Monday.

text: Ginkumpirma ni Atty. Reginald Tongol, spokesperson sang impeachment court nga wala pa sang may ginpadala nga sabat si Vice President Duterte.
english: It was confirmed by Atty. Reginald Tongol, spokesperson of the impeachment court, said Vice President Duterte has not yet sent a response.

text: Suno sa iya, may sabat man ukon wala, magapadayon sagihapon ang proseso.
english: He said that whether there is an answer or not, the process will continue.

text: Gin-athag man sini nga si Vice President Duterte ang possible nga mag-atubang sa trial pagkatapos sang 19th congress.
english: He also explained that Vice President Duterte is likely to face trial after the 19th congress.

text: Nagsabat si Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas kasunod sang ginapahayag nga wala ini naghatag sang “peace” kanday former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog kag Congresswoman Julienne Baronda kadungan sang pag-exchange sang “sign of peace” sa Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas responded following allegations that he did not give “peace” to former Mayor Jed Patrick Mabilog and Congresswoman Julienne Baronda during the exchange of “sign of peace” at the Jaro Metropolitan Cathedral.

text: Nagapungko sa isa lang ka pulungkuan sanday Treñas, Mabilog kag Baronda sa front row.
english: Treñas, Mabilog and Baronda were sitting in the same seat in the front row.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagtambong ang mga ini sa seremonya sa pormal nga pagpungko subong nga adlaw bilang bag-o nga arsobispo sang Archdiocese of Jaro si Most Rev.
english: They attended the formal inauguration ceremony today as the new archbishop of the Archdiocese of Jaro, Most Rev. Fr.

text: Midyphil Bermejo Billones, D.D. bulos kay Most Rev.
english: Midyphil Bermejo Billones, D.D. replacing Most Rev.

text: Jose Romeo O. Lazo, D.D., Archbishop-emeritus of Jaro.
english: Jose Romeo O. Lazo, D.D., Archbishop-emeritus of Jaro.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mayor Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga wala lang nagtabuay ang ila panulok nanday Mabilog kag Baronda.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Mayor Treñas said that Mabilog and Baronda did not meet.

text: Suno sa alkalde, naghatag man ini sang sign of peace kay Vice Mayoralty candidate Love-love Baronda nga yara man nagatindog sa likod nila.
english: The mayor said he also gave a sign of peace to Vice Mayoralty candidate Love-love Baronda who was also standing behind them.

text: Pahayag sang alkalde, kun nahatagan lang sang kahigayunan nga nagtabuay ang ila panulok, luyag gid sini nga maghatag sang paghidaet sa anay alkalde kag sa kongresista.
english: The mayor said that if given the opportunity to meet, he would like to give peace to the former mayor and the congressman.

text: Sa baylo nga sa St.
english: Instead of St.

text: Peter’s Square magpanguna sa Angelus prayer kaangay sa kinaandan sang mga tumuluo, nagtinir si Pope Francis sa iya ginapuy-an sa Casa Santa Marta kag nagpangayo sang bulig sa isa ka Vatican official agud basahon ang iya nga mensahe.
english: Peter's Square to lead the Angelus prayer as usual for the faithful, Pope Francis stayed at his residence in Casa Santa Marta and asked for help from a Vatican official to read his message.

text: Suno sa Santo Papa, naga-suprer siya sa lung inflammation kag sa hingapusan sang iya mensahe, naghingyo man ini sa mga tawo nga indi magkalipat nga magpangamuyo man para sa iya.
english: According to the Pope, he is suffering from lung inflammation and at the end of his message, he also asked people not to forget to pray for him.

text: Nakit-an ang 86-anyos nga Pope nga nagapungko lamang sa chapel, naga-ubo kun kaisa, kag may bandage pa sa iya nga kamot.
english: The 86-year-old Pope was found sitting alone in the chapel, coughing occasionally, and with a bandage on his hand.

text: Bangud sini, gin-broadcast na lamang sang live ang pangamuyo sa screens sa St Peter’s Square kag gin-stream man sa Vatican News website.
english: The prayer was broadcast live on screens in St Peter's Square and streamed on the Vatican News website.

text: Matandaan nga sang nagligad lamang nga Sabado, nagpa-opistal si Pope Francis sa Roma para sa CT scan.
english: Last Saturday, Pope Francis went to the hospital in Rome for a CT scan.

text: Sandig sa una nga anunsyo sang Vatican, may gamay nga trangkaso ang Santo Papa apang negatibo ang resulta sa anuman nga risgo sang pulmonary complications.
english: According to the Vatican's initial announcement, the Pope had a mild flu but tested negative for any risk of pulmonary complications.

text: Wala pa sang paathag ang Vatican kun ngaa may kinalain sa anunsyo sini ipaanggid sa ginkumpirma ni Pope Francis nga may yara siya sang lung inflammation.
english: The Vatican has yet to explain why there is a difference in its announcement compared to Pope Francis' confirmation that he has lung inflammation.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginkuha ang isa sa lungs sang Santo Papa sang bataon pa lamang ini kag nagatinir pa lamang sa Argentina.
english: It is known that one of the Pope's lungs was removed when he was young and still living in Argentina.

text: Bangud sa kondisyon ni Pope, si Father Paolo Braida ang nagbasa sang iya mensahe lakip na ang apelar sa kalinong sa Ukraine, pagpasalamat sa ceasefire sa Gaza, kag kumpirmasyon sa intensyon sang Santo Papa nga magbyahe sa Dubai sa Disyembre 1 agud magtambong sa UN climate change conference.
english: Due to the Pope's condition, Father Paolo Braida read his message including an appeal for peace in Ukraine, thanks for the ceasefire in Gaza, and confirmation of the Pope's intention to travel to Dubai on December 1 to attend the UN climate change conference.

text: Sa iya traditional closing remarks, pahayag sini: “I wish everyone a good Sunday.
english: In his traditional closing remarks, he said: “I wish everyone a good Sunday.

text: Please do not forget to pray for me.
english: Please do not forget to pray for me.

text:
Have a good lunch and see you next time.”

Nahibaluan nga antes sini nga kondisyon sang Santo Papa, siyam man ini ka adlaw sa ospital sang Hunyo bangud sa iya nga abdominal hernia, apang naka-recover naman sa amo nga operasyon.#
english:
Have a good lunch and see you next time.”

Before the Pope's condition, he was hospitalized for nine days in June due to an abdominal hernia, but recovered from the operation.

text: Gin-abi abi ni Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla ang 17 Philippine government officials nga nakabalik nga safe sa Pilipinas nagikan sa study tour sa Israel.
english: DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla welcomed 17 Philippine government officials who returned safely to the Philippines from a study tour in Israel.

text: “We are just happy that they are safely home.
english: “We are just happy that they are safely home.

text: Marami silang pinagdaanan.
english: They went through a lot.

text: Talagang 24/7 nakamonitor tayo hanggang sa sila ay makauwi nang ligtas,” suno kay Remulla.
english: We are really monitoring 24/7 until they return home safely,” Remulla said.

text: Ang mga delegates ang nagtinir sa Israel umpisa Hunyo 9 tubtob 20, 2025 para sa study tour nga naga-focus sa sustainability kag food security sang natabo ang tensyon sa tunga sang Israel kag Iran.
english: The delegates were in Israel from June 9 to 20, 2025 for a study tour focusing on sustainability and food security when tensions between Israel and Iran occurred.

text: Pahayag ni DILG Region 6 Regional Director Juan Jovian E. Ingeniero nga isa sa mga opisyal nga upod sa Israel, samtang sakay sila sa bus ginkakibot nila nga may bomba sila nga nabati-an.
english: DILG Region 6 Regional Director Juan Jovian E. Ingeniero, one of the officials who accompanied Israel, said that while they were on the bus, they were surprised to hear a bomb.

text: 10 kilometros lang ang kalayuon sang explosion nagikan sa ila nga ginatiniran.
english: The explosion was only 10 kilometers away from their residence.

text: Kaupod ni Ingeniero amo si DILG Region 1 Regional Director Jonathan Paul M. Leusen, Jr.
english: Ingeniero was accompanied by DILG Region 1 Regional Director Jonathan Paul M. Leusen, Jr.

text: Yara man ang presensya sang pila ka mga alkalde kag bise alkalde sang nagkalain-lain nga lugar.
english: There was also the presence of several mayors and vice mayors of various areas.

text: Bangud sa conflict sang duha ka mga pungsod, nagtinir anay sila sa temporary shelter antes gindala sa Jordan.
english: Due to the conflict between the two countries, they stayed in a temporary shelter before being taken to Jordan.

text: “Kung kinakailangan na magcharter tayo ng isang PAL o Cebu Pacific flight, gagawin ng ating gobyerno para ligtas silang makauwi sa kani-kanilang mga pamilya,” dugang nga pahayag ni Sec.
english: “If we need to charter a PAL or Cebu Pacific flight, our government will do it so that they can return safely to their families,” Sec.

text: Remulla para sa mga Filipinos nga yara sa duha ka mga pungsod nga luyag magpauli sa Pilipinas.
english: Remulla for Filipinos in both countries who want to return to the Philippines.

text: Gin-abi-abi ni Pope Francis ang apat ka adlaw nga ceasefire sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas militants kag ang paghilway sa pila sa mga bihag.
english: Pope Francis welcomed the four-day ceasefire between Israel and Hamas militants and the release of some of the hostages.

text: “Today we thank God because there is finally a truce between Israel and Palestine and some hostages have been freed,” suno sa mensahe sang Santo Papa nga ginbasa lamang sang isa ka Vatican official kadungan sang weekly Angelus prayer.
english: “Today we thank God because there is finally a truce between Israel and Palestine and some hostages have been freed,” the Pope said in a message read out by a Vatican official during the weekly Angelus prayer.

text:
Dugang pa sang Pope: “We pray that they all may be (freed) as rapidly as possible and that more humanitarian aid arrives in Gaza and that they insist on dialogue.”

Ginsulit man sini nga ang dayalogo lamang ang isahanon nga banas para nga maangkon ang kalinong sa Middle East.
english:
The Pope added: “We pray that they all may be (freed) as rapidly as possible and that more humanitarian aid arrives in Gaza and that they insist on dialogue.”

He also reiterated that dialogue is the only path to achieve peace in the Middle East.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginpaiway ni Pope Francis ang pagkadto sa St.
english: Pope Francis has canceled his visit to St.

text: Peter’s Square para sa pagpangamuyo bangud suno sa iya, nagasuprer siya sa lung inflammation.
english: Peter’s Square for prayer because he said he was suffering from lung inflammation.

text: Nagtinir lamang ini sa Casa Santa Marta samtang si Father Paolo Braida naman ang nagbasa sang iya mensahe lakip na ang apelar sa kalinong sa Ukraine, pagpasalamat sa ceasefire sa Gaza, kag kumpirmasyon sa intensyon sini nga magbyahe sa Dubai sa Disyembre 1 agud magtambong sa United Nations (UN) climate change conference.
english: He stayed at Casa Santa Marta while Father Paolo Braida read his message including an appeal for peace in Ukraine, thanks for the ceasefire in Gaza, and confirmation of his intention to travel to Dubai on December 1 to attend the United Nations (UN) climate change conference.

text: Nag-abot na sa Manila sang Sabado sang aga ang 21 ka mga opisyal sang gobyerno sang Pilipinas nga na-stranded sa Israel bangud sang nagapadayon nga tensyon sa tunga sang Israel kag Iran.
english: Twenty-one Philippine government officials stranded in Israel due to ongoing tensions between Israel and Iran arrived in Manila on Saturday morning.

text: Ang mga opisyal — 17 ka mga lokal nga opisyal sang gobyerno nga nagtambong sa agricultural technology training kag apat ka mga eksperto sa industriya sang gatas halin sa Department of Agriculture (DA) — kon sa diin ginsugat sa Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 3 ni Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonvic Remulla.
english: The officials — 17 local government officials who attended the agricultural technology training and four experts in the dairy industry from the Department of Agriculture (DA) — where met at Ninoy Aquino International Airport Terminal 3 by Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Jonmulla.

text: Sa 17 ka mga opisyal, duha ang mga kongresista, siyam ang mga alkalde (mayors), apat ka mga bise-alkalde (vice mayors), kag duha ang regional directors.
english: Of the 17 officials, two are congressmen, nine are mayors, four are vice mayors, and two are regional directors.

text: Nagsugod ang ila training sang Hunyo 10 kag ginplano nga matapos ini sa Hunyo 20.
english: Their training began on June 10 and was scheduled to end on June 20.

text: Ginpahayag ni Remulla nga safe kag maayo ang kahimtangan sang tanan nga 21 ka opisyal.
english: Remulla said all 21 officers are safe and in good condition.

text: Nagpasalamat man si Remulla sa gobyerno sang Israel, sa mga opisyal sang Philippine Embassy sa Israel kag Jordan, kag sa iban pa nga ahensya sang gobyerno sa ila dasig nga koordinasyon agud mapapauli ang mga na-stranded nga Pilipino.
english: Remulla also thanked the Israeli government, officials of the Philippine Embassy in Israel and Jordan, and other government agencies for their prompt coordination to repatriate the stranded Filipinos.

text: Suno kay Remulla, halin sa kibbutz nga ila gin-estaran sa Israel, nagsakay ang mga opisyal sa bus padulong sa Amman, Jordan.
english: According to Remulla, from the kibbutz where they lived in Israel, the officers took a bus to Amman, Jordan.

text: Halin didto, nagsakay sila sang eroplano padulong sa Dubai, kag halin sa Dubai, nagpauli sila sa Manila paagi sa commercial flight.
english: From there, they flew to Dubai, and from Dubai, they returned to Manila on a commercial flight.

text: Gin-atake sang wala pa nakilal-an nga grupo ang isa naman ka panibag-o nga barko nga ginapahayag naangot man gihapon sa isa ka Israeli billionaire.
english: An unidentified group attacked another new ship that is also allegedly linked to an Israeli billionaire.

text: Sandig man sa nauna nga impormasyon sang kumpaniya, may nalakip nga Filipino sa crew sang barko apang indi matumod kun isahanon lamang ini ukon madamo sila nga Pinoy.
english: According to the company's previous information, there was a Filipino on the crew of the ship but it was not clear whether it was just one or many Filipinos.

text: Ginhingadlan ang Liberian-flagged chemical tanker nga Central Park, may karga nga phosphoric acid, kag gina-manage sang Zodiac Maritime, isa ka international ship management company nga naka-base sa London kag kabahin sang Zodiac Group sang Israeli billionaire nga si Eyal Ofer.
english: The Liberian-flagged chemical tanker was named Central Park, loaded with phosphoric acid, and managed by Zodiac Maritime, an international ship management company based in London and part of the Zodiac Group of Israeli billionaire Eyal Ofer.

text:
(Zodiac Maritime via AP)

Natabo ang insidente sa Gulf of Aden nga napalibutan sang Yemen sa north, Arabian Sea sa east, Djibouti sa west, kag ang Guardafui Channel, Socotra kag Somalia sa south.
english:
(Zodiac Maritime via AP)

The incident took place in the Gulf of Aden bordered by Yemen to the north, Arabian Sea to the east, Djibouti to the west, and the Guardafui Channel, Socotra and Somalia to the south.

text: Sa ginpaguwa naman nga statement sang Zodiac Maritime, ginpahayag nga naulamid ang barko nga Central Park sa ginasuspetsahan nga “piracy incident” samtang nagatabok sa dagat nga 54 nautical miles ang kalayuon sa coast sang Somalia.
english: In a statement, Zodiac Maritime said the ship Central Park was involved in a suspected piracy incident while crossing the sea 54 nautical miles off the coast of Somalia.

text: Pahayag pa sa amo nga statement, 22 ang crew nga sakay sa amo nga barko lakip ang Russian, Vietnamese, Bulgarian, Indian, Georgian kag Filipino nationals samtang Turkish naman ang kapitan.
english: According to the statement, there were 22 crew members on board the ship including Russian, Vietnamese, Bulgarian, Indian, Georgian and Filipino nationals while the captain was Turkish.

text: Wala pa sang nag-ako kun sin-o ukon ano nga grupo ang may kahimuan sa bag-o nga insidente sa dagat nga sakop sang Middle East.
english: No one has claimed responsibility for the new incident at sea in the Middle East.

text: Ini ang katapusan sa serye sa mga pagpang-atake sa mga barko sa dagat sa amo nga rehiyon halin sang nagluntad ang Israel-Hamas war.
english: It is the latest in a series of attacks on naval vessels in the region since the outbreak of the Israel-Hamas war.

text: Sang nagligad nga semana, may yara man sang cargo ship nga naglabay lamang sa Red Sea apang gin-hijack sang Houthi, grupo sang mga rebelde nga naka-base sa Yemen kag suportado sang Iran.
english: Last week, there was also a cargo ship that just passed through the Red Sea but was hijacked by the Houthi, Yemen-based and Iranian-backed rebel group.

text: Ginpahayag gindala ang amo nga barko sa port sa Yemen.
english: The ship was reportedly taken to a port in Yemen.

text: May 17 ka Filipinos sa amo nga cargo ship kag wala gihapon nahilway tubtub subong.
english: There were 17 Filipinos on board the cargo ship and they have not been released yet.
